```js
// Session manager (SP3): the one place that owns a session's life.
//
// It starts an agent's own terminal program in a PTY (pty-host.js) with the
// profile from profiles.js, feeds every byte of output to the screen mirror
// (mirror.js) and the recording (recorder.js), hands that output to every
// window attached to the session with flow control, works out the activity
// state, and keeps <AGENT_OS_HOME>/sessions/<id>/meta.json (0600, in a 0700
// folder).
//
// Hard rules (spec "SP3 Sessions engine and page", Security 6):
// - The only bytes this file writes into a PTY are the writer's input
//   (write()) and the mirror's replies to terminal queries, which the mirror
//   sends only while no window is the writer (startProcess()).
// - An agent session starts or resumes only when Safety allows running agents
//   (decision Q15). The update kind is not gated.
// - At most `maxLive` live agent sessions. Update sessions are not counted,
//   and at most one update session runs at a time.
import { promises as fs } from "node:fs";
import crypto from "node:crypto";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { getAdapter } from "../agents/index.js";
import { BUILDER_AGENT_IDS } from "../builders/brains.js";
import { resolveBrainForRun } from "../builders/resolve.js";
import { isExecutionEnabled } from "../execution-gate.js";
import { RUNTIME_VERSION, ensurePrivateDir, readJson, runtimePaths, writeJson } from "../store.js";
import { isSessionId, sessionError } from "./errors.js";
import { checkSessionFolder } from "./folders.js";
import { createMirror, isUserInput } from "./mirror.js";
import { OPENCLAW_FOLDER_HONOURED, SESSION_AGENTS, SESSION_AGENT_LABEL, buildSessionProfile } from "./profiles.js";
import { ptyAvailable, spawnPty } from "./pty-host.js";
import { createRecorder, enforceRecordingCap } from "./recorder.js";
import { readSessionSettings } from "./settings.js";

// Each shared name has one home: errors.js (the id pattern and the error
// shape) and profiles.js (the agents' short names). Re-exported here so
// routes.js, ws.js and the tests may import them from the manager.
export { SESSION_ID_RE, isSessionId, sessionError } from "./errors.js";
export { SESSION_AGENT_LABEL } from "./profiles.js";

// The basic activity rule, used for every session in SP3.
export const IDLE_AFTER_MS = 20 * 1000;
// Flow control (spec "WebSocket protocol", Back-pressure).
export const PAUSE_LAG_BYTES = 512 * 1024;
export const CLOSE_LAG_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
// A PTY paused this long closes the windows that still lag (updateFlow()).
export const PAUSED_DROP_MS = 10 * 1000;
// One `in` frame carries at most 64 KB.
export const MAX_INPUT_BYTES = 64 * 1024;

const START_COLS = 120;
const START_ROWS = 32;
// After a resize the agent redraws for the new size, and the mirror may count
// that reflow; for this long it is not activity (Task S4 Notes item 4).
const RESIZE_QUIET_MS = 1000;
const META_FILE = "meta.json";
const META_VERSION = 1;
const RECORDING_FILES = ["screen.cast", "screen.prev.cast"];
const BRAIN_LABEL = { plan: "Plan", openrouter: "OpenRouter", local: "Local" };
const LOOK_ONLY_MESSAGE = "Safety is on Look only, so no session can start. Allow running agents in Safety, then try again.";
const PTY_MESSAGE = "Agent OS could not load its terminal module on this computer, so sessions can't start.";
const UNKNOWN_MESSAGE = "That session doesn't exist anymore.";
const SIGNAL_NAMES = signalNameTable();

// ---- small helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function unknownSession() {
  return sessionError(404, "unknown_session", UNKNOWN_MESSAGE);
}

function assertSessionId(id) {
  if (!isSessionId(id)) throw unknownSession();
}

// The first name for each signal number (SIGABRT before SIGIOT).
function signalNameTable() {
  const table = {};
  for (const [name, number] of Object.entries(os.constants.signals)) {
    if (!(number in table)) table[number] = name;
  }
  return table;
}

function signalName(signal) {
  if (typeof signal === "string" && signal) return signal;
  if (typeof signal === "number" && signal > 0) return SIGNAL_NAMES[signal] || `SIG${signal}`;
  return null;
}

function iso(ms) {
  return new Date(ms).toISOString();
}

function sessionsRoot() {
  return runtimePaths().sessions;
}

function sessionDir(id) {
  return path.join(sessionsRoot(), id);
}

async function readMeta(id) {
  const meta = await readJson(path.join(sessionDir(id), META_FILE), null);
  return meta && typeof meta === "object" && meta.id === id ? meta : null;
}

async function listSessionIds() {
  try {
    return (await fs.readdir(sessionsRoot())).filter((name) => isSessionId(name));
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

async function recordingBytes(id) {
  let total = 0;
  for (const name of RECORDING_FILES) {
    try {
      total += (await fs.stat(path.join(sessionDir(id), name))).size;
    } catch {
      // no such segment yet
    }
  }
  return total;
}

// The branch the folder is on, read from git's own files (no git process):
// walk up to the nearest .git, follow a worktree's "gitdir:" file, and read
// HEAD. A detached HEAD or no checkout at all gives null.
export async function readGitBranch(folder) {
  let dir = path.resolve(String(folder || "/"));
  for (let depth = 0; depth < 64; depth += 1) {
    const dotGit = path.join(dir, ".git");
    let info = null;
    try {
      info = await fs.stat(dotGit);
    } catch {
      info = null;
    }
    if (info) {
      let gitDir = dotGit;
      if (info.isFile()) {
        const pointer = await fs.readFile(dotGit, "utf8").catch(() => "");
        const match = /^gitdir:\s*(.+?)\s*$/m.exec(pointer);
        if (!match) return null;
        gitDir = path.resolve(dir, match[1]);
      }
      const head = await fs.readFile(path.join(gitDir, "HEAD"), "utf8").catch(() => "");
      const ref = /^ref:\s*refs\/heads\/(.+?)\s*$/.exec(head.trim());
      return ref ? ref[1].slice(0, 200) : null;
    }
    const parent = path.dirname(dir);
    if (parent === dir) return null;
    dir = parent;
  }
  return null;
}

// The Brain row of the side panel. Hermes and OpenClaw keep their model in
// their own config, so Agent OS shows no brain for them.
function brainSummary(agentId, resolved) {
  if (!BUILDER_AGENT_IDS.includes(agentId)) return null;
  const kind = resolved && Object.hasOwn(BRAIN_LABEL, resolved.mode) ? resolved.mode : "plan";
  return { kind, label: BRAIN_LABEL[kind] };
}

function titleOf(meta) {
  if (meta.kind === "update") return `${meta.agentLabel} update`;
  return `${meta.agentLabel} · ${meta.folderShown === false ? "Set by OpenClaw" : meta.folderName}`;
}

function byCreated(a, b) {
  return String(a.createdAt || a.startedAt || "").localeCompare(String(b.createdAt || b.startedAt || ""));
}

function safeSend(attachment, frame) {
  try {
    attachment.send(frame);
  } catch {
    // a closing window must never break the session
  }
}

function defaultDetect(agentId) {
  const adapter = getAdapter(agentId);
  return adapter ? adapter.detect() : Promise.resolve({ installed: false, path: "" });
}

function defaultResolveBrain(agentId) {
  return resolveBrainForRun(agentId, undefined, { prepare: true });
}

// ---- the manager --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function createSessionManager({
  now = Date.now,
  spawn = spawnPty,
  buildProfile = buildSessionProfile,
  recorderFactory = createRecorder,
  mirrorFactory = createMirror,
  maxLive = 8,
  isExecutionAllowed = isExecutionEnabled,
  checkFolder = checkSessionFolder,
  ptyCheck = ptyAvailable,
  detect = defaultDetect,
  resolveBrain = defaultResolveBrain,
  readSettings = readSessionSettings,
  enforceCap = enforceRecordingCap
} = {}) {
  // id -> state, while the session's process runs. Disk is the truth for
  // every ended session.
  const live = new Map();
  // ids being resumed or dismissed right now, so two requests never race.
  const busy = new Set();
  // Slots held by starts that have not finished yet.
  let reservedAgents = 0;
  let reservedUpdate = false;

  function liveCount(kind) {
    let count = 0;
    for (const state of live.values()) {
      if (state.meta.kind === kind && state.status !== "exited") count += 1;
    }
    return count;
  }

  function reserve(kind) {
    if (kind === "update") {
      if (reservedUpdate || liveCount("update") > 0) {
        throw sessionError(409, "update_running", "An update is already running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.");
      }
      reservedUpdate = true;
      return;
    }
    if (liveCount("agent") + reservedAgents >= maxLive) {
      throw sessionError(409, "too_many_sessions", `Agent OS runs at most ${maxLive} sessions at once. Stop one, then try again.`);
    }
    reservedAgents += 1;
  }

  // Returns a function that gives the slot back once. It runs as soon as the
  // session is in `live` (where liveCount sees it), or when the start fails,
  // so a session is never counted twice.
  function reserveSlot(kind) {
    reserve(kind);
    let held = true;
    return () => {
      if (!held) return;
      held = false;
      if (kind === "update") reservedUpdate = false;
      else reservedAgents -= 1;
    };
  }

  async function requirePty() {
    const status = await ptyCheck();
    if (!status?.ok) throw sessionError(503, "pty_unavailable", PTY_MESSAGE);
  }

  // The folder a session runs in. OpenClaw picks its own folder until spike
  // S5 shows it honours one, so no folder is asked for or checked for it.
  async function resolveFolder(agentId, kind, folder) {
    if (kind === "agent" && agentId === "openclaw" && !OPENCLAW_FOLDER_HONOURED) return { folder: null, shown: false };
    const checked = await checkFolder(typeof folder === "string" ? folder : "");
    if (!checked?.ok) {
      throw sessionError(400, "folder_refused", checked?.message || "That folder can't be used.", {
        code: checked?.code || "refused"
      });
    }
    return { folder: checked.path, shown: true };
  }

  function newState(dir, meta) {
    let resolveExited;
    const exited = new Promise((resolve) => {
      resolveExited = resolve;
    });
    return {
      dir,
      meta,
      profile: null,
      status: "starting",
      stateSince: meta.startedAt,
      handle: null,
      mirror: null,
      recorder: null,
      attachments: new Map(),
      writerId: null,
      paused: false,
      pauseTimer: null,
      idleTimer: null,
      ignoreCountedUntil: 0,
      offs: [],
      writes: Promise.resolve(),
      cols: START_COLS,
      rows: START_ROWS,
      endedBy: null,
      exitSeen: false,
      exited,
      resolveExited
    };
  }

  // meta.json writes for one session run one after another, each writing the
  // newest meta, so an older write can never land last.
  function persist(state) {
    const write = () => writeJson(path.join(state.dir, META_FILE), { ...state.meta });
    const next = state.writes.then(write, write);
    state.writes = next.catch(() => {});
    return next;
  }

  function stateFrame(state) {
    const frame = { t: "state", status: state.status };
    if (state.status === "exited") {
      frame.exitCode = state.meta.exitCode;
      frame.signal = state.meta.signal;
      frame.endedBy = state.meta.endedBy;
    }
    return frame;
  }

  function broadcast(state, frame, { queue = false } = {}) {
    for (const attachment of [...state.attachments.values()]) {
      if (attachment.pending) {
        if (queue) attachment.pending.push({ frame });
      } else {
        safeSend(attachment, frame);
      }
    }
  }

  function setStatus(state, status) {
    if (state.status === status) return;
    state.status = status;
    state.stateSince = iso(now());
    broadcast(state, stateFrame(state));
  }

  function armIdle(state) {
    clearTimeout(state.idleTimer);
    state.idleTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      state.idleTimer = null;
      if (state.status === "live") setStatus(state, "idle");
    }, IDLE_AFTER_MS);
    state.idleTimer.unref?.();
  }

  // Counted output or user input: the session is live, and the 20 s start again.
  function markActive(state) {
    if (state.status === "exited") return;
    if (state.status !== "live") setStatus(state, "live");
    armIdle(state);
  }

  // Pause reading the PTY only when every open window lags more than 512 KB;
  // never with no window at all (the mirror and the recording keep reading).
  // While paused, no output reaches a window, so its lag never grows to the
  // 4 MB close. A window that keeps the PTY paused for PAUSED_DROP_MS (a
  // hidden window, a throttled browser tab, a sleeping second screen) is closed
  // instead, so the agent never blocks on its own output. A window that leaves
  // resumes the PTY through this function, which stops the timer; while the
  // other windows still lag, the timer keeps running.
  function updateFlow(state) {
    if (!state.handle || state.status === "exited") return;
    const open = [...state.attachments.values()];
    const shouldPause =
      open.length > 0 && open.every((attachment) => !attachment.pending && attachment.sent - attachment.acked > PAUSE_LAG_BYTES);
    if (shouldPause && !state.paused) {
      state.paused = true;
      state.handle.pause();
      armPausedDrop(state);
    } else if (!shouldPause && state.paused) {
      state.paused = false;
      clearPausedDrop(state);
      state.handle.resume();
    }
  }

  function armPausedDrop(state) {
    clearPausedDrop(state);
    state.pauseTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      state.pauseTimer = null;
      for (const attachment of [...state.attachments.values()]) {
        if (!attachment.pending && attachment.sent - attachment.acked > PAUSE_LAG_BYTES) {
          dropAttachment(state, attachment.id, "too_far_behind");
        }
      }
      updateFlow(state);
    }, PAUSED_DROP_MS);
    state.pauseTimer.unref?.();
  }

  function clearPausedDrop(state) {
    clearTimeout(state.pauseTimer);
    state.pauseTimer = null;
  }

  function removeAttachment(state, attachmentId) {
    const attachment = state.attachments.get(attachmentId);
    if (!attachment) return null;
    state.attachments.delete(attachmentId);
    if (state.writerId === attachmentId) {
      state.writerId = null;
      try {
        state.mirror.setWriterAttached(false);
      } catch {
        // the mirror is gone once the session has ended
      }
    }
    updateFlow(state);
    return attachment;
  }

  function dropAttachment(state, attachmentId, reason) {
    const attachment = removeAttachment(state, attachmentId);
    if (!attachment) return;
    try {
      attachment.close?.(reason);
    } catch {
      // already closing
    }
  }

  function sendOut(state, attachment, chunk, bytes = Buffer.byteLength(chunk, "utf8")) {
    attachment.sent += bytes;
    safeSend(attachment, { t: "out", seq: attachment.sent, d: chunk });
    if (attachment.sent - attachment.acked > CLOSE_LAG_BYTES) dropAttachment(state, attachment.id, "too_far_behind");
  }

  function onOutput(state, data) {
    const chunk = typeof data === "string" ? data : String(data ?? "");
    if (!chunk) return;
    try {
      state.recorder.output(chunk);
    } catch {
      // the recording must never stop the terminal
    }
    try {
      state.mirror.write(chunk);
    } catch {
      // nor must the mirror
    }
    if (state.status === "starting") markActive(state);
    const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(chunk, "utf8");
    for (const attachment of [...state.attachments.values()]) {
      if (attachment.pending) attachment.pending.push({ chunk });
      else sendOut(state, attachment, chunk, bytes);
    }
    updateFlow(state);
  }

  async function onProcessExit(state, event = {}) {
    if (state.exitSeen) return;
    state.exitSeen = true;
    clearTimeout(state.idleTimer);
    state.idleTimer = null;
    clearPausedDrop(state);
    for (const off of state.offs.splice(0)) {
      try {
        off();
      } catch {
        // already unsubscribed
      }
    }
    const signal = signalName(event.signal);
    const endedAt = state.meta.endedAt || iso(now());
    state.meta.status = "exited";
    state.meta.endedAt = endedAt;
    state.meta.exitCode = signal ? null : Number.isInteger(event.exitCode) ? event.exitCode : null;
    state.meta.signal = signal;
    state.meta.endedBy = state.endedBy || null;
    state.meta.lastUsedAt = endedAt;
    state.status = "exited";
    state.stateSince = endedAt;
    const frame = stateFrame(state);
    for (const attachment of [...state.attachments.values()]) {
      if (!attachment.pending) safeSend(attachment, frame);
      dropAttachment(state, attachment.id, "session_ended");
    }
    try {
      state.mirror.dispose();
    } catch {
      // already disposed
    }
    try {
      await state.recorder.close();
    } catch {
      // the recording keeps what it has
    }
    try {
      await persist(state);
    } catch {
      // recovery at the next start covers a failed write
    }
    live.delete(state.meta.id);
    state.resolveExited();
    try {
      // A session stays in `live` until its recording is closed and meta.json
      // is written, so the cap never removes a recording that is still being
      // written. meta.json alone can't tell: during a quit, shutdownAll (Task
      // S7) marks every live session "exited" before its process ends.
      await enforceCap({ isLive: (sessionId) => live.has(sessionId) });
    } catch {
      // the cap runs again at the next start
    }
  }

  // Spawns the profile in a PTY with a fresh mirror and recording.
  async function startProcess(state, profile, { append }) {
    state.profile = profile;
    state.recorder = recorderFactory({ dir: state.dir, cols: state.cols, rows: state.rows, append, now });
    state.mirror = mirrorFactory({
      cols: state.cols,
      rows: state.rows,
      now,
      // Security 6: the mirror answers standard terminal queries only while no
      // window is the writer (mirror.js decides); its reply goes to the agent.
      onQueryReply: (reply) => {
        if (state.handle && state.status !== "exited") state.handle.write(reply);
      },
      onAlert: (raw) => broadcast(state, { t: "alert", raw }, { queue: true })
    });
    state.mirror.setWriterAttached(false);
    try {
      state.handle = await spawn({
        command: profile.command,
        args: profile.args,
        cwd: profile.cwd,
        env: profile.env,
        cols: state.cols,
        rows: state.rows
      });
    } catch (error) {
      try {
        state.mirror.dispose();
      } catch {
        // nothing to dispose
      }
      try {
        await state.recorder.close();
      } catch {
        // nothing recorded
      }
      // pty-host.js marks a terminal module that loaded but can't make a terminal.
      if (error?.code === "pty_unavailable") throw sessionError(503, "pty_unavailable", PTY_MESSAGE);
      throw sessionError(
        500,
        "start_failed",
        `Agent OS could not start ${state.meta.agentLabel}. Check that it is installed, then try again.`
      );
    }
    state.offs.push(state.handle.onData((data) => onOutput(state, data)));
    state.offs.push(
      state.handle.onExit((event) => {
        onProcessExit(state, event);
      })
    );
    // Counted output wakes the session, except the redraw right after a resize.
    state.offs.push(
      state.mirror.onCountedOutput(() => {
        if (now() < state.ignoreCountedUntil) return;
        markActive(state);
      })
    );
  }

  // ---- summaries ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  function viewOfState(state) {
    return { ...state.meta, status: state.status, stateSince: state.stateSince };
  }

  function viewOfMeta(meta) {
    return { ...meta, stateSince: meta.status === "exited" ? meta.endedAt || meta.startedAt : meta.startedAt };
  }

  async function collectViews() {
    const ids = new Set([...(await listSessionIds()), ...live.keys()]);
    const views = await Promise.all(
      [...ids].map(async (id) => {
        const state = live.get(id);
        if (state) return viewOfState(state);
        const meta = await readMeta(id);
        return meta ? viewOfMeta(meta) : null;
      })
    );
    return views.filter(Boolean);
  }

  // Resume rules (spec "Resume per agent", decision Q36), worked out on every read.
  function resumeOf(view, views, installed) {
    const fallback = view.kind === "agent" && view.resumeMode === "fallback";
    if (view.kind !== "agent" || view.status !== "exited") return { available: false, reason: null, fallback };
    const label = view.agentLabel;
    if (installed.get(view.agentId) === false) {
      return { available: false, reason: `${label} isn't installed anymore.`, fallback };
    }
    if (fallback) {
      const sameFolder = views.filter(
        (other) => other.kind === "agent" && other.agentId === view.agentId && other.folder === view.folder
      );
      if (sameFolder.some((other) => other.status !== "exited")) {
        return { available: false, reason: `Another ${label} session is open in this folder. Stop it first.`, fallback };
      }
      if (sameFolder.filter((other) => other.status === "exited").length > 1) {
        return {
          available: false,
          reason: `More than one ended ${label} session used this folder, so Agent OS can't tell which conversation to resume.`,
          fallback
        };
      }
    }
    return { available: true, reason: null, fallback };
  }

  async function toSummary(view, views, installed) {
    return {
      id: view.id,
      kind: view.kind,
      agentId: view.agentId,
      agentLabel: view.agentLabel,
      folder: view.folder,
      folderName: view.folderName,
      folderShown: view.folderShown !== false,
      branch: view.branch ?? null,
      status: view.status,
      stateSince: view.stateSince,
      startedAt: view.startedAt,
      endedAt: view.endedAt ?? null,
      exitCode: view.exitCode ?? null,
      signal: view.signal ?? null,
      endedBy: view.endedBy ?? null,
      dismissed: view.dismissed === true,
      brain: view.brain ?? null,
      resume: resumeOf(view, views, installed),
      alerts: "basic",
      recordingBytes: await recordingBytes(view.id)
    };
  }

  async function summaries(views, wanted) {
    const endedAgents = new Set(
      wanted.filter((view) => view.kind === "agent" && view.status === "exited").map((view) => view.agentId)
    );
    const installed = new Map();
    await Promise.all(
      [...endedAgents].map(async (agentId) => {
        try {
          installed.set(agentId, (await detect(agentId))?.installed !== false);
        } catch {
          installed.set(agentId, true); // unknown: let Resume try, it checks again
        }
      })
    );
    return Promise.all(wanted.map((view) => toSummary(view, views, installed)));
  }

  async function list({ includeUpdate = false } = {}) {
    const views = await collectViews();
    const wanted = views.filter((view) => includeUpdate || view.kind === "agent").sort(byCreated);
    return summaries(views, wanted);
  }

  async function get(id) {
    assertSessionId(id);
    const views = await collectViews();
    const view = views.find((candidate) => candidate.id === id);
    if (!view) throw unknownSession();
    return (await summaries(views, [view]))[0];
  }

  // ---- starting, resuming, dismissing -----------------------------------------------------------------

  async function startNew({ kind, agentId, folder }) {
    if (!SESSION_AGENTS.includes(agentId)) {
      throw sessionError(400, "unknown_agent", "Agent OS can't start a session for that agent.");
    }
    if (kind === "update" && agentId !== "hermes") {
      throw sessionError(400, "update_not_available", "Only Hermes is updated in a session.");
    }
    if (kind === "agent" && !(await isExecutionAllowed())) {
      throw sessionError(409, "execution_gate_off", LOOK_ONLY_MESSAGE);
    }
    const releaseSlot = reserveSlot(kind);
    let id = null;
    try {
      await requirePty();
      const where = await resolveFolder(agentId, kind, folder);
      const detected = await detect(agentId);
      const brain = kind === "agent" ? await resolveBrain(agentId) : null;
      const settings = await readSettings();
      id = crypto.randomUUID();
      const dir = sessionDir(id);
      await ensurePrivateDir(sessionsRoot());
      await ensurePrivateDir(dir);
      const profile = await buildProfile({
        agentId,
        folder: where.folder,
        sessionId: id,
        kind,
        resume: null,
        settings,
        detected,
        brain,
        agentOsVersion: RUNTIME_VERSION
      });
      const at = iso(now());
      const folderPath = where.folder ?? profile.cwd;
      const shown = profile.folderShown ?? where.shown;
      const meta = {
        version: META_VERSION,
        id,
        kind,
        agentId,
        agentLabel: SESSION_AGENT_LABEL[agentId],
        folder: folderPath,
        folderName: path.basename(folderPath),
        folderShown: shown,
        branch: shown ? await readGitBranch(folderPath) : null,
        status: "starting",
        createdAt: at,
        startedAt: at,
        endedAt: null,
        exitCode: null,
        signal: null,
        endedBy: null,
        dismissed: false,
        brain: kind === "agent" ? brainSummary(agentId, brain) : null,
        agentSessionId: profile.agentSessionId ?? null,
        resumeMode: kind === "agent" ? profile.resumeMode ?? null : null,
        resumes: 0,
        lastUsedAt: at
      };
      const state = newState(dir, meta);
      await startProcess(state, profile, { append: false });
      live.set(id, state);
      releaseSlot();
      await persist(state);
      return get(id);
    } catch (error) {
      if (id && !live.has(id)) await fs.rm(sessionDir(id), { recursive: true, force: true }).catch(() => {});
      throw error;
    } finally {
      releaseSlot();
    }
  }

  function create({ agentId, folder } = {}) {
    return startNew({ kind: "agent", agentId, folder });
  }

  // The update kind (spec "Session kinds"): made only by the update service,
  // never by POST /api/sessions.
  function createUpdateSession({ agentId, folder } = {}) {
    return startNew({ kind: "update", agentId, folder });
  }

  // True while the session's process runs. A session whose process has just
  // ended may still be closing its recording and writing meta.json; it counts
  // as ended, and callers wait for that to finish (finishedExit) instead of
  // refusing.
  function isRunning(id) {
    const state = live.get(id);
    return Boolean(state) && state.status !== "exited";
  }

  async function finishedExit(id) {
    const state = live.get(id);
    if (state && state.status === "exited") await state.exited;
  }

  async function resume(id) {
    assertSessionId(id);
    if (isRunning(id) || busy.has(id)) {
      throw sessionError(409, "session_live", "That session is still running, so there is nothing to resume.");
    }
    busy.add(id);
    try {
      await finishedExit(id);
      const meta = await readMeta(id);
      if (!meta) throw unknownSession();
      if (meta.kind !== "agent") throw sessionError(409, "not_resumable", "An update session can't be resumed.");
      if (meta.status !== "exited") {
        throw sessionError(409, "session_live", "That session is still running, so there is nothing to resume.");
      }
      if (!(await isExecutionAllowed())) throw sessionError(409, "execution_gate_off", LOOK_ONLY_MESSAGE);
      const releaseSlot = reserveSlot("agent");
      try {
        await requirePty();
        const views = await collectViews();
        const view = views.find((candidate) => candidate.id === id) || viewOfMeta(meta);
        const [summary] = await summaries(views, [view]);
        if (!summary.resume.available) {
          throw sessionError(409, "not_resumable", summary.resume.reason || "This session can't be resumed.");
        }
        const where = await resolveFolder(meta.agentId, "agent", meta.folder);
        const detected = await detect(meta.agentId);
        const brain = await resolveBrain(meta.agentId);
        const settings = await readSettings();
        const dir = sessionDir(id);
        await ensurePrivateDir(dir);
        const profile = await buildProfile({
          agentId: meta.agentId,
          folder: where.folder,
          sessionId: id,
          kind: "agent",
          resume: { agentSessionId: meta.agentSessionId ?? null },
          settings,
          detected,
          brain,
          agentOsVersion: RUNTIME_VERSION
        });
        const at = iso(now());
        const folderPath = where.folder ?? profile.cwd;
        const shown = profile.folderShown ?? where.shown;
        const state = newState(dir, {
          ...meta,
          folder: folderPath,
          folderName: path.basename(folderPath),
          folderShown: shown,
          branch: shown ? await readGitBranch(folderPath) : null,
          status: "starting",
          startedAt: at,
          endedAt: null,
          exitCode: null,
          signal: null,
          endedBy: null,
          dismissed: false,
          brain: brainSummary(meta.agentId, brain),
          agentSessionId: profile.agentSessionId ?? meta.agentSessionId ?? null,
          resumeMode: profile.resumeMode ?? meta.resumeMode ?? null,
          resumes: (Number(meta.resumes) || 0) + 1,
          lastUsedAt: at
        });
        // The recorder writes the "--- resumed ---" marker itself (append: true).
        await startProcess(state, profile, { append: true });
        live.set(id, state);
        releaseSlot();
        await persist(state);
        return get(id);
      } finally {
        releaseSlot();
      }
    } finally {
      busy.delete(id);
    }
  }

  // Hides an ended tab (decision Q37). The recording and Resume stay in Runs.
  async function dismiss(id) {
    assertSessionId(id);
    const stillRunning = () =>
      sessionError(409, "session_live", "That session is still running. Stop it first, then dismiss it.");
    if (isRunning(id) || busy.has(id)) throw stillRunning();
    busy.add(id);
    try {
      await finishedExit(id);
      const meta = await readMeta(id);
      if (!meta) throw unknownSession();
      if (meta.status !== "exited") throw stillRunning();
      if (meta.dismissed !== true) {
        meta.dismissed = true;
        await writeJson(path.join(sessionDir(id), META_FILE), meta);
      }
    } finally {
      busy.delete(id);
    }
    return get(id);
  }

  // ---- windows ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  // The manager sends the snapshot frame itself, then the state, then every
  // output chunk that arrived while the snapshot was taken, so nothing is lost
  // or sent twice.
  async function attach(id, attachment) {
    assertSessionId(id);
    const state = live.get(id);
    if (!state || state.status === "exited") {
      if (state || (await readMeta(id))) {
        throw sessionError(409, "session_ended", "That session has ended. Its recording is in Runs.");
      }
      throw unknownSession();
    }
    if (!attachment || typeof attachment.id !== "string" || !attachment.id || typeof attachment.send !== "function") {
      throw new TypeError("attach() needs { id, send, close }.");
    }
    if (state.attachments.has(attachment.id)) throw new TypeError("That window is already attached.");
    const entry = { id: attachment.id, send: attachment.send, close: attachment.close, sent: 0, acked: 0, pending: [] };
    state.attachments.set(entry.id, entry);
    updateFlow(state);
    let snapshot;
    try {
      snapshot = await state.mirror.snapshot();
    } catch (error) {
      removeAttachment(state, entry.id);
      throw error;
    }
    const detach = () => {
      removeAttachment(state, entry.id);
    };
    if (state.attachments.get(entry.id) !== entry) return { snapshot, detach }; // closed while attaching
    safeSend(entry, { t: "snapshot", data: snapshot.data, cols: snapshot.cols, rows: snapshot.rows, modes: snapshot.modes });
    safeSend(entry, stateFrame(state));
    const pending = entry.pending;
    entry.pending = null;
    for (const item of pending) {
      if (state.attachments.get(entry.id) !== entry) break;
      if (item.frame) safeSend(entry, item.frame);
      else sendOut(state, entry, item.chunk);
    }
    updateFlow(state);
    return { snapshot, detach };
  }

  function attachmentOf(id, attachmentId) {
    const state = live.get(id);
    if (!state || state.status === "exited") return null;
    const attachment = state.attachments.get(attachmentId);
    return attachment ? { state, attachment } : null;
  }

  // {t:"focus"}: this window becomes the writer, the previous writer a viewer.
  function focus(id, attachmentId) {
    const found = attachmentOf(id, attachmentId);
    if (!found) return false;
    found.state.writerId = attachmentId;
    found.state.mirror.setWriterAttached(true);
    return true;
  }

  // {t:"in"}: accepted only from the writer, at most 64 KB per frame. The
  // writer's input is the only other thing ever written into the PTY.
  function write(id, attachmentId, data) {
    const found = attachmentOf(id, attachmentId);
    if (!found || found.state.writerId !== attachmentId) return false;
    if (typeof data !== "string" || data.length === 0) return false;
    if (Buffer.byteLength(data, "utf8") > MAX_INPUT_BYTES) return false;
    found.state.handle.write(data);
    if (isUserInput(data)) markActive(found.state);
    return true;
  }

  // {t:"resize"}: applied only from the writer, cols 2-500 and rows 1-200.
  function resize(id, attachmentId, cols, rows) {
    const found = attachmentOf(id, attachmentId);
    if (!found || found.state.writerId !== attachmentId) return false;
    if (!Number.isInteger(cols) || !Number.isInteger(rows)) return false;
    if (cols < 2 || cols > 500 || rows < 1 || rows > 200) return false;
    const { state } = found;
    state.cols = cols;
    state.rows = rows;
    state.ignoreCountedUntil = now() + RESIZE_QUIET_MS;
    state.handle.resize(cols, rows);
    try {
      // An asciicast "r" event, so a replay draws at the right width.
      state.recorder.resize?.(cols, rows);
    } catch {
      // the recording must never stop the terminal
    }
    try {
      state.mirror.resize(cols, rows);
    } catch {
      // the mirror catches up on its next write
    }
    return true;
  }

  // {t:"ack", seq}: what this window has processed; never past what was sent.
  function ack(id, attachmentId, seq) {
    const found = attachmentOf(id, attachmentId);
    if (!found || !Number.isFinite(seq)) return false;
    const { state, attachment } = found;
    attachment.acked = Math.max(attachment.acked, Math.min(Math.floor(seq), attachment.sent));
    updateFlow(state);
    return true;
  }

  // ---- quit check and recovery ------------------------------------------------------------------------

  async function quitCheck() {
    const running = [...live.values()]
      .filter((state) => state.status !== "exited")
      .map((state) => state.meta)
      .sort(byCreated);
    // The kind lets the quit question leave out "you can resume them later"
    // when an update session is listed (an update is never resumed).
    return { live: running.map((meta) => ({ id: meta.id, title: titleOf(meta), kind: meta.kind })) };
  }

  // Whether this manager runs the session right now (ruling R8). A session
  // stays in `live` until its recording is closed and meta.json is written,
  // so one still closing its recording counts as live and is never listed as
  // ended or deleted. The recordings routes (Task S8) hand this to the recorder.
  function isLive(id) {
    return live.has(id);
  }

  // On server start: a session still recorded as running belongs to a
  // previous run that ended without its exit handler (a hard kill or a
  // crash). It is shown as "ended (Agent OS quit)", with Resume.
  async function recoverStaleSessions() {
    await ensurePrivateDir(sessionsRoot());
    let recovered = 0;
    for (const id of await listSessionIds()) {
      if (live.has(id) || busy.has(id)) continue;
      const meta = await readMeta(id);
      if (!meta || meta.status === "exited") continue;
      meta.status = "exited";
      meta.endedAt = meta.endedAt || iso(now());
      meta.endedBy = "quit";
      meta.exitCode = null;
      meta.signal = null;
      meta.lastUsedAt = meta.endedAt;
      await writeJson(path.join(sessionDir(id), META_FILE), meta);
      recovered += 1;
    }
    return { recovered };
  }

  return {
    create,
    createUpdateSession,
    list,
    get,
    attach,
    focus,
    write,
    resize,
    ack,
    resume,
    dismiss,
    quitCheck,
    isLive,
    recoverStaleSessions
  };
}

let defaultManager = null;

export function getSessionManager() {
  if (!defaultManager) defaultManager = createSessionManager();
  return defaultManager;
}
```

#### Notes

1. **One choice beyond the spec.** For 1 s after an applied resize (`RESIZE_QUIET_MS`), counted output does not wake an idle session: the agent redraws for the new size, and without this, resizing the window would show an idle agent as live for 20 s. Keystrokes still wake it at once.
2. **Who says "live" (ruling R8).** The Runs list and a Delete from Runs use `manager.isLive` (Task S8), the same rule as the cap after each exit: a session counts as live until its recording is closed and its meta.json written, so one still closing its recording is never listed as ended or deleted.
3. **Deliberate limit.** If meta.json cannot be written when a process ends, the next start's recovery marks that session "ended (Agent OS quit)", with Resume, instead of its real end.

---

### Task S7: Stop sequence, quit sequence, soft stops (Claude /bg, OpenClaw safe default)

Stop is the only way a live session ends on purpose, and quitting Agent OS ends every session the same way. The Stop sequence never types into the terminal. Step 1 is the agent's own soft stop, with a hard 2 s limit for the whole step: for Claude Code, `claude agents --json` and, when this session shows there as a background session (it moved to Claude's own background with `/bg`), `claude stop <id>`; for OpenClaw, the safe default until spike S5 (no CLI call, and the honest note "Stopped the terminal. OpenClaw may still be finishing its last step."); nothing for the other agents or for update sessions. When the 2 s run out, the CLI calls it started are killed. Step 2 is `killProcessTree(pid, { graceMs: 3000 })` from Task S1, which also catches a grandchild that left the process group with `setsid`.

Quitting (`shutdownAll`) first writes `status: "exited"` and `endedBy: "quit"` into every live session's `meta.json`, before any kill, so a hard exit in the middle still leaves an honest record with Resume (a session the person was already stopping keeps `endedBy: "stop"`). Then it stops every session (both kinds) at the same time, and never waits more than 7 s, which keeps it inside the server's 8 s hard exit (and the desktop shell's 10 s `QUIT_GRACE`). The shared manager registers it as the shutdown task `"sessions"`, so SIGTERM, SIGINT and the desktop shell's stdin line all use it; Task S1's `shutdown()` runs it in parallel with the runs' own stop and awaits it before its kill sweep.

- Test: Create `test/sessions-soft-stop.test.js` and `test/sessions-stop.test.js`.

```js
// an injected CLI runner, plus runCli with a plain Node child (never an agent).
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import os from "node:os";
import test from "node:test";
import {
  OPENCLAW_STOP_NOTE,
  SOFT_STOP_LIMIT_MS,
  findBackgroundAgent,
  runCli,
  runSoftStop
} from "../server/runtime/sessions/soft-stop.js";

const isWindows = process.platform === "win32";
const SKIP_POSIX = { skip: isWindows ? "process groups are POSIX-only" : false };
const CLAUDE_UUID = "0b5f1e9a-3c2d-4e8f-9a1b-2c3d4e5f6a7b";

function isAlive(pid) {
  try {
    process.kill(pid, 0);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {

async function waitFor(predicate, { timeoutMs = 5000, intervalMs = 20 } = {}) {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    const value = await predicate();
    if (value) return value;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, intervalMs));
  }
  throw new Error("timed out waiting for condition");
}

test("Claude: asks `claude agents --json` with the session's own environment and folder, then `claude stop <id>` only for this session's background entry", async () => {
  const calls = [];
  const run = async (command, args, options) => {
    calls.push({ command, args, env: options.env, cwd: options.cwd, signal: options.signal });
    if (args[0] === "agents") {
      return {
        ok: true,
        code: 0,
        aborted: false,
        stdout: JSON.stringify([
          { id: "bg-other", kind: "background", sessionId: "11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555" },
          { id: "fg-1", kind: "interactive", sessionId: CLAUDE_UUID },
          { id: "bg-7", kind: "background", sessionId: CLAUDE_UUID }
        ])
      };
    }
    return { ok: true, code: 0, aborted: false, stdout: "" };
  };
  const env = { PATH: "/usr/bin:/bin", HOME: "/Users/someone" };
  const result = await runSoftStop({
    softStop: "claude-bg",
    command: "/fake/bin/claude",
    env,
    cwd: "/Users/someone/projects/demo",
    agentSessionId: CLAUDE_UUID,
    pid: 4242,
    run
  });
  assert.deepEqual(result, { outcome: "stopped-background", note: null });
  assert.deepEqual(calls.map((call) => call.args), [["agents", "--json"], ["stop", "bg-7"]]);
  for (const call of calls) {
    assert.equal(call.command, "/fake/bin/claude");
    assert.equal(call.env, env, "the session's environment, never the server's");
    assert.equal(call.cwd, "/Users/someone/projects/demo");
    assert.ok(call.signal instanceof AbortSignal, "every call can be cut off");
  }

  // Not a background session: nothing more is run.
  calls.length = 0;
  const quiet = async (command, args, options) => {
    calls.push({ args, options });
    return { ok: true, code: 0, aborted: false, stdout: "[]" };
  };
  assert.deepEqual(
    await runSoftStop({ softStop: "claude-bg", command: "/fake/bin/claude", env, cwd: "/", agentSessionId: CLAUDE_UUID, pid: 4242, run: quiet }),
    { outcome: "none", note: null }
  );
  assert.deepEqual(calls.map((call) => call.args), [["agents", "--json"]]);
});

test("the whole soft stop has a hard 2 s limit: when it runs out, the CLI call it started is told to stop and Stop moves on", async () => {
  assert.equal(SOFT_STOP_LIMIT_MS, 2000);
  let aborted = false;
  const hanging = (command, args, { signal }) =>
    new Promise((resolve) => {
      signal.addEventListener(
        "abort",
        () => {
          aborted = true;
          resolve({ ok: false, code: null, aborted: true, stdout: "" });
        },
        { once: true }
      );
    });
  const started = Date.now();
  const result = await runSoftStop({
    softStop: "claude-bg",
    command: "/fake/bin/claude",
    env: {},
    cwd: "/",
    agentSessionId: CLAUDE_UUID,
    pid: 1,
    run: hanging,
    limitMs: 150
  });
  const elapsed = Date.now() - started;
  assert.deepEqual(result, { outcome: "timeout", note: null });
  assert.equal(aborted, true);
  assert.ok(elapsed >= 100 && elapsed < 1500, `${elapsed} ms`);

  // A call that ignores the signal cannot hold the step either.
  const deaf = () => new Promise(() => {});
  const again = Date.now();
  assert.deepEqual(
    await runSoftStop({ softStop: "claude-bg", command: "/fake/bin/claude", env: {}, cwd: "/", agentSessionId: CLAUDE_UUID, pid: 1, run: deaf, limitMs: 150 }),
    { outcome: "timeout", note: null }
  );
  assert.ok(Date.now() - again < 1500);
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the soft stop.** Create `server/runtime/sessions/soft-stop.js` with exactly this content:

```js
// The agent's own soft stop: step 1 of the Stop sequence (spec "Persistence,
// quit and Stop"). It never writes into the session's terminal. The whole step
// has a hard limit of 2 s: when it runs out, every CLI call it started is
// killed and the Stop sequence moves on to killing the process tree.
//
// - Claude Code: `claude agents --json`; when this session is listed there as
//   a background session (moved to Claude's own background with /bg), then
//   `claude stop <id>`.
// - OpenClaw: until spike S5 confirms the Gateway abort command, no CLI call,
//   and the honest note below.
// - Every other agent, and every update session: no soft stop.
//
// Each CLI call gets the session's own environment and folder (decision Q11),
// never the server's own environment, which holds AGENT_OS_TOKEN.
import { killProcessTree, spawnTracked } from "../process-tree.js";

export const SOFT_STOP_LIMIT_MS = 2000;
export const OPENCLAW_STOP_NOTE = "Stopped the terminal. OpenClaw may still be finishing its last step.";
const MAX_CLI_OUTPUT_CHARS = 1024 * 1024;
const CLI_KILL_GRACE_MS = 500;
// What may be passed back to `claude stop`: an id, never anything that could
// read as an option.
const SAFE_AGENT_ID = /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}$/;

// Finds this session in `claude agents --json` output: an entry of kind
// "background" whose session id or pid is this session's. The live fidelity
// spike (S0, the /bg item) records the real shape; anything this does not
// recognise means "not found", and Stop goes on to kill the terminal.
export function findBackgroundAgent(text, { agentSessionId = null, pid = null } = {}) {
  let parsed;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(String(text ?? ""));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  const entries = Array.isArray(parsed)
    ? parsed
    : Array.isArray(parsed?.agents)
      ? parsed.agents
      : Array.isArray(parsed?.sessions)
        ? parsed.sessions
        : [];
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (!entry || typeof entry !== "object") continue;
    if (String(entry.kind ?? entry.type ?? "").toLowerCase() !== "background") continue;
    const ids = [entry.id, entry.sessionId, entry.session_id].filter((value) => typeof value === "string" && value);
    const sameSession = Boolean(agentSessionId) && ids.includes(agentSessionId);
    const samePid = Number.isInteger(pid) && pid > 0 && Number(entry.pid) === pid;
    if (!sameSession && !samePid) continue;
    return ids.find((value) => SAFE_AGENT_ID.test(value)) || null;
  }
  return null;
}

// Runs one CLI call (argv only, never a shell, no input) with exactly the
// environment it is handed. Never rejects: { ok, code, aborted, stdout }.
// When `signal` aborts, the call's whole process tree is killed.
export function runCli(command, args, { env, cwd, signal, onSpawn } = {}) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    if (signal?.aborted) {
      resolve({ ok: false, code: null, aborted: true, stdout: "" });
      return;
    }
    let child;
    try {
      child = spawnTracked(command, args, { cwd, env: env || {}, stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "ignore"], windowsHide: true });
    } catch {
      resolve({ ok: false, code: null, aborted: false, stdout: "" });
      return;
    }
    if (child.pid) onSpawn?.(child.pid);
    let stdout = "";
    let settled = false;
    const finish = (result) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      signal?.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
      resolve(result);
    };
    function onAbort() {
      if (child.pid) killProcessTree(child.pid, { graceMs: CLI_KILL_GRACE_MS }).catch(() => {});
      finish({ ok: false, code: null, aborted: true, stdout });
    }
    signal?.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });
    child.stdout.setEncoding("utf8");
    child.stdout.on("data", (chunk) => {
      if (stdout.length < MAX_CLI_OUTPUT_CHARS) stdout += chunk;
    });
    child.once("error", () => finish({ ok: false, code: null, aborted: false, stdout }));
    child.once("close", (code) => finish({ ok: code === 0, code, aborted: false, stdout }));
  });
}

export async function runSoftStop({
  softStop,
  command,
  env,
  cwd,
  agentSessionId = null,
  pid = null,
  limitMs = SOFT_STOP_LIMIT_MS,
  run = runCli,
  onSpawn
} = {}) {
  if (softStop === "openclaw-abort") return { outcome: "terminal-only", note: OPENCLAW_STOP_NOTE };
  if (softStop !== "claude-bg" || !command) return { outcome: "none", note: null };

  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timedOut = new Promise((resolve) => {
    controller.signal.addEventListener("abort", () => resolve({ outcome: "timeout", note: null }), { once: true });
  });
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), limitMs);
  const options = { env, cwd, signal: controller.signal, onSpawn };
  const work = (async () => {
    const listed = await run(command, ["agents", "--json"], options);
    if (controller.signal.aborted) return { outcome: "timeout", note: null };
    const backgroundId = findBackgroundAgent(listed?.stdout, { agentSessionId, pid });
    if (!backgroundId) return { outcome: "none", note: null };
    const stopped = await run(command, ["stop", backgroundId], options);
    if (controller.signal.aborted) return { outcome: "timeout", note: null };
    return { outcome: stopped?.ok ? "stopped-background" : "failed", note: null };
  })().catch(() => ({ outcome: "failed", note: null }));
  try {
    return await Promise.race([work, timedOut]);
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    if (!controller.signal.aborted) controller.abort();
  }
}
```

```js
// Stop and quit (SP3, Task S7). The Stop sequence never types into the
// terminal: the agent's soft stop (at most 2 s), then the process tree with a
// 3 s grace. Quitting writes "ended (Agent OS quit)" before any kill and stays
// inside the 8 s hard exit. Fakes for the logic; the W1 TUI fakes in a real PTY
// for the process tree and the hung `claude agents --json`. PATH is a fake bin
// folder with all six agent names plus the system folders, and SHELL is W1's
// stand-in login shell, so no real agent and no real shell setup ever runs.
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import crypto from "node:crypto";

import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import test from "node:test";
import { listDescendants } from "../server/runtime/process-tree.js";
import { HARD_EXIT_MS, SHUTDOWN_TASK_LIMIT_MS, shutdown } from "../server/runtime/shutdown.js";
import {

  STOP_GRACE_MS,
  createSessionManager,
  getSessionManager
} from "../server/runtime/sessions/manager.js";
import { spawnPty } from "../server/runtime/sessions/pty-host.js";
import { SOFT_STOP_LIMIT_MS, runSoftStop } from "../server/runtime/sessions/soft-stop.js";
import { FAKE_LOGIN_SHELL, makeFakeAgentBin } from "./helpers/fake-agents.js";

const isWindows = process.platform === "win32";
const SKIP_POSIX = { skip: isWindows ? "the fake agents are POSIX shell shims" : false };
// Node's own folder is left out on purpose: it can hold real agents.
const SYSTEM_PATH_DIRS = ["/usr/bin", "/bin", "/usr/sbin", "/sbin"];
const CLAUDE_UUID = "0b5f1e9a-3c2d-4e8f-9a1b-2c3d4e5f6a7b";
const T0 = Date.parse("2026-10-14T09:00:00.000Z");
const FALLBACK_AGENTS = new Set(["hermes", "codex", "cursor"]);

// A temp HOME (with two project folders in it), a separate temp AGENT_OS_HOME
// and a fake bin folder that holds all six agent names (POSIX shims), all
// canonical paths. PATH is the fake bin plus the system folders only, and
// SHELL is the stand-in login shell (rulings R15, R16). Restored after.
async function withSessionEnv(fn) {
  const home = await realpath(await mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "agent-os-stop-home-")));
  const agentOsHome = await realpath(await mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "agent-os-stop-data-")));
  const bin = await realpath(await mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "agent-os-stop-bin-")));
  const project = path.join(home, "projects", "demo");
  const other = path.join(home, "projects", "other");

    HOME: home,
    USERPROFILE: home,
    AGENT_OS_HOME: agentOsHome,
    HERMES_AGENT_OS_HOME: undefined,
    HERMES_HOME: undefined,
    HERMES_AGENT_OS_ENABLE_EXEC: undefined,
    HERMES_AGENT_OS_SCHEDULER: "0",
    SHELL: FAKE_LOGIN_SHELL,
    PATH: [bin, ...SYSTEM_PATH_DIRS].join(path.delimiter)
  };
  const saved = {};
  try {
    await mkdir(project, { recursive: true });
    await mkdir(other, { recursive: true });
    if (!isWindows) await makeFakeAgentBin(bin);
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(vars)) {
      saved[key] = process.env[key];
      if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
      else process.env[key] = value;
    }
    assert.equal(os.homedir(), home, "tests must never see the real home folder");
    return await fn({ home, agentOsHome, bin, project, other });
  } finally {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(saved)) {
      if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
      else process.env[key] = value;
    }
    await rm(home, { recursive: true, force: true });
    await rm(agentOsHome, { recursive: true, force: true });
    await rm(bin, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
}

async function waitFor(predicate, { timeoutMs = 10000, intervalMs = 20 } = {}) {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    const value = await predicate();
    if (value) return value;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, intervalMs));
  }
  throw new Error("timed out waiting for condition");
}

function isAlive(pid) {
  try {
    process.kill(pid, 0);
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    return error.code === "EPERM";
  }
}

async function metaOnDisk(agentOsHome, id) {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(agentOsHome, "sessions", id, "meta.json"), "utf8"));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// What every meta.json on disk says right now: { id: { status, endedBy } }.
async function allMetas() {
  const root = process.env.AGENT_OS_HOME;
  const result = {};
  for (const name of await readdir(path.join(root, "sessions")).catch(() => [])) {
    const meta = await metaOnDisk(root, name);
    if (meta) result[name] = { status: meta.status, endedBy: meta.endedBy };
  }
  return result;
}

// ---- injected fakes (the same shapes as in test/sessions-manager.test.js) --------------------------

function fakePty(pid, options) {
  const dataListeners = new Set();
  const exitListeners = new Set();
  const pty = {
    pid,
    opts: options,
    writes: [],
    resizes: [],
    kills: [],
    paused: false,
    write(data) {
      pty.writes.push(data);
    },
    resize(cols, rows) {
      pty.resizes.push([cols, rows]);
    },
    kill(signal = "SIGTERM") {
      pty.kills.push(signal);
    },
    pause() {
      pty.paused = true;
    },
    resume() {
      pty.paused = false;
    },
    onData(cb) {
      dataListeners.add(cb);
      return () => dataListeners.delete(cb);
    },
    onExit(cb) {
      exitListeners.add(cb);
      return () => exitListeners.delete(cb);
    },
    emit(data) {
      for (const cb of [...dataListeners]) cb(data);
    },
    exit(exitCode = 0, signal) {
      for (const cb of [...exitListeners]) cb({ exitCode, signal });
    }
  };
  return pty;
}

function fakeMirror(options) {
  const counted = new Set();
  const mirror = {
    opts: options,
    written: [],
    writerAttached: null,
    disposed: false,
    write(chunk) {
      mirror.written.push(chunk);
    },
    resize() {},
    async snapshot() {
      return {
        data: mirror.written.join(""),
        cols: options.cols,
        rows: options.rows,
        modes: {
          altScreen: false,
          bracketedPaste: false,
          mouseTracking: "none",
          mouseEncoding: "default",
          focusReporting: false,
          cursorKeysApp: false,
          kittyFlags: 0
        }
      };
    },
    setWriterAttached(value) {
      mirror.writerAttached = value;
    },
    onCountedOutput(cb) {
      counted.add(cb);
      return () => counted.delete(cb);
    },
    dispose() {
      mirror.disposed = true;
    }
  };
  return mirror;
}

function fakeRecorder(options) {
  const recorder = {
    opts: options,
    closed: false,
    output() {},
    marker() {},
    resize() {},
    async close() {
      recorder.closed = true;
    }
  };
  return recorder;
}

function fakeProfile({ agentId, folder, kind, resume }) {
  return {
    command: `/fake/bin/${agentId}`,
    args: kind === "update" ? ["update"] : [],
    cwd: folder || os.homedir(),
    env: { TERM: "xterm-256color" },
    agentSessionId: agentId === "claude" ? resume?.agentSessionId || CLAUDE_UUID : null,
    settingsFile: null,
    softStop: kind === "update" ? null : agentId === "claude" ? "claude-bg" : agentId === "openclaw" ? "openclaw-abort" : null,
    resumeMode: kind === "update" ? null : FALLBACK_AGENTS.has(agentId) ? "fallback" : "id",
    folderShown: kind === "update" || agentId !== "openclaw",
    notes: []
  };
}

async function fakeCheckFolder(input) {
  const home = await realpath(os.homedir());
  let real;
  try {
    real = await realpath(String(input || ""));
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, code: "missing", message: "That folder doesn't exist." };
  }
  if (!real.startsWith(home + path.sep)) {
    return { ok: false, code: "outside_home", message: "Pick a folder inside your home folder." };
  }
  return { ok: true, path: real, name: path.basename(real) };
}

// killTree records what every meta.json said at the moment of the kill, and
// (by default) makes the fake process end with SIGTERM, like a real one.
function fakeWorld(over = {}) {
  const world = {
    clock: T0,
    gate: true,
    ptys: [],
    events: [],
    softCalls: [],
    softTimes: [],
    softDelayMs: 0,
    killCalls: [],
    killMakesExit: true,
    nextPid: 52000
  };
  world.deps = {
    now: () => world.clock,
    spawn: async (options) => {
      const pty = fakePty(world.nextPid, options);
      world.nextPid += 1;
      world.ptys.push(pty);
      return pty;
    },
    buildProfile: async (input) => fakeProfile(input),
    recorderFactory: fakeRecorder,
    mirrorFactory: fakeMirror,
    isExecutionAllowed: async () => world.gate,
    checkFolder: fakeCheckFolder,
    ptyCheck: async () => ({ ok: true, reason: null }),
    detect: async (agentId) => ({ installed: true, path: `/fake/bin/${agentId}` }),
    resolveBrain: async () => null,
    readSettings: async () => ({ claudeFullscreen: false }),
    enforceCap: async () => ({ deleted: [] }),
    softStop: async (input) => {
      world.events.push("soft");
      world.softCalls.push(input);
      const start = Date.now();
      if (world.softDelayMs) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, world.softDelayMs));
      world.softTimes.push({ start, end: Date.now() });
      return { outcome: "none", note: null };
    },
    killTree: async (pid, options) => {
      world.events.push("kill");
      world.killCalls.push({ pid, options, metas: await allMetas() });
      const pty = world.ptys.find((candidate) => candidate.pid === pid);
      if (pty && world.killMakesExit) pty.exit(null, "SIGTERM");
    },
    ...over
  };
  world.manager = createSessionManager(world.deps);
  return world;
}

async function ended(world, id) {
  return waitFor(async () => {
    const summary = await world.manager.get(id);
    return summary.status === "exited" ? summary : null;
  });
}

test("stop: the agent's soft stop first, then the process tree with a 3 s grace; nothing is typed into the terminal; the session ends as stopped by you", async () => {
  await withSessionEnv(async ({ agentOsHome, project }) => {

    const world = fakeWorld();
    const summary = await world.manager.create({ agentId: "claude", folder: project });
    const pty = world.ptys[0];
    const frames = [];
    await world.manager.attach(summary.id, { id: "w", send: (frame) => frames.push(frame), close() {} });
    assert.equal(world.manager.focus(summary.id, "w"), true);

    world.clock = Date.parse("2026-10-14T09:10:00.000Z");
    const result = await world.manager.stop(summary.id);

    assert.deepEqual(world.events, ["soft", "kill"]);
    assert.deepEqual(world.softCalls[0], {

    });

    assert.deepEqual(world.killCalls[0].options, { graceMs: 3000 });
    assert.deepEqual(pty.writes, [], "Stop never types into the terminal");
    assert.deepEqual(pty.kills, [], "nor does it use the PTY's own kill");

    assert.equal(result.id, summary.id);
    assert.equal(result.status, "exited");
    assert.equal(result.endedBy, "stop");
    assert.equal(result.signal, "SIGTERM");
    assert.equal(result.exitCode, null);
    assert.equal(result.endedAt, "2026-10-14T09:10:00.000Z");
    assert.equal(result.note, null);
    assert.deepEqual(frames.at(-1), { t: "state", status: "exited", exitCode: null, signal: "SIGTERM", endedBy: "stop" });
    assert.equal((await metaOnDisk(agentOsHome, summary.id)).endedBy, "stop");
  });
});

test("stop: OpenClaw ends with the honest note while its Gateway abort waits for spike S5", async () => {
  await withSessionEnv(async () => {
    const world = fakeWorld({ softStop: runSoftStop });
    const summary = await world.manager.create({ agentId: "openclaw" });
    const result = await world.manager.stop(summary.id);
    assert.equal(result.note, "Stopped the terminal. OpenClaw may still be finishing its last step.");
    assert.equal(result.endedBy, "stop");
    assert.equal(result.status, "exited");
    assert.equal(world.killCalls.length, 1, "the terminal is still killed");
  });
});

test("stop: an ended session answers as it is, an unknown id is unknown, and two Stops at once run the sequence once", async () => {

    assert.equal(world.softCalls.length, 0);

    assert.equal(world.softCalls.length, 1);

// ---- Quit -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

test("quit: shutdownAll writes 'ended (Agent OS quit)' into every live session's meta.json before any kill, then stops both kinds at the same time", async () => {
  await withSessionEnv(async ({ agentOsHome, project, other }) => {
    const world = fakeWorld();
    world.softDelayMs = 300;
    const a = await world.manager.create({ agentId: "claude", folder: project });
    const b = await world.manager.create({ agentId: "codex", folder: other });
    const update = await world.manager.createUpdateSession({ agentId: "hermes", folder: project });
    const earlier = await world.manager.create({ agentId: "cursor", folder: project });
    world.ptys[3].exit(0, null);
    await ended(world, earlier.id);

    world.clock = Date.parse("2026-10-14T12:00:00.000Z");
    assert.deepEqual(await world.manager.shutdownAll({ reason: "quit" }), { stopped: 3 });

    assert.equal(world.killCalls.length, 3);
    for (const pty of world.ptys) assert.deepEqual(pty.writes, [], "quitting never types into a terminal (Security 6)");
    for (const call of world.killCalls) {
      for (const id of [a.id, b.id, update.id]) {
        assert.deepEqual(call.metas[id], { status: "exited", endedBy: "quit" }, "written before this kill");
      }
    }
    assert.equal(world.softTimes.length, 3);
    const lastStart = Math.max(...world.softTimes.map((time) => time.start));
    const firstEnd = Math.min(...world.softTimes.map((time) => time.end));
    assert.ok(lastStart < firstEnd, "every soft stop started before the first one finished: they ran at the same time");

    for (const id of [a.id, b.id, update.id]) {
      const meta = await metaOnDisk(agentOsHome, id);
      assert.equal(meta.status, "exited");
      assert.equal(meta.endedBy, "quit");
      assert.equal(meta.endedAt, "2026-10-14T12:00:00.000Z");
      assert.equal(meta.signal, "SIGTERM");
    }
    assert.equal((await world.manager.get(earlier.id)).endedBy, null, "a session that had already ended is left as it was");
    assert.equal((await world.manager.get(a.id)).resume.available, true, "Resume stays available after a quit");
    assert.deepEqual((await world.manager.quitCheck()).live, []);
  });
});

test("quit: a session the person is already stopping keeps 'stopped by you', and its one Stop sequence is shared", async () => {
  await withSessionEnv(async ({ agentOsHome, project }) => {
    const world = fakeWorld();
    world.softDelayMs = 200;
    const summary = await world.manager.create({ agentId: "claude", folder: project });
    const stopping = world.manager.stop(summary.id);

    assert.deepEqual(await world.manager.shutdownAll({ reason: "quit" }), { stopped: 1 });
    const stopped = await stopping;

    assert.equal(world.softCalls.length, 1, "the quit did not start a second soft stop");
    assert.equal(world.killCalls.length, 1);
    assert.deepEqual(world.killCalls[0].metas[summary.id], { status: "exited", endedBy: "stop" }, "written before the kill");
    assert.equal(stopped.endedBy, "stop");
    assert.equal((await metaOnDisk(agentOsHome, summary.id)).endedBy, "stop");
  });
});

test("quit: shutdownAll never waits more than 7 s, even when a stop hangs", async (t) => {
  await withSessionEnv(async ({ agentOsHome, project }) => {
    assert.equal(SHUTDOWN_GUARD_MS, 7000);
    assert.ok(
      SHUTDOWN_GUARD_MS <= SHUTDOWN_TASK_LIMIT_MS && SHUTDOWN_TASK_LIMIT_MS < HARD_EXIT_MS,
      "the sessions' quit fits inside shutdown.js's task limit and the 8 s hard exit"
    );
    const world = fakeWorld({
      killTree: async (pid, options) => {
        world.killCalls.push({ pid, options });
        await new Promise(() => {}); // never returns
      }
    });
    const summary = await world.manager.create({ agentId: "hermes", folder: project });
    t.mock.timers.enable({ apis: ["setTimeout"] });
    let finished = false;
    const quitting = world.manager.shutdownAll({ reason: "quit" }).then((result) => {
      finished = true;
      return result;
    });
    while (world.killCalls.length === 0) await new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
    t.mock.timers.tick(SHUTDOWN_GUARD_MS - 1);
    await new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
    assert.equal(finished, false);
    t.mock.timers.tick(1);
    assert.deepEqual(await quitting, { stopped: 1 });
    const meta = await metaOnDisk(agentOsHome, summary.id);
    assert.equal(meta.status, "exited");
    assert.equal(meta.endedBy, "quit", "the record says why it ended, even though the process outlived the stop");
  });
});

test("quit: the shared session manager is a shutdown task, so shutdown() ends every session", async () => {
  await withSessionEnv(async () => {
    const manager = getSessionManager();
    assert.equal(getSessionManager(), manager);
    assert.equal(typeof manager.stop, "function");
    assert.equal(typeof manager.shutdownAll, "function");
    const calls = [];
    const original = manager.shutdownAll;
    manager.shutdownAll = async (options) => {
      calls.push(options);
      return original(options);
    };
    try {
      await shutdown({});
    } finally {
      manager.shutdownAll = original;
    }
    assert.deepEqual(calls, [{ reason: "quit" }]);
  });
});

// ---- real PTY, with the W1 TUI fakes ----------------------------------------------------------------

// The environment of a fake agent's terminal, which the soft stop's CLI calls
// also get (the session's own environment, decision Q11): the fake bin and the
// system folders only, the stand-in login shell, and the fake's mode (the
// shims use FAKE_AGENT_MODE from their environment).
function ptyEnv({ home, bin, mode, pidFile = null }) {
  return {
    PATH: [bin, ...SYSTEM_PATH_DIRS].join(path.delimiter),
    HOME: home,
    USERPROFILE: home,
    SHELL: FAKE_LOGIN_SHELL,
    TERM: "xterm-256color",
    LANG: "en_US.UTF-8",
    FAKE_AGENT_MODE: mode,
    ...(pidFile ? { FAKE_AGENT_PIDFILE: pidFile } : {})
  };
}

// Real PTY, mirror, recorder, folder policy, process-tree kill and soft stop;
// only the profiles, the gate, detection and the brain are given, so no real
// agent can start. Every CLI call the soft stop starts is recorded in cliPids.
function realDeps(profiles, { spawned, cliPids }) {
  return {
    isExecutionAllowed: async () => true,
    detect: async (agentId) => ({ installed: true, path: profiles[agentId].command }),
    resolveBrain: async () => null,
    buildProfile: async (input) => {
      const profile = profiles[input.agentId];
      return {
        command: profile.command,
        args: profile.args,
        cwd: input.folder ?? os.homedir(),
        env: profile.env,
        agentSessionId: profile.agentSessionId ?? null,
        settingsFile: null,
        softStop: profile.softStop ?? null,
        resumeMode: profile.resumeMode ?? null,
        folderShown: true,
        notes: []
      };
    },
    spawn: async (options) => {
      const handle = await spawnPty(options);
      spawned.push(handle);
      return handle;
    },
    softStop: (input) => runSoftStop({ ...input, onSpawn: (pid) => cliPids.push(pid) })
  };
}

function killPids(pids) {
  for (const pid of pids) {
    try {
      process.kill(pid, "SIGKILL");
    } catch {
      // already gone
    }
  }
}

// Waits until meta.json on disk says the session ended.
async function settled(agentOsHome, id) {
  return waitFor(async () => {
    const meta = await metaOnDisk(agentOsHome, id);
    return meta?.status === "exited" ? meta : null;
  });
}

// The grandchild's pid, from the file the fake writes in mode setsid-grandchild.
async function grandchildPid(pidFile) {
  return Number(await waitFor(async () => (await readFile(pidFile, "utf8").catch(() => "")).trim()));
}

test("real PTY: Stop kills the whole tree, including a grandchild that left the process group with setsid", SKIP_POSIX, async () => {
  await withSessionEnv(async ({ home, agentOsHome, bin, project }) => {
    const pidFile = path.join(bin, "grandchild.pid");
    const spawned = [];
    const cliPids = [];
    let descendants = [];
    try {
      const manager = createSessionManager(
        realDeps(
          {
            hermes: {
              command: path.join(bin, "hermes"),
              args: [],
              env: ptyEnv({ home, bin, mode: "setsid-grandchild", pidFile }),
              softStop: null,
              resumeMode: "fallback"
            }
          },
          { spawned, cliPids }
        )
      );
      const summary = await manager.create({ agentId: "hermes", folder: project });
      const pid = spawned[0].pid;
      const grandchild = await grandchildPid(pidFile);
      descendants = await waitFor(async () => {
        const found = await listDescendants(pid);
        return found.includes(grandchild) ? found : null;
      });

      await manager.stop(summary.id);
      for (const each of [pid, grandchild, ...descendants]) {
        await waitFor(() => !isAlive(each), { timeoutMs: 5000 });
      }
      const meta = await settled(agentOsHome, summary.id);
      assert.equal(meta.endedBy, "stop");
      assert.equal((await manager.get(summary.id)).status, "exited");
      assert.deepEqual(cliPids, [], "Hermes has no soft stop, so no CLI call was made");
    } finally {
      killPids([...spawned.map((handle) => handle.pid), ...descendants]);
    }
  });
});

test("real PTY: quitting while Claude's `claude agents --json` hangs still finishes inside the 8 s hard exit, kills every process and records the quit", SKIP_POSIX, async () => {
  await withSessionEnv(async ({ home, agentOsHome, bin, project, other }) => {
    const pidFile = path.join(bin, "grandchild.pid");
    const spawned = [];
    const cliPids = [];
    let descendants = [];
    try {
      const manager = createSessionManager(
        realDeps(
          {
            claude: {
              command: path.join(bin, "claude"),
              args: ["--session-id", CLAUDE_UUID],
              env: ptyEnv({ home, bin, mode: "agents-hang" }),
              agentSessionId: CLAUDE_UUID,
              softStop: "claude-bg",
              resumeMode: "id"
            },
            hermes: {
              command: path.join(bin, "hermes"),
              args: [],
              env: ptyEnv({ home, bin, mode: "setsid-grandchild", pidFile }),
              softStop: null,
              resumeMode: "fallback"
            }
          },
          { spawned, cliPids }
        )
      );
      const claude = await manager.create({ agentId: "claude", folder: project });
      const hermes = await manager.create({ agentId: "hermes", folder: other });
      await waitFor(async () => (await manager.list()).every((summary) => summary.status === "live"));
      const grandchild = await grandchildPid(pidFile);
      descendants = await waitFor(async () => {
        const found = await listDescendants(spawned[1].pid);
        return found.includes(grandchild) ? found : null;
      });

      const started = Date.now();
      assert.deepEqual(await manager.shutdownAll({ reason: "quit" }), { stopped: 2 });
      const elapsed = Date.now() - started;
      assert.ok(elapsed >= SOFT_STOP_LIMIT_MS - 100, `it waited for the hung CLI up to the 2 s limit (${elapsed} ms)`);
      assert.ok(elapsed < HARD_EXIT_MS, `inside the 8 s hard exit (${elapsed} ms)`);
      assert.ok(cliPids.length >= 1, "claude agents --json was asked");

      for (const pid of [spawned[0].pid, spawned[1].pid, grandchild, ...descendants, ...cliPids]) {
        await waitFor(() => !isAlive(pid), { timeoutMs: 5000 });
      }
      for (const id of [claude.id, hermes.id]) {
        const meta = await settled(agentOsHome, id);
        assert.equal(meta.endedBy, "quit");
      }
    } finally {
      killPids([...spawned.map((handle) => handle.pid), ...descendants, ...cliPids]);
    }
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Add Stop and quit.** In `server/runtime/sessions/manager.js`, replace the returned object at the end of `createSessionManager`, exactly this block:

```js

    createUpdateSession,

```

with:

```js
  // ---- Stop and quit ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  function waitForExit(state, ms) {
    let timer;
    return Promise.race([
      state.exited,
      new Promise((resolve) => {
        timer = setTimeout(resolve, ms);
      })
    ]).finally(() => clearTimeout(timer));
  }

  // The summary after a Stop, built from the state in memory when meta.json
  // can't be read back (a full disk, or a session folder removed by hand).
  async function summaryAfterStop(state) {
    try {
      return await get(state.meta.id);
    } catch {
      const view = viewOfState(state);
      return toSummary(view, [view], new Map());
    }
  }

  // The Stop sequence. It never writes into the PTY:
  // 1. the agent's own soft stop (soft-stop.js), at most 2 s for the whole step;
  // 2. the process tree, SIGTERM then SIGKILL after a 3 s grace (process-tree.js
  //    lists the descendants first, so a grandchild that called setsid dies too).
  async function runStopSequence(state) {
    const profile = state.profile || {};
    let soft = { outcome: "none", note: null };
    try {
      soft = await softStop({
        softStop: profile.softStop ?? null,
        command: profile.command,
        env: profile.env,
        cwd: profile.cwd,
        agentSessionId: state.meta.agentSessionId ?? null,
        pid: state.handle?.pid ?? null
      });
    } catch {
      soft = { outcome: "failed", note: null };
    }
    state.stopNote = soft?.note ?? null;
    if (state.status !== "exited" && state.handle?.pid) {
      try {
        await killTree(state.handle.pid, { graceMs: STOP_GRACE_MS });
      } catch {
        // killProcessTree never rejects; nothing else to do here
      }
    }
    await waitForExit(state, EXIT_WAIT_MS);
  }

  // Stop (the Stop dialog, Hold to stop all, and quit). Two Stops of the same
  // session share one sequence. Answers the session's summary plus `note`
  // (the honest OpenClaw sentence, or null).
  async function stop(id, { by = "stop" } = {}) {
    assertSessionId(id);
    const state = live.get(id);
    if (!state) return { ...(await get(id)), note: null };
    if (state.status !== "exited" && !state.stopping) {
      if (!state.endedBy) state.endedBy = by === "quit" ? "quit" : "stop";
      state.stopping = runStopSequence(state);
    }
    if (state.stopping) await state.stopping;
    else await waitForExit(state, EXIT_WAIT_MS);
    return { ...(await summaryAfterStop(state)), note: state.stopNote ?? null };
  }

  // Quitting Agent OS: "ended (Agent OS quit)" goes into every live session's
  // meta.json BEFORE any kill, so a hard exit in the middle still leaves an
  // honest record with Resume (a session the person is already stopping keeps
  // "stop"). Then every session (both kinds) stops at the same time, and the
  // whole quit never waits more than SHUTDOWN_GUARD_MS. Only meta.json says
  // "exited" early: the state in memory keeps the real status, so list(),
  // resume() and dismiss() still treat the session as running until it ends.
  async function shutdownAll({ reason = "quit" } = {}) {
    const endedBy = reason === "stop" ? "stop" : "quit";
    const running = [...live.values()].filter((state) => state.status !== "exited");
    const endedAt = iso(now());
    await Promise.all(
      running.map((state) => {
        if (!state.endedBy) state.endedBy = endedBy;
        state.meta.status = "exited";
        state.meta.endedAt = endedAt;
        state.meta.endedBy = state.endedBy;
        state.meta.lastUsedAt = endedAt;
        return persist(state).catch(() => {});
      })
    );
    let timer;
    const guard = new Promise((resolve) => {
      timer = setTimeout(resolve, SHUTDOWN_GUARD_MS);
    });
    try {
      await Promise.race([Promise.allSettled(running.map((state) => stop(state.meta.id, { by: endedBy }))), guard]);
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timer);
    }
    return { stopped: running.length };
  }

  return {
    create,
    createUpdateSession,
    list,
    get,
    attach,
    focus,
    write,
    resize,
    ack,
    resume,
    dismiss,
    stop,
    shutdownAll,
    quitCheck,
    isLive,
    recoverStaleSessions
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 9: Register the quit.** In `server/runtime/sessions/manager.js`, replace the whole `getSessionManager` function:

```js
export function getSessionManager() {
  if (!defaultManager) defaultManager = createSessionManager();
  return defaultManager;
}
```

with:

```js
export function getSessionManager() {
  if (!defaultManager) {
    const manager = createSessionManager();
    // Quitting Agent OS (SIGTERM or SIGINT, the desktop shell's stdin line, or
    // its Quit) ends every session with the Stop sequence, after writing
    // "ended (Agent OS quit)" into each meta.json. The task looks the method up
    // when it runs.
    registerShutdownTask("sessions", () => manager.shutdownAll({ reason: "quit" }));
    defaultManager = manager;
  }
  return defaultManager;
}
```
