```tsx
// One session's real terminal (spec "Browser terminal"): xterm.js 6.1 shows what the agent's own program
// draws, and the person's keys go straight to it. The server keeps the session; this view only attaches
// (the snapshot first, then live output) and can be closed and opened again at any time (spec "Persistence").
// Only Agent OS's own shortcuts are kept from the agent (⌘K, ⌘T, ⌘1-9 on a Mac; Ctrl+Shift+K/T/1-9 elsewhere;
// isAppShortcut in sessionsShared.ts). The palette key is handled here; ⌘T and ⌘1-9 bubble on to the Sessions
// page's own key handler. Every other key, Ctrl+K and Ctrl+R included, reaches the agent.
import { forwardRef, useEffect, useImperativeHandle, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Terminal } from "@xterm/xterm";
import type { ITerminalOptions, ITheme } from "@xterm/xterm";
import { ClipboardAddon } from "@xterm/addon-clipboard";
import type { IClipboardProvider } from "@xterm/addon-clipboard";
import { FitAddon } from "@xterm/addon-fit";
import { SearchAddon } from "@xterm/addon-search";
import { Unicode11Addon } from "@xterm/addon-unicode11";
import { WebLinksAddon } from "@xterm/addon-web-links";
import { WebglAddon } from "@xterm/addon-webgl";
import "@xterm/xterm/css/xterm.css";
import "../terminal.css";
import { openSessionSocket } from "../../sessionsApi";
import type { SessionSocket } from "../../sessionsApi";
import type { SessionSnapshot, SessionStateFrame } from "../../types";
import { isDesktopApp } from "../desktop";
import { togglePalette } from "../palette";
import { isAppShortcut, isMacPlatform } from "../sessionsShared";
import {
  isAsciiOnly,
  isOsc52Read,
  linkAllowed,
  modeRestoreSequence,
  RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS,
  reconnectDelay,
  sameTheme,
  terminalTheme,
  TERMINAL_FONT_SIZE,
  TERMINAL_LINE_HEIGHT,
  TERMINAL_SCROLLBACK
} from "../terminalShared";

const IS_MAC = isMacPlatform(typeof navigator !== "undefined" ? navigator.platform || navigator.userAgent || "" : "");
// The terminal measures its letters when it opens, so it waits (this long at most) for JetBrains Mono.
const FONT_WAIT_MS = 1500;

// The terminal's own words (planning decisions Q40 and Q45, "Terminal notices"). `linkNotCopied` is for the
// rare window that refuses the copy too.
const WORDS = {
  connecting: "Connecting…",
  reconnecting: "Reconnecting…",
  lost: "Lost the connection to this session.",
  reconnect: "Reconnect",
  linkCopied: "Link copied. Open it in your browser.",
  linkNotCopied: "Agent OS couldn't open or copy that link."
} as const;

export type TerminalConnection = "connecting" | "open" | "reconnecting" | "lost" | "ended";

export interface SessionTerminalProps {
  sessionId: string;
  // The terminal's accessible name, for example "Claude Code · my-app terminal".
  label: string;
  // The two browser-only settings; the page keeps them and their defaults (spec: they stay in the browser).
  kittyKeyboard: boolean;
  webgl: boolean;
  // Take the keys (become the writer) once the screen is restored, and whenever it is shown again.
  autoFocus?: boolean;
  // false while its tab is hidden: it does not fit or take the keys then. Default true.
  active?: boolean;
  // The page's latest session list says this session has ended: never attach again. The server refuses an
  // ended session's attach with a bare 403, which reaches onClose as 1006 with no reason, so only the page
  // can tell a refused try from a dropped connection (planning decision Q40).
  ended?: boolean;
  onState?: (state: SessionStateFrame) => void;
  // SP3 forwards the raw OSC 9 / 99 / 777 payload, or "bel"; SP4 turns them into alerts.
  onAlert?: (raw: string) => void;
  onConnection?: (connection: TerminalConnection) => void;
  // A sentence for the page to show (a link copied instead of opened: "Link copied. Open it in your browser.").
  onNotice?: (text: string) => void;
}

export interface SessionTerminalHandle {
  focus(): void;
  findNext(text: string): boolean;
  findPrevious(text: string): boolean;
  clearSearch(): void;
}

function readToken(name: string): string {
  return getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(name);
}

async function waitForFont(family: string): Promise<void> {
  if (typeof document === "undefined" || !document.fonts) return;
  await Promise.race([
    document.fonts.load(`${TERMINAL_FONT_SIZE}px ${family}`).then(
      () => undefined,
      () => undefined
    ),
    new Promise<void>((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, FONT_WAIT_MS))
  ]);
}

// Links open in the person's browser: a new tab in browser mode; in the desktop app through the opener, which
// only opens the addresses Agent OS lists (desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/default.json, the scope the owner
// approved). An address outside that list is refused by the opener, so it is copied instead, and the page is
// handed the sentence that says so (decision Q45). Only http and https ever open.
async function openLink(uri: string, say: (text: string) => void): Promise<void> {
  if (!linkAllowed(uri)) return;
  if (!isDesktopApp()) {
    window.open(uri, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
    return;
  }
  try {
    const { openUrl } = await import("@tauri-apps/plugin-opener");
    await openUrl(new URL(uri).href);
  } catch {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(uri);
      say(WORDS.linkCopied);
    } catch {
      say(WORDS.linkNotCopied);
    }
  }
}

// OSC 52: a program may put text on the clipboard; reading it is refused (spec). Read requests never get
// this far: the guard registered after the addon swallows them first (see below).
const CLIPBOARD: IClipboardProvider = {
  readText: () => "",
  async writeText(_selection: string, text: string) {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    } catch {
      // The window would not allow it: nothing is copied.
    }
  }
};

const SessionTerminal = forwardRef<SessionTerminalHandle, SessionTerminalProps>(function SessionTerminal(props, ref) {
  const { sessionId, label, kittyKeyboard, webgl, autoFocus = false, active = true, ended = false } = props;
  const hostRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const termRef = useRef<Terminal | null>(null);
  const searchRef = useRef<SearchAddon | null>(null);
  const fitRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null);
  const rendererRef = useRef<((wantWebgl: boolean) => void) | null>(null);
  // Set while the terminal is mounted: the Reconnect button, and the page saying the session has ended.
  const actionsRef = useRef<{ reconnect(): void; pageSaysEnded(): void } | null>(null);
  // The newest props, for callbacks that live as long as the terminal (a new callback never reconnects).
  const latest = useRef(props);
  latest.current = props;
  const [connection, setConnection] = useState<TerminalConnection>("connecting");

  useImperativeHandle(
    ref,
    () => ({
      focus: () => termRef.current?.focus(),
      findNext: (text: string) => searchRef.current?.findNext(text) ?? false,
      findPrevious: (text: string) => searchRef.current?.findPrevious(text) ?? false,
      clearSearch: () => searchRef.current?.clearDecorations()
    }),
    []
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const host = hostRef.current;
    if (!host) return undefined;
    let disposed = false;
    let term: Terminal | null = null;
    let socket: SessionSocket | null = null;
    // The session has ended (an exited state frame, a session_ended close, or the page's `ended`): this
    // window keeps its last screen and never attaches again.
    let sessionEnded = false;
    // Tries in a row that ended without a screen, since the last snapshot (Q40: at most RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS).
    let attempts = 0;
    let firstTry = true;
    let shown: TerminalConnection | null = null;
    let retryTimer: number | null = null;
    let frame = 0;
    let webglAddon: WebglAddon | null = null;
    const cleanups: Array<() => void> = [];

    const report = (next: TerminalConnection) => {
      if (disposed || shown === next) return;
      shown = next;
      setConnection(next);
      latest.current.onConnection?.(next);
    };
    // The page shows these sentences (the Sessions page as a toast), so the terminal never shows them twice.
    const say = (text: string) => {
      if (!disposed) latest.current.onNotice?.(text);
    };
    const cancelRetry = () => {
      if (retryTimer !== null) window.clearTimeout(retryTimer);
      retryTimer = null;
    };
    const finish = () => {
      cancelRetry();
      sessionEnded = true;
      report("ended");
    };

    void (async () => {
      const fontFamily = readToken("--os-font-mono").trim() || "monospace";
      await waitForFont(fontFamily);
      if (disposed) return;

      const options: ITerminalOptions = {
        allowProposedApi: true,
        fontFamily,
        fontSize: TERMINAL_FONT_SIZE,
        lineHeight: TERMINAL_LINE_HEIGHT,
        scrollback: TERMINAL_SCROLLBACK,
        scrollOnEraseInDisplay: true,
        theme: terminalTheme(readToken),
        vtExtensions: { kittyKeyboard: latest.current.kittyKeyboard },
        // OSC 8 links: only http and https are shown as links (xterm's own rule while allowNonHttpProtocols
        // is false), and openLink checks the scheme again.
        linkHandler: { activate: (_event, uri) => void openLink(uri, say), allowNonHttpProtocols: false }
      };
      const t = new Terminal(options);
      term = t;
      termRef.current = t;

      const fit = new FitAddon();
      const search = new SearchAddon();
      t.loadAddon(fit);
      t.loadAddon(search);
      t.loadAddon(new Unicode11Addon());
      t.unicode.activeVersion = "11";
      // Plain-text links: the addon's own pattern needs "//" after the scheme, so `mailto:` text is never a
      // link (Q45); openLink lets only http and https through.
      t.loadAddon(new WebLinksAddon((_event, uri) => void openLink(uri, say)));
      t.loadAddon(new ClipboardAddon(undefined, CLIPBOARD));
      // Registered after the clipboard addon, so xterm asks it first ("The most recently added handler is
      // tried first", xterm.d.ts registerOscHandler): a READ request is answered with nothing at all, and a
      // write goes on to the addon.
      t.parser.registerOscHandler(52, (data) => isOsc52Read(data));
      searchRef.current = search;

      // Agent OS's own shortcuts never reach the agent; everything else does (spec, App shortcuts). xterm calls
      // this for keydown, keypress and keyup, and returning false keeps the key from the agent. The palette
      // key is handled here (the Shell ignores keys typed in a terminal). ⌘T and ⌘1-9 are left untouched (not
      // prevented, not stopped), so they bubble on to the Sessions page's window handler. There is no
      // Ctrl+Shift+C/V in SP3 (Q45): the spec's key list sends every other key to the agent.
      t.attachCustomKeyEventHandler((event) => {
        const shortcut = isAppShortcut(event, { isMac: IS_MAC, desktop: isDesktopApp() });
        if (!shortcut) return true;
        if (event.type === "keydown" && shortcut.action === "palette") {
          event.preventDefault();
          togglePalette();
        }
        return false;
      });

      t.onData((data) => socket?.input(data));
      // Only the X10 mouse form produces bytes above 127, which the text protocol cannot carry unchanged:
      // those few reports are dropped rather than sent wrong.
      t.onBinary((data) => {
        if (isAsciiOnly(data)) socket?.input(data);
      });

      t.open(host);

      // Taking the keys makes this window the writer for its session ({t:"focus"}, then its size).
      const onFocus = () => socket?.focus();
      const textarea = t.textarea;
      textarea?.addEventListener("focus", onFocus);
      cleanups.push(() => textarea?.removeEventListener("focus", onFocus));

      const fitNow = () => {
        frame = 0;
        if (disposed || host.clientWidth === 0 || host.clientHeight === 0) return;
        try {
          fit.fit();
        } catch {
          return;
        }
        socket?.resize(t.cols, t.rows);
      };
      fitRef.current = () => {
        if (!frame) frame = window.requestAnimationFrame(fitNow);
      };
      const sizeWatch = new ResizeObserver(() => fitRef.current?.());
      sizeWatch.observe(host);
      cleanups.push(() => {
        sizeWatch.disconnect();
        if (frame) window.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
        fitRef.current = null;
      });

      // Q17: read the tokens again when the page's theme could have changed.
      let theme: ITheme = options.theme ?? {};
      const themeWatch = new MutationObserver(() => {
        const next = terminalTheme(readToken);
        if (!sameTheme(next, theme)) {
          theme = next;
          t.options.theme = next;
        }
      });
      themeWatch.observe(document.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["data-theme", "class", "style"] });
      cleanups.push(() => themeWatch.disconnect());

      // The renderer: the page's setting decides (its default follows Q45); back to the DOM renderer if the
      // WebGL context is lost (it stays there until the setting is switched off and on).
      rendererRef.current = (wantWebgl: boolean) => {
        if (wantWebgl && !webglAddon) {
          try {
            const addon = new WebglAddon();
            addon.onContextLoss(() => {
              addon.dispose();
              if (webglAddon === addon) webglAddon = null;
            });
            t.loadAddon(addon);
            webglAddon = addon;
          } catch {
            // No WebGL here: the DOM renderer stays.
            webglAddon = null;
          }
        } else if (!wantWebgl && webglAddon) {
          webglAddon.dispose();
          webglAddon = null;
        }
      };
      rendererRef.current(latest.current.webgl);

      // Reattach (spec "Persistence"): a full reset through the write queue (so nothing still queued from an
      // earlier socket lands on the new screen), the snapshot at the size it was taken, then the modes the
      // snapshot does not carry, then this window's own size (D-U2-7).
      // Never resize or fit inside a write callback (here, in onOut, or anywhere else): xterm's resize() flushes
      // the write queue synchronously from the start of its buffer, which runs already-parsed chunks and their
      // callbacks again, and the outer resize then lands last. Each step waits until its write is parsed, then
      // acts outside the callback.
      const writeParsed = (data: string) => new Promise<void>((resolve) => t.write(data, resolve));
      const restore = async (snapshot: SessionSnapshot) => {
        await writeParsed("\x1bc");
        t.resize(snapshot.cols, snapshot.rows);
        await writeParsed(snapshot.data);
        const modes = modeRestoreSequence(snapshot.modes, {
          altActive: t.buffer.active.type === "alternate",
          kitty: Boolean(t.options.vtExtensions?.kittyKeyboard)
        });
        if (modes) await writeParsed(modes);
        fitNow();
      };

      const connect = () => {
        if (disposed || sessionEnded) return;
        // The page's session list says the session has ended: the server would refuse the attach (Q40).
        if (latest.current.ended === true) {
          finish();
          return;
        }
        report(firstTry ? "connecting" : "reconnecting");
        firstTry = false;
        socket = openSessionSocket(sessionId, {
          onSnapshot: async (snapshot) => {
            if (disposed) return;
            attempts = 0;
            await restore(snapshot);
            if (disposed) return;
            report("open");
            // Take the keys back after a reattach, or take them now when asked to.
            if (document.activeElement === t.textarea) socket?.focus();
            else if (latest.current.active !== false && latest.current.autoFocus) t.focus();
          },
          onOut: (data) =>
            new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
              if (disposed) resolve();
              else t.write(data, resolve);
            }),
          onState: (state) => {
            if (state.status === "exited") sessionEnded = true;
            latest.current.onState?.(state);
          },
          onAlert: (raw) => latest.current.onAlert?.(raw),
          onClose: (info) => {
            socket = null;
            if (disposed) return;
            // An ended session has nothing to attach to: keep its last screen (an exited state frame, the
            // session_ended close, or the page's list saying so).
            if (sessionEnded || info.advice === "ended" || latest.current.ended === true) {
              finish();
              return;
            }
            // Too far behind: attach again at once for a fresh snapshot (spec, Back-pressure).
            if (info.reason === "too_far_behind") {
              attempts = 0;
              connect();
              return;
            }
            // A refused attach, a dropped connection (1006), Agent OS restarting or attach_failed: try again
            // at a slowing pace while the page still says the session is live, then stop and offer Reconnect.
            if (attempts >= RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS) {
              report("lost");
              return;
            }
            const wait = reconnectDelay(attempts, info.advice);
            attempts += 1;
            report("reconnecting");
            retryTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
              retryTimer = null;
              connect();
            }, wait);
          }
        });
      };

      actionsRef.current = {
        // "Reconnect" after the last try: a fresh round of tries, and the keys go back to this terminal.
        reconnect: () => {
          if (disposed || socket || sessionEnded) return;
          cancelRetry();
          attempts = 0;
          connect();
          if (!sessionEnded) t.focus();
        },
        // The page's list now says the session has ended. An open socket hears it from the server itself
        // (the exited state frame, then the session_ended close); between tries, stop trying now.
        pageSaysEnded: () => {
          if (disposed || socket) return;
          finish();
        }
      };
      connect();
    })();

    return () => {
      disposed = true;
      cancelRetry();
      socket?.close();
      socket = null;
      for (const cleanup of cleanups) cleanup();
      actionsRef.current = null;
      rendererRef.current = null;
      searchRef.current = null;
      termRef.current = null;
      term?.dispose();
    };
  }, [sessionId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const t = termRef.current;
    if (t) t.options.vtExtensions = { kittyKeyboard };
  }, [kittyKeyboard]);

  useEffect(() => {
    rendererRef.current?.(webgl);
  }, [webgl]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (ended) actionsRef.current?.pageSaysEnded();
  }, [ended]);

  // Shown again (its tab selected): fit the box, and take the keys when asked to.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!active) return;
    fitRef.current?.();
    if (autoFocus) termRef.current?.focus();
  }, [active, autoFocus]);

  const lost = connection === "lost";
  const notice =
    connection === "connecting" ? WORDS.connecting : connection === "reconnecting" ? WORDS.reconnecting : lost ? WORDS.lost : null;

  return (
    <div className="os-term" role="group" aria-label={label} data-connection={connection}>
      <div className="os-term__screen" ref={hostRef} />
      {notice ? (
        <div className={lost ? "os-term__notice os-term__notice--lost" : "os-term__notice"}>
          <p className="os-term__notice-text" role="status">
            {notice}
          </p>
          {lost ? (
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => actionsRef.current?.reconnect()}>
              {WORDS.reconnect}
            </button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
});

export default SessionTerminal;
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Create the probe `.superpowers/ui-audit/probes/terminal.mjs`** (git-ignored, never committed):

```js
// Task U2: the session terminal (xterm.js 6.1), mounted for real in the running app against a mock
// WebSocket. Run from the worktree root, after `npm run build`:
//   node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs probe .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/terminal.mjs
// The Sessions page arrives in Task U3, so this probe bundles SessionTerminal with esbuild (the way
// kit2.mjs mounted the kit) and mounts it on the Runs page, in plain positioned boxes inside a fixed layer
// over the page (the page's frame is U3's). The Runs page never gets the Sessions page's ⌘T / ⌘1-9 window
// handler or its New session dialog, so this probe keeps passing after U3. The server end of each socket is
// played by context.routeWebSocket: no session or agent is ever started. Part 5 waits through the whole
// reconnect pace, so the probe takes about a minute.
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
import { mkdir } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";

const W = 1470, H = 956;
const ATTACH = /\/api\/sessions\/([^/]+)\/attach$/;
const IDS = {
  A: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa",
  B: "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb",
  C: "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc",
  D: "dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddddd",
  E: "eeeeeeee-eeee-4eee-8eee-eeeeeeeeeeee",
  F: "ffffffff-ffff-4fff-8fff-ffffffffffff"
};
const PLAIN = { altScreen: false, bracketedPaste: true, mouseTracking: "none", mouseEncoding: "default", focusReporting: false, cursorKeysApp: false, kittyFlags: 0 };
const MOUSE = { ...PLAIN, bracketedPaste: false, mouseTracking: "vt200", mouseEncoding: "sgr" };
const FIRST = "\u001b[1mHello\u001b[0m from the probe \u001b[31mred\u001b[0m\r\n> ";
// What each session's snapshot shows; n counts the attaches of that session (refused ones included).
const SNAP = {
  [IDS.A]: (n) => (n === 1 ? FIRST : "Second snapshot\r\n> "),
  [IDS.B]: () => "Mouse on\r\n",
  [IDS.C]: () => "WebGL terminal\r\n",
  [IDS.D]: (n) => (n === 1 ? "Drop test\r\n> " : "Back again\r\n> "),
  [IDS.E]: () => "Ended test\r\n> ",
  [IDS.F]: () => "Never shown\r\n"
};
// Sessions whose attach the mock server refuses at once, without a snapshot, and with which close. S9 refuses
// an attach with a bare 403, which the browser reports as close 1006 with no reason.
const refuse = new Map();

const HARNESS = String.raw`
import { createRoot } from "react-dom/client";
import type { Root } from "react-dom/client";
import SessionTerminal from "./src/ui/components/SessionTerminal";

const probe: any = ((window as any).__probe = { states: [], alerts: [], notices: [], connection: {}, connectionLog: [], bubbled: [] });
// What reaches the page's own window handler from inside a terminal (U3 reads ⌘T and ⌘1-9 there).
window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  const target = e.target as Element | null;
  if (target && typeof target.closest === "function" && target.closest(".xterm")) {
    probe.bubbled.push({ code: e.code, prevented: e.defaultPrevented });
  }
});
type MountOptions = { webgl: boolean; width: number; height: number; autoFocus: boolean };
const roots: Record<string, { root: Root; host: HTMLDivElement; id: string; opts: MountOptions; ended: boolean }> = {};
// Every draw passes new callback functions, as a page's render does.
function draw(key: string) {
  const r = roots[key];
  if (!r) return;
  r.root.render(
    <SessionTerminal
      sessionId={r.id}
      label={"Probe terminal " + key}
      kittyKeyboard
      webgl={r.opts.webgl}
      autoFocus={r.opts.autoFocus}
      ended={r.ended}
      onState={(s) => probe.states.push({ key, status: s.status })}
      onAlert={(raw) => probe.alerts.push({ key, raw })}
      onConnection={(c) => {
        probe.connection[key] = c;
        probe.connectionLog.push({ key, c });
      }}
      onNotice={(text) => probe.notices.push({ key, text })}
    />
  );
}
probe.mount = (key: string, id: string, opts: MountOptions) => {
  const host = document.createElement("div");
  host.id = "probe-term-" + key;
  host.style.cssText = "position:relative;width:" + opts.width + "px;height:" + opts.height + "px;margin:16px 0;";
  // A fixed layer over the page: every host stays on screen (xterm pauses drawing off screen) whatever the
  // page under it draws. z-index 40 is below the palette's 80, so the palette still opens over it.
  let layer = document.getElementById("probe-layer");
  if (!layer) {
    layer = document.createElement("div");
    layer.id = "probe-layer";
    layer.style.cssText = "position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:40;overflow:auto;padding:0 16px;background:var(--os-bg-0);";
    document.body.appendChild(layer);
  }
  layer.appendChild(host);
  roots[key] = { root: createRoot(host), host, id, opts, ended: false };
  draw(key);
};
probe.redraw = (key: string) => draw(key);
probe.setEnded = (key: string, ended: boolean) => {
  if (!roots[key]) return;
  roots[key].ended = ended;
  draw(key);
};
probe.setSize = (key: string, w: number, h: number) => {
  const r = roots[key];
  if (r) {
    r.host.style.width = w + "px";
    r.host.style.height = h + "px";
  }
};
probe.unmount = (key: string) => {
  roots[key]?.root.unmount();
  roots[key]?.host.remove();
  delete roots[key];
};
`;

export default async function ({ browser, pass, fail, BASE, TOKEN, HERE }) {
  const check = (ok, name, why = "") => (ok ? pass(name) : fail(name, String(why)));
  const REPO = path.resolve(HERE, "..", "..");

  // 1. Bundle SessionTerminal with its CSS (xterm.css and terminal.css). Nothing is written to disk.
  let js = null;
  let css = "";
  try {
    const { build } = createRequire(path.join(REPO, "package.json"))("esbuild");
    const result = await build({
      stdin: { contents: HARNESS, resolveDir: REPO, loader: "tsx", sourcefile: "terminal-harness.tsx" },
      bundle: true, write: false, outdir: path.join(HERE, ".terminal-bundle"), format: "iife", platform: "browser",
      jsx: "automatic", logLevel: "silent", define: { "process.env.NODE_ENV": '"production"' }
    });
    js = result.outputFiles.find((f) => f.path.endsWith(".js"))?.text ?? null;
    css = result.outputFiles.find((f) => f.path.endsWith(".css"))?.text ?? "";
    js && /\.xterm\b/.test(css) && /\.os-term\b/.test(css) ? pass("SessionTerminal bundles with xterm.css and terminal.css") : fail("bundle", `js=${Boolean(js)} css=${css.length}`);
  } catch (error) {
    fail("bundle", String(error.errors?.[0]?.text || error.message).slice(0, 300));
  }
  if (!js) return;

  // The server end of every socket: records what the page sends and lets the probe answer.
  let conns = [];
  async function open(page) {
    conns = [];
    const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: W, height: H } });
    await context.routeWebSocket(ATTACH, (ws) => {
      const id = ATTACH.exec(new URL(ws.url()).pathname)?.[1] || "";
      const conn = { ws, id, msgs: [], closed: null, at: Date.now(), seq: 0 };
      conns.push(conn);
      ws.onMessage((m) => {
        try { conn.msgs.push(JSON.parse(String(m))); } catch { conn.msgs.push({ bad: String(m) }); }
      });
      ws.onClose((code) => { conn.closed = code ?? 0; });
      const no = refuse.get(id);
      if (no) {
        ws.close(no).catch(() => {});
        return;
      }
      const n = conns.filter((c) => c.id === id).length;
      setTimeout(() => ws.send(JSON.stringify({ t: "snapshot", data: SNAP[id](n), cols: 80, rows: 24, modes: id === IDS.B ? MOUSE : PLAIN })), 50);
    });
    await context.addInitScript(() => {
      window.__clip = { writes: [], reads: 0 };
      Object.defineProperty(navigator, "clipboard", {
        configurable: true,
        value: {
          writeText: async (text) => { window.__clip.writes.push(text); },
          readText: async () => { window.__clip.reads += 1; return "SECRET"; }
        }
      });
      window.__opened = [];
      window.open = (url) => { window.__opened.push(String(url)); return null; };
    });
    const tab = await context.newPage();
    const errors = [];
    tab.on("console", (m) => { if (m.type() === "error") errors.push(m.text()); });
    tab.on("pageerror", (e) => errors.push(String(e)));
    await tab.goto(`${BASE}/?launch=${TOKEN}`);
    await tab.goto(`${BASE}/?page=${page}`);
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1200);
    await tab.addStyleTag({ content: css });
    await tab.evaluate(js);
    return { context, tab, errors };
  }
  const until = async (tab, fn, ms = 4000) => {
    const end = Date.now() + ms;
    while (Date.now() < end) {
      if (await fn()) return true;
      await tab.waitForTimeout(50);
    }
    return false;
  };
  const conn = (id, n = 1) => conns.filter((c) => c.id === id)[n - 1];
  const count = (id) => conns.filter((c) => c.id === id).length;
  const ins = (c) => c.msgs.filter((m) => m.t === "in").map((m) => m.d);
  // Live output with a correct seq (the UTF-8 bytes sent on this socket so far).
  const out = (c, d) => {
    c.seq += Buffer.byteLength(d, "utf8");
    c.ws.send(JSON.stringify({ t: "out", seq: c.seq, d }));
  };
  const screenText = (tab, key) =>
    tab.evaluate((k) => (document.querySelector(`#probe-term-${k} .xterm-rows`)?.textContent || "").split(String.fromCharCode(160)).join(" "), key);
  const noticeText = (tab, key) => tab.evaluate((k) => document.querySelector(`#probe-term-${k} .os-term__notice-text`)?.textContent || "", key);
  const connectionOf = (tab, key) => tab.evaluate((k) => window.__probe.connection[k], key);
  const shotOf = async (tab, key, name) => {
    const dir = path.join(HERE, "shots", "terminal", `${W}x${H}`);
    await mkdir(dir, { recursive: true });
    await tab.locator(`#probe-term-${key}`).screenshot({ path: path.join(dir, `${name}.png`) });
  };
  // Hover, then click the first characters of `text` on the terminal's screen (xterm finds a link on hover).
  const clickText = async (tab, key, text) => {
    const spot = await tab.evaluate(({ k, text }) => {
      const rows = document.querySelector(`#probe-term-${k} .xterm-rows`);
      if (!rows) return null;
      const walker = document.createTreeWalker(rows, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
      for (let n = walker.nextNode(); n; n = walker.nextNode()) {
        const at = n.textContent.indexOf(text);
        if (at >= 0) {
          const r = document.createRange();
          r.setStart(n, at);
          r.setEnd(n, at + Math.min(7, text.length));
          const b = r.getBoundingClientRect();
          return { x: b.x + b.width / 2, y: b.y + b.height / 2 };
        }
      }
      return null;
    }, { k: key, text });
    if (spot) {
      await tab.mouse.move(spot.x, spot.y);
      await tab.waitForTimeout(300);
      await tab.mouse.down();
      await tab.mouse.up();
      await tab.waitForTimeout(400);
    }
    return spot;
  };

  // ---- 2. Browser mode: attach, look, keys, paste, output, clipboard, links, resize, reattach, end ----
  {
    const { context, tab, errors } = await open("runs");
    const isMac = await tab.evaluate(() => /mac/i.test(navigator.platform || navigator.userAgent || ""));
    await tab.evaluate((id) => window.__probe.mount("A", id, { webgl: false, width: 900, height: 420, autoFocus: true }), IDS.A);
    await until(tab, () => Boolean(conn(IDS.A)?.msgs.some((m) => m.t === "focus")), 5000);
    const a = conn(IDS.A);
    await until(tab, async () => /Hello from the probe/.test(await screenText(tab, "A")));
    check(/Hello from the probe red/.test(await screenText(tab, "A")), "the snapshot is on screen", await screenText(tab, "A"));
    const first = a?.msgs.slice(0, 2) || [];
    check(first[0]?.t === "focus" && first[1]?.t === "resize" && first[1].cols >= 2 && first[1].cols <= 500 && first[1].rows >= 1 && first[1].rows <= 200, 'autoFocus makes it the writer: {t:"focus"}, then its size at once', JSON.stringify(a?.msgs.slice(0, 3)));
    const fitted = first[1] || { cols: 0, rows: 0 };
    check(fitted.cols !== 80 || fitted.rows !== 24, "it fits its own box (not the snapshot's 80 × 24)", JSON.stringify(fitted));
    const domRows = await tab.evaluate(() => document.querySelectorAll("#probe-term-A .xterm-rows > div").length);
    check(domRows === fitted.rows, "the terminal itself has the size it sent", `${domRows} rows on screen, ${fitted.rows} sent`);

    const look = await tab.evaluate(() => {
      const box = document.querySelector("#probe-term-A .os-term");
      const rows = document.querySelector("#probe-term-A .xterm-rows");
      const red = [...document.querySelectorAll("#probe-term-A .xterm-rows span")].find((s) => s.textContent === "red");
      const st = rows ? getComputedStyle(rows) : null;
      const host = document.querySelector("#probe-term-A").getBoundingClientRect();
      const fill = box ? box.getBoundingClientRect() : null;
      return {
        bg: box ? getComputedStyle(box).backgroundColor : "",
        border: box ? getComputedStyle(box).borderTopWidth : "",
        fills: Boolean(fill) && Math.abs(fill.width - host.width) <= 1 && Math.abs(fill.height - host.height) <= 1,
        fg: st?.color || "",
        font: st?.fontFamily || "",
        size: st?.fontSize || "",
        red: red ? getComputedStyle(red).color : "",
        role: box?.getAttribute("role"),
        label: box?.getAttribute("aria-label")
      };
    });
    check(look.bg === "rgb(9, 11, 15)" && look.fg === "rgb(230, 233, 239)", "Cobalt ground and ink from --os-term-bg and --os-term-fg", JSON.stringify(look));
    check(look.red === "rgb(229, 103, 95)", "ANSI red is --os-ansi-1", look.red);
    check(/JetBrains Mono/.test(look.font) && look.size === "13px", "JetBrains Mono at 13 px", `${look.font} ${look.size}`);
    check(look.role === "group" && look.label === "Probe terminal A", "the terminal is a named group", JSON.stringify(look));
    check(look.fills && look.border === "0px", "it fills its box and draws no frame of its own (the page's frame is U3's)", JSON.stringify(look));
    await shotOf(tab, "A", "attached");

    a.msgs.length = 0;
    await tab.keyboard.type("a");
    await tab.keyboard.press("Control+KeyK");
    await tab.keyboard.press("Control+KeyR");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(300);
    check(ins(a).join("") === "a\u000b\u0012", "keys reach the agent, Ctrl+K and Ctrl+R included", JSON.stringify(ins(a)));

    const paletteOpen = async () => (await tab.locator(".os-palette").count()) > 0;
    a.msgs.length = 0;
    await tab.keyboard.press(isMac ? "Meta+KeyK" : "Control+Shift+KeyK");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(300);
    check(await paletteOpen(), "the palette key opens the palette from inside the terminal");
    check(ins(a).length === 0, "...and nothing of it reaches the agent", JSON.stringify(ins(a)));
    await tab.keyboard.press("Escape");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(300);
    const back = await tab.evaluate(() => Boolean(document.activeElement?.closest("#probe-term-A .xterm")));
    check(!(await paletteOpen()) && back, "Escape closes it and the keys go back to the terminal", String(back));

    a.msgs.length = 0;
    await tab.evaluate(() => {
      const ta = document.querySelector("#probe-term-A .xterm-helper-textarea");
      const dt = new DataTransfer();
      dt.setData("text/plain", "pasted text");
      ta.dispatchEvent(new ClipboardEvent("paste", { clipboardData: dt, bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
    });
    await tab.waitForTimeout(300);
    check(ins(a).join("") === "\u001b[200~pasted text\u001b[201~", "paste is wrapped in bracketed-paste marks (the snapshot's mode was put back)", JSON.stringify(ins(a)));

    a.msgs.length = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i += 1) out(a, "y".repeat(9999) + "\n");
    await until(tab, () => a.msgs.some((m) => m.t === "ack"), 5000);
    const acks = a.msgs.filter((m) => m.t === "ack");
    check(acks.length >= 1 && acks[0].seq >= 65536 && acks[0].seq <= 70000, "an ack once 64 KB are on screen", JSON.stringify(acks));
    a.ws.send(JSON.stringify({ t: "alert", raw: "bel" }));
    a.ws.send(JSON.stringify({ t: "state", status: "idle" }));
    await tab.waitForTimeout(300);
    const got = await tab.evaluate(() => ({ alerts: window.__probe.alerts, states: window.__probe.states }));
    check(got.alerts.some((x) => x.key === "A" && x.raw === "bel") && got.states.some((x) => x.key === "A" && x.status === "idle"), "alerts and state changes reach the page", JSON.stringify(got));

    a.msgs.length = 0;
    out(a, "\u001b]52;c;aGVsbG8=\u0007");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(400);
    let clip = await tab.evaluate(() => window.__clip);
    check(clip.writes.includes("hello"), "a program may copy to the clipboard (OSC 52 write)", JSON.stringify(clip));
    out(a, "\u001b]52;c;?\u0007");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(600);
    clip = await tab.evaluate(() => window.__clip);
    check(clip.reads === 0 && !ins(a).some((d) => d.includes("]52;")), "a program may never read the clipboard (an OSC 52 read gets no answer)", JSON.stringify({ clip, ins: ins(a) }));

    out(a, "\r\nsee https://example.com/docs now\r\nfile:///etc/hosts\r\nmail mailto:someone@example.com\r\n");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(400);
    const spot = await clickText(tab, "A", "example.com/docs");
    const opened = await tab.evaluate(() => window.__opened);
    check(opened.length === 1 && opened[0] === "https://example.com/docs", "an https link opens (a new tab in browser mode)", JSON.stringify({ spot, opened }));
    await clickText(tab, "A", "/etc/hosts");
    await clickText(tab, "A", "someone@example.com");
    const opened2 = await tab.evaluate(() => window.__opened);
    check(opened2.length === 1, "file: and mailto: text is never a link (Q45)", JSON.stringify(opened2));

    a.msgs.length = 0;
    await tab.evaluate(() => window.__probe.setSize("A", 700, 360));
    await until(tab, () => a.msgs.some((m) => m.t === "resize"), 2000);
    await tab.waitForTimeout(200);
    const resized = a.msgs.filter((m) => m.t === "resize");
    check(resized.length === 1 && resized[0].cols < fitted.cols, "a smaller box sends one new size", JSON.stringify(resized));

    await tab.evaluate(() => window.__probe.redraw("A"));
    await tab.waitForTimeout(600);
    check(count(IDS.A) === 1, "new callback functions from the page never reconnect", String(count(IDS.A)));

    const closedAt = Date.now();
    await a.ws.close({ code: 4000, reason: "too_far_behind" });
    await until(tab, () => count(IDS.A) === 2, 3000);
    const a2 = conn(IDS.A, 2);
    check(Boolean(a2) && a2.at - closedAt < 450, "too far behind: it attaches again at once (no 0.5 s wait)", a2 ? `${a2.at - closedAt} ms` : "no second attach");
    await until(tab, async () => /Second snapshot/.test(await screenText(tab, "A")), 3000);
    const text2 = await screenText(tab, "A");
    check(/Second snapshot/.test(text2) && !/Hello from the probe/.test(text2), "it shows only the fresh snapshot", text2.slice(0, 200));
    await until(tab, () => Boolean(a2?.msgs.some((m) => m.t === "focus")), 2000);
    check(a2?.msgs[0]?.t === "focus" && a2.msgs[1]?.t === "resize", "the terminal that had the keys takes them again after reattaching", JSON.stringify(a2?.msgs.slice(0, 2)));
    const logA = await tab.evaluate(() => window.__probe.connectionLog.filter((x) => x.key === "A").map((x) => x.c));
    check(JSON.stringify(logA) === JSON.stringify(["connecting", "open", "reconnecting", "open"]), "the page hears connecting, open, reconnecting, open", JSON.stringify(logA));
    check((await tab.locator("#probe-term-A .os-term__notice").count()) === 0, "no notice once it is back");

    a2.ws.send(JSON.stringify({ t: "state", status: "exited", exitCode: 0, signal: null, endedBy: null }));
    await tab.waitForTimeout(200);
    await a2.ws.close({ code: 4001, reason: "session_ended" });
    await tab.waitForTimeout(2500);
    const endedAs = await connectionOf(tab, "A");
    check(count(IDS.A) === 2 && endedAs === "ended" && /Second snapshot/.test(await screenText(tab, "A")), "an ended session keeps its last screen and is not attached again", `${count(IDS.A)} ${endedAs}`);

    await tab.evaluate((id) => window.__probe.mount("B", id, { webgl: false, width: 700, height: 300, autoFocus: false }), IDS.B);
    await until(tab, async () => /Mouse on/.test(await screenText(tab, "B")), 4000);
    const b = conn(IDS.B);
    check(Boolean(b) && !b.msgs.some((m) => m.t === "focus"), "a terminal without autoFocus does not take the keys", JSON.stringify(b?.msgs));
    const box = await tab.locator("#probe-term-B .xterm-screen").boundingBox();
    await tab.mouse.click(box.x + 40, box.y + 20);
    await tab.waitForTimeout(400);
    check(b.msgs.some((m) => m.t === "focus") && ins(b).some((d) => d.startsWith("\u001b[<0;")), "a click makes it the writer and is reported in SGR mouse form (the snapshot's mouse modes were put back)", JSON.stringify(b.msgs.slice(0, 6)));
    await tab.evaluate(() => window.__probe.unmount("B"));
    await tab.waitForTimeout(400);
    check(b.closed !== null, "unmounting closes its socket", String(b.closed));

    const sideways = await tab.evaluate(() => document.scrollingElement.scrollWidth > document.scrollingElement.clientWidth);
    check(!sideways, "no sideways scroll");
    check(errors.length === 0, "browser mode: console clean", errors.join(" | "));
    await context.close();
  }

  // ---- 3. Desktop app: ⌘T and ⌘1-9 bubble on to the page untouched; a link outside the opener's list is copied ----
  {
    const { context, tab, errors } = await open("runs&desktop=1");
    const isMac = await tab.evaluate(() => /mac/i.test(navigator.platform || navigator.userAgent || ""));
    await tab.evaluate((id) => window.__probe.mount("A", id, { webgl: false, width: 900, height: 420, autoFocus: true }), IDS.A);
    await until(tab, () => Boolean(conn(IDS.A)?.msgs.some((m) => m.t === "focus")), 5000);
    const a = conn(IDS.A);
    a.msgs.length = 0;
    await tab.evaluate(() => { window.__probe.bubbled = []; });
    await tab.keyboard.press(isMac ? "Meta+KeyT" : "Control+Shift+KeyT");
    await tab.keyboard.press(isMac ? "Meta+Digit3" : "Control+Shift+Digit3");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(300);
    const bubbled = await tab.evaluate(() => window.__probe.bubbled);
    const reached = (code) => bubbled.some((x) => x.code === code && x.prevented === false);
    check(reached("KeyT") && reached("Digit3"), "desktop app: ⌘T and ⌘1-9 (Ctrl+Shift+T / 1-9) reach the page's window handler, not prevented", JSON.stringify(bubbled));
    check(ins(a).length === 0, "...and nothing of them reaches the agent", JSON.stringify(ins(a)));

    // No Tauri here, so the opener refuses every address, as it refuses one outside its allow list (Q45).
    out(a, "\r\nsee https://example.org/pr/1 now\r\n");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(400);
    const spot = await clickText(tab, "A", "example.org/pr/1");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(300);
    const clip = await tab.evaluate(() => window.__clip);
    const notices = await tab.evaluate(() => window.__probe.notices);
    check(
      clip.writes.includes("https://example.org/pr/1") && notices.some((n) => n.key === "A" && n.text === "Link copied. Open it in your browser."),
      'desktop app: a link the opener refuses is copied, and the page is handed "Link copied. Open it in your browser."',
      JSON.stringify({ spot, clip, notices })
    );
    check((await noticeText(tab, "A")) === "", "the terminal does not show that sentence itself (the page shows it once)", await noticeText(tab, "A"));
    check((await tab.evaluate(() => window.__opened.length)) === 0, "desktop app: no browser window is opened from the page");
    check(errors.length === 0, "desktop mode: console clean", errors.join(" | "));
    await context.close();
  }

  // ---- 4. WebGL as a setting, and back to the DOM renderer when its context is lost ----
  {
    const { context, tab, errors } = await open("runs");
    await tab.evaluate((id) => window.__probe.mount("C", id, { webgl: true, width: 700, height: 300, autoFocus: false }), IDS.C);
    await until(tab, () => Boolean(conn(IDS.C)), 4000);
    await tab.waitForTimeout(800);
    const renderer = () =>
      tab.evaluate(() => ({
        canvas: document.querySelectorAll("#probe-term-C canvas").length,
        rows: document.querySelectorAll("#probe-term-C .xterm-rows").length
      }));
    const before = await renderer();
    if (before.canvas > 0) {
      pass("WebGL: the WebGL renderer draws when the setting is on");
      await tab.evaluate(() => {
        for (const c of document.querySelectorAll("#probe-term-C canvas")) c.getContext("webgl2")?.getExtension("WEBGL_lose_context")?.loseContext();
      });
      // xterm waits 3 s for the context to come back before it reports the loss.
      await tab.waitForTimeout(4000);
      const after = await renderer();
      check(after.rows >= 1 && /WebGL terminal/.test(await screenText(tab, "C")), "WebGL: a lost context falls back to the DOM renderer, text still on screen", JSON.stringify(after));
    } else {
      check(before.rows >= 1, "WebGL is not available in this browser: the DOM renderer was kept", JSON.stringify(before));
    }
    check(errors.length === 0, "WebGL: console clean", errors.join(" | "));
    await context.close();
  }

  // ---- 5. A dropped connection (Q40): the pace, "Lost the connection", Reconnect, the page's `ended`, "wait" ----
  {
    const { context, tab, errors } = await open("runs");
    await tab.evaluate((ids) => {
      window.__probe.mount("D", ids.D, { webgl: false, width: 700, height: 260, autoFocus: false });
      window.__probe.mount("E", ids.E, { webgl: false, width: 700, height: 260, autoFocus: false });
    }, IDS);
    await until(tab, async () => /Drop test/.test(await screenText(tab, "D")) && /Ended test/.test(await screenText(tab, "E")), 5000);
    const d1 = conn(IDS.D);
    const e1 = conn(IDS.E);
    // From now on every attach of D and E is refused the way S9 refuses one, and every attach of F with attach_failed.
    refuse.set(IDS.D, { code: 1006, reason: "" });
    refuse.set(IDS.E, { code: 1006, reason: "" });
    refuse.set(IDS.F, { code: 4004, reason: "attach_failed" });
    await tab.evaluate((id) => window.__probe.mount("F", id, { webgl: false, width: 700, height: 120, autoFocus: false }), IDS.F);
    const droppedAt = Date.now();
    await d1.ws.close({ code: 1006, reason: "" });
    await e1.ws.close({ code: 1006, reason: "" });
    // The page's list now says E has ended (U3 passes ended={status === "exited"}).
    await tab.evaluate(() => window.__probe.setEnded("E", true));
    check(await until(tab, async () => (await connectionOf(tab, "E")) === "ended", 300), "the page's ended stops the tries at once");
    const eCount = count(IDS.E);

    await until(tab, () => count(IDS.D) >= 3, 3000);
    check((await noticeText(tab, "D")) === "Reconnecting…", "Reconnecting… while it waits", await noticeText(tab, "D"));
    await until(tab, () => count(IDS.F) >= 2, 8000);
    const f1 = conn(IDS.F, 1);
    const f2 = conn(IDS.F, 2);
    check(Boolean(f2) && f2.at - f1.at >= 4500 && f2.at - f1.at <= 6500, "attach_failed: the next try waits 5 s, not 0.5 s", f2 ? `${f2.at - f1.at} ms` : "no second try");
    await tab.evaluate(() => window.__probe.unmount("F"));

    await until(tab, () => count(IDS.D) >= 6, 17000);
    const times = [droppedAt, ...[2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((n) => conn(IDS.D, n)?.at ?? 0)];
    const gaps = times.slice(1).map((t, i) => t - times[i]);
    const want = [500, 1000, 2000, 5000, 5000];
    check(gaps.every((g, i) => g >= want[i] - 150 && g <= want[i] + 900), "five tries after 0.5, 1, 2, 5 and 5 s", JSON.stringify(gaps));
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
    check(count(IDS.D) === 6 && (await connectionOf(tab, "D")) === "lost", "then it stops trying", `${count(IDS.D)} ${await connectionOf(tab, "D")}`);
    const button = tab.locator("#probe-term-D .os-term__notice button", { hasText: "Reconnect" });
    check((await noticeText(tab, "D")) === "Lost the connection to this session." && (await button.count()) === 1, 'it says "Lost the connection to this session." with a Reconnect button', await noticeText(tab, "D"));
    check(/Drop test/.test(await screenText(tab, "D")), "the last screen stays while it is lost");
    check(count(IDS.E) === eCount && (await connectionOf(tab, "E")) === "ended" && /Ended test/.test(await screenText(tab, "E")), "an ended terminal makes no more tries and keeps its last screen", `${count(IDS.E)} ${eCount}`);
    await shotOf(tab, "D", "lost");

    refuse.delete(IDS.D);
    const clickAt = Date.now();
    await button.click();
    await until(tab, () => count(IDS.D) >= 7, 2000);
    const d7 = conn(IDS.D, 7);
    check(Boolean(d7) && d7.at - clickAt < 450, "Reconnect tries again at once", d7 ? `${d7.at - clickAt} ms` : "no new attach");
    await until(tab, async () => /Back again/.test(await screenText(tab, "D")), 3000);
    await until(tab, () => Boolean(d7?.msgs.some((m) => m.t === "focus")), 2000);
    check((await connectionOf(tab, "D")) === "open" && (await tab.locator("#probe-term-D .os-term__notice").count()) === 0 && d7.msgs.some((m) => m.t === "focus"), "back with a fresh screen, no notice, and it has the keys", JSON.stringify(d7?.msgs.slice(0, 3)));
    refuse.clear();
    check(errors.length === 0, "reconnect: console clean", errors.join(" | "));
    await context.close();
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 9: Run the probe and the keyboard path, one at a time.**

```bash
npm run build >/dev/null && node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs probe .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/terminal.mjs | grep -E "^(PASS|FAIL)"
node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs probe .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/kbdpath.mjs | grep -E "^FAIL"
lsof -nP -iTCP:8791 -sTCP:LISTEN | wc -l
```

Expected:
- every `terminal.mjs` line is PASS (about 50 lines; the probe takes about a minute, because part 5 waits through the whole reconnect pace); the WebGL part prints either its two WebGL lines or "WebGL is not available in this browser: the DOM renderer was kept";
- no FAIL from `kbdpath`;
- `0` listeners on 8791.

#### Notes

1. **Links in the desktop app (owner, ruling R25).** A terminal link opens only when its address is on the opener's allow list (`desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/default.json`, approved in commit `8264b2b`). Agents print many other addresses (pull requests, docs, sign-in pages); those are copied, and the Sessions page says "Link copied. Open it in your browser." Opening them directly would need a wider opener scope, a security choice for the owner. `mailto:` text is never a link (Q45). There is no Ctrl+Shift+C/V in SP3, so on Windows and Linux Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V reach the agent (Ctrl+C interrupts, as in any terminal) and paste works through the context menu; ⌘\ also reaches the agent in SP3 (split arrives with SP4).
2. **Copy for the owner's review (E1, decision Q32).** One sentence is new: "Agent OS couldn't open or copy that link.", shown only when the window refuses the copy too. The probe saves the lost notice ("Lost the connection to this session." with "Reconnect") at `.superpowers/ui-audit/shots/terminal/1470x956/lost.png` for the review.
3. **Deliberate limits.** A viewer (a second window without the keys) fits its own box; the agent draws for the writer's size, so a viewer of another size may wrap lines differently until it takes the keys (the protocol has no "size changed" frame from the server). X10 mouse reports with bytes above 127 are dropped (D-U2-8). `tokens.css` has one terminal theme today; the contrast test checks every block that sets a terminal token, so a later light theme is tested without changing the test.
4. **Names beyond the contract's list:** `RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS`, the optional `advice` argument of `reconnectDelay`, and the classes `.os-term__notice-text` and `.os-term__notice--lost`. The handle's `findNext`, `findPrevious` and `clearSearch` use the search addon the spec asks for; SP3 has no search box.
5. **What was checked while drafting.** The xterm packages arrive with W0, so the probe itself has not run. In a throwaway copy: `tsc` passed with U1's drafted `types.ts` block, `sessionsShared.ts`, `sessionsApi.ts` and `palette.ts` and the typings of the exact pinned xterm set; the test file gave Steps 2, 4 and 7 exactly as written; and the component's connection logic ran in Chrome with xterm stubbed and the server played by `routeWebSocket` (the checks of the probe's part 5, too far behind, the exited close, the desktop link copy). All passed, and removing the five-try limit, the at-once rule for `too_far_behind` or the `ended` effect each made a check fail. In review, the whole probe then ran in a throwaway copy with the exact pinned xterm set and U1's drafted files: an earlier `restore()` that resized inside a write callback left the terminal at the snapshot's size (the link checks failed), and an earlier probe mounted on the Sessions page failed once U3's ⌘T handler arrived; with `restore()` as written above (D-U2-7) and the probe on the Runs page in its own layer, every check passed, before and after U1-U4.

### Task U3: Sessions page (tabs, side panel, New session dialog, Stop dialog, ended state, empty state, settings menu)

This task turns the SP2 placeholder at `?page=sessions` into the real Sessions page of `prototype/sessions.html`, in its SP3 form: a tab per session (an ended tab reads "Ended · open recording" and can be dismissed), the agent's own terminal in the middle (the `SessionTerminal` component from Task U2), and the selected session's side panel on the right (336 px, 304 px at ≤ 1320 px): folder, agent, state in words, every Live meter row with "—" and the hint "— means unknown", and a footer with Recorded, Stop session and the keyboard hints (desktop app only). It also builds the one New session dialog (agent and folder: recent folders, the native folder picker in the desktop app, a typed full path in a browser tab, OpenClaw without a folder, the Look only note), which the Shell mounts like New run so that Home, Agents (Task U4), the palette and ⌘T all open the same dialog; the Stop dialog and the Resume confirm with the decided words; the designed empty state; the "Terminal settings" menu; the quiet login-shell notice; and ⌘T / ⌘1-9 in the desktop app. The prototype has no picture of the ended tab, the empty state, the settings menu or the folder field's states, so those are built from the Cobalt kit and shown to Harsha in Task E1 (decision Q32).

Why it is built this way, in plain words: the list of sessions comes from the one shared poll (`useSessionsList`, decision Q30), so the menu count, Home and this page never disagree; only the selected tab's terminal is attached (the others keep running in the engine and come back with their screen when picked); the selected tab lives in the address (`?session=<id>`), so leaving the page and coming back lands on the same tab; and a session that ends while you watch keeps its last screen on view, so an agent's own error message stays readable.

```js
// The Sessions page's pure logic (src/ui/sessionsPageShared.ts) and the New session dialog's
// (src/ui/newSession.ts): tab order and selection, the ended tab's words, the Live meter rows, the
// New session button's hint, the terminal's own settings, and the words for a start, stop, resume or
// dismiss that went wrong. (Titles, status words, the Stop and Resume words and the app shortcuts are
// Task U1's, tested in test/sessions-shared.test.js.) Node strips the TypeScript types itself (decision P14), so the .ts files are imported
// directly; both files keep only `import type` imports. No server, no browser: the page itself is
// checked by the Sessions probe of the UI audit (.superpowers/ui-audit/probes/sessions.mjs).
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { test } from "node:test";
import * as dialog from "../src/ui/newSession.ts";
import * as page from "../src/ui/sessionsPageShared.ts";

const NOW = Date.parse("2026-10-14T15:00:00.000Z");
const iso = (msAgo) => new Date(NOW - msAgo).toISOString();
const session = (over = {}) => ({
  id: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", kind: "agent", agentId: "claude", agentLabel: "Claude Code",
  folder: "/Users/you/projects/my-app", folderName: "my-app", folderShown: true, branch: null,
  status: "live", stateSince: iso(700_000), startedAt: iso(760_000), endedAt: null, exitCode: null, signal: null, endedBy: null,
  dismissed: false, brain: { kind: "plan", label: "Plan" }, resume: { available: false, reason: null, fallback: false },
  alerts: "basic", recordingBytes: 0, ...over
});
// What src/api.ts throws for a refusal: name "ApiError", message = the code, detail = the server's sentence.
const apiError = (code, detail = "") => Object.assign(new Error(code), { name: "ApiError", detail, status: 400 });
const LOOK_ONLY = "Safety is on Look only, so no session can start. Allow running agents in Safety, then try again.";

test("tabs keep their place: known ids stay in order, new ones join at the end in the list's order", () => {
  // The server lists sessions by their first start (meta.json createdAt), which a resume never changes.
  const a = session({ id: "a", startedAt: iso(30_000) });
  const b = session({ id: "b", startedAt: iso(60_000) });
  const c = session({ id: "c", startedAt: iso(10_000) });
  assert.deepEqual(page.stableOrder([], [a, b]), ["a", "b"], "a page opened fresh shows the list's order, not the latest start");
  assert.deepEqual(page.stableOrder(["b", "a"], [a, b, c]), ["b", "a", "c"]);
  // Resume keeps the session id: a resumed tab keeps its place even with a newer start time.
  assert.deepEqual(page.stableOrder(["b", "a", "c"], [a, session({ id: "b", startedAt: iso(1000) }), c]), ["b", "a", "c"]);
  assert.deepEqual(page.stableOrder(["b", "a", "c"], [a, c]), ["a", "c"]);
});

test("tabs: open sessions and ended ones not dismissed; an open session always shows; update sessions never", () => {
  const live = session({ id: "live" });
  const ended = session({ id: "ended", status: "exited", endedAt: iso(5000) });
  const gone = session({ id: "gone", status: "exited", dismissed: true });
  const back = session({ id: "back", status: "starting", dismissed: true });
  const upd = session({ id: "upd", kind: "update" });
  const order = ["live", "ended", "gone", "back", "upd"];
  assert.deepEqual(page.visibleTabs([live, ended, gone, back, upd], order).map((s) => s.id), ["live", "ended", "back"]);
  assert.deepEqual(page.visibleTabs([live, ended], ["live", "ended"], new Set(["ended"])).map((s) => s.id), ["live"], "dismissed here, before the list says so");
});

test("the selected tab: the one asked for, else the first open one, else the first", () => {
  const tabs = [session({ id: "e1", status: "exited" }), session({ id: "l1" }), session({ id: "l2", status: "idle" })];
  assert.equal(page.pickSelected(tabs, "l2"), "l2");
  assert.equal(page.pickSelected(tabs, "missing"), "l1");
  assert.equal(page.pickSelected(tabs, ""), "l1");
  assert.equal(page.pickSelected([session({ id: "e1", status: "exited" })], ""), "e1");
  assert.equal(page.pickSelected([], "x"), "");
});

test("an ended tab says so; Dismiss names the tab; the waiting and held markers (SP4) are words", () => {
  assert.equal(page.tabLabel("Claude Code · my-app", "exited"), "Claude Code · my-app · Ended · open recording");
  assert.equal(page.tabLabel("Claude Code · my-app", "live"), "Claude Code · my-app");
  assert.equal(page.dismissLabel("Claude Code · my-app"), "Dismiss Claude Code · my-app");
  assert.equal(page.tabMarker("live"), null);
  assert.equal(page.tabMarker("exited"), null);
  assert.deepEqual(page.tabMarker("waiting"), { kind: "waiting", word: "Waiting for you" });
  assert.deepEqual(page.tabMarker("held"), { kind: "held", word: "Plan ran out" });
});

test("a resumed session gets a fresh terminal: its generation goes up when it comes back from ended", () => {
  let gens = page.nextGenerations({}, [session({ id: "s", status: "live" })]);
  assert.equal(page.terminalKey("s", gens), "s:0");
  gens = page.nextGenerations(gens, [session({ id: "s", status: "exited" })]);
  assert.equal(page.terminalKey("s", gens), "s:0", "ending keeps the same terminal, so its last screen stays");
  gens = page.nextGenerations(gens, [session({ id: "s", status: "starting" })]);
  assert.equal(page.terminalKey("s", gens), "s:1");
  gens = page.nextGenerations(gens, [session({ id: "s", status: "live" })]);
  assert.equal(page.terminalKey("s", gens), "s:1");
  assert.equal(page.terminalKey("other", gens), "other:0");
});

test("Live meter: every row, and null (shown as —) for each one whose source arrives later", () => {
  assert.equal(page.durationWords(iso(40_000), NOW), "40 s");
  assert.equal(page.durationWords(iso(760_000), NOW), "12 m 40 s");
  assert.equal(page.durationWords(iso(65 * 60_000), NOW), "1 h 05 m");
  assert.equal(page.durationWords(null, NOW), "—");
  assert.equal(page.durationWords(iso(-5000), NOW), "—");
  assert.deepEqual(page.meterRows(session(), NOW).map((r) => [r.label, r.value, r.dim ?? null]), [
    ["Brain", "Plan", "your subscription"],
    ["Model", null, null],
    ["Running for", "12 m 40 s", null],
    ["Context used", null, null],
    ["Plan used", null, null]
  ]);
  const openrouter = page.meterRows(session({ brain: { kind: "openrouter", label: "OpenRouter" } }), NOW);
  assert.deepEqual(openrouter.map((r) => r.label), ["Brain", "Model", "Running for", "Context used", "Cost so far"]);
  assert.equal(openrouter[0].dim, "pay per use");
  assert.equal(page.meterRows(session({ brain: { kind: "local", label: "Local" } }), NOW)[0].dim, "on this computer");
  const none = page.meterRows(session({ agentId: "hermes", brain: null }), NOW);
  assert.deepEqual(none.map((r) => [r.label, r.value]), [["Brain", null], ["Model", null], ["Running for", "12 m 40 s"], ["Context used", null]]);
  const ended = page.meterRows(session({ status: "exited", endedAt: iso(160_000) }), NOW);
  assert.deepEqual(ended[2], { id: "time", label: "Ran for", value: "10 m 00 s" });
  assert.equal(page.meterRows(session({ status: "exited", endedAt: null }), NOW)[2].value, null, "an unknown end is —, never a time that keeps growing");
});

test("the panel's folder and the OpenClaw stop note", () => {
  assert.equal(page.panelFolder(session()), "my-app");
  assert.equal(page.panelFolder(session({ agentId: "openclaw", folderShown: false, folderName: "you" })), "Set by OpenClaw");
  assert.equal(page.OPENCLAW_STOP_NOTE, "Stopped the terminal. OpenClaw may still be finishing its last step.");
  assert.equal(page.stopResultNote(session({ agentId: "openclaw", status: "exited", endedBy: "stop" })), page.OPENCLAW_STOP_NOTE);
  assert.equal(page.stopResultNote(session({ status: "exited", endedBy: "stop" })), null);
  assert.equal(page.stopResultNote(session({ agentId: "openclaw", status: "exited", endedBy: "quit" })), null);
  // Right after a Stop from this page, the server's own note wins, null included; it lasts while that ended run is on show.
  const openclawEnded = session({ agentId: "openclaw", status: "exited", endedBy: "stop" });
  assert.equal(page.panelStopNote(openclawEnded, "s:0", { key: "s:0", note: null }), null, "the server said nothing is left running");
  assert.equal(page.panelStopNote(session({ status: "exited", endedBy: "stop" }), "s:0", { key: "s:0", note: "Server words." }), "Server words.");
  assert.equal(page.panelStopNote(openclawEnded, "s:0", null), page.OPENCLAW_STOP_NOTE, "an ended tab opened later: the session's own rule");
  assert.equal(page.panelStopNote(openclawEnded, "s:1", { key: "s:0", note: null }), page.OPENCLAW_STOP_NOTE, "a note from an earlier run does not apply");
  assert.equal(page.panelStopNote(session({ agentId: "openclaw" }), "s:0", { key: "s:0", note: page.OPENCLAW_STOP_NOTE }), null, "the list does not say ended yet, or it runs again");
});

test("terminal settings kept in this browser: kitty on; DOM drawing on WebKit (macOS, Linux app), WebGL elsewhere; junk is ignored", () => {
  assert.equal(page.TERMINAL_PREFS_KEY, "agentos.terminalPrefs");
  const mac = { platform: "MacIntel", desktop: false };
  const macApp = { platform: "MacIntel", desktop: true };
  const linuxApp = { platform: "Linux x86_64", desktop: true };
  const linuxTab = { platform: "Linux x86_64", desktop: false };
  const windowsApp = { platform: "Win32", desktop: true };
  const windowsTab = { platform: "Win32", desktop: false };
  // Decision Q45: DOM on macOS and in the Linux desktop app (both WebKit), WebGL in the Windows app and in a
  // browser tab on Windows or Linux.
  assert.deepEqual(page.defaultTerminalPrefs(mac), { kittyKeyboard: true, webgl: false });
  assert.deepEqual(page.defaultTerminalPrefs(macApp), { kittyKeyboard: true, webgl: false });
  assert.deepEqual(page.defaultTerminalPrefs(linuxApp), { kittyKeyboard: true, webgl: false });
  assert.deepEqual(page.defaultTerminalPrefs(linuxTab), { kittyKeyboard: true, webgl: true });
  assert.deepEqual(page.defaultTerminalPrefs(windowsApp), { kittyKeyboard: true, webgl: true });
  assert.deepEqual(page.defaultTerminalPrefs(windowsTab), { kittyKeyboard: true, webgl: true });
  assert.deepEqual(page.defaultTerminalPrefs({ platform: "", desktop: false }), { kittyKeyboard: true, webgl: true }, "an unknown computer gets WebGL, with the terminal's own DOM fallback");
  assert.deepEqual(page.parseTerminalPrefs(null, macApp), { kittyKeyboard: true, webgl: false });
  assert.deepEqual(page.parseTerminalPrefs(null, windowsApp), { kittyKeyboard: true, webgl: true });
  assert.deepEqual(page.parseTerminalPrefs("{not json", linuxApp), { kittyKeyboard: true, webgl: false });
  assert.deepEqual(page.parseTerminalPrefs('{"kittyKeyboard":false,"webgl":"yes"}', mac), { kittyKeyboard: false, webgl: false });
  const saved = page.serializeTerminalPrefs({ kittyKeyboard: false, webgl: true });
  assert.deepEqual(page.parseTerminalPrefs(saved, mac), { kittyKeyboard: false, webgl: true }, "a choice the person made wins over the default");
});
```
