```ts
// Pure logic of the New session dialog: how any page asks for it, the checks that give a plain reason before
// anything is sent, and the words for what the server may answer. No React and only `import type` (decision
// P14), so `node --test` loads it straight from src/ (test/sessions-page-logic.test.js).
import type { ExecutionGateStatus } from "../types";

export const NEW_SESSION_EVENT = "aos-new-session";
export interface NewSessionRequest {
  agentId?: string;
}

// The Shell listens for this and shows the one New session dialog, so the Sessions page's button and ⌘T, Home,
// Agents and the palette all open the same thing.
export function openNewSession(request: NewSessionRequest = {}) {
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent<NewSessionRequest>(NEW_SESSION_EVENT, { detail: request }));
}

// The dialog's agent order (the prototype's): the three coding agents, then Hermes and OpenClaw.
export const SESSION_AGENT_ORDER = ["claude", "codex", "cursor", "hermes", "openclaw"];

// The agent the dialog starts on: the one asked for, else the first installed one, else Claude Code.
export function pickSessionAgent(agents: Array<{ id: string; detected: { installed: boolean } }> | null, wanted?: string): string {
  if (wanted && SESSION_AGENT_ORDER.includes(wanted)) return wanted;
  const installed = agents ? SESSION_AGENT_ORDER.find((id) => agents.some((agent) => agent.id === id && agent.detected.installed)) : undefined;
  return installed || SESSION_AGENT_ORDER[0];
}

// Decision Q15, verbatim.
export const LOOK_ONLY_NOTE = "Safety is on Look only, so no session can start. Allow running agents in Safety, then try again.";

// true at Look only (the server's level 0 is "the gate is off"), false when a session may start, null while not known.
export function isLookOnly(gate: Pick<ExecutionGateStatus, "enabled" | "level"> | null): boolean | null {
  if (!gate) return null;
  if (gate.enabled === false) return true;
  return typeof gate.level === "number" ? gate.level === 0 : false;
}

// OpenClaw starts in your home folder until spike S5 checks that it honours a chosen folder (spec, Launch
// profiles), so the dialog offers no folder for it and says so.
export const OPENCLAW_FOLDER_NOTE = "OpenClaw picks its own folder for now.";
export function needsFolder(agentId: string): boolean {
  return agentId !== "openclaw";
}

export const FOLDER_FORMAT_PROBLEM = "Type the full path, starting with / (or a drive letter on Windows).";
export const FOLDER_EXAMPLE = "For example /Users/you/projects/my-app";

// A folder typed in a browser tab (a browser picker cannot give a full path). Empty: nothing to say yet.
// Everything else (inside your home folder, not Agent OS's own folder, a real folder) is the server's check.
export function typedFolderProblem(text: string): string {
  const value = text.trim();
  if (!value) return "";
  if (value.startsWith("/") || /^[A-Za-z]:[\\/]/.test(value)) return "";
  return FOLDER_FORMAT_PROBLEM;
}

// Open agent sessions count toward the most at once; ended ones and update sessions do not (spec, Session kinds).
export function liveSessionCount(sessions: Array<{ status: string; kind?: string }>): number {
  return sessions.filter((session) => session.kind !== "update" && session.status !== "exited").length;
}
// Decision Q25's words, with the server's own number.
export function maxLiveNote(maxLive: number): string {
  return `Agent OS runs at most ${maxLive} sessions at once. Stop one, then try again.`;
}

// The start got no answer in time (or the connection dropped). The session may well have started, so the words
// never say "nothing started"; they send the person to the tabs to look.
export const START_NO_ANSWER =
  "Agent OS hasn't answered. The session may have started: look at the tabs on the Sessions page before you press Start session again.";

export interface StartProblem {
  text: string;
  // "folder": the words belong under the Folder field (the server's folder policy refused it).
  field?: "folder";
  // Which way out the dialog offers next to the words.
  fix?: "safety" | "setup" | "sessions";
}

// The words for a start that failed. An error that is not Agent OS's own answer (src/api.ts throws an Error named
// "ApiError" for those) is no answer at all.
export function startProblem(error: unknown): StartProblem {
  if (!(error instanceof Error) || error.name !== "ApiError") return { text: START_NO_ANSWER, fix: "sessions" };
  const code = error.message;
  const detail = String((error as Error & { detail?: unknown }).detail || "").trim();
  if (code === "folder_refused") return { text: detail || "Agent OS can't use that folder. Pick another one.", field: "folder" };
  if (code === "execution_gate_off") return { text: LOOK_ONLY_NOTE, fix: "safety" };
  if (code === "agent_not_installed") return { text: detail || "That agent isn't installed, or Agent OS can't find it. Install it in Setup, then try again.", fix: "setup" };
  if (code === "not_available") return { text: "Sessions are not available in this mode of Agent OS." };
  return { text: detail || "Agent OS couldn't start the session." };
}

// What the person picked and typed, kept in memory while the app stays open: closing the dialog, or going to
// Safety or Setup to fix what blocked it, never loses a typed folder (SP2 lesson). A start clears it.
let draft: { agentId: string; folder: string } | null = null;
export function rememberSessionDraft(next: { agentId: string; folder: string } | null) {
  draft = next;
}
export function peekSessionDraft(): { agentId: string; folder: string } | null {
  return draft;
}

// After Start session (or Resume conversation in Runs) the button that was pressed is gone, so the new session's
// terminal takes the keyboard. A one-shot flag, because the Sessions page may not be mounted yet.
let focusNextSession = false;
export function askToFocusNextSession() {
  focusNextSession = true;
}
export function takeFocusNextSession(): boolean {
  const asked = focusNextSession;
  focusNextSession = false;
  return asked;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Write `src/ui/sessionsPageShared.ts`.**

```ts
// The Sessions page's pure logic: the order of the tabs, which tab is selected, an ended tab's words, the side
// panel's Live meter rows, the New session button's hint, the terminal's own settings, and the words for a
// stop, resume or dismiss that went wrong. `import type` only (decision P14): test/sessions-page-logic.test.js
// loads this file straight from src/. Runs → Session recordings (recordingsShared.ts) keeps a copy of
// durationWords, checked by its test, because Node cannot follow an import written without a file extension.
import type { SessionSummary } from "../types";

type Tabbable = Pick<SessionSummary, "id" | "kind" | "status" | "dismissed">;

// Tabs keep their place: ids already shown stay in the order they were first seen, and new ones join at the end
// in the list's own order. The server sorts the list by each session's first start (meta.json createdAt, which a
// resume never changes), so a page opened fresh shows the same order too. Resume keeps the session id, so a
// resumed tab never jumps.
export function stableOrder(prev: string[], sessions: Array<Pick<SessionSummary, "id">>): string[] {
  const present = new Set(sessions.map((session) => session.id));
  const kept = prev.filter((id) => present.has(id));
  const known = new Set(kept);
  const added = sessions.filter((session) => !known.has(session.id)).map((session) => session.id);
  return [...kept, ...added];
}

// The tabs: every open agent session, and every ended one that was not dismissed (here, or in meta.json). An open
// session always shows, even if an old dismissal is still stored. Update sessions are never tabs (spec, Session kinds).
export function visibleTabs<T extends Tabbable>(sessions: T[], order: string[], hidden: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set<string>()): T[] {
  const byId = new Map(sessions.map((session) => [session.id, session]));
  return order
    .map((id) => byId.get(id))
    .filter((session): session is T => Boolean(session))
    .filter((session) => session.kind !== "update")
    .filter((session) => session.status !== "exited" || (!session.dismissed && !hidden.has(session.id)));
}

// The selected tab: the one asked for (?session=), else the first open one, else the first ended one, else none.
export function pickSelected(tabs: Array<Pick<SessionSummary, "id" | "status">>, wanted: string): string {
  if (wanted && tabs.some((tab) => tab.id === wanted)) return wanted;
  return (tabs.find((tab) => tab.status !== "exited") || tabs[0])?.id || "";
}

// Decision copy: an ended tab reads "<agent> · <folder> · Ended · open recording".
export const ENDED_WORDS = "Ended · open recording";
export function tabLabel(title: string, status: string): string {
  return status === "exited" ? `${title} · ${ENDED_WORDS}` : title;
}

// The marker after a tab's title (spec, Session activity states). No SP3 session is waiting or held; SP4's alerts
// bring these two.
export function tabMarker(status: string): { kind: "waiting" | "held"; word: string } | null {
  if (status === "waiting") return { kind: "waiting", word: "Waiting for you" };
  if (status === "held") return { kind: "held", word: "Plan ran out" };
  return null;
}

export function dismissLabel(title: string): string {
  return `Dismiss ${title}`;
}

// A resumed session starts a new process under the same id. Each time a session comes back from ended, its
// generation goes up, so the page attaches a fresh terminal instead of reusing the ended one. Ending does not
// change it, so the terminal that was on screen when the session ended keeps its last screen.
export type Generations = Record<string, { status: string; gen: number }>;
export function nextGenerations(prev: Generations, sessions: Array<Pick<SessionSummary, "id" | "status">>): Generations {
  const out: Generations = {};
  for (const session of sessions) {
    const before = prev[session.id];
    const gen = before ? before.gen + (before.status === "exited" && session.status !== "exited" ? 1 : 0) : 0;
    out[session.id] = { status: session.status, gen };
  }
  return out;
}
export function terminalKey(id: string, gens: Generations): string {
  return `${id}:${gens[id]?.gen ?? 0}`;
}

// "40 s", "12 m 40 s", "1 h 05 m"; "—" when the start is not known (or lies in the future).
export function durationWords(fromIso: string | null | undefined, toMs: number): string {
  const from = fromIso ? Date.parse(fromIso) : NaN;
  if (!Number.isFinite(from) || !Number.isFinite(toMs) || toMs < from) return "—";
  const seconds = Math.floor((toMs - from) / 1000);
  if (seconds < 60) return `${seconds} s`;
  const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes} m ${String(seconds % 60).padStart(2, "0")} s`;
  return `${Math.floor(minutes / 60)} h ${String(minutes % 60).padStart(2, "0")} m`;
}

// The Brain row, in the prototype's words.
export function brainWords(brain: SessionSummary["brain"]): { main: string; dim: string } | null {
  if (!brain) return null;
  if (brain.kind === "plan") return { main: "Plan", dim: "your subscription" };
  if (brain.kind === "openrouter") return { main: "OpenRouter", dim: "pay per use" };
  if (brain.kind === "local") return { main: "Local", dim: "on this computer" };
  return null;
}

export interface MeterRow {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  // null: not known, shown as "—" (with "unknown" for screen readers).
  value: string | null;
  dim?: string;
}

// Every Live meter row from SP3 (spec, Side panel). Model, Context used, Plan used and Cost so far come from
// Claude's statusLine in SP4, so they are null today. Plan used is for a plan brain and Cost so far for an
// OpenRouter brain, as in the prototype; neither applies to a Local brain or an agent with no brain choice.
export function meterRows(s: Pick<SessionSummary, "brain" | "status" | "startedAt" | "endedAt">, now: number): MeterRow[] {
  const brain = brainWords(s.brain);
  const ended = s.status === "exited";
  const endMs = ended ? (s.endedAt ? Date.parse(s.endedAt) : NaN) : now;
  const time = durationWords(s.startedAt, endMs);
  const rows: MeterRow[] = [
    brain ? { id: "brain", label: "Brain", value: brain.main, dim: brain.dim } : { id: "brain", label: "Brain", value: null },
    { id: "model", label: "Model", value: null },
    { id: "time", label: ended ? "Ran for" : "Running for", value: time === "—" ? null : time },
    { id: "context", label: "Context used", value: null }
  ];
  if (s.brain?.kind === "plan") rows.push({ id: "plan", label: "Plan used", value: null });
  if (s.brain?.kind === "openrouter") rows.push({ id: "cost", label: "Cost so far", value: null });
  return rows;
}

// The panel's title: the folder's name, or "Set by OpenClaw" while OpenClaw picks its own folder (spec L388).
export function panelFolder(s: Pick<SessionSummary, "folderShown" | "folderName">): string {
  return s.folderShown === false ? "Set by OpenClaw" : s.folderName || "—";
}

// After Stop, OpenClaw's Gateway may still finish its step (until spike S5 brings its abort): the spec's honest note.
// Used only for an ended OpenClaw tab opened later (after a reload, or stopped from another window); right after a
// Stop from this page the panel shows the server's own note instead (panelStopNote below).
// This mirrors S7's OPENCLAW_STOP_NOTE rule (server/runtime/sessions/soft-stop.js); update both when spike S5 lands.
export const OPENCLAW_STOP_NOTE = "Stopped the terminal. OpenClaw may still be finishing its last step.";
export function stopResultNote(s: Pick<SessionSummary, "agentId" | "status" | "endedBy">): string | null {
  return s.agentId === "openclaw" && s.status === "exited" && s.endedBy === "stop" ? OPENCLAW_STOP_NOTE : null;
}

// The note under the panel's state line. Right after a Stop from this page it is the server's own answer (S7's
// `note`, passed through by S8; null when nothing is left running), kept with the terminal key of the run that was
// stopped, so it applies only while the list says that same run has ended (a resume raises the key). Any other
// time it is stopResultNote's rule.
export interface StopNote {
  key: string;
  note: string | null;
}
export function panelStopNote(
  s: Pick<SessionSummary, "agentId" | "status" | "endedBy">,
  key: string,
  stopped: StopNote | null
): string | null {
  if (stopped && stopped.key === key && s.status === "exited") return stopped.note;
  return stopResultNote(s);
}

// (Why Resume can't be pressed is resumeConfirmCopy(s).blocked, and which key is an app shortcut is isAppShortcut,
// both in sessionsShared.ts, Task U1.)

// The tab bar's New session button names its shortcut only where the page really receives it (spec: a browser
// keeps ⌘T and Ctrl+T for itself).
export function newSessionHint({ isMac, desktop }: { isMac: boolean; desktop: boolean }): string {
  if (!desktop) return "New session";
  return isMac ? "New session (⌘T)" : "New session (Ctrl+Shift+T)";
}

// Kitty keyboard and the drawing method change only this browser's terminal, so they are kept in this browser
// (spec, Browser terminal). Kitty is on by default. The drawing method's default follows decision Q45: the DOM
// on macOS and in the Linux desktop app (both draw with WebKit, where WebGL glyph corruption is reported), and
// WebGL in the Windows desktop app and in a browser tab on Windows or Linux. A terminal whose WebGL context is
// lost falls back to the DOM by itself (SessionTerminal, Task U2).
export interface TerminalPrefs {
  kittyKeyboard: boolean;
  webgl: boolean;
}
// `platform` is navigator.platform (or the user agent when that is empty); `desktop` is isDesktopApp().
export interface TerminalPlatform {
  platform: string;
  desktop: boolean;
}
export const TERMINAL_PREFS_KEY = "agentos.terminalPrefs";
export function defaultTerminalPrefs({ platform, desktop }: TerminalPlatform): TerminalPrefs {
  const mac = /mac/i.test(platform);
  const linux = /linux/i.test(platform) && !/android/i.test(platform);
  return { kittyKeyboard: true, webgl: !(mac || (linux && desktop)) };
}
export function parseTerminalPrefs(raw: string | null, platform: TerminalPlatform): TerminalPrefs {
  const base = defaultTerminalPrefs(platform);
  if (!raw) return base;
  try {
    const value = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<Record<keyof TerminalPrefs, unknown>> | null;
    return {
      kittyKeyboard: typeof value?.kittyKeyboard === "boolean" ? value.kittyKeyboard : base.kittyKeyboard,
      webgl: typeof value?.webgl === "boolean" ? value.webgl : base.webgl
    };
  } catch {
    return base;
  }
}
export function serializeTerminalPrefs(prefs: TerminalPrefs): string {
  return JSON.stringify({ kittyKeyboard: prefs.kittyKeyboard, webgl: prefs.webgl });
}

const NO_ANSWER = {
  stop: "Agent OS hasn't answered. The session may have stopped: its tab says Ended once it has.",
  resume: "Agent OS hasn't answered. The session may have started again: its tab shows it once it has.",
  dismiss: "Agent OS hasn't answered. If the tab is still here after the next update, press Dismiss again."
};
const REFUSED = {
  stop: "Agent OS couldn't stop the session.",
  resume: "Agent OS couldn't resume the conversation.",
  dismiss: "Agent OS couldn't dismiss the tab."
};

// The words for a Stop, Resume or Dismiss that failed. No answer is not a refusal: the change may have happened,
// so the words say so (the page reads the list again). A refusal uses the server's own sentence (decisions Q15,
// Q25, Q36 and Q37 give each one).
export function actionProblem(error: unknown, action: "stop" | "resume" | "dismiss"): string {
  if (!(error instanceof Error) || error.name !== "ApiError") return NO_ANSWER[action];
  const detail = String((error as Error & { detail?: unknown }).detail || "").trim();
  if (detail) return detail;
  if (error.message === "unknown_session") return "That session doesn't exist anymore.";
  return REFUSED[action];
}

// A Resume refused because Safety is on Look only: the dialog then offers the way to Safety (Review Focus 5).
export function isLookOnlyRefusal(error: unknown): boolean {
  return error instanceof Error && error.name === "ApiError" && error.message === "execution_gate_off";
}
```

```tsx
// The Sessions page's tab strip (the prototype's .ss-tabs): one tab per session, a terminal icon and the session's
// title. An ended tab reads "<title> · Ended · open recording" and has a Dismiss control (×) beside it; an open tab
// has no close control, because a session ends with Stop (spec, App shortcuts). WAI-ARIA tabs with automatic
// activation: Left/Right/Home/End move and select, and Delete on an ended tab dismisses it. The kit's Tabs has no
// marker or close slot, so this strip is its own component in the same look.
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import type { KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { CircleHelp, CirclePause, SquareTerminal, X } from "lucide-react";
import { dismissLabel, tabLabel, tabMarker } from "../sessionsPageShared";

export interface SessionTabItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  status: string;
}

export const sessionTabDomId = (id: string) => `os-sess-tab-${id}`;

export default function SessionTabs({
  tabs,
  selectedId,
  panelId,
  onSelect,
  onDismiss
}: {
  tabs: SessionTabItem[];
  selectedId: string;
  panelId: string;
  onSelect: (id: string) => void;
  onDismiss: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // The selected tab is always in view, also when ⌘1-9 picked one that was scrolled out of sight.
  useEffect(() => {
    listRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[role="tab"][aria-selected="true"]')?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", inline: "nearest" });
  }, [selectedId]);

  function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, index: number) {
    // Leave Alt/Ctrl/Cmd + a key to the app shortcuts and the browser.
    if (event.altKey || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) return;
    if (event.key === "Delete" && tabs[index].status === "exited") {
      event.preventDefault();
      onDismiss(tabs[index].id);
      return;
    }
    let next = -1;
    if (event.key === "ArrowRight") next = (index + 1) % tabs.length;
    else if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") next = (index - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length;
    else if (event.key === "Home") next = 0;
    else if (event.key === "End") next = tabs.length - 1;
    if (next < 0) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    onSelect(tabs[next].id);
    document.getElementById(sessionTabDomId(tabs[next].id))?.focus();
  }

  return (
    <div ref={listRef} className="os-sess-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Sessions">
      {tabs.map((tab, index) => {
        const selected = tab.id === selectedId;
        const ended = tab.status === "exited";
        const label = tabLabel(tab.title, tab.status);
        const marker = tabMarker(tab.status);
        return (
          <div key={tab.id} className={`os-sess-tab${selected ? " is-selected" : ""}${ended ? " is-ended" : ""}`} role="presentation">
            <button
              type="button"
              role="tab"
              id={sessionTabDomId(tab.id)}
              className="os-sess-tab__btn"
              aria-selected={selected}
              aria-controls={panelId}
              tabIndex={selected ? 0 : -1}
              title={label}
              onClick={() => onSelect(tab.id)}
              onKeyDown={(event) => onKeyDown(event, index)}
            >
              <SquareTerminal size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
              <span className="os-sess-tab__label">{label}</span>
              {marker ? (
                <span className="os-sess-tab__mark">
                  {marker.kind === "waiting" ? <CircleHelp size={15} aria-hidden="true" /> : <CirclePause size={15} aria-hidden="true" />}
                  {marker.word}
                </span>
              ) : null}
            </button>
            {ended ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="os-sess-tab__dismiss"
                aria-label={dismissLabel(tab.title)}
                title="Dismiss"
                tabIndex={selected ? 0 : -1}
                onClick={() => onDismiss(tab.id)}
              >
                <X size={14} aria-hidden="true" />
              </button>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";

import { resumeConfirmCopy, sessionPanelLine, sessionStateWord } from "../sessionsShared";

import StatusWord from "./StatusWord";
import { useInterval } from "./useInterval";

export default function SessionSidePanel({

              >
                <History size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
                Resume conversation

                  )}

            ))}
          </dl>
        </section>
      </div>
      <footer className="os-sess-panel__foot">
        <div className="os-sess-panel__rec">
          <span className="os-sess-panel__recorded">

}
```

```tsx
// "Terminal settings" in the Sessions page's tab bar: a small menu with the three terminal settings (spec, Browser
// terminal; the prototype has no menu, so it is built from the kit: a ghost button, a raised panel, check boxes).
// Kitty keyboard and Faster drawing change only this browser's terminal, so the page keeps them in this browser.
// The Claude Code fullscreen view changes how Claude Code starts, so Agent OS keeps it (GET/PUT
// /api/sessions/settings) and it applies to sessions started or resumed afterwards. Arrow keys move, Enter or Space
// toggles, Escape (or a click outside) closes, and focus goes back to the button.
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { Check, Settings2 } from "lucide-react";
// Both calls carry their own time limit (sessionsApi.ts, SESSION_LIMITS_MS.settings).
import { getSessionSettings, putSessionSettings } from "../../sessionsApi";
import type { TerminalPrefs } from "../sessionsPageShared";

type Phase = "loading" | "ready" | "saving" | "failed";

function Box({ checked, phase }: { checked: boolean; phase?: Phase }) {
  return (
    <span className="os-sess-settings__box" aria-hidden="true">
      {phase === "loading" ? "…" : phase === "failed" ? "—" : checked ? <Check size={13} /> : null}
    </span>
  );
}

export default function SessionSettingsMenu({ prefs, onPrefs }: { prefs: TerminalPrefs; onPrefs: (next: TerminalPrefs) => void }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [fullscreen, setFullscreen] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>("loading");
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const buttonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const menuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const alive = useRef(true);
  // The newest read or write wins: an older answer never lands over a newer one.
  const newest = useRef(0);
  const menuId = useId();
  const noteId = useId();

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  async function load(after = "") {
    const mine = ++newest.current;
    setPhase("loading");
    setMessage("");
    try {
      const settings = await getSessionSettings();
      if (!alive.current || mine !== newest.current) return;
      setFullscreen(Boolean(settings.claudeFullscreen));
      setPhase("ready");
      setMessage(after);
    } catch {
      if (!alive.current || mine !== newest.current) return;
      setFullscreen(null);
      setPhase("failed");
      setMessage("Couldn't read this setting. Close the menu and open it again to try again.");
    }
  }

  function openMenu() {
    setOpen(true);
    void load();
  }
  function closeMenu(returnFocus: boolean) {
    setOpen(false);
    if (returnFocus) buttonRef.current?.focus();
  }

  // Focus goes into the menu when it opens.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) menuRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[role="menuitemcheckbox"]')?.focus();
  }, [open]);

  // A press outside closes it, without taking focus back: the person is busy with something else.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return undefined;
    function onDown(event: MouseEvent) {
      const target = event.target as Node;
      if (menuRef.current?.contains(target) || buttonRef.current?.contains(target)) return;
      setOpen(false);
    }
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", onDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onDown);
  }, [open]);

  async function toggleFullscreen() {
    if (phase !== "ready" || fullscreen === null) return;
    const next = !fullscreen;
    const mine = ++newest.current;
    setPhase("saving");
    setFullscreen(next);
    setMessage("");
    try {
      const saved = await putSessionSettings({ claudeFullscreen: next });
      if (!alive.current || mine !== newest.current) return;
      setFullscreen(Boolean(saved.claudeFullscreen));
      setPhase("ready");
    } catch {
      if (!alive.current || mine !== newest.current) return;
      // A refusal or no answer: read back what Agent OS really kept, and say so.
      void load("Agent OS didn't confirm the change. The box shows what it has kept.");
    }
  }

  function onMenuKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
    const items = Array.from(menuRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role="menuitemcheckbox"]') || []);
    const index = items.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLElement);
    if (event.key === "Escape") {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      closeMenu(true);
      return;
    }
    if (event.key === "Tab") {
      setOpen(false);
      return;
    }
    let next = -1;
    if (event.key === "ArrowDown") next = (index + 1) % items.length;
    else if (event.key === "ArrowUp") next = (index - 1 + items.length) % items.length;
    else if (event.key === "Home") next = 0;
    else if (event.key === "End") next = items.length - 1;
    if (next < 0) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    items[next]?.focus();
  }

  return (
    <div className="os-sess-settings">
      <button
        ref={buttonRef}
        type="button"
        className="os-btn os-btn--ghost os-sess-settings__btn"
        aria-haspopup="menu"
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls={open ? menuId : undefined}
        onClick={() => (open ? closeMenu(false) : openMenu())}
      >
        <Settings2 size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
        Terminal settings
      </button>
      {open ? (
        <div ref={menuRef} id={menuId} className="os-sess-settings__menu" role="menu" aria-label="Terminal settings" onKeyDown={onMenuKeyDown}>
          <button
            type="button"
            role="menuitemcheckbox"
            aria-checked={prefs.kittyKeyboard}
            tabIndex={-1}
            className="os-sess-settings__item"
            onClick={() => onPrefs({ ...prefs, kittyKeyboard: !prefs.kittyKeyboard })}
          >
            <Box checked={prefs.kittyKeyboard} />
            <span>Kitty keyboard (turn off if typing in your language misbehaves)</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            role="menuitemcheckbox"
            aria-checked={prefs.webgl}
            tabIndex={-1}
            className="os-sess-settings__item"
            onClick={() => onPrefs({ ...prefs, webgl: !prefs.webgl })}
          >
            <Box checked={prefs.webgl} />
            <span>Faster drawing (WebGL)</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            role="menuitemcheckbox"
            aria-checked={fullscreen === true}
            aria-disabled={phase !== "ready" ? true : undefined}
            aria-describedby={noteId}
            tabIndex={-1}
            className="os-sess-settings__item"
            onClick={() => void toggleFullscreen()}
          >
            <Box checked={fullscreen === true} phase={phase === "saving" ? undefined : phase} />
            <span>
              Use Claude Code&apos;s fullscreen view in Agent OS (recommended)
              <span id={noteId} className="os-sess-settings__note">
                Applies to new sessions
              </span>
            </span>
          </button>
          {message ? (
            <p className="os-sess-settings__msg" role="status">
              {message}
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// The New session dialog: an agent and a folder (the prototype's Home dialog, without the separate-copy offer,
// which is SP4). The Sessions page (its button and ⌘T), Home, Agents and the palette all open this one: the Shell
// mounts it, like New run. It never sends what it knows will be refused: an agent that isn't installed, no terminal
// module, or the most sessions at once are said in plain words first, and at Look only the Look only note replaces
// the form (decision Q14: a Look only refusal comes before a folder refusal). A folder the server refuses (the
// folder policy, D12) is said under the field, and what was typed stays. The folder comes from the native picker in
// the desktop app, from recent folders, or (in a browser tab, or when the picker fails) as a typed full path.
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { Check, FolderOpen } from "lucide-react";
import { getExecutionGateStatus, listAgents } from "../../api";
import { navigateTo } from "../../nav";
import { createSession, listSessionFolders } from "../../sessionsApi";
import type { AgentSummary, ExecutionGateStatus } from "../../types";
import { AGENT_LABEL, AGENT_MAKER, SETUP_CAN_INSTALL_AGENT_SET, collapseHomePath } from "../agentsShared";
import { isDesktopApp } from "../desktop";
import { withTimeout } from "../homeShared";
import {
  FOLDER_EXAMPLE,
  LOOK_ONLY_NOTE,
  OPENCLAW_FOLDER_NOTE,
  SESSION_AGENT_ORDER,
  askToFocusNextSession,
  isLookOnly,
  liveSessionCount,
  maxLiveNote,
  needsFolder,
  peekSessionDraft,
  pickSessionAgent,
  rememberSessionDraft,
  startProblem,
  typedFolderProblem
} from "../newSession";
import type { NewSessionRequest, StartProblem } from "../newSession";
import { useSessionsList } from "../useSessionsList";
import AgentConfirmModal from "./AgentConfirmModal";
import Banner from "./Banner";
import "../sessions.css";

// The agents list waits on each agent's own checks (the server gives them about 13 s). The sessions calls
// (createSession, listSessionFolders, and the shared list's own read) carry their own time limits (sessionsApi.ts,
// SESSION_LIMITS_MS: the start waits up to 30 s, for the login-shell environment and the agent's detection).
const AGENTS_TIMEOUT_MS = 15000;
const GATE_TIMEOUT_MS = 10000;
const PTY_WORDS = "Agent OS could not load its terminal module on this computer, so sessions can't start.";
const STEP: Record<string, number> = { ArrowRight: 1, ArrowDown: 1, ArrowLeft: -1, ArrowUp: -1 };

interface RecentFolder {
  path: string;
  name: string;
}

export default function NewSessionDialog({ request, onClose }: { request: NewSessionRequest; onClose: () => void }) {
  const desktop = isDesktopApp();
  const [draft] = useState(peekSessionDraft);
  const [agents, setAgents] = useState<AgentSummary[] | null>(null);
  const [agentsFailed, setAgentsFailed] = useState(false);
  const [gate, setGate] = useState<ExecutionGateStatus | null>(null);
  const [gateFailed, setGateFailed] = useState(false);
  const [recent, setRecent] = useState<RecentFolder[]>([]);
  // The one shared sessions poll (decision Q30): the terminal module and the open sessions, for the limit. The
  // Shell mounts this dialog inside U1's SessionsListProvider.
  const sessionsList = useSessionsList();
  const { refresh: refreshSessions } = sessionsList;
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState(request.agentId || draft?.agentId || "");
  const [folder, setFolder] = useState(draft?.folder || "");
  const [pickerFailed, setPickerFailed] = useState(false);
  const [picking, setPicking] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [rechecking, setRechecking] = useState(false);
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<StartProblem | null>(null);
  const alive = useRef(true);
  const folderRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const chipsRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  async function loadAgents(refresh = false) {
    try {
      const { agents: list } = await withTimeout(listAgents(refresh), AGENTS_TIMEOUT_MS);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setAgents(Array.isArray(list) ? list : []);
      setAgentsFailed(false);
    } catch {
      if (alive.current) setAgentsFailed(true);
    }
  }
  async function loadGate() {
    try {
      const next = await withTimeout(getExecutionGateStatus(), GATE_TIMEOUT_MS);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setGate(next);
      setGateFailed(false);
    } catch {
      if (alive.current) setGateFailed(true);
    }
  }
  function reload() {
    void loadAgents(true);
    void loadGate();
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    void loadAgents();
    void loadGate();
    // A fresh read of the shared list, so the limit counts sessions started a moment ago.
    refreshSessions();
    // Recent folders (and the limits below) help, but are not needed: if they can't load, the dialog still
    // works and the server says no to anything it can't do.
    listSessionFolders()
      .then((answer) => {
        if (!alive.current || !answer || !Array.isArray(answer.folders)) return;
        setRecent(answer.folders.filter((item) => item && typeof item.path === "string" && item.path).slice(0, 8));
      })
      .catch(() => undefined);
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  // The limits from the shared list, only while it is fresh: a stale or missing list blocks nothing here.
  const listBody = sessionsList.source.state === "ok" && !sessionsList.source.stale ? sessionsList.source.data : null;
  const limits =
    listBody && Array.isArray(listBody.sessions)
      ? {
          ptyOk: listBody.pty?.ok !== false,
          ptyReason: listBody.pty?.reason || "",
          live: liveSessionCount(listBody.sessions),
          maxLive: typeof listBody.maxLive === "number" ? listBody.maxLive : 8
        }
      : null;

  // When the native picker could not open, the typed field takes the keyboard.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (pickerFailed) folderRef.current?.focus();
  }, [pickerFailed]);

  // `picked` may be an id from a link; pickSessionAgent ignores one it does not know.
  const agentId = pickSessionAgent(agents, picked);
  const label = AGENT_LABEL[agentId] || agentId;
  const agent = agents?.find((item) => item.id === agentId);
  const installed = agent ? agent.detected.installed : null; // null: not known yet
  const lookOnly = isLookOnly(gate);
  const folderWanted = needsFolder(agentId);
  const typed = !desktop || pickerFailed;
  const typedIssue = folderWanted && typed ? typedFolderProblem(folder) : "";
  const folderIssue = problem?.field === "folder" ? problem.text : typedIssue;
  const full = limits !== null && limits.live >= limits.maxLive;
  const ptyBlocked = limits !== null && !limits.ptyOk;
  const offline = (gate === null && gateFailed) || (agents === null && agentsFailed);
  const checking = (agents === null && !agentsFailed) || (gate === null && !gateFailed);
  const cannotStart =
    busy || gate === null || lookOnly !== false || agents === null || installed !== true || ptyBlocked || full || (folderWanted && (!folder.trim() || typedIssue !== ""));

  function selectAgent(id: string) {
    setPicked(id);
    setProblem(null);
  }
  function onChipKey(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) {
    const step = STEP[event.key];
    if (!step) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const index = SESSION_AGENT_ORDER.indexOf(agentId);
    const next = SESSION_AGENT_ORDER[(index + step + SESSION_AGENT_ORDER.length) % SESSION_AGENT_ORDER.length];
    selectAgent(next);
    chipsRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(`[data-agent="${next}"]`)?.focus();
  }

  // Closing, or going to Safety or Setup to fix what blocked the start, keeps what was typed (newSession.ts).
  function keepDraft() {
    rememberSessionDraft(folder.trim() ? { agentId, folder } : null);
  }
  function requestClose() {
    if (busy) return;
    keepDraft();
    onClose();
  }
  function openElsewhere(page: string, extra: Record<string, string> = {}) {
    keepDraft();
    onClose();
    navigateTo(page, extra);
  }
  async function recheck() {
    setRechecking(true);
    await loadAgents(true);
    if (alive.current) setRechecking(false);
  }

  async function chooseFolder() {
    setPicking(true);
    setProblem(null);
    try {
      const { open } = await import("@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog");
      // plugin-dialog 2.8.3: `open<T extends OpenDialogOptions>(options?: T): Promise<OpenDialogReturn<T>>`, which is
      // `string | null` for { directory: true, multiple: false } (null when the person cancels).
      const chosen = await open({ directory: true, multiple: false, title: "Choose a folder for the session" });
      if (!alive.current) return;
      if (typeof chosen === "string" && chosen) setFolder(chosen);
    } catch {
      if (!alive.current) return;
      // No native picker here, or it failed: the dialog offers a typed path instead, so it never dead-ends.
      setPickerFailed(true);
      setProblem({ text: "The folder picker didn't open. Type the folder's full path instead.", field: "folder" });
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setPicking(false);
    }
  }

  async function start() {
    if (cannotStart) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setProblem(null);
    try {
      const created = await createSession({ agentId, folder: folderWanted ? folder.trim() : null });
      if (!alive.current) return;
      rememberSessionDraft(null);
      // The Start button is gone after this, so the new session's terminal takes the keyboard.
      askToFocusNextSession();
      navigateTo("sessions", { session: created.id });
      onClose();
    } catch (caught) {
      if (!alive.current) return;
      const next = startProblem(caught);
      setProblem(next);
      setBusy(false);
      if (caught instanceof Error && caught.message === "execution_gate_off") void loadGate();
      if (next.field === "folder" && typed) window.requestAnimationFrame(() => folderRef.current?.focus());
    }
  }

  const folderNote = (
    <p
      id="os-newsess-folder-note"
      className={`os-newrun__note${folderIssue ? " os-newrun__note--bad" : ""}`}
      role={folderIssue ? "alert" : undefined}
    >
      {folderIssue || (typed ? FOLDER_EXAMPLE : "A folder inside your home folder.")}
    </p>
  );

  return (
    <AgentConfirmModal
      title="New session"
      confirmLabel="Start session"
      confirmDisabled={cannotStart}
      busy={busy}
      wide
      closeOnBackdrop={false}
      onConfirm={() => void start()}
      onClose={requestClose}
    >
      <p className="os-newrun__lede">The agent opens in its own terminal inside Agent OS.</p>

      {offline ? (
        <Banner
          tone="danger"
          title="Agent OS isn't responding"
          actions={
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={reload}>
              Try again
            </button>
          }
        >
          Agent OS can&apos;t check your safety level or your agents right now. Try again in a moment.
        </Banner>
      ) : null}
      {/* Decision Q14: at Look only the note replaces the form; what was picked and typed stays in this dialog. */}
      {lookOnly ? (
        <Banner
          tone="warn"
          actions={
            <a
              className="os-btn os-btn--secondary"
              href="?page=safety"
              onClick={(event) => {
                event.preventDefault();
                openElsewhere("safety");
              }}
            >
              Open Safety
            </a>
          }
        >
          {LOOK_ONLY_NOTE}
        </Banner>
      ) : (
        <>
          {ptyBlocked ? (
            <Banner tone="warn" title="Sessions can't start on this computer">
              {limits?.ptyReason || PTY_WORDS}
            </Banner>
          ) : null}
          {full && limits ? <Banner tone="warn">{maxLiveNote(limits.maxLive)}</Banner> : null}
          {installed === false ? (
            <Banner
              tone="warn"
              title={`${label} isn't installed`}
              actions={
                <>
                  <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => openElsewhere("setup", { step: "plan" })}>
                    Open Setup
                  </button>
                  <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--ghost" onClick={() => void recheck()} disabled={rechecking}>
                    {rechecking ? "Checking…" : "Re-check"}
                  </button>
                </>
              }
            >
              {SETUP_CAN_INSTALL_AGENT_SET.has(agentId) ? "Install it from Setup, then come back and press Re-check." : `Install ${label}, then press Re-check.`}
            </Banner>
          ) : null}

          <div className="os-field">
            <span className="os-field__label" id="os-newsess-agent-label">
              Agent
            </span>
            <div ref={chipsRef} className="os-newsess__chips" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="os-newsess-agent-label">
              {SESSION_AGENT_ORDER.map((id) => {
                const on = id === agentId;
                const found = agents?.find((item) => item.id === id);
                return (
                  <button
                    key={id}
                    type="button"
                    role="radio"
                    data-agent={id}
                    aria-checked={on}
                    tabIndex={on ? 0 : -1}
                    className="os-chip"
                    onClick={() => selectAgent(id)}
                    onKeyDown={onChipKey}
                  >
                    {on ? <Check size={14} aria-hidden="true" /> : null}
                    {AGENT_LABEL[id]}
                    {found && !found.detected.installed ? <span className="os-visually-hidden"> (not installed)</span> : null}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            <p className="os-newrun__note">
              {AGENT_MAKER[agentId] || "—"}
              {installed === false ? " · Not installed" : ""}
            </p>
          </div>

          {!folderWanted ? (
            <div className="os-field">
              <span className="os-field__label">Folder</span>
              <p className="os-newrun__note">{OPENCLAW_FOLDER_NOTE}</p>
            </div>
          ) : typed ? (
            <div className="os-field">
              <label className="os-field__label" htmlFor="os-newsess-folder">
                Folder (full path)
              </label>
              <input
                id="os-newsess-folder"
                ref={folderRef}
                type="text"
                value={folder}
                autoComplete="off"
                spellCheck={false}
                aria-invalid={folderIssue ? true : undefined}
                aria-describedby="os-newsess-folder-note"
                onChange={(event) => {
                  setFolder(event.target.value);
                  setProblem(null);
                }}
              />
              {folderNote}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="os-field">
              <span className="os-field__label" id="os-newsess-folder-label">
                Folder
              </span>
              <div className="os-newsess__pick">
                {folder ? (
                  <code className="os-newsess__path os-mono" title={collapseHomePath(folder)}>
                    {collapseHomePath(folder)}
                  </code>
                ) : (
                  <span className="os-newsess__path os-newsess__path--none">No folder chosen yet</span>
                )}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="os-btn os-btn--secondary"
                  onClick={() => void chooseFolder()}
                  disabled={picking}
                  aria-describedby="os-newsess-folder-note"
                >
                  <FolderOpen size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
                  {picking ? "Choosing…" : "Choose folder…"}
                </button>
              </div>
              {folderNote}
            </div>
          )}

          {folderWanted && recent.length ? (
            <div className="os-field">
              <span className="os-field__label" id="os-newsess-recent-label">
                Recent folders
              </span>
              <div className="os-newsess__recent" role="group" aria-labelledby="os-newsess-recent-label">
                {recent.map((item) => {
                  const on = folder.trim() === item.path;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={item.path}
                      type="button"
                      className="os-chip"
                      aria-pressed={on}
                      title={collapseHomePath(item.path)}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setFolder(item.path);
                        setProblem(null);
                      }}
                    >
                      {on ? <Check size={14} aria-hidden="true" /> : null}
                      <span className="os-newsess__recent-name">{item.name || collapseHomePath(item.path)}</span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null}

          {checking ? (
            <p className="os-newrun__hint" role="status">
              Checking your agents and safety level…
            </p>
          ) : (
            <p className="os-newrun__hint">Inside the folder, {label} asks for its own permissions, the same as in your own terminal.</p>
          )}

          {problem && problem.field !== "folder" ? (
            <p className="os-newrun__error" role="alert">
              {problem.text}{" "}
              {problem.fix === "safety" ? (
                <button type="button" className="os-newrun__link" onClick={() => openElsewhere("safety")}>
                  Open Safety
                </button>
              ) : null}
              {problem.fix === "setup" ? (
                <button type="button" className="os-newrun__link" onClick={() => openElsewhere("setup", { step: "plan" })}>
                  Open Setup
                </button>
              ) : null}
              {problem.fix === "sessions" ? (
                <button type="button" className="os-newrun__link" onClick={() => openElsewhere("sessions")}>
                  Open Sessions
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </>
      )}
    </AgentConfirmModal>
  );
}
```

```css
/* Sessions (the prototype's sessions.html, in its SP3 form) and the New session dialog. Tokens only (tokens.css);
   no colour literals. Shared pieces come from base.css and kit.css. */

/* ---- The page fills the window under the top bar ------------------------------------------------ */
/* The Shell gives its content box this class while the Sessions page is shown (Shell.tsx). Three classes, so it

.os-shell .aos-phase2-content.os-content--fill {
  display: flex;

  height: calc(100svh - var(--os-bar-h));

}

  min-height: 0;

}
/* The empty, loading and "not available" views scroll like an ordinary page, with the usual page padding. */
.os-sess__pad {
  flex: 1;

  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: var(--os-sp-7) var(--os-sp-7) var(--os-sp-9);
}
@media (min-width: 901px) and (max-width: 1440px) {

  }
}

}

}

/* ---- Tab bar ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
.os-sess__bar {

  padding: 0 var(--os-sp-6);

/* The terminal's frame. SessionTerminal (Task U2) fills it; the frame's edge turns cobalt while it has the keyboard. */
.os-sess-term {

/* ---- Side panel ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

}

  min-height: 0;
  overflow-y: auto;
}

}

  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--os-sp-2);

}

}

  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;

}
```

```tsx
// Sessions: each agent's own terminal program, one tab per session (the prototype's sessions.html, in its SP3 form).
// The tabs run across the top (an ended one says so and can be dismissed), the terminal fills the middle, and the
// selected session's details sit on the right: folder, state, Live meter and Stop. The list is the one shared
// sessions poll (useSessionsList, decision Q30). The selected tab is in the address (?session=<id>), so leaving the
// page and coming back lands on the same tab. Only the selected session's terminal is attached; the others keep
// running in the engine and come back with their screen when picked. A session that ends while it is on screen
// keeps its terminal (and so its last screen, an agent's own error message for example) until another tab is picked;
// that terminal is told the session ended (`ended`), so it never tries to attach again (ruling R12).
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Info, Plus, SquareTerminal } from "lucide-react";
import { navigateTo, queryParam } from "../nav";
import { dismissSession, resumeSession, stopSession } from "../sessionsApi";
import type { SessionSummary } from "../types";
import AgentConfirmModal from "../ui/components/AgentConfirmModal";
import Banner from "../ui/components/Banner";
import EmptyState from "../ui/components/EmptyState";
import PageHeader from "../ui/components/PageHeader";
import SessionSettingsMenu from "../ui/components/SessionSettingsMenu";
import SessionSidePanel from "../ui/components/SessionSidePanel";
import SessionTabs, { sessionTabDomId } from "../ui/components/SessionTabs";
import SessionTerminal from "../ui/components/SessionTerminal";
import StatusWord from "../ui/components/StatusWord";
import Toast from "../ui/components/Toast";
import { isDesktopApp } from "../ui/desktop";
import { openNewSession, takeFocusNextSession } from "../ui/newSession";
import {
  isAppShortcut,
  isMacPlatform,
  resumeConfirmCopy,
  sessionPanelLine,
  sessionTitle,
  shortcutHints,
  stopDialogCopy
} from "../ui/sessionsShared";
import {
  TERMINAL_PREFS_KEY,
  actionProblem,
  isLookOnlyRefusal,
  newSessionHint,
  nextGenerations,
  parseTerminalPrefs,
  panelStopNote,
  pickSelected,
  serializeTerminalPrefs,
  stableOrder,
  terminalKey,
  visibleTabs
} from "../ui/sessionsPageShared";
import type { Generations, StopNote, TerminalPrefs } from "../ui/sessionsPageShared";
import { useSessionsList } from "../ui/useSessionsList";
import "../ui/sessions.css";

// Stop, Resume and Dismiss carry their own time limits (sessionsApi.ts, SESSION_LIMITS_MS: 15 s for Stop, which
// waits on the agent's soft stop and the kill grace; 30 s for Resume, which waits on the login-shell environment).
// What computer this is, read the same way as the Shell and the terminal (isMacPlatform, Task U1).
const PLATFORM = typeof navigator !== "undefined" ? navigator.platform || navigator.userAgent || "" : "";
const IS_MAC = isMacPlatform(PLATFORM);
const PTY_WORDS = "Agent OS could not load its terminal module on this computer, so sessions can't start.";
const PANEL_ID = "os-sess-main";

type Asking = { session: SessionSummary; busy: boolean; error: string; toSafety: boolean };

// The terminal's own settings, kept in this browser; the defaults follow decision Q45 (sessionsPageShared.ts).
function readPrefs(desktop: boolean): TerminalPrefs {
  const platform = { platform: PLATFORM, desktop };
  try {
    return parseTerminalPrefs(window.localStorage.getItem(TERMINAL_PREFS_KEY), platform);
  } catch {
    return parseTerminalPrefs(null, platform);
  }
}

export default function SessionsPage() {
  const list = useSessionsList();
  const { refresh } = list;
  const desktop = isDesktopApp();
  const body = list.source.state === "ok" ? list.source.data : null;
  const stale = list.source.state === "ok" && Boolean(list.source.stale);
  const sessions = useMemo<SessionSummary[]>(() => (body && Array.isArray(body.sessions) ? body.sessions : []), [body]);
  const orderRef = useRef<string[]>([]);
  const gensRef = useRef<Generations>({});
  const order = useMemo(() => (orderRef.current = stableOrder(orderRef.current, sessions)), [sessions]);
  const gens = useMemo(() => (gensRef.current = nextGenerations(gensRef.current, sessions)), [sessions]);
  // Tabs dismissed here, hidden at once while the request is on its way.
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(() => new Set<string>());
  const tabs = useMemo(() => visibleTabs(sessions, order, hidden), [sessions, order, hidden]);
  const [wanted, setWanted] = useState(() => queryParam("session"));
  const selectedId = pickSelected(tabs, wanted);
  const selected = tabs.find((tab) => tab.id === selectedId) || null;
  const key = selected ? terminalKey(selected.id, gens) : "";
  // The terminal key that was on screen while its session was open (see the comment at the top).
  const [liveShown, setLiveShown] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [prefs, setPrefs] = useState<TerminalPrefs>(() => readPrefs(desktop));
  const [focusTerminal, setFocusTerminal] = useState(() => takeFocusNextSession());
  // A sentence from the terminal itself, for example "Link copied. Open it in your browser." (ruling R25).
  const [terminalNote, setTerminalNote] = useState<{ id: number; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [stopping, setStopping] = useState<Asking | null>(null);
  // The server's own note from the last Stop pressed here, with the terminal key of the run it stopped.
  const [stopNote, setStopNote] = useState<StopNote | null>(null);
  const [resuming, setResuming] = useState<Asking | null>(null);
  const [pageError, setPageError] = useState("");
  const alive = useRef(true);
  const askedFor = useRef("");
  const tabsRef = useRef(tabs);
  tabsRef.current = tabs;
  const headingRef = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const lastSeen = useRef<{ id: string; status: string } | null>(null);
  const focusAfterDismiss = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  // The address picks the tab: a link from Runs, Home or Agents, or the New session dialog after a start.
  useEffect(() => {
    function sync() {
      setWanted(queryParam("session"));
      if (takeFocusNextSession()) setFocusTerminal(true);
    }
    window.addEventListener("aos-navigate", sync);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("aos-navigate", sync);
  }, []);

  // A session the list does not hold yet (it started a moment ago): read the list again, once.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!wanted || !body || sessions.some((session) => session.id === wanted) || askedFor.current === wanted) return;
    askedFor.current = wanted;
    refresh();
  }, [wanted, body, sessions, refresh]);

  // Another tab picked: whatever terminal was on screen goes. An open session puts its own up.
  useEffect(() => {
    setLiveShown(null);
  }, [selectedId]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selected && selected.status !== "exited") setLiveShown(key);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [key, selected?.status]);
  const showTerminal = selected !== null && (selected.status !== "exited" || liveShown === key);

  // When the selected session ends while you look at it, the Stop button goes; keyboard focus then goes to the
  // panel's title instead of falling to the page. A page opened on an ended tab does not move focus.
  useEffect(() => {
    const before = lastSeen.current;
    lastSeen.current = selected ? { id: selected.id, status: selected.status } : null;
    if (!selected || selected.status !== "exited" || !before || before.id !== selected.id || before.status === "exited") return;
    const active = document.activeElement;
    if (!active || active === document.body) headingRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [selected?.id, selected?.status]);

  // After Dismiss: focus goes to the tab that is selected now, or to New session when no tab is left.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!focusAfterDismiss.current) return;
    focusAfterDismiss.current = false;
    const target = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.os-sess-tabs [role="tab"][aria-selected="true"]') || document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".os-sess-empty-new");
    target?.focus();
  }, [tabs]);

  function select(id: string, focusIt = false) {
    setWanted(id);
    setFocusTerminal(focusIt);
    navigateTo("sessions", { session: id });
  }

  // ⌘T and ⌘1-9 (Ctrl+Shift+T and Ctrl+Shift+1-9 on Windows and Linux), in the desktop app only: a browser keeps
  // these keys for itself (spec, App shortcuts). The terminal lets them through to here.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!desktop) return undefined;
    function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.defaultPrevented || event.repeat) return;
      // A dialog or the palette has the keyboard: leave its keys alone.
      if (document.querySelector('[aria-modal="true"]')) return;
      // Events from inside a terminal are NOT skipped: the terminal (Task U2) lets ⌘T and ⌘1-9 through to here
      // untouched. The palette key is the terminal's and the Shell's own business.
      const shortcut = isAppShortcut(event, { isMac: IS_MAC, desktop: true });
      if (!shortcut || shortcut.action === "palette") return;
      event.preventDefault();
      if (shortcut.action === "new-session") {
        openNewSession();
        return;
      }
      const target = tabsRef.current[shortcut.index];
      if (!target) return;
      const fromTerminal = event.target instanceof Element && Boolean(event.target.closest(".xterm"));
      select(target.id, fromTerminal);
    }
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [desktop]);

  const onTerminalState = useCallback(() => {
    if (alive.current) refresh();
  }, [refresh]);
  const onTerminalNotice = useCallback((text: string) => {
    if (alive.current && text) setTerminalNote({ id: Date.now(), text });
  }, []);

  function changePrefs(next: TerminalPrefs) {
    setPrefs(next);
    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem(TERMINAL_PREFS_KEY, serializeTerminalPrefs(next));
    } catch {
      // A locked-down webview: the setting lasts until the page reloads.
    }
  }

  async function confirmStop() {
    if (!stopping || stopping.busy) return;
    const { session } = stopping;
    // Ending does not raise the generation, so this is still the key while the stopped run stays on show.
    const stoppedKey = terminalKey(session.id, gens);
    setStopping({ session, busy: true, error: "", toSafety: false });
    try {
      const result = await stopSession(session.id);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      // S7's answer carries its own note (S8 passes it through): OpenClaw's honest sentence until spike S5 brings
      // its Gateway abort, null once nothing is left running. The panel shows it instead of guessing.
      setStopNote({ key: stoppedKey, note: result.note ?? null });
      setStopping(null);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setStopping({ session, busy: false, error: actionProblem(error, "stop"), toSafety: false });
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) refresh();
    }
  }

  async function confirmResume() {
    if (!resuming || resuming.busy) return;
    const { session } = resuming;
    setResuming({ session, busy: true, error: "", toSafety: false });
    try {
      await resumeSession(session.id);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setResuming(null);
      setFocusTerminal(true);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setResuming({ session, busy: false, error: actionProblem(error, "resume"), toSafety: isLookOnlyRefusal(error) });
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) refresh();
    }
  }

  async function dismiss(id: string) {
    setPageError("");
    focusAfterDismiss.current = true;
    setHidden((prev) => new Set(prev).add(id));
    try {
      await dismissSession(id);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setHidden((prev) => {
        const next = new Set(prev);
        next.delete(id);
        return next;
      });
      setPageError(actionProblem(error, "dismiss"));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) refresh();
    }
  }

  const notice = body?.environmentNotice || "";
  const ptyProblem = body && body.pty && !body.pty.ok ? body.pty.reason || PTY_WORDS : "";
  const staleBanner = stale ? (
    <Banner tone="warn" title="Can't reach Agent OS">
      Showing what was last known. This page tries again every few seconds.
    </Banner>
  ) : null;
  const ptyBanner = ptyProblem ? (
    <Banner tone="warn" title="Sessions can't start on this computer">
      {ptyProblem}
    </Banner>
  ) : null;
  const noticeLine = notice ? (
    <p className="os-sess__notice">
      <Info size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
      {notice}
    </p>
  ) : null;

  if (!list.available) {
    return (
      <section className="os-sess" aria-labelledby="os-sessions-title">
        <div className="os-sess__pad">
          <PageHeader title="Sessions" titleId="os-sessions-title" />
          <EmptyState
            icon={SquareTerminal}
            title="Sessions aren't available here"
            body="Sessions run only when Agent OS runs on your own computer, not in the public demo or on a shared server."
          />
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }

  if (!body) {
    return (
      <section className="os-sess" aria-labelledby="os-sessions-title">
        <div className="os-sess__pad">
          <PageHeader title="Sessions" titleId="os-sessions-title" />
          {list.source.state === "error" ? (
            <Banner
              tone="danger"
              title="Agent OS isn't responding"
              actions={
                <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => refresh()}>
                  Try again
                </button>
              }
            >
              The sessions can&apos;t be listed right now. This page tries again every few seconds.
            </Banner>
          ) : (
            <p className="os-sess__loading">
              <StatusWord state="loading" />
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }

  if (!selected) {
    return (
      <section className="os-sess" aria-labelledby="os-sessions-title">
        <div className="os-sess__pad">
          <PageHeader title="Sessions" titleId="os-sessions-title" />
          {staleBanner}
          {ptyBanner}
          {noticeLine}
          {pageError ? (
            <p className="os-sess__error" role="alert">
              {pageError}
            </p>
          ) : null}
          <EmptyState
            icon={SquareTerminal}
            title="No sessions yet"
            body="A session is an agent's own terminal, running in a folder you pick. It works the same as in Terminal."
            action={
              <div className="os-sess-empty__acts">
                <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--primary os-sess-empty-new" onClick={() => openNewSession()}>
                  <Plus size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
                  New session
                </button>
                <a
                  className="os-sess-empty__link"
                  href="?page=help"
                  onClick={(event) => {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    navigateTo("help");
                  }}
                >
                  How a session works
                </a>
              </div>
            }
          />
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }

  const title = sessionTitle(selected);
  // Empty in a browser tab, which keeps ⌘T and ⌘1-9 for itself (spec, Browser mode).
  const hints = shortcutHints({ isMac: IS_MAC, desktop });
  const stopCopy = stopping ? stopDialogCopy(stopping.session) : null;
  const resumeCopy = resuming ? resumeConfirmCopy(resuming.session) : null;

  return (
    <section className="os-sess" aria-labelledby="os-sessions-title">
      <h1 id="os-sessions-title" className="os-visually-hidden">
        Sessions
      </h1>
      <div className="os-sess__bar">
        <SessionTabs
          tabs={tabs.map((session) => ({ id: session.id, title: sessionTitle(session), status: session.status }))}
          selectedId={selectedId}
          panelId={PANEL_ID}
          onSelect={(id) => select(id)}
          onDismiss={(id) => void dismiss(id)}
        />
        <button
          type="button"
          className="os-btn os-btn--ghost os-sess-new"
          aria-label="New session"
          title={newSessionHint({ isMac: IS_MAC, desktop })}
          onClick={() => openNewSession()}
        >
          <Plus size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
        </button>
        <span className="os-sess__spacer" />
        <SessionSettingsMenu prefs={prefs} onPrefs={changePrefs} />
      </div>
      <div className="os-sess__body">
        <div className="os-sess__main" role="tabpanel" id={PANEL_ID} aria-labelledby={sessionTabDomId(selected.id)}>
          {staleBanner}
          {selected.status === "exited" ? ptyBanner : null}
          {pageError ? <Banner tone="warn">{pageError}</Banner> : null}
          {noticeLine}
          {showTerminal ? (
            <div className="os-sess-term">
              <SessionTerminal
                key={key}
                sessionId={selected.id}
                label={`${title} terminal`}
                kittyKeyboard={prefs.kittyKeyboard}
                webgl={prefs.webgl}
                ended={selected.status === "exited"}
                autoFocus={focusTerminal}
                onState={onTerminalState}
                onNotice={onTerminalNotice}
              />
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="os-sess-ended">
              <SquareTerminal size={22} aria-hidden="true" />
              <p className="os-sess-ended__title">This session has ended</p>
              <p className="os-sess-ended__body">{sessionPanelLine(selected, Date.now())}</p>
            </div>
          )}
          <p className="os-sess__cap">
            <SquareTerminal size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
            {selected.agentLabel}&apos;s own terminal program, with your own settings.
          </p>
        </div>
        <SessionSidePanel
          session={selected}
          note={panelStopNote(selected, key, stopNote)}
          hints={hints}
          headingRef={headingRef}
          onStop={() => setStopping({ session: selected, busy: false, error: "", toSafety: false })}
          onResume={() => setResuming({ session: selected, busy: false, error: "", toSafety: false })}
          onOpenRecording={() => navigateTo("runs", { tab: "recordings", highlight: selected.id })}
        />
      </div>

      {stopping && stopCopy ? (
        <AgentConfirmModal
          title={stopCopy.title}
          confirmLabel="Stop session"
          cancelLabel="Keep it running"
          danger
          busy={stopping.busy}
          onConfirm={() => void confirmStop()}
          onClose={() => {
            if (!stopping.busy) setStopping(null);
          }}
        >
          <p>{stopCopy.body}</p>
          {stopCopy.note ? <p>{stopCopy.note}</p> : null}
          {stopping.error ? (
            <p className="os-sess__error" role="alert">
              {stopping.error}
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </AgentConfirmModal>
      ) : null}

      {resuming && resumeCopy ? (
        <AgentConfirmModal
          title={resumeCopy.title}
          confirmLabel="Resume conversation"
          busy={resuming.busy}
          onConfirm={() => void confirmResume()}
          onClose={() => {
            if (!resuming.busy) setResuming(null);
          }}
        >
          <p>{resumeCopy.body}</p>
          {resumeCopy.warning ? <Banner tone="warn">{resumeCopy.warning}</Banner> : null}
          {resuming.error ? (
            <p className="os-sess__error" role="alert">
              {resuming.error}{" "}
              {resuming.toSafety ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="os-newrun__link"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setResuming(null);
                    navigateTo("safety");
                  }}
                >
                  Open Safety
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </AgentConfirmModal>
      ) : null}

      {terminalNote ? <Toast key={terminalNote.id} message={terminalNote.text} tone="neutral" onClose={() => setTerminalNote(null)} /> : null}
    </section>
  );
}
```
