- [ ] **Step 13: Create `src/ui/components/SessionRecordings.tsx`.**

```tsx
// Runs → Session recordings: every recorded session, newest first (GET /api/recordings), joined with the shared
// sessions list for Resume. A live one offers "Open live session". An ended one offers "Resume conversation" (or says
// why it can't) and the note "Replay arrives in a later update" (the player is SP4). An update recording ("<agent>
// update") offers nothing: it is never resumed. "Open recording" on an ended Sessions tab lands here with that row
// highlighted (?highlight=<session id>), and the row takes keyboard focus once. listRecordings and resumeSession carry
// their own time limits (sessionsApi.ts, SESSION_LIMITS_MS). Where sessions do not run (the public demo, a shared
// server) the route answers 404 not_available: the tab says so once and stops asking, instead of "isn't responding".
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { CircleDot, History, SquareTerminal } from "lucide-react";
import { ApiError } from "../../api";
import { navigateTo } from "../../nav";
import { listRecordings, resumeSession } from "../../sessionsApi";
import type { SessionSummary } from "../../types";
import { collapseHomePath } from "../agentsShared";
import { askToFocusNextSession } from "../newSession";
import { CAP_NOTE, EMPTY_BODY, EMPTY_TITLE, REPLAY_LATER, readRecordings, recordingLength, rowAction } from "../recordingsShared";
import type { RecordingRow, RecordingsBody } from "../recordingsShared";
import { resumeConfirmCopy, sessionTitle } from "../sessionsShared";
import { actionProblem, isLookOnlyRefusal } from "../sessionsPageShared";
import { useSessionsList } from "../useSessionsList";
import AgentConfirmModal from "./AgentConfirmModal";
import Banner from "./Banner";
import EmptyState from "./EmptyState";
import { TimeAgo } from "./RelativeTime";
import StatusWord from "./StatusWord";
import { useInterval } from "./useInterval";

export type RecordingsState =
  | { state: "loading" }
  | { state: "ok"; data: RecordingsBody; stale: boolean }
  | { state: "error" }
  | { state: "unavailable" };

// The answer outside local mode (requireLocalMode, Task S8): sessions and their recordings do not exist here.
function notAvailable(error: unknown): boolean {
  return error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 404 && error.message === "not_available";
}

// The list, read while the tab is open: every 5 s and one read at a time. After a good read, a failed one keeps the
// rows under a warning (SP2 lessons). A not_available answer is final: nothing is asked again.
export function useRecordings(active: boolean): { value: RecordingsState; reload: () => void } {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<RecordingsState>({ state: "loading" });
  const alive = useRef(true);
  const busy = useRef(false);
  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    if (busy.current) return;
    busy.current = true;
    try {
      const body = readRecordings(await listRecordings());
      if (!body) throw new Error("not a list");
      if (alive.current) setValue({ state: "ok", data: body, stale: false });
    } catch (error) {
      if (!alive.current) return;
      if (notAvailable(error)) setValue({ state: "unavailable" });
      else setValue((prev) => (prev.state === "ok" ? { ...prev, stale: true } : { state: "error" }));
    } finally {
      busy.current = false;
    }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
  }, []);
  const asking = active && value.state !== "unavailable";
  useEffect(() => {
    if (asking) void load();
  }, [asking, load]);
  useInterval(() => void load(), asking ? 5000 : null);
  return { value, reload: () => void load() };
}

function whereWords(row: RecordingRow): string {
  if (row.kind === "update") return "Agent update";
  if (!row.folderShown) return "Folder set by OpenClaw";
  return collapseHomePath(row.folder) || "—";
}

export default function SessionRecordings({ value, highlight, onReload }: { value: RecordingsState; highlight: string; onReload: () => void }) {
  const sessionsList = useSessionsList();
  const sessionsState: "loading" | "ok" | "error" = sessionsList.available ? sessionsList.source.state : "ok";
  const sessions: SessionSummary[] =
    sessionsList.source.state === "ok" && Array.isArray(sessionsList.source.data.sessions) ? sessionsList.source.data.sessions : [];
  const byId = new Map(sessions.map((session) => [session.id, session]));
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  const [resuming, setResuming] = useState<{ session: SessionSummary; busy: boolean; error: string; toSafety: boolean } | null>(null);
  const alive = useRef(true);
  const highlighted = useRef("");
  const anyLive = value.state === "ok" && value.data.rows.some((row) => row.live);
  useInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), anyLive ? 1000 : null);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  // The row asked for comes into view and takes focus, once per request.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!highlight || highlighted.current === highlight || value.state !== "ok") return;
    const row = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-recording="${CSS.escape(highlight)}"]`);
    if (!row) return;
    highlighted.current = highlight;
    row.scrollIntoView({ block: "center" });
    row.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }, [highlight, value]);

  async function confirmResume() {
    if (!resuming || resuming.busy) return;
    const { session } = resuming;
    setResuming({ session, busy: true, error: "", toSafety: false });
    try {
      await resumeSession(session.id);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      sessionsList.refresh();
      // The Resume button is gone after this: the session's terminal takes the keyboard on the Sessions page.
      askToFocusNextSession();
      navigateTo("sessions", { session: session.id });
    } catch (error) {
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setResuming({ session, busy: false, error: actionProblem(error, "resume"), toSafety: isLookOnlyRefusal(error) });
      onReload();
    }
  }

  if (value.state === "loading") {
    return (
      <p className="os-runs-rec__status">
        <StatusWord state="loading" />
      </p>
    );
  }
  if (value.state === "unavailable") {
    // The Sessions page's own words for the same answer (Task U3).
    return (
      <EmptyState
        icon={CircleDot}
        title="Session recordings aren't available here"
        body="Sessions run only when Agent OS runs on your own computer, not in the public demo or on a shared server."
      />
    );
  }
  if (value.state === "error") {
    return (
      <Banner
        tone="danger"
        title="Agent OS isn't responding"
        actions={
          <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={onReload}>
            Try again
          </button>
        }
      >
        The recordings can&apos;t be listed right now. This page tries again every few seconds.
      </Banner>
    );
  }

  const { rows, removedByCap } = value.data;
  const copy = resuming ? resumeConfirmCopy(resuming.session) : null;
  return (
    <div className="os-runs-rec__wrap">
      {value.stale ? (
        <Banner tone="warn" title="Can't reach Agent OS">
          This is the last list it got. It keeps trying, and this page updates by itself when Agent OS is back.
        </Banner>
      ) : null}
      {removedByCap > 0 ? <Banner tone="info">{CAP_NOTE}</Banner> : null}
      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState icon={CircleDot} title={EMPTY_TITLE} body={EMPTY_BODY} />
      ) : (
        <div className="os-table os-runs-rec" role="table" aria-label="Session recordings">
          <div className="os-table__head" role="row">
            <span className="os-table__cell" role="columnheader">
              Recording
            </span>
            <span className="os-table__cell" role="columnheader">
              State
            </span>
            <span className="os-table__cell os-runs-rec__len" role="columnheader">
              Length
            </span>
            <span className="os-table__cell os-runs-rec__when" role="columnheader">
              Recorded
            </span>
            <span className="os-table__cell" role="columnheader">
              <span className="os-visually-hidden">Actions</span>
            </span>
          </div>
          {rows.map((row) => {
            const session = byId.get(row.sessionId);
            const action = rowAction(row, session, sessionsState);
            const length = recordingLength(row, now);
            const lit = row.sessionId === highlight;
            const title = sessionTitle(row);
            const where = whereWords(row);
            return (
              <div
                key={row.sessionId}
                className={`os-table__row os-runs-rec__row${lit ? " is-highlighted" : ""}`}
                role="row"
                data-recording={row.sessionId}
                tabIndex={lit ? -1 : undefined}
              >
                <div className="os-table__cell" role="cell">
                  <span className="os-table__title os-trunc" title={title}>
                    {title}
                  </span>
                  <span className="os-table__sub os-trunc" title={where}>
                    {where}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="os-table__cell" role="cell">
                  {action.kind === "open" ? <StatusWord state="live" label="Recording" /> : <StatusWord state="ready" label="Saved" />}
                </div>
                <div className="os-table__cell os-runs-rec__len" role="cell">
                  <span className="os-mono">{length.value}</span>
                  {length.soFar ? <span className="os-runs-rec__sofar">so far</span> : null}
                </div>
                <div className="os-table__cell os-runs-rec__when" role="cell">
                  {row.startedAt ? <TimeAgo since={row.startedAt} /> : "—"}
                </div>
                <div className="os-table__cell os-runs-rec__acts" role="cell">
                  {action.kind === "open" ? (
                    <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => navigateTo("sessions", { session: row.sessionId })}>
                      <SquareTerminal size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
                      Open live session
                    </button>
                  ) : null}
                  {action.kind === "resume" ? (
                    <>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="os-btn os-btn--secondary"
                        disabled={!action.available || !session}
                        aria-describedby={`os-rec-note-${row.sessionId}`}
                        onClick={() => {
                          if (session) setResuming({ session, busy: false, error: "", toSafety: false });
                        }}
                      >
                        <History size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
                        Resume conversation
                      </button>
                      <span id={`os-rec-note-${row.sessionId}`} className="os-runs-rec__note">
                        {action.available ? REPLAY_LATER : `${action.reason} ${REPLAY_LATER}.`}
                      </span>
                    </>
                  ) : null}
                  {action.kind === "none" && !row.live ? <span className="os-runs-rec__note">{REPLAY_LATER}</span> : null}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {resuming && copy ? (
        <AgentConfirmModal
          title={copy.title}
          confirmLabel="Resume conversation"
          busy={resuming.busy}
          onConfirm={() => void confirmResume()}
          onClose={() => {
            if (!resuming.busy) setResuming(null);
          }}
        >
          <p>{copy.body}</p>
          {copy.warning ? <Banner tone="warn">{copy.warning}</Banner> : null}
          {resuming.error ? (
            <p className="os-newrun__error" role="alert">
              {resuming.error}{" "}
              {resuming.toSafety ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="os-newrun__link"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setResuming(null);
                    navigateTo("safety");
                  }}
                >
                  Open Safety
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </AgentConfirmModal>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

When Resume is blocked, the note reads, for example, "Another Codex session is open in this folder. Stop it first. Replay arrives in a later update." (the reason, then the replay note). While the sessions list loads it reads "… Replay arrives in a later update.".

- [ ] **Step 14: Rewrite `src/pages/RunsPage.tsx`.** Replace the whole file with:

```tsx
// Runs: the Board of every run in three bays (Active, Held, Landed), the Session recordings tab (every recorded
// session, Task U4), and one run's console when ?run=<id> is set. ?tab=recordings opens the recordings tab, and
// ?highlight=<session id> marks one of its rows ("Open recording" on an ended Sessions tab lands there).
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { ArrowLeft, Plus } from "lucide-react";
import { listRuns } from "../api";
import { navigateTo, queryParam } from "../nav";
import type { RunMeta } from "../types";
import Banner from "../ui/components/Banner";
import PageHeader from "../ui/components/PageHeader";
import RunBoard from "../ui/components/RunBoard";
import RunConsole from "../ui/components/RunConsole";
import SessionRecordings, { useRecordings } from "../ui/components/SessionRecordings";
import Tabs, { tabPanelProps } from "../ui/components/Tabs";
import { useInterval } from "../ui/components/useInterval";
import { openNewRun, takeFocusNextRun } from "../ui/newRun";
import { SAFE_EXAMPLE_PROMPT } from "../ui/onboardingShared";
import { splitBays } from "../ui/runsBoard";
import "../ui/runs.css";

const WATCHDOG_MS = 15000;
type TabId = "board" | "recordings";
const tabFromUrl = (): TabId => (queryParam("tab") === "recordings" ? "recordings" : "board");

export default function RunsPage() {
  const [runs, setRuns] = useState<RunMeta[] | null>(null);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false); // the last load failed
  const [timedOut, setTimedOut] = useState(false); // nothing has loaded for 15 seconds
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState(() => queryParam("run"));
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<TabId>(tabFromUrl);
  const [highlight, setHighlight] = useState(() => queryParam("highlight"));
  // True when the run was opened by something the person did (Start run in the dialog, a row on the Board), so the
  // console takes keyboard focus: the control they used is gone. A page loaded straight on ?run= does not grab focus.
  const [focusConsole, setFocusConsole] = useState(() => takeFocusNextRun());
  // The recordings are read only while their tab is on screen.
  const recordings = useRecordings(tab === "recordings" && !selectedId);

  async function loadRuns() {
    try {
      const { runs: list } = await listRuns({ limit: 100 });
      setRuns(list);
      setFailed(false);
    } catch {
      setFailed(true);
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadRuns();
  }, []);
  useInterval(() => void loadRuns(), 5000);

  // Never wait forever on a server that does not answer.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (runs !== null) {
      setTimedOut(false);
      return undefined;
    }
    const id = setTimeout(() => setTimedOut(true), WATCHDOG_MS);
    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  }, [runs]);

  useEffect(() => {
    function sync() {
      setSelectedId(queryParam("run"));
      setTab(tabFromUrl());
      setHighlight(queryParam("highlight"));
      if (queryParam("run") && takeFocusNextRun()) setFocusConsole(true);
      // The Get started checklist sends ?example=safe: open the dialog with the example typed in, then tidy
      // the address. The timer lets the Shell (the parent, whose listener is added after this page's effects
      // on a first load) be listening before the request is sent.
      if (queryParam("example") === "safe") {
        const agentId = queryParam("agent") || undefined;
        window.setTimeout(() => openNewRun({ agentId, prompt: SAFE_EXAMPLE_PROMPT }), 0);
        navigateTo("runs");
      }
    }
    sync();
    window.addEventListener("aos-navigate", sync);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("aos-navigate", sync);
  }, []);

  function open(id: string) {
    setFocusConsole(true);
    setSelectedId(id);
    navigateTo("runs", { run: id });
  }
  function back() {
    setFocusConsole(false);
    setSelectedId("");
    navigateTo("runs");
  }
  // The tab is in the address too, so a link (Open recording) and a reload land on the same tab.
  function changeTab(id: string) {
    const next: TabId = id === "recordings" ? "recordings" : "board";
    setTab(next);
    navigateTo("runs", next === "recordings" ? { tab: "recordings" } : {});
  }

  const bays = runs ? splitBays(runs) : null;
  const offline = runs === null && (failed || timedOut);
  // "New run" lives in the Active bay while that bay shows its empty state, and in the header otherwise.
  const activeEmpty = tab === "board" && !selectedId && bays !== null && bays.active.length === 0;
  const count = (n: number | undefined) => (n === undefined ? (offline ? "—" : "…") : n);
  const recCount = recordings.value.state === "ok" ? recordings.value.data.rows.length : recordings.value.state === "error" ? "—" : "…";
  // Where sessions do not run (404 not_available), the tab says so and claims nothing about this computer.
  const recUnavailable = recordings.value.state === "unavailable";

  const lede = selectedId
    ? undefined
    : tab === "board"
      ? "A run is one task an agent does on its own. It starts Active, may be Held by a limit, and ends Landed."
      : recUnavailable
        ? undefined
        : "Every session is recorded here as it happens, on this computer, so you can pick the conversation up again.";

  return (
    <section className={`os-runs${selectedId ? " os-runs--detail" : ""}`} aria-labelledby="os-runs-title">
      <PageHeader
        title="Runs"
        titleId="os-runs-title"
        lede={lede}
        actions={
          selectedId || activeEmpty ? undefined : (
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--primary" onClick={() => openNewRun()}>
              <Plus size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
              New run
            </button>
          )
        }
      />

      {selectedId ? (
        <div className="os-runs__detail">
          <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--ghost os-runs__back" onClick={back}>
            <ArrowLeft size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
            All runs
          </button>
          <RunConsole runId={selectedId} focusTitle={focusConsole} onEnded={() => void loadRuns()} />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="os-runs__tabbar">
            <Tabs
              label="Runs views"
              idPrefix="runs"
              tabs={[
                { id: "board", label: "Board" },
                { id: "recordings", label: "Session recordings" }
              ]}
              value={tab}
              onChange={changeTab}
            />
            <p className="os-runs__tally">
              {tab === "board" ? (
                <>
                  <span className="os-mono">{count(bays?.active.length)}</span> in the air
                  <span className="os-runs__sep" aria-hidden="true" />
                  <span className="os-mono">{count(bays?.held.length)}</span> held
                  <span className="os-runs__sep" aria-hidden="true" />
                  <span className="os-mono">{count(bays?.landed.length)}</span> landed
                </>
              ) : recUnavailable ? null : (
                <>
                  <span className="os-mono">{recCount}</span> kept on this computer
                </>
              )}
            </p>
          </div>

          {tab === "board" ? (
            <div {...tabPanelProps("runs", "board")}>
              {offline ? (
                <Banner
                  tone="danger"
                  title="Agent OS isn't responding"
                  actions={
                    <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => void loadRuns()}>
                      Try again
                    </button>
                  }
                >
                  {failed ? "The runs can't be listed right now." : "It is taking too long to answer, so the runs can't be listed yet."} Agent OS keeps trying, and
                  this page fills in by itself when it is back.
                </Banner>
              ) : (
                <>
                  {runs && failed ? (
                    <Banner tone="warn" title="Can't reach Agent OS">
                      This is the last list it got. It keeps trying, and this page updates by itself when Agent OS is back.
                    </Banner>
                  ) : null}
                  <RunBoard runs={runs} onOpen={open} onNew={() => openNewRun()} />
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div {...tabPanelProps("runs", "recordings")}>
              <SessionRecordings value={recordings.value} highlight={highlight} onReload={recordings.reload} />
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 18: Create `src/pages/HelpPage.tsx`.**

```tsx
// Help: "How a session works" (the prototype's how-it-works.html, in its SP3 form). Not in the menu: Safety's "How
// stopping works" and the Sessions page's "How a session works" link here. Every sentence is true today: the alerts,
// the Home strip, the top-bar badge, desktop notifications and hand-offs arrive later, so this page does not show them
// (the prototype's Lane B, its hand-off item and its "Review guide" button are left out). What closing the window does
// depends on where Agent OS runs (lifeSection, helpShared.ts). The diagrams are the prototype's SVGs on the app's tokens.
import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import { CircleHelp, CircleStop, History, Lock, Maximize, Power, SquareTerminal, X } from "lucide-react";
import type { LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";
import PageHeader from "../ui/components/PageHeader";
import { isDesktopApp } from "../ui/desktop";
import { GLOSSARY, HELP_LEDE, HELP_TITLE, PROMISES, ROUTE_QUIET, ROUTE_TITLE, ROUTE_WORDS, lifeSection } from "../ui/helpShared";
import type { LifeStep } from "../ui/helpShared";
import "../ui/help.css";

const IS_MAC = typeof navigator !== "undefined" && /mac/i.test(navigator.platform || navigator.userAgent || "");
const STEP_ICON: Record<LifeStep["id"], LucideIcon> = { close: X, reopen: Maximize, quit: Power, resume: History };
const PROMISE_ICON: Record<string, LucideIcon> = { stop: CircleStop, flags: Lock, answers: CircleHelp };
const AGENT_CHIPS: Array<[number, number, number, string]> = [
  [832, 104, 62, "claude"],
  [902, 104, 56, "codex"],
  [966, 104, 54, "agent"],
  [832, 138, 62, "hermes"],
  [902, 138, 78, "openclaw"]
];

// The prototype's lane A only (lane B, the alerts, is SP4): the window, the private connection, the engine (with its
// real terminal, invisible screen copy and local recording) and the agent's own program.
function RouteDiagram({ engineNote }: { engineNote: string }) {
  return (
    <svg className="os-help-svg" viewBox="24 0 1012 340" role="img" aria-labelledby="os-help-route-t os-help-route-d">
      <title id="os-help-route-t">How typing travels between the Agent OS window and an agent</title>
      <desc id="os-help-route-d">
        Your keys go from the Agent OS window over a private connection to the engine on your computer, which types them into the agent&apos;s real
        terminal. The agent&apos;s screen goes back through an invisible screen copy, which is also recorded on this computer, and is streamed to your
        window.
      </desc>
      <defs>
        <marker id="os-help-ah-g" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8.5" refY="5" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" orient="auto">
          <path d="M1.5 1.5 8.5 5 1.5 8.5" className="os-help-arrow os-help-arrow--g" />
        </marker>
        <marker id="os-help-ah-b" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8.5" refY="5" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" orient="auto">
          <path d="M1.5 1.5 8.5 5 1.5 8.5" className="os-help-arrow os-help-arrow--b" />
        </marker>
      </defs>

      {/* The private connection, drawn behind the arrows that travel through it. */}
      <rect x="250" y="92" width="128" height="156" rx="8" className="os-help-ws" />
      <text x="314" y="110" textAnchor="middle" className="os-help-s os-help-blue os-help-strong">
        Private connection
      </text>
      <text x="314" y="126" textAnchor="middle" className="os-help-m os-help-blue">
        a WebSocket
      </text>

      {/* Agent OS window */}
      <rect x="24" y="36" width="220" height="200" rx="10" className="os-help-box" />
      <text x="40" y="66" className="os-help-t">
        Agent OS window
      </text>
      <text x="40" y="86" className="os-help-s">
        What you see and type into
      </text>
      <rect x="40" y="104" width="188" height="116" rx="6" className="os-help-screen" />
      <rect x="48" y="112" width="62" height="16" rx="3" className="os-help-tab" />
      <rect x="114" y="112" width="62" height="16" rx="3" className="os-help-tab2" />
      <rect x="48" y="142" width="118" height="5" rx="2.5" className="os-help-l8" />
      <rect x="48" y="154" width="150" height="5" rx="2.5" className="os-help-l4" />
      <rect x="48" y="166" width="96" height="5" rx="2.5" className="os-help-l2" />
      <rect x="48" y="178" width="132" height="5" rx="2.5" className="os-help-l8" />
      <rect x="48" y="192" width="7" height="12" className="os-help-cursor" />

      {/* Engine */}
      <rect x="384" y="36" width="282" height="292" rx="10" className="os-help-box" />
      <text x="400" y="66" className="os-help-t">
        Engine on your computer
      </text>
      <text x="400" y="86" className="os-help-s">
        {engineNote}
      </text>
      <text x="400" y="112" className="os-help-s os-help-strong">
        Session manager
      </text>
      <rect x="400" y="124" width="250" height="52" rx="8" className="os-help-part" />
      <text x="414" y="146" className="os-help-t14">
        Real terminal
      </text>
      <text x="414" y="164" className="os-help-s">
        a pseudo-terminal for the agent
      </text>
      <path d="M525 177 V190" className="os-help-line os-help-line--g" markerEnd="url(#os-help-ah-g)" />
      <rect x="400" y="192" width="250" height="52" rx="8" className="os-help-part" />
      <text x="414" y="214" className="os-help-t14">
        Invisible screen copy
      </text>
      <text x="414" y="232" className="os-help-s">
        always knows what is on screen
      </text>
      <path d="M525 245 V258" className="os-help-line os-help-line--g" markerEnd="url(#os-help-ah-g)" />
      <rect x="400" y="260" width="250" height="52" rx="8" className="os-help-part" />
      <text x="414" y="282" className="os-help-t14">

      <text x="414" y="300" className="os-help-s">

      {/* Agent program */}
      <rect x="816" y="36" width="220" height="200" rx="10" className="os-help-box" />
      <text x="832" y="66" className="os-help-t">

      {AGENT_CHIPS.map(([x, y, w, label]) => (
        <g key={label}>
          <rect x={x} y={y} width={w} height="26" rx="5" className="os-help-part" />
          <text x={x + w / 2} y={y + 17.5} textAnchor="middle" className="os-help-m">

      <text x="832" y="190" className="os-help-s">

      </text>
      <text x="832" y="208" className="os-help-s">
        Hermes, OpenClaw
      </text>

      {/* The arrows */}
      <text x="314" y="158" textAnchor="middle" className="os-help-s">
        you type
      </text>
      <path d="M246 166 H398" className="os-help-line os-help-line--b" markerEnd="url(#os-help-ah-b)" />
      <text x="314" y="212" textAnchor="middle" className="os-help-s">
        the screen
      </text>
      <path d="M398 222 H246" className="os-help-line os-help-line--b" markerEnd="url(#os-help-ah-b)" />
      <text x="741" y="130" textAnchor="middle" className="os-help-s">
        what you typed

      <path d="M814 166 H652" className="os-help-line os-help-line--g" markerEnd="url(#os-help-ah-g)" />
      <text x="741" y="186" textAnchor="middle" className="os-help-s">
        what it draws
      </text>
    </svg>
  );
}

// The prototype's timeline under the four steps: shown only where closing the window hides it (macOS desktop app).
function Timeline() {
  const bar = (x: number, y: number, w: number, kind: "solid" | "live" | "dash", label: string) => (
    <g key={`${x}-${y}`}>
      <rect x={x} y={y} width={w} height="22" rx="4" className={`os-help-bar--${kind}`} />
      <text x={x + 10} y={y + 15.5} className={kind === "live" ? "os-help-s os-help-blue os-help-strong" : "os-help-s"}>
        {label}
      </text>
    </g>
  );
  return (
    <svg className="os-help-svg" viewBox="0 0 1060 152" role="img" aria-labelledby="os-help-time-t os-help-time-d">
      <title id="os-help-time-t">The window and your sessions across the four steps</title>
      <desc id="os-help-time-d">
        Step 1: the window is closed and the sessions keep running. Step 2: the window is open again and the sessions are still running. Step 3: Agent
        OS is quit, the window is gone and the sessions end. Step 4: Agent OS is opened again and the conversation continues through the agent&apos;s own
        resume.
      </desc>
      <g className="os-help-sep">
        <line x1="265" y1="2" x2="265" y2="126" />
        <line x1="530" y1="2" x2="530" y2="126" />
        <line x1="795" y1="2" x2="795" y2="126" />
      </g>
      <text x="0" y="16" className="os-help-lane">
        Agent OS window
      </text>
      {bar(0, 26, 261, "dash", "closed")}
      {bar(269, 26, 257, "solid", "open again, screen restored")}
      {bar(534, 26, 257, "dash", "Agent OS is not running")}
      {bar(799, 26, 261, "solid", "open")}
      <text x="0" y="84" className="os-help-lane">
        Your sessions
      </text>
      {bar(0, 94, 518, "live", "Running the whole time, window open or not")}
      <CircleStop x={521} y={96} size={18} className="os-help-warn-icon" aria-hidden="true" />
      {bar(545, 94, 246, "dash", "can be resumed")}
      {bar(799, 94, 261, "live", "conversation continues")}
      <text x="530" y="140" className="os-help-s">
        ended on quit
      </text>
      <text x="799" y="140" className="os-help-s">
        through the agent&apos;s own resume
      </text>
    </svg>
  );
}

export default function HelpPage() {
  const life = lifeSection({ desktop: isDesktopApp(), isMac: IS_MAC });
  return (
    <section className="os-help" aria-labelledby="os-help-title">
      <PageHeader titleId="os-help-title" title={HELP_TITLE} lede={HELP_LEDE} />

      <section className="os-help-section" aria-labelledby="os-help-route">
        <div className="os-help-section__head">
          <h2 id="os-help-route">{ROUTE_TITLE}</h2>
          <p className="os-help-section__quiet">{ROUTE_QUIET}</p>
        </div>
        <RouteDiagram engineNote={life.engineNote} />
        <div className="os-help-legend" aria-hidden="true">
          <span>
            <i className="is-b" />
            Private connection
          </span>
          <span>
            <i />
            Inside your computer
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="os-help-words">
          <h3>
            <SquareTerminal size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
            In words
          </h3>
          <ol className="os-help-list">
            {ROUTE_WORDS.map((parts, index) => (
              <li key={index}>
                <span>{parts.map((part, i) => (part.bold ? <b key={i}>{part.text}</b> : <span key={i}>{part.text}</span>))}</span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ol>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="os-help-section" aria-labelledby="os-help-life">
        <div className="os-help-section__head">
          <h2 id="os-help-life">{life.title}</h2>
          <p className="os-help-section__quiet">{life.quiet}</p>
        </div>
        <ol className="os-help-steps" style={{ "--os-help-steps": life.steps.length } as CSSProperties}>
          {life.steps.map((step, index) => {
            const Icon = STEP_ICON[step.id];
            return (
              <li key={step.id} className={step.id === "quit" ? "is-quit" : undefined}>
                <span className="os-help-n" aria-hidden="true">
                  {index + 1}
                </span>
                <h3>
                  <Icon size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
                  {step.title}
                </h3>
                <p>{step.body}</p>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ol>
        {life.timeline ? (
          <div className="os-help-time">
            <Timeline />
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </section>

      <section className="os-help-section" aria-label="Promises">
        <div className="os-help-pair">
          {PROMISES.map((promise) => {
            const Icon = PROMISE_ICON[promise.id] || CircleHelp;
            return (
              <div key={promise.id}>
                <h3>
                  <Icon size={20} aria-hidden="true" />
                  {promise.title}
                </h3>
                <p>{promise.body}</p>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="os-help-section" aria-labelledby="os-help-gloss">
        <div className="os-help-section__head">
          <h2 id="os-help-gloss">Three words used above</h2>
        </div>
        <dl className="os-help-gloss">
          {GLOSSARY.map((item) => (
            <div key={item.term}>
              <dt>{item.term}</dt>
              <dd>{item.text}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      </section>
    </section>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 22: Create the probe `.superpowers/ui-audit/probes/sp3-pages.mjs`** (git-ignored).

```js
// Task U4: Home's New session and Orbit, Agents' Open/New session and "What works here", Runs → Session recordings,
// Safety's "How stopping works" and the Help page.
// Run (after `npm run build`), from the worktree root:
//   node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs probe .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/sp3-pages.mjs
// Real throwaway server (the fake login shell as SHELL) and real PTY sessions of W1's TUI-like fake, through the six
// shims Task U1 put in fake-bin/. Page-level stubs (route) only for what the fakes and the harness cannot produce: an
// update recording, the 1 GB cap note, an empty list, a server where sessions do not run, a Look only refusal and an
// unlocked gate for Safety's level words (the harness's gate is locked on by HERMES_AGENT_OS_ENABLE_EXEC=1), a
// not-installed agent and a Windows computer.
// Nothing here starts a real agent.
import { mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const W = 1470, H = 956;
const WORKS = "Agent OS runs each agent's own terminal program, with your login, settings, plugins, skills, MCP servers and hooks. Features that live only in a vendor's desktop app or editor, such as the Claude desktop app, the Codex app or the Cursor editor, are not part of a terminal, so they are not here.";
const LOOK_ONLY = "Safety is on Look only, so no session can start. Allow running agents in Safety, then try again.";

export default async function ({ browser, openPage, shot, pass, fail, BASE, HOME }) {
  const check = (ok, name, why = "") => (ok ? pass(name) : fail(name, String(why)));
  if (!HOME) {
    fail("harness", "audit.mjs does not pass HOME to probes yet (Task U1 sets up the harness)");
    return;
  }
  const myApp = path.join(HOME, "projects", "my-app");
  mkdirSync(myApp, { recursive: true });
  const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
  const waitFor = async (fn, ms = 10000) => {
    const end = Date.now() + ms;
    while (Date.now() < end) {
      try { if (await fn()) return true; } catch {}
      await sleep(250);
    }
    return false;
  };
  const sideways = (tab) => tab.evaluate(() => document.scrollingElement.scrollWidth > document.scrollingElement.clientWidth);
  const go = async (tab, query) => {
    await tab.goto(`${BASE}/?${query}`);
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
  };
  const selectedTabText = async (tab) => (await tab.locator('.os-sess-tabs [role="tab"][aria-selected="true"]').textContent()) || "";
  async function startSession(tab, agent, folder) {
    await go(tab, "page=sessions");
    await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" }).first().click();
    const dialog = tab.getByRole("dialog", { name: "New session" });
    await dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: agent, exact: true }).click();
    await dialog.getByLabel("Folder (full path)").fill(folder);
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Start session" }).click();
    await waitFor(async () => (await dialog.count()) === 0, 25000);
    await waitFor(async () => Boolean(new URL(tab.url()).searchParams.get("session")), 5000);
    return new URL(tab.url()).searchParams.get("session") || "";
  }
  async function stopSession(tab, id) {
    await go(tab, `page=sessions&session=${id}`);
    await tab.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Session details" }).getByRole("button", { name: "Stop session" }).click();
    await tab.getByRole("dialog", { name: /^Stop / }).getByRole("button", { name: "Stop session" }).click();
    return waitFor(async () => /Ended · open recording/.test(await selectedTabText(tab)), 15000);
  }

  // 1. Home, nothing open: New session is the page's one primary button and opens the dialog.
  {
    const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "fleet");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
    const button = tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" });
    check((await button.count()) === 1 && /os-btn--primary/.test((await button.getAttribute("class")) || ""), "Home: New session is the page's primary button");
    check(await tab.getByText("All five are installed. Nothing is running right now.").isVisible(), "quiet lede with no session");
    check(/Open sessions\s*0/.test((await tab.locator(".os-home-activity__quiet").textContent()) || ""), "Recent activity: Open sessions 0");
    await button.click();
    check(await tab.getByRole("dialog", { name: "New session" }).isVisible(), "Home's New session opens the dialog");
    await tab.keyboard.press("Escape");
    check(await tab.evaluate(() => Boolean(document.activeElement?.textContent?.includes("New session"))), "focus is back on New session");
    check(errors.length === 0, "Home console clean", errors.join(" / "));
    await shot(tab, "sp3-pages", W, H, "home-quiet");
    await context.close();
  }
  {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, 1280, 720, "fleet");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1200);
    const box = await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" }).boundingBox();
    check(Boolean(box) && box.y >= 0 && box.y + box.height <= 720, "1280x720: New session is on screen", JSON.stringify(box));
    await context.close();
  }

  // 2. A live session lights Claude Code's line; after 20 s with no new output it is idle, and idle stays dim.
  let id = "";
  {
    const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "sessions");
    id = await startSession(tab, "Claude Code", myApp);
    check(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/.test(id), "a session started through the dialog", id);
    const started = Date.now();
    await go(tab, "page=fleet");
    check(await waitFor(async () => (await tab.locator(".os-orbit [data-agent='claude']").getAttribute("data-state")) === "live", 10000), "Home: a live session lights Claude Code's line");
    check(await tab.getByText("Claude Code is working.").isVisible(), "the lede names who is working");
    const row = (await tab.locator(".os-home-agents .os-table__row", { hasText: "Claude Code" }).textContent()) || "";
    check(/Live/.test(row) && /Session in my-app/.test(row), "the agent row says Live and Session in my-app", row);
    check(/Open sessions\s*1/.test((await tab.locator(".os-home-activity__quiet").textContent()) || ""), "Recent activity: Open sessions 1");
    await shot(tab, "sp3-pages", W, H, "home-live");
    await sleep(Math.max(0, 27000 - (Date.now() - started)));
    check(await waitFor(async () => (await tab.locator(".os-orbit [data-agent='claude']").getAttribute("data-state")) === "dim", 10000), "Home: an idle session stays dim");
    const idleRow = (await tab.locator(".os-home-agents .os-table__row", { hasText: "Claude Code" }).textContent()) || "";
    check(/Idle/.test(idleRow) && /Session in my-app/.test(idleRow), "the agent row says Idle and Session in my-app", idleRow);
    check(errors.length === 0, "console clean (Home with a session)", errors.join(" / "));
    await context.close();
  }

  // 3. Agents: Open session for an agent with an open session, New session otherwise, and What works here for every agent.
  {
    const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "agents&agent=claude");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(2000);
    const open = tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Open session" });
    check(await open.isVisible(), "Agents: Claude Code has an open session, so Open session");
    check((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" }).count()) === 0, "and no New session beside it");
    check(await tab.getByRole("heading", { name: "What works here" }).isVisible(), "What works here");
    check(await tab.getByText(WORKS).isVisible(), "the decided H8 words");
    await shot(tab, "sp3-pages", W, H, "agents-claude");
    await open.click();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(800);
    const url = new URL(tab.url());
    check(url.searchParams.get("page") === "sessions" && url.searchParams.get("session") === id, "Open session lands on that session's tab", url.search);
    await go(tab, "page=agents&agent=codex");
    const fresh = tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" });
    check(await fresh.isVisible(), "Agents: Codex has no session, so New session");
    await fresh.click();
    const dialog = tab.getByRole("dialog", { name: "New session" });
    check((await dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: "Codex", exact: true }).getAttribute("aria-checked")) === "true", "the dialog starts on Codex");
    await tab.keyboard.press("Escape");
    const agentsList = (u) => u.pathname === "/api/agents";
    await tab.route(agentsList, async (route) => {
      if (route.request().method() !== "GET") return route.continue();
      const res = await route.fetch();
      const body = await res.json();
      for (const a of body.agents || []) if (a.id === "codex") a.detected = { ...a.detected, installed: false };
      return route.fulfill({ response: res, json: body });
    });
    await tab.reload();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(2000);
    check((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" }).count()) === 0, "a missing agent offers no New session");
    check(await tab.getByRole("heading", { name: "What works here" }).isVisible(), "What works here also for a missing agent");
    await tab.unroute(agentsList);
    check(errors.length === 0, "Agents console clean", errors.join(" / "));
    await context.close();
  }

  // 4. Runs → Session recordings: a live row, Open recording's highlight, the ended row, and Resume from here.
  {
    const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "runs&tab=recordings");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
    check(/Session recordings/.test((await tab.getByRole("tab", { selected: true }).textContent()) || ""), "?tab=recordings opens the recordings tab");
    const row = tab.locator(".os-runs-rec__row", { hasText: "Claude Code · my-app" });
    check(await waitFor(async () => (await row.count()) === 1, 8000), "the session's recording is listed");
    check(/Recording/.test((await row.textContent()) || ""), "a live recording reads Recording");
    check(await row.getByRole("button", { name: "Open live session" }).isVisible(), "Open live session on a live row");
    check(/kept on this computer/.test((await tab.locator(".os-runs__tally").textContent()) || ""), "the tally says where recordings are kept");
    check(!(await sideways(tab)), "recordings: no sideways scroll");
    await shot(tab, "sp3-pages", W, H, "runs-recordings-live");
    await row.getByRole("button", { name: "Open live session" }).click();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(800);
    check(new URL(tab.url()).searchParams.get("session") === id, "Open live session lands on the session");
    check(await stopSession(tab, id), "stopped from the Sessions page");
    await tab.getByRole("complementary", { name: "Session details" }).getByRole("button", { name: "Open recording" }).click();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
    const lit = tab.locator(".os-runs-rec__row.is-highlighted");
    check((await lit.count()) === 1 && (await lit.getAttribute("data-recording")) === id, "Open recording: that row is highlighted");
    check(await tab.evaluate(() => Boolean(document.activeElement?.classList.contains("is-highlighted"))), "and it takes focus");
    const litText = (await lit.textContent()) || "";
    check(/Saved/.test(litText) && /Replay arrives in a later update/.test(litText), "an ended row: Saved, and the replay note", litText);
    const resume = lit.getByRole("button", { name: "Resume conversation" });
    check(await waitFor(async () => await resume.isEnabled(), 8000), "Resume conversation is offered");
    await shot(tab, "sp3-pages", W, H, "runs-recordings-ended");
    await resume.click();
    const confirm = tab.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Resume Claude Code · my-app?" });
    check(await confirm.isVisible(), "Resume asks first, with the decided title");
    // Review Focus 5 (ruling R28): at Look only the server refuses a resume with 409 execution_gate_off (S6). The
    // harness's gate is locked on, so this one answer is stubbed; the dialog stays open, says why and offers Safety.
    const resumeCall = (u) => /^\/api\/sessions\/[^/]+\/resume$/.test(u.pathname);
    await tab.route(resumeCall, (route) =>
      route.fulfill({ status: 409, contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify({ error: "execution_gate_off", message: LOOK_ONLY }) })
    );
    await confirm.getByRole("button", { name: "Resume conversation" }).click();
    check(await waitFor(async () => await confirm.getByText(LOOK_ONLY).isVisible(), 5000), "Look only: Resume is refused with the Look only sentence");
    check(await confirm.getByRole("button", { name: "Open Safety" }).isVisible(), "Look only: the refusal offers Open Safety");
    check(new URL(tab.url()).searchParams.get("page") === "runs", "Look only: the page stays on Runs");
    await tab.unroute(resumeCall);
    await confirm.getByRole("button", { name: "Resume conversation" }).click();
    check(await waitFor(async () => new URL(tab.url()).searchParams.get("page") === "sessions", 20000), "Resume lands on Sessions");
    check(await waitFor(async () => !/Ended/.test(await selectedTabText(tab)), 15000), "the same tab is open again");
    check(errors.length === 0, "Runs console clean", errors.join(" / "));
    await context.close();
  }

  // 5. What the fakes cannot produce: an update recording, the cap note, an empty list, and a server where sessions
  // do not run.
  {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "runs&tab=recordings");
    const recList = (u) => u.pathname === "/api/recordings";
    await tab.route(recList, async (route) => {
      const res = await route.fetch();
      const body = await res.json();
      const list = Array.isArray(body) ? body : body.recordings || [];
      const update = {
        sessionId: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", kind: "update", agentId: "hermes", agentLabel: "Hermes",
        folder: `${HOME}/.hermes/hermes-agent`, folderName: "hermes-agent", folderShown: true,
        startedAt: new Date(Date.now() - 600000).toISOString(), endedAt: new Date(Date.now() - 300000).toISOString(), bytes: 2048, live: false
      };
      return route.fulfill({ response: res, json: { recordings: [update, ...list], removedByCap: 2 } });
    });
    await tab.reload();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(2000);
    const upd = tab.locator(".os-runs-rec__row", { hasText: "Hermes update" });
    check((await upd.count()) === 1, "an update recording reads Hermes update");
    check((await upd.getByRole("button").count()) === 0, "an update recording offers no button");
    check(await tab.getByText("Older recordings were removed to stay under 1 GB.").isVisible(), "the cap note");
    await shot(tab, "sp3-pages", W, H, "runs-recordings-update");
    await tab.unroute(recList);
    const emptyList = (u) => u.pathname === "/api/recordings";
    await tab.route(emptyList, (route) => route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify({ recordings: [], removedByCap: 0 }) }));
    await tab.reload();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
    check(await tab.getByText("No recordings yet").isVisible(), "empty: No recordings yet");
    check(await tab.getByText("Every session is recorded here: what its terminal showed, including anything you typed that appeared on screen.").isVisible(), "empty: the decided body");
    await shot(tab, "sp3-pages", W, H, "runs-recordings-empty");
    await tab.unroute(emptyList);
    // Where sessions do not run, the route answers 404 not_available (S8's requireLocalMode): said once, never
    // "isn't responding", and not asked again.
    const gone = (u) => u.pathname === "/api/recordings";
    let asks = 0;
    await tab.route(gone, (route) => {
      asks += 1;
      return route.fulfill({ status: 404, contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify({ error: "not_available" }) });

    await tab.waitForTimeout(6500);
    check(await tab.getByText("Session recordings aren't available here").isVisible(), "not available: the tab says so");

    check(!/kept on this computer/.test((await tab.locator(".os-runs__tally").textContent()) || ""), "not available: the tally claims nothing");
    check(asks === 1, "not available: asked once, not every 5 s", asks);
    await tab.unroute(gone);
    await context.close();

  // 6. Safety's level words (the server is at Level 1: sessions started above), its link, and the Help page in a

    await tab.route("**/api/execution-gate", (r) => (r.request().method() === "GET" ? r.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify({ enabled: true, level: 1, envLocked: false }) }) : r.continue()));

    await shot(tab, "sp3-pages", W, H, "safety-levels");

    check((await tab.locator('.os-nav__item[aria-current="page"]').count()) === 0, "Help is not in the menu, so no menu item reads as current");
    const text = (await tab.locator(".os-help").innerText()) || "";

    check(/OpenClaw may still finish its last step after the terminal closes\./.test(text), "Stop adds the OpenClaw sentence");
    check(/Stop ends the agent and what runs under it/.test(text) && !/everything it started/.test(text), "Stop promises only what runs under the agent");
    check(
      /Stop on a session, Hold to stop all, or Stop all agent work ends the agent's program and the commands it started in its terminal\./.test(text) &&
        /A Claude Code background task moved with \/bg may keep running if Agent OS can't find it/.test(text) &&
        !/Stop all runs/.test(text),
      "Stop names the three ways to stop and the /bg limit (rulings R22, R24)"
    );
    check(/Close this tab/.test(text), "browser tab: closing the tab, not the window");
    check(await tab.getByRole("img", { name: "How typing travels between the Agent OS window and an agent" }).isVisible(), "the diagram has a name");
    check(!(await sideways(tab)), "Help: no sideways scroll");
    check(errors.length === 0, "Help console clean", errors.join(" / "));
    await shot(tab, "sp3-pages", W, H, "help-browser");
    await context.close();

  // 7. The Help page in the desktop app: on a Mac, and on Windows (navigator.platform set before the page loads).
  {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "help&desktop=1");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1000);
    check(await tab.getByText("Close the window, and nothing stops").isVisible(), "desktop on a Mac: the window hides, nothing stops");
    check(

    check((await tab.getByRole("img", { name: "The window and your sessions across the four steps" }).count()) === 0, "Windows: no timeline of a closed window with running sessions");

  // 8. The Sessions empty state links here too.
```

### Task B1a: Setup session kind, OpenClaw sign-in terminal routes and the 2026.9.7 version gate

OpenClaw's official "Sign in with ChatGPT" (`openclaw models auth login --provider openai --method siwc`) refuses to run without a real terminal, so the plan-brains spec (§1) gives the session engine a third kind next to `agent` and `update`: a `setup` session that runs exactly that one command in the person's HOME and keeps nothing. This task builds that kind on the server. `profiles.js` gets a frozen action table (`SETUP_ACTIONS`, today one action, `OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION`) and learns `kind: "setup"` in `buildSessionProfile` and `assertSessionArgvSafe`, so the only argv a setup session can ever run is the action's own, item by item, and an agent session can never run it. The manager gets `createSetupSession({ action, detected })` and `liveSetupSession()`. A setup session lives in memory only: no session folder, no meta.json, no recorder (the recorder factory is never called). It is not counted toward the 8 live sessions and not gated by Safety. One runs at a time: a second start gets 409 `setup_running` naming the first one, even while the first is still starting, because its id is made before anything else. It never appears in the quit question. Its input goes straight to the PTY and is never scanned. Its mirror is disposed the moment it ends, and in that same step it leaves the live list, so it is simply gone: 404 from every session route, and the WebSocket refuses a window. Hold to stop all and quitting stop it like any session.

It also adds the two routes the brain card uses, `POST` and `GET /api/setup/openclaw/signin-terminal`, each behind `requireLocalMode`, and the server half of §3's version gate: `parseVersion` and `versionAtLeast` are exported from `resolve.js`, and a new `setup/openclaw-version.js` turns OpenClaw's detected version line into `{ have, need, newEnough }`. The start route reads OpenClaw with a fresh detection every time (never the 30 s cache), so an update installed a moment ago counts. It refuses an OpenClaw that is missing (409 `agent_not_installed`, the sessions sentence), whose version can't be read (409 `openclaw_version_unknown`) or that is older than 2026.9.7 (409 `openclaw_too_old`), with the spec's sentences, and answers every session refusal with `errorBody`, so `setup_running` keeps its `sessionId` and `setupAction`.

The client learns the new kind's name only where it must: `SessionKind` gains `"setup"`, `sessionTitle` and `sessionStopTitle` call a setup session "OpenClaw · ChatGPT sign-in" (the palette's "Stop all agent work" list shows it), and Hold to stop all's OpenClaw note ("OpenClaw may still be finishing its last step.") is never added for a sign-in. The card itself is Task B2. For the tests, W1's TUI fake learns `FAKE_AGENT_VERSION` and the sign-in program (a link, a code, Enter, a saved row), records every `OPENCLAW_*` variable it is given, and, under the name `openclaw`, logs each quick answer (`--version`, `--help`) as a `probe` record, so the Safety tests also check the commands detection runs. Two shared helpers are created for the later plan-brains tasks: `test/helpers/fake-knobs.js` (the knob files and the fakes' state file) and `test/helpers/plan-brains-safety.js` (the file-access spy moved out of `test/setup-builders.test.js`, plus the Safety 3 and Safety 4 checks).

This task owns plan-brains spec §1, the server half of §3's version gate, §7's two sign-in routes, Safety 2 (the setup argv), Safety 4 for the session and the detection commands before it, Safety 5, and its share of Safety 1 and 3 (the sign-in session's start and stop, the action table and the new module). It also writes Review Focus 1 and 2's server tests (an OpenClaw updated while the card is open; a sign-in left half way).

Depends on: Tasks S3 (`profiles.js`, `errors.js`), S6 and S7 (the manager, Stop and quit), S8 (`requireLocalMode`, the sessions and recordings routers), S9 (the WebSocket's `isLive` check), S10 (Hold to stop all and the live-only list), U1 (`SessionKind`, `sessionTitle`) and W1 (the TUI fake, `makeFakeAgentBin`, `FAKE_LOGIN_SHELL`). It runs after U4, one task at a time (plan-brains contract, task 19); B1b, B1c and B2 build on it.

```js
// HOME. $HOME/.fake-agent-state.json holds what the fake agents "saved":
// { primary, models, authRows }.
// A helper, not a test file: the runner only runs test/*.test.js.
import { mkdir, readFile, rm, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";

export const FAKE_KNOBS_DIR = ".fake-knobs";
export const FAKE_AGENT_STATE_FILE = ".fake-agent-state.json";
const KNOB_NAME = /^FAKE_[A-Z0-9_]+$/;

// Sets a knob for every fake that runs with this HOME; null removes it.
export async function setFakeKnob(home, name, value) {
  if (!KNOB_NAME.test(String(name))) throw new Error(`setFakeKnob: "${name}" is not a FAKE_* knob name`);
  const file = path.join(home, FAKE_KNOBS_DIR, name);
  if (value === null) {
    await rm(file, { force: true });
    return;
  }
  if (typeof value !== "string") throw new TypeError("setFakeKnob: the value is a string, or null to remove the knob");
  await mkdir(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  await writeFile(file, value);
}

// The fakes' saved state; a missing or unreadable file reads as nothing saved yet.
export async function readFakeAgentState(home) {
  let value = null;
  try {
    value = JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(home, FAKE_AGENT_STATE_FILE), "utf8"));
  } catch {
    value = null;
  }
  const state = { primary: null, models: null, authRows: [], ...(value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value) ? value : {}) };
  if (!Array.isArray(state.authRows)) state.authRows = [];
  return state;
}

export async function writeFakeAgentState(home, state) {
  await writeFile(path.join(home, FAKE_AGENT_STATE_FILE), `${JSON.stringify(state, null, 2)}\n`);
}
```

```js
// Shared checks for the plan-brains Safety items (spec
// docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-15-plan-brains-design.md, "Safety"), used by
// test/plan-brains-safety.test.js and the other plan-brains tests. A helper,
// not a test file: the runner (scripts/run-tests.mjs) only runs test/*.test.js.
//   Safety 1: the file-access spy (moved verbatim from test/setup-builders.test.js,
//             which imports it from here) and the one agent file Agent OS may touch;
//   Safety 3: the argv rules for every fake's argv log, and the source scan;
//   Safety 4: the variables Agent OS never sets or overrides (H1).
import fs, { promises as fsp } from "node:fs";
import { syncBuiltinESMExports } from "node:module";
import path from "node:path";

// ---- Safety 1 ---------------------------------------------------------------

export const FORBIDDEN_PATH = /(^|[\\/])(\.claude|\.codex|\.cursor|\.hermes|\.openclaw)([\\/]|$)|auth\.json|(^|[\\/])\.env($|\.)/;

// Records the first argument (the path) of the file-system calls these modules
// could use to look at a file, then puts everything back.
export function spyOnFileAccess(seen) {
  const undo = [];
  const wrap = (target, name) => {
    const original = target[name];
    if (typeof original !== "function") return;
    target[name] = function spied(...args) {
      const first = args[0];
      if (typeof first === "string" || first instanceof URL || Buffer.isBuffer(first)) seen.push(String(first));
      return original.apply(this, args);
    };
    undo.push(() => {
      target[name] = original;
    });
  };
  for (const name of ["readFile", "open", "access", "stat", "lstat", "readdir", "opendir", "realpath", "readlink", "copyFile", "cp", "writeFile", "mkdir", "rm"]) {
    wrap(fsp, name);
  }
  for (const name of ["readFileSync", "openSync", "existsSync", "statSync", "lstatSync", "readdirSync", "accessSync", "createReadStream"]) {
    wrap(fs, name);
  }
  syncBuiltinESMExports();
  return () => {
    undo.forEach((restore) => restore());
    syncBuiltinESMExports();
  };
}

// The one agent file Agent OS may touch (spec Safety 1): brain.js checks that
// ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json exists and reads nothing from it. FORBIDDEN_PATH
// matches it, so a test leaves out exactly this path and no other.
export function allowedAgentFile(home) {
  return path.join(home, ".openclaw", "openclaw.json");
}

// ---- Safety 3 ---------------------------------------------------------------

// Never run or offered by Agent OS (spec "Terms basis" and Safety 3), and
// --probe, so `models status` never calls a model (plan-brains contract).
export const FORBIDDEN_ARGV = Object.freeze([
  "setup-token",
  "paste-token",
  "--token",
  "--method oauth",
  "--device-code",
  "--dangerously-skip-permissions",
  "--yolo",
  "--probe"
]);

// A word on its own ("--token", also "--token=x"), or a flag and its value
// ("--method oauth", also "--method=oauth").
function hasWord(argv, word) {
  const [flag, value] = word.split(" ");
  if (value === undefined) return argv.some((arg) => arg === flag || arg.startsWith(`${flag}=`));
  return argv.some((arg, index) => (arg === flag && argv[index + 1] === value) || arg === `${flag}=${value}`);
}

// Safety 3 over argv lists, each the arguments after the program as the fakes
// log them. One sentence per problem ([] when there is none): a forbidden word,
// --accept-risk anywhere but on `onboard`, --accept-risk without the risk
// tick, or an entry that is not a list of strings.
export function argvProblems(argvLists, { riskTicked = false } = {}) {
  const problems = [];
  for (const argv of argvLists) {
    if (!Array.isArray(argv) || !argv.every((arg) => typeof arg === "string")) {
      problems.push(`not an argv list: ${JSON.stringify(argv)}`);
      continue;
    }
    const shown = argv.join(" ");
    for (const word of FORBIDDEN_ARGV) {
      if (hasWord(argv, word)) problems.push(`${word} in: ${shown}`);
    }
    if (hasWord(argv, "--accept-risk")) {
      if (argv[0] !== "onboard") problems.push(`--accept-risk outside onboard in: ${shown}`);
      else if (riskTicked !== true) problems.push(`--accept-risk without the risk tick in: ${shown}`);
    }
  }
  return problems;
}

// Safety 3 over a server module's source, comments stripped (the same rule as
// the scan of signin.js in test/setup-builders.test.js): none of FORBIDDEN_ARGV,
// as a string, as a flag and its value in an argv list ("--method", "oauth"),
// or as flag=value.
export function sourceProblems(text) {
  const code = String(text)
    .replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, "")
    .replace(/^\s*\/\/.*$/gm, "")
    .replace(/\s\/\/ .*$/gm, "");
  const problems = [];
  for (const word of FORBIDDEN_ARGV) {
    const [flag, value] = word.split(" ");
    const found = value === undefined ? code.includes(flag) : new RegExp(flag + "[\"'`\\s,=]+[\"'`]?" + value + "\\b").test(code);
    if (found) problems.push(word);
  }
  return problems;
}

// ---- Safety 4 ---------------------------------------------------------------

// The variables Agent OS never sets or overrides for anything this feature runs
// (spec Safety 4, H1). HOME and USERPROFILE are not in the list: a test checks
// that they reach a fake unchanged instead.
export const H1_ENV_NAMES = Object.freeze([
  "XDG_CONFIG_HOME",
  "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR",
  "CODEX_HOME",
  "HERMES_HOME",
  "OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR",
  "OPENCLAW_PROFILE",
  "OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH",
  "OPENCLAW_HOME",
  "OPENCLAW_AGENT_DIR"
]);

// `env`, plus every H1 name and every OPENCLAW_* variable this process has set
// to undefined: ready for a test's withEnv() (undefined removes a variable) or
// a child's env (spawn leaves undefined values out). A Safety 4 test starts
// from here, so any of them that reaches a fake was set by Agent OS.
export function withoutH1Env(env = {}) {
  const cleared = {};
  for (const name of H1_ENV_NAMES) cleared[name] = undefined;
  for (const name of Object.keys(process.env)) {
    if (name.startsWith("OPENCLAW_")) cleared[name] = undefined;
  }
  return { ...cleared, ...env };
}
```

```js
async function withEnv(vars, fn) {
  const previous = {};
  for (const key of Object.keys(vars)) previous[key] = process.env[key];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(vars)) {
    if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
    else process.env[key] = String(value);
  }
  try {
    return await fn();
  } finally {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(previous)) {
      if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
      else process.env[key] = value;
    }
  }
}

async function waitFor(predicate, { timeoutMs = 15000, intervalMs = 20 } = {}) {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    const value = await predicate();
    if (value) return value;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, intervalMs));
  }
  throw new Error("timed out waiting for condition");
}

// Every file under a folder, as full paths ([] when the folder is missing).
async function filesUnder(dir) {
  let entries;
  try {
    entries = await readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error.code === "ENOENT") return [];
    throw error;
  }
  const files = [];
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) files.push(...(await filesUnder(full)));
    else files.push(full);
  }
  return files;
}

// W1's fake log: one JSON line per event ({ name, pid, at, event, ... }).
async function readFakeLog(file) {
  const text = await readFile(file, "utf8").catch((error) => {
    if (error.code === "ENOENT") return "";
    throw error;
  });
  return text
    .split("\n")
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map((line) => JSON.parse(line));
}

// ---- injected fakes (the pattern of test/sessions-manager.test.js) ---------------------------------

function fakePty(pid, options) {
  const dataListeners = new Set();
  const exitListeners = new Set();
  const pty = {
    pid,
    opts: options,
    writes: [],
    resizes: [],
    write(data) {
      pty.writes.push(data);
    },
    resize(cols, rows) {
      pty.resizes.push([cols, rows]);
    },
    kill() {},
    pause() {},
    resume() {},
    onData(cb) {
      dataListeners.add(cb);
      return () => dataListeners.delete(cb);
    },
    onExit(cb) {
      exitListeners.add(cb);
      return () => exitListeners.delete(cb);
    },
    emit(data) {
      for (const cb of [...dataListeners]) cb(data);
    },
    exit(exitCode = 0, signal) {
      for (const cb of [...exitListeners]) cb({ exitCode, signal });
    }
  };
  return pty;
}

function fakeMirror(options) {
  const counted = new Set();
  const mirror = {
    opts: options,
    written: [],
    disposed: false,
    writerAttached: null,
    write(chunk) {
      mirror.written.push(chunk);
    },
    resize() {},
    async snapshot() {
      return { data: mirror.disposed ? "" : mirror.written.join(""), cols: options.cols, rows: options.rows, modes: {} };
    },
    setWriterAttached(value) {
      mirror.writerAttached = value;
    },
    onCountedOutput(cb) {
      counted.add(cb);
      return () => counted.delete(cb);
    },
    dispose() {
      mirror.disposed = true;
    }
  };
  return mirror;
}

  }

    // The next spawn waits for this promise (one shot), so a test can look at
    // the manager while a start is still in flight.
    spawnGate: null,
    spawnCalls: 0
  };
  world.deps = {
    now: () => world.clock,
    spawn: async (options) => {
      world.spawnCalls += 1;
      const gate = world.spawnGate;
      world.spawnGate = null;
      if (gate) await gate;
      const pty = fakePty(world.nextPid, options);
      world.nextPid += 1;
      world.ptys.push(pty);
      return pty;
    },
    buildProfile: async (input) => {
      world.profileInputs.push(input);
      return fakeProfile(input);
    },
    recorderFactory: () => {
      world.recorderCalls += 1;
      return { output() {}, marker() {}, resize() {}, async close() {} };
    },
    mirrorFactory: (options) => {
      const mirror = fakeMirror(options);
      world.mirrors.push(mirror);
      return mirror;
    },
    isExecutionAllowed: async () => world.gate,
    checkFolder: async (input) => {
      world.folderChecks += 1;
      return { ok: true, path: String(input), name: path.basename(String(input)) };
    },
    ptyCheck: async () => world.pty,
    detect: async (agentId) => {
      world.detectCalls.push(agentId);
      return { installed: true, path: `/fake/bin/${agentId}`, version: "OpenClaw 2026.9.7", features: {} };
    },
    resolveBrain: async () => null,
    readSettings: async () => ({ claudeFullscreen: false }),
    enforceCap: async () => {
      world.capCalls += 1;
      return { deleted: [] };
    },
    // meta.json writes are only counted: these tests read nothing back from disk.
    writeJson: async (file) => {
      world.writes.push(file);
    },
    // The process tree "dies" at once, as SIGTERM would end it.
    killTree: async (pid, options) => {
      world.kills.push([pid, options]);
      world.ptys.find((pty) => pty.pid === pid)?.exit(null, "SIGTERM");
    },
    softStop: async (input) => {
      world.softStops.push(input);
      return { outcome: "none", note: null };
    },
    ...over
  };
  world.manager = createSessionManager(world.deps);
  return world;
}

// An app on a free local port with `mount`'s routers, and an error handler
// like server/index.js's last one: anything passed on with next(error) answers
// the error's own status (requireAdminWhenPublic's 403), else 500, as
// { ok: false, error: <message> }. `call(method, url, body, headers)` answers
// { status, body }.
async function withApp(mount, fn) {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json());
  mount(app);
  app.use((error, _req, res, _next) => res.status(error?.status || 500).json({ ok: false, error: String(error?.message || error) }));
  const server = await new Promise((resolve) => {
    const listening = app.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", () => resolve(listening));
  });
  const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`;
  async function call(method, url, body, headers = {}) {
    const response = await fetch(`${base}${url}`, {
      method,
      headers: { ...(body === undefined ? {} : { "Content-Type": "application/json" }), ...headers },
      body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body)
    });
    const text = await response.text();
    let parsed = null;
    try {
      parsed = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
    } catch {
      parsed = text;
    }
    return { status: response.status, body: parsed };
  }
  try {
    return await fn({ base, call });
  } finally {
    server.closeAllConnections?.();
    await new Promise((resolve) => server.close(resolve));
  }
}

// The routers as server/index.js mounts them: the setup router behind
// requireAdminWhenPublic (its new routes also carry requireLocalMode
// themselves), the sessions and recordings routers behind requireLocalMode.
function withSetupApp(manager, fn) {
  return withApp((app) => {
    app.use("/api/setup", requireAdminWhenPublic, createSetupRouter({ sessionManager: manager }));
    app.use("/api/sessions", requireLocalMode, createSessionsRouter({ manager }));
    app.use("/api/recordings", requireLocalMode, createRecordingsRouter({ manager }));
  }, fn);
}

// `running` holds the pids this test started and has not seen exit; the
// clean-up signals only those (a pid seen exiting may belong to another
// process by now).
function track(running, handle) {
  running.add(handle.pid);
  handle.onExit(() => {
    running.delete(handle.pid);
  });
  return handle;
}

function killLeftovers(running) {
  for (const pid of [...running]) {
    try {
      process.kill(pid, "SIGKILL");
    } catch {
      // already gone
    }
    running.delete(pid);
  }
}

function buildSetupProfile(ctx, over = {}) {
  return buildSessionProfile({
    agentId: "openclaw",
    folder: null,
    sessionId: crypto.randomUUID(),
    kind: "setup",
    setupAction: OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION,
    settings: { claudeFullscreen: false },
    detected: { installed: true, path: path.join(ctx.bin, "openclaw"), version: "OpenClaw 2026.9.7", features: {} },
    agentOsVersion: "9.9.9-test",
    ...over
  });
}

test("profile: the setup kind runs exactly the sign-in argv in HOME, with the H2 environment, no folder shown, no soft stop and no resume", POSIX_ONLY, async () => {
  await withSetupEnv(async (ctx) => {
    const sessionId = crypto.randomUUID();
    const profile = await buildSetupProfile(ctx, {
      sessionId,
      // None of these reaches the setup kind: a folder (the policy would refuse /etc), a resume, the fullscreen opt-in.
      folder: "/etc",
      resume: { agentSessionId: `agentos-${sessionId}` },
      settings: { claudeFullscreen: true }
    });
    assert.equal(profile.command, path.join(ctx.bin, "openclaw"), "the detected openclaw (H1)");
    assert.deepEqual(profile.args, SIGNIN_ARGS);
    assert.notEqual(profile.args, SETUP_ACTIONS[OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION].args, "a fresh copy, never the table's own array");
    assert.equal(profile.cwd, ctx.home, "HOME, the one other exception to the folder policy");
    assert.equal(profile.folderShown, false);
    assert.equal(profile.softStop, null, "never openclaw-abort: a sign-in has no last step to finish");
    assert.equal(profile.resumeMode, null);
    assert.equal(profile.agentSessionId, null);
    assert.equal(profile.settingsFile, null);
    assert.deepEqual(profile.notes, []);
    const { env } = profile;
    assert.equal(env.HOME, ctx.home, "H1: HOME as the person has it");
    assert.equal(env.PWD, ctx.home);
    assert.equal(env.TERM, "xterm-256color");
    assert.equal(env.TERM_PROGRAM, "AgentOS");
    assert.equal(env.TERM_PROGRAM_VERSION, "9.9.9-test");
    assert.equal(env.AGENT_OS_SESSION_ID, sessionId);
    assert.equal(env.CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER, undefined, "the fullscreen opt-in is Claude Code's only");
    for (const name of H1_ENV_NAMES) assert.equal(env[name], undefined, `${name} is never set (Safety 4)`);
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(env).filter((key) => key.startsWith("OPENCLAW_")), []);
    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(env).filter((key) => key.startsWith("AGENT_OS_") && key !== "AGENT_OS_SESSION_ID"), []);
    assert.deepEqual([...SETUP_ACTIONS[OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION].args], SIGNIN_ARGS, "the table is unchanged");
  });
});

test("profile: the setup kind is refused for an unknown action, a prototype name or another agent; an OpenClaw agent session still runs its TUI", POSIX_ONLY, async () => {
  await withSetupEnv(async (ctx) => {
    for (const setupAction of [null, undefined, "", "openclaw-codex-signin", "constructor", "__proto__", "toString", "hasOwnProperty", 42]) {
      await assert.rejects(() => buildSetupProfile(ctx, { setupAction }), isUnknownKind, String(setupAction));
    }
    for (const agentId of ["claude", "codex", "cursor", "hermes"]) {
      await assert.rejects(() => buildSetupProfile(ctx, { agentId }), isUnknownKind, agentId);
    }
    await assert.rejects(() => buildSetupProfile(ctx, { kind: "shell" }), isUnknownKind, "any other kind name is still unknown");
    // The action name never turns an agent session into a sign-in.
    const sessionId = crypto.randomUUID();
    const agent = await buildSetupProfile(ctx, { kind: "agent", sessionId });
    assert.deepEqual(agent.args, ["tui", "--session", `agentos-${sessionId}`]);
    assert.equal(agent.softStop, "openclaw-abort");
  });
});

test("assertSessionArgvSafe: the setup kind accepts only the action's own argv, item by item (Safety 2); an agent session can never run it; two-argument callers are unchanged", () => {
  const signIn = { kind: "setup", setupAction: OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION };
  const uuid = "123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000";
  assert.doesNotThrow(() => assertSessionArgvSafe("openclaw", [...SIGNIN_ARGS], signIn));
  const refused = [
    ["openclaw", SIGNIN_ARGS.slice(0, -1), signIn],
    ["openclaw", [...SIGNIN_ARGS, "--device-code"], signIn],
    ["openclaw", ["models", "auth", "login", "--provider", "openai", "--method", "oauth"], signIn],
    ["openclaw", ["models", "auth", "login", "--provider", "openai", "--method", "SIWC"], signIn],
    ["openclaw", ["models", "auth", "setup-token", "--provider", "anthropic"], signIn],
    ["openclaw", ["models", "auth", "paste-token", "--provider", "anthropic"], signIn],
    ["openclaw", ["auth", "models", "login", "--provider", "openai", "--method", "siwc"], signIn],
    ["openclaw", ["tui", "--session", `agentos-${uuid}`], signIn],
    ["openclaw", [], signIn],
    ["openclaw", SIGNIN_ARGS.join(" "), signIn],
    ["hermes", [...SIGNIN_ARGS], signIn],
    ["claude", [...SIGNIN_ARGS], signIn],
    ["constructor", [...SIGNIN_ARGS], signIn],
    ["openclaw", [...SIGNIN_ARGS], { kind: "setup", setupAction: "constructor" }],
    ["openclaw", [...SIGNIN_ARGS], { kind: "setup", setupAction: "__proto__" }],
    ["openclaw", [...SIGNIN_ARGS], { kind: "setup", setupAction: null }],
    ["openclaw", [...SIGNIN_ARGS], { kind: "setup" }],
    // Every other kind keeps today's shapes, so the sign-in argv is never an agent or update session's.
    ["openclaw", [...SIGNIN_ARGS], { kind: "agent", setupAction: OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION }],
    ["openclaw", [...SIGNIN_ARGS], { kind: "update" }],
    ["openclaw", [...SIGNIN_ARGS], {}],
    ["openclaw", [...SIGNIN_ARGS], undefined]
  ];
  for (const [agentId, args, options] of refused) {
    assert.throws(
      () => assertSessionArgvSafe(agentId, args, options),
      (error) => error.status === 500 && error.code === "unsafe_argv" && /never adds\.$/.test(error.message),
      `${agentId} ${JSON.stringify(args)} ${JSON.stringify(options)}`
    );
  }
  // Two-argument callers keep today's answers.
  assert.doesNotThrow(() => assertSessionArgvSafe("openclaw", ["tui", "--session", `agentos-${uuid}`]));
  assert.throws(() => assertSessionArgvSafe("openclaw", [...SIGNIN_ARGS]), (error) => error.code === "unsafe_argv");
  // The table: one action, frozen all the way down.
  assert.equal(OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION, "openclaw-chatgpt-signin");
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(SETUP_ACTIONS), [OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION]);
  assert.equal(SETUP_ACTIONS[OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION].agentId, "openclaw");
  assert.ok(Object.isFrozen(SETUP_ACTIONS));
  assert.ok(Object.isFrozen(SETUP_ACTIONS[OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION]));
  assert.ok(Object.isFrozen(SETUP_ACTIONS[OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION].args));
});
```
