```js
test("resolve.js exports parseVersion and versionAtLeast, unchanged: three numbers from a version line, compared as arrays", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(parseVersion("OpenClaw 2026.9.6 (eb377ac)"), [2026, 9, 6]);
  assert.deepEqual(parseVersion("openclaw 9.9.9-fake"), [9, 9, 9]);
  for (const text of ["OpenClaw unknown", "OpenClaw 2026.9", "", null, undefined]) assert.equal(parseVersion(text), null, String(text));
  assert.equal(versionAtLeast([2026, 9, 6], [2026, 9, 7]), false);
  assert.equal(versionAtLeast([2026, 9, 7], [2026, 9, 7]), true);
  assert.equal(versionAtLeast([2026, 10, 1], [2026, 9, 7]), true);
  assert.equal(versionAtLeast([2027, 0, 0], [2026, 9, 7]), true);
  assert.equal(versionAtLeast([2025, 12, 31], [2026, 9, 7]), false);
});

test("openclawVersionInfo: the three numbers of OpenClaw's version line against 2026.9.7, and null when OpenClaw is missing or its line holds no version", () => {
  assert.equal(OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_MIN_VERSION, "2026.9.7");
  assert.equal(OPENCLAW_TOO_OLD_MESSAGE, "Update OpenClaw first: its ChatGPT sign-in needs version 2026.9.7 or newer.");
  assert.equal(OPENCLAW_VERSION_UNKNOWN_MESSAGE, "Agent OS couldn't read OpenClaw's version.");
  const installed = (version) => ({ installed: true, path: "/fake/bin/openclaw", version, features: {} });
  const unread = { have: null, need: "2026.9.7", newEnough: null };
  const cases = [
    [installed("OpenClaw 2026.9.6 (eb377ac)"), { have: "2026.9.6", need: "2026.9.7", newEnough: false }],
    [installed("OpenClaw 2026.9.7"), { have: "2026.9.7", need: "2026.9.7", newEnough: true }],
    [installed("OpenClaw 2026.10.1"), { have: "2026.10.1", need: "2026.9.7", newEnough: true }],
    [installed("openclaw 9.9.9-fake"), { have: "9.9.9", need: "2026.9.7", newEnough: false }],
    [installed("OpenClaw unknown"), unread],
    [installed("OpenClaw 2026.9"), unread],
    [installed(""), unread],
    [{ installed: false, path: "", version: "OpenClaw 2026.9.7", features: {} }, unread],
    [undefined, unread],
    [null, unread]
  ];
  for (const [detected, expected] of cases) assert.deepEqual(openclawVersionInfo(detected), expected, JSON.stringify(detected));
});

test("createSetupSession: one sign-in in memory only, in HOME, with the action's argv: not gated by Safety, no folder check, no brain, no session folder, no meta.json, no recording", async () => {
  await withSetupEnv(
    async ({ home, agentOsHome }) => {
      const world = fakeWorld();
      world.gate = false; // Look only: a sign-in is a Setup step, not agent work (spec §1, Limits)
      const summary = await world.manager.createSetupSession({ action: OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION, detected: DETECTED });
      assert.match(summary.id, UUID);
      assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(summary).sort(), [...SUMMARY_KEYS].sort(), "the same 20 keys as every session, and no new one");
      assert.deepEqual(
        { ...summary, id: "-", stateSince: "-", startedAt: "-" },
        {
          id: "-",
          kind: "setup",
          agentId: "openclaw",
          agentLabel: "OpenClaw",
          folder: home,
          folderName: path.basename(home),
          folderShown: false,
          branch: null,
          status: "starting",
          stateSince: "-",
          startedAt: "-",
          endedAt: null,
          exitCode: null,
          signal: null,
          endedBy: null,
          dismissed: false,
          brain: null,
          resume: { available: false, reason: null, fallback: false },
          alerts: "basic",
          recordingBytes: 0
        }
      );
      assert.deepEqual(world.profileInputs, [
        {
          agentId: "openclaw",
          folder: null,
          sessionId: summary.id,
          kind: "setup",
          setupAction: OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION,
          settings: { claudeFullscreen: false },
          detected: DETECTED
        }
      ]);
      assert.equal(world.ptys.length, 1);
      assert.deepEqual(world.ptys[0].opts.args, SIGNIN_ARGS);
      assert.equal(world.ptys[0].opts.cwd, home);
      assert.deepEqual(world.detectCalls, [], "the route's fresh detection is used as it is");
      assert.equal(world.folderChecks, 0, "HOME is not put through the folder policy");
      assert.equal(world.recorderCalls, 0, "the recorder factory is never called");
      assert.deepEqual(world.writes, [], "no meta.json");
      assert.deepEqual(await sessionFolders(agentOsHome), [], "no session folder");
      assert.equal((await world.manager.liveSetupSession()).id, summary.id);

      // Without a detection of its own, the manager detects OpenClaw itself.
      await world.manager.stop(summary.id);
      await world.manager.createSetupSession({ action: OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION });
      assert.deepEqual(world.detectCalls, ["openclaw"]);
      assert.equal(world.profileInputs[1].detected.path, "/fake/bin/openclaw");
    },
    { fakes: false }
  );
});

test("one sign-in at a time: a second start gets 409 setup_running with the first one's id and action, while it is still starting and once it runs; it never takes one of the 8 places", async () => {
  await withSetupEnv(
    async ({ project }) => {
      const world = fakeWorld({ maxLive: 1 });
      const start = () => world.manager.createSetupSession({ action: OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION, detected: DETECTED });
      let release;
      world.spawnGate = new Promise((resolve) => {
        release = resolve;
      });
      const first = start();
      await waitFor(() => world.spawnCalls === 1);

      const whileStarting = await start().then(
        () => null,
        (error) => error
      );
      assert.equal(whileStarting?.status, 409);
      assert.equal(whileStarting.code, "setup_running");
      assert.match(whileStarting.extra.sessionId, UUID);
      assert.deepEqual(errorBody(whileStarting), {
        error: "setup_running",
        message: SETUP_RUNNING,
        sessionId: whileStarting.extra.sessionId,
        setupAction: OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION
      });
      assert.equal(await world.manager.liveSetupSession(), null, "a start still before its spawn is not live yet");

      // The limit (1 here, 8 in Agent OS) does not count the sign-in: an agent session still starts...
      await world.manager.create({ agentId: "claude", folder: project });
      release();
      const summary = await first;
      assert.equal(summary.id, whileStarting.extra.sessionId, "the 409 named the very session that was starting");

      const whileLive = await start().then(
        () => null,
        (error) => error
      );
      assert.deepEqual(errorBody(whileLive), {
        error: "setup_running",
        message: SETUP_RUNNING,
        sessionId: summary.id,
        setupAction: OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION
      });
      assert.equal((await world.manager.liveSetupSession()).id, summary.id);
      // ... while the limit still holds for agent sessions.
      await assert.rejects(
        world.manager.create({ agentId: "codex", folder: project }),
        (error) => error.status === 409 && error.code === "too_many_sessions"
      );
      const signIns = world.ptys.filter((pty) => pty.opts.args.join(" ") === SIGNIN_ARGS.join(" "));
      assert.equal(signIns.length, 1, "the refused starts spawned nothing");
    },
    { fakes: false }
  );
});

test("when a sign-in ends: its mirror is disposed at once, nothing is written or recorded, and it is gone: get, Stop, Resume and Dismiss answer 404, a window can't attach, and the recording cap does not run", async () => {
  await withSetupEnv(
    async ({ agentOsHome }) => {
      const world = fakeWorld();
      const setup = await world.manager.createSetupSession({ action: OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION, detected: DETECTED });
      const [pty] = world.ptys;
      const [mirror] = world.mirrors;
      const frames = [];
      const closes = [];
      await world.manager.attach(setup.id, { id: "card", send: (frame) => frames.push(frame), close: (reason) => closes.push(reason) });
      pty.emit(`Code: ${CODE}\r\n`);
      pty.exit(0);
      // In the same step as the exit: there is nothing to close or write first.
      assert.equal(mirror.disposed, true, "the mirror is disposed when it ends");
      assert.equal(world.manager.isLive(setup.id), false, "the sessions WebSocket refuses a new window (ws.js asks isLive)");
      assert.deepEqual(frames.at(-1), { t: "state", status: "exited", exitCode: 0, signal: null, endedBy: null });
      assert.deepEqual(closes, ["session_ended"]);
      await assert.rejects(world.manager.get(setup.id), isUnknownSession);
      await assert.rejects(world.manager.stop(setup.id), isUnknownSession);
      await assert.rejects(world.manager.resume(setup.id), isUnknownSession);
      await assert.rejects(world.manager.dismiss(setup.id), isUnknownSession);
      await assert.rejects(world.manager.attach(setup.id, { id: "late", send() {}, close() {} }), isUnknownSession);
      assert.equal(await world.manager.liveSetupSession(), null);
      assert.equal(world.recorderCalls, 0);
      assert.deepEqual(world.writes, []);
      assert.equal(world.capCalls, 0, "no recording, so no cap run");
      assert.deepEqual(await sessionFolders(agentOsHome), []);
      // A new sign-in can start at once.
      assert.equal((await world.manager.createSetupSession({ action: OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION, detected: DETECTED })).kind, "setup");
    },
    { fakes: false }
  );
});

test("a sign-in's input is a byte pipe: the writer's bytes reach the PTY as they are and are never scanned (no activity from input); a viewer can't type; resize reaches the PTY and no recorder", async () => {
  await withSetupEnv(
    async ({ project }) => {
      const world = fakeWorld();
      const agent = await world.manager.create({ agentId: "claude", folder: project }); // the control
      const setup = await world.manager.createSetupSession({ action: OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION, detected: DETECTED });
      const setupPty = world.ptys.find((pty) => pty.opts.args.join(" ") === SIGNIN_ARGS.join(" "));
      for (const id of [agent.id, setup.id]) {
        await world.manager.attach(id, { id: "w", send() {}, close() {} });
        assert.equal(world.manager.focus(id, "w"), true);
      }
      assert.equal(world.manager.write(agent.id, "w", "a"), true);
      assert.equal((await world.manager.get(agent.id)).status, "live", "control: a key wakes an agent session");

      assert.equal(world.manager.write(setup.id, "w", `${CODE}\r`), true);
      assert.deepEqual(setupPty.writes, [`${CODE}\r`], "the bytes reach the PTY as they are");
      assert.equal((await world.manager.get(setup.id)).status, "starting", "input is never scanned, so typing is not activity");

      await world.manager.attach(setup.id, { id: "viewer", send() {}, close() {} });
      assert.equal(world.manager.write(setup.id, "viewer", "x"), false, "only the writer types");
      assert.deepEqual(setupPty.writes, [`${CODE}\r`]);

      assert.equal(world.manager.resize(setup.id, "w", 100, 30), true);
      assert.deepEqual(setupPty.resizes, [[100, 30]]);
      assert.equal(world.recorderCalls, 1, "only the agent session's recorder was ever made");

      setupPty.emit("Signed in.\r\n");
      assert.equal((await world.manager.get(setup.id)).status, "live", "its activity comes from its output");
    },
    { fakes: false }
  );
});

test("Stop with no window attached, and quitting: a sign-in stops like any session, with no soft stop and no note; shutdownAll stops it and writes no meta.json for it", async () => {
  await withSetupEnv(
    async ({ agentOsHome, project }) => {
      const world = fakeWorld();
      const setup = await world.manager.createSetupSession({ action: OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION, detected: DETECTED });
      const stopped = await world.manager.stop(setup.id);
      assert.equal(stopped.id, setup.id);
      assert.equal(stopped.kind, "setup");
      assert.equal(stopped.status, "exited");
      assert.equal(stopped.endedBy, "stop");
      assert.equal(stopped.signal, "SIGTERM");
      assert.equal(stopped.note, null, "never OpenClaw's 'last step' note: a sign-in has none");
      assert.deepEqual(world.softStops.map((input) => input.softStop), [null], "no soft stop");
      assert.deepEqual(world.kills.map(([, options]) => options), [{ graceMs: 3000 }], "the process tree, as every Stop");
      assert.equal(world.manager.isLive(setup.id), false);

      // Quitting Agent OS (the "sessions" shutdown task): both kinds stop; only the agent session's meta.json is written.
      const again = await world.manager.createSetupSession({ action: OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION, detected: DETECTED });
      const agent = await world.manager.create({ agentId: "claude", folder: project });
      world.writes.length = 0;
      assert.deepEqual(await world.manager.shutdownAll({ reason: "quit" }), { stopped: 2 });
      assert.equal(world.manager.isLive(again.id), false);
      assert.equal(world.manager.isLive(agent.id), false);
      assert.ok(world.writes.some((file) => file.includes(agent.id)), "control: the agent session's meta.json says it ended by quit");
      assert.deepEqual(world.writes.filter((file) => file.includes(again.id)), [], "no meta.json for the sign-in");
      assert.deepEqual(await sessionFolders(agentOsHome), [agent.id], "only the agent session has a folder");
      assert.deepEqual((await world.manager.quitCheck()).live, []);
    },
    { fakes: false }
  );
});

test("outside local mode nothing starts: the public demo and an admin request get 404 not_available before anything else, a request without the admin token gets index.js's 403 first; POST needs { confirm: true }", async () => {
  await withSetupEnv(
    async () => {
      const world = fakeWorld();
      await withSetupApp(world.manager, async ({ call }) => {
        for (const body of [undefined, {}, { confirm: "true" }, { confirm: 1 }, { confirm: false }]) {
          assert.deepEqual(
            await call("POST", SIGNIN_PATH, body),
            { status: 400, body: { ok: false, error: "confirm must be true" } },
            JSON.stringify(body)
          );
        }
        // The public demo: requireAdminWhenPublic lets every request through, and requireLocalMode answers.
        for (const vars of [{ DEMO_PUBLIC: "1" }, { HERMES_AGENT_OS_DEMO_PUBLIC: "1" }]) {
          await withEnv(vars, async () => {
            assert.deepEqual(await call("POST", SIGNIN_PATH, { confirm: true }), NOT_AVAILABLE, JSON.stringify(vars));
            assert.deepEqual(await call("POST", SIGNIN_PATH, {}), NOT_AVAILABLE, "local mode is checked before the body");
            assert.deepEqual(await call("GET", SIGNIN_PATH), NOT_AVAILABLE);
          });
        }
        // The admin-token public mode: index.js's requireAdminWhenPublic refuses a request without the admin
        // token first (403); an admin request reaches requireLocalMode and gets 404 not_available.
        for (const mode of [{ HERMES_AGENT_OS_PUBLIC_MODE: "1" }, { HERMES_AGENT_OS_REQUIRE_AUTH: "1" }]) {
          await withEnv({ ...mode, HERMES_AGENT_OS_ADMIN_TOKEN: ADMIN_TOKEN }, async () => {
            assert.deepEqual(await call("POST", SIGNIN_PATH, { confirm: true }), ADMIN_REFUSED, JSON.stringify(mode));
            assert.deepEqual(await call("GET", SIGNIN_PATH), ADMIN_REFUSED, JSON.stringify(mode));
            assert.deepEqual(await call("POST", SIGNIN_PATH, { confirm: true }, AS_ADMIN), NOT_AVAILABLE, `${JSON.stringify(mode)}, admin`);
            assert.deepEqual(await call("POST", SIGNIN_PATH, {}, AS_ADMIN), NOT_AVAILABLE, "local mode is checked before the body");
            assert.deepEqual(await call("GET", SIGNIN_PATH, undefined, AS_ADMIN), NOT_AVAILABLE);
          });
        }
        assert.equal(world.spawnCalls, 0, "nothing started");
        assert.deepEqual(await call("GET", SIGNIN_PATH), { status: 200, body: { session: null } });
      });
    },
    { fakes: false }
  );
});

test("POST signin-terminal reads OpenClaw's version fresh each time, never the 30 s detection cache: too old and unreadable are refused with their sentences, 2026.9.7 or newer starts the sign-in (201)", POSIX_ONLY, async () => {
  await withSetupEnv(async ({ home, bin }) => {
    const world = fakeWorld();
    await withSetupApp(world.manager, async ({ call }) => {
      const post = () => call("POST", SIGNIN_PATH, { confirm: true });
      // No knob: W1's fake prints "openclaw 9.9.9-fake", older than 2026.9.7 (the default stays too old).
      assert.deepEqual(await post(), TOO_OLD);
      await setFakeKnob(home, "FAKE_AGENT_VERSION", "OpenClaw 2026.9.6 (eb377ac)");
      assert.deepEqual(await post(), TOO_OLD);
      await setFakeKnob(home, "FAKE_AGENT_VERSION", "OpenClaw unknown");
      assert.deepEqual(await post(), VERSION_UNKNOWN);
      assert.equal(world.spawnCalls, 0, "a refused version starts nothing");

      // Review Focus 1: OpenClaw is updated while the card is open. Detection's 30 s cache still holds
      // 2026.9.6 when the person presses Sign in with ChatGPT again a moment later.
      await setFakeKnob(home, "FAKE_AGENT_VERSION", "OpenClaw 2026.9.6 (eb377ac)");
      assert.equal((await ADAPTERS.openclaw.detect({ refresh: true })).version, "OpenClaw 2026.9.6 (eb377ac)");
      await setFakeKnob(home, "FAKE_AGENT_VERSION", "OpenClaw 2026.9.7");
      assert.equal((await ADAPTERS.openclaw.detect()).version, "OpenClaw 2026.9.6 (eb377ac)", "the cache still says 2026.9.6");
      const started = await post();
      assert.equal(started.status, 201, JSON.stringify(started.body));
      assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(started.body), ["session"]);
      assert.equal(started.body.session.kind, "setup");
      assert.equal(started.body.session.agentId, "openclaw");
      assert.equal(started.body.session.folderShown, false);
      const input = world.profileInputs.at(-1);
      assert.equal(input.detected.version, "OpenClaw 2026.9.7", "the manager got the fresh detection");
      assert.equal(input.detected.path, path.join(bin, "openclaw"));
      assert.equal(input.setupAction, OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION);
      assert.deepEqual(world.detectCalls, [], "the manager never falls back to its own (cached) detection here");
      assert.equal((await call("GET", SIGNIN_PATH)).body.session.id, started.body.session.id);

      await world.manager.stop(started.body.session.id);
      await setFakeKnob(home, "FAKE_AGENT_VERSION", "OpenClaw 2026.10.1");
      assert.equal((await post()).status, 201, "newer is fine too");
    });
  });
});

test("POST signin-terminal: OpenClaw missing is refused with the sessions sentence (409 agent_not_installed) before its version is looked at", async () => {
  await withSetupEnv(
    async () => {
      const world = fakeWorld();
      const original = ADAPTERS.openclaw.detect;
      const asked = [];
      // A stand-in detection: "not found" is never left to the real lookup, which also searches
      // /opt/homebrew/bin and /usr/local/bin, where a real OpenClaw may live.
      ADAPTERS.openclaw.detect = async (options) => {
        asked.push(options);
        return {
          installed: false,
          path: "",
          version: "OpenClaw 2026.9.7",
          features: {},
          error: "openclaw was not found on PATH or in common install locations."
        };
      };
      try {
        await withSetupApp(world.manager, async ({ call }) => {
          assert.deepEqual(await call("POST", SIGNIN_PATH, { confirm: true }), {
            status: 409,
            body: { error: "agent_not_installed", message: OPENCLAW_MISSING }
          });
        });
      } finally {
        ADAPTERS.openclaw.detect = original;
      }
      assert.deepEqual(asked, [{ refresh: true }], "one fresh detection");
      assert.equal(world.spawnCalls, 0);
    },
    { fakes: false }
  );
});

test("one sign-in at a time over HTTP (Review Focus 2): a second POST answers 409 with the first one's id while it starts and while it runs; GET finds it with no window attached; Close (Stop) works with no window; a 503 frees the place; POST /api/sessions never makes one", POSIX_ONLY, async () => {
  await withSetupEnv(async ({ home }) => {
    await setFakeKnob(home, "FAKE_AGENT_VERSION", "OpenClaw 2026.9.7");
    const world = fakeWorld();
    await withSetupApp(world.manager, async ({ call }) => {
      let release;
      world.spawnGate = new Promise((resolve) => {
        release = resolve;
      });
      const firstPost = call("POST", SIGNIN_PATH, { confirm: true });
      await waitFor(() => world.spawnCalls === 1);

      const whileStarting = await call("POST", SIGNIN_PATH, { confirm: true });
      assert.equal(whileStarting.status, 409);
      assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(whileStarting.body).sort(), ["error", "message", "sessionId", "setupAction"]);
      assert.equal(whileStarting.body.error, "setup_running");
      assert.equal(whileStarting.body.message, SETUP_RUNNING);
      assert.equal(whileStarting.body.setupAction, OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION);
      assert.match(whileStarting.body.sessionId, UUID);
      assert.deepEqual(await call("GET", SIGNIN_PATH), { status: 200, body: { session: null } }, "still starting: nothing to attach to yet");

      release();
      const first = await firstPost;
      assert.equal(first.status, 201);
      assert.equal(first.body.session.id, whileStarting.body.sessionId, "the 409 named the session that was starting");

      const whileLive = await call("POST", SIGNIN_PATH, { confirm: true });
      assert.deepEqual(whileLive, {
        status: 409,
        body: { error: "setup_running", message: SETUP_RUNNING, sessionId: first.body.session.id, setupAction: OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION }
      });
      // Found again with no window attached (the card was closed, the page left or reloaded).
      assert.equal((await call("GET", SIGNIN_PATH)).body.session.id, first.body.session.id);
      assert.equal(world.ptys.length, 1, "the refused starts spawned nothing");

      // Close: the card stops it through the sessions route, with no window attached.
      const stopped = await call("POST", `/api/sessions/${first.body.session.id}/stop`, {});
      assert.equal(stopped.status, 200);
      assert.equal(stopped.body.status, "exited");
      assert.equal(stopped.body.endedBy, "stop");
      assert.equal(stopped.body.note, null);
      assert.deepEqual(await call("GET", SIGNIN_PATH), { status: 200, body: { session: null } });
      assert.deepEqual(await call("GET", `/api/sessions/${first.body.session.id}`), { status: 404, body: UNKNOWN_SESSION });

      // The terminal module can't load: 503 with the manager's sentence, and the place is free again after.
      world.pty = { ok: false, reason: "test: no terminal module" };
      assert.deepEqual(await call("POST", SIGNIN_PATH, { confirm: true }), {
        status: 503,
        body: { error: "pty_unavailable", message: PTY_MESSAGE }
      });
      world.pty = { ok: true, reason: null };
      const next = await call("POST", SIGNIN_PATH, { confirm: true });
      assert.equal(next.status, 201);
      assert.notEqual(next.body.session.id, first.body.session.id);

      // Spec §1: only this route makes a setup session. POST /api/sessions takes only agentId and folder from
      // its body, so a kind and an action sent there start an ordinary OpenClaw agent session.
      const viaSessions = await call("POST", "/api/sessions", {
        agentId: "openclaw",
        folder: null,
        kind: "setup",
        setupAction: OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION
      });
      assert.equal(viaSessions.status, 201, JSON.stringify(viaSessions.body));
      assert.equal(viaSessions.body.kind, "agent");
      assert.equal(world.profileInputs.at(-1).kind, "agent");
      assert.ok(!("setupAction" in world.profileInputs.at(-1)), "no action reaches the profile");
      assert.equal((await call("POST", `/api/sessions/${viaSessions.body.id}/stop`, {})).status, 200);
      assert.equal((await call("GET", SIGNIN_PATH)).body.session.id, next.body.session.id, "the sign-in is still the one running");
    });
  });
});

test("a real sign-in in a PTY against W1's fake: the link and the code are shown, the typed line reaches the program, it signs in and ends, and nothing is kept (Safety 5)", POSIX_ONLY, async () => {
  await withSetupEnv(async ({ home, agentOsHome, log }) => {
    await setFakeKnob(home, "FAKE_AGENT_VERSION", "OpenClaw 2026.9.7");
    const running = new Set();
    const mirrors = [];
    let disposeCalls = 0;
    let recorderCalls = 0;
    // The real manager, PTY, mirror, login shell and profile. Only the spawn is tracked (for the clean-up),
    // the mirror's dispose is counted, and a recorder that is ever asked for fails the start.
    const manager = createSessionManager({
      spawn: async (options) => track(running, await spawnPty(options)),
      mirrorFactory: (options) => {
        const real = createMirror(options);
        mirrors.push(real);
        return {
          ...real,
          dispose() {
            disposeCalls += 1;
            return real.dispose();
          }
        };
      },
      recorderFactory: () => {
        recorderCalls += 1;
        throw new Error("a setup session must never be recorded");
      }
    });
    try {
      await withSetupApp(manager, async ({ call }) => {
        const started = await call("POST", SIGNIN_PATH, { confirm: true });
        assert.equal(started.status, 201, JSON.stringify(started.body));
        const { session } = started.body;
        assert.equal(session.kind, "setup");
        assert.equal(session.folder, home);
        assert.equal(session.folderShown, false);
        assert.equal(session.recordingBytes, 0);
        const { id } = session;
        assert.equal((await call("GET", SIGNIN_PATH)).body.session.id, id);

        // Listed only with kind=all (Hold to stop all's list), never as a tab or in the quit question.
        assert.deepEqual((await call("GET", "/api/sessions")).body.sessions, []);
        assert.deepEqual(
          (await call("GET", "/api/sessions?kind=all")).body.sessions.map((item) => `${item.kind}:${item.id}`),
          [`setup:${id}`]
        );
        assert.deepEqual((await call("GET", "/api/sessions?kind=all&live=1")).body.sessions.map((item) => item.id), [id]);
        assert.deepEqual(await call("POST", "/api/sessions/quit-check", {}), { status: 200, body: { live: [] } });

        // The card's window, in process: the manager's attach, focus and write, which ws.js calls for every
        // window, and the frames ws.js would send. The upgrade itself is ws.js's and unchanged: it asks isLive,
        // and test/sessions-ws.test.js covers its 403 for an ended or unknown session.
        const frames = [];
        const closes = [];
        await manager.attach(id, { id: "card", send: (frame) => frames.push(frame), close: (reason) => closes.push(reason) });
        assert.equal(manager.focus(id, "card"), true);
        const screen = () => frames.map((frame) => (frame.t === "snapshot" ? frame.data : frame.t === "out" ? frame.d : "")).join("");
        await waitFor(() => screen().includes("Press Enter after you approve in your browser."));
        assert.ok(screen().includes(`Sign in with ChatGPT: ${LINK}`), "the sign-in link is on screen");
        assert.ok(screen().includes(`Code: ${CODE}`), "and the one-time code");

        assert.equal(manager.write(id, "card", `${TYPED}\r`), true);
        await waitFor(() => screen().includes("Signed in."));
        await waitFor(() => !manager.isLive(id));
        assert.deepEqual(frames.at(-1), { t: "state", status: "exited", exitCode: 0, signal: null, endedBy: null });
        assert.deepEqual(closes, ["session_ended"]);
        assert.deepEqual(
          (await readFakeAgentState(home)).authRows,
          [{ provider: "openai", method: "siwc", tokenSharing: true, email: "someone@example.com" }],
          "the program signed in (the fake saved its row, as OpenClaw saves the profile)"
        );

        // Gone at once, and nothing kept.
        assert.equal(disposeCalls, 1, "the mirror was disposed when it ended");
        assert.equal((await mirrors[0].snapshot()).data, "", "so no screen of it is ever served");
        assert.equal(recorderCalls, 0, "no recorder was ever made");
        assert.deepEqual(await call("GET", `/api/sessions/${id}`), { status: 404, body: UNKNOWN_SESSION });
        assert.deepEqual(await call("POST", `/api/sessions/${id}/stop`, {}), { status: 404, body: UNKNOWN_SESSION });
        assert.deepEqual(await call("GET", SIGNIN_PATH), { status: 200, body: { session: null } });
        assert.equal(manager.isLive(id), false, "the sessions WebSocket refuses a new window with a bare 403 (ws.js asks isLive)");
        await assert.rejects(manager.attach(id, { id: "late", send() {}, close() {} }), isUnknownSession);
        const recordings = await call("GET", "/api/recordings");
        assert.equal(recordings.status, 200);
        assert.deepEqual(recordings.body.recordings, [], "never in Runs' session recordings");
        assert.deepEqual(await sessionFolders(agentOsHome), [], "no session folder, so startup recovery never sees it");
        const kept = await filesUnder(agentOsHome);
        assert.deepEqual(kept.filter((file) => file.endsWith(".cast") || path.basename(file) === "meta.json"), []);
        for (const file of kept) {
          const text = await readFile(file, "utf8").catch(() => "");
          for (const secret of [CODE, TYPED, LINK]) assert.ok(!text.includes(secret), `${file} holds nothing of the sign-in`);
        }

        // The program ran in HOME with exactly the sign-in argv, in a real terminal.
        const start = (await readFakeLog(log)).find((entry) => entry.event === "start" && entry.name === "openclaw");
        assert.deepEqual(start.argv, SIGNIN_ARGS);
        assert.equal(start.cwd, home);
        assert.equal(start.isTTY, true);
      });
    } finally {
      await manager.shutdownAll({ reason: "quit" });
      killLeftovers(running);
    }
  });
});
```

Create `test/plan-brains-safety.test.js` with exactly this content:

```js
// Plan brains, Safety 1, 3 and 4 across every flow of the feature (spec
// docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-15-plan-brains-design.md, "Safety"):
//   1. Agent OS opens no agent file (the file-access spy; the one exception is
//      brain.js's existence check of ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json);
//   3. only the fixed commands run: no setup-token, paste-token, --token,
//      --method oauth, --device-code, permission bypass or --probe in any
//      fake's argv log (W1's fake logs its programs as "start" records and,
//      under the name openclaw, its quick answers as "probe" records, so the
//      commands detection runs count too), --accept-risk only on a ticked
//      onboard, and none of those words in the new server modules;
//   4. HOME reaches every fake unchanged and none of the H1 variables does
//      (every "start" and "probe" record).
// Task B1a adds the ChatGPT sign-in session (its start and its stop); Tasks
// B1b and B1c add their flows here and their modules to NEW_SERVER_MODULES.
// Temp HOME and AGENT_OS_HOME (real paths), W1's fakes and stand-in login
// shell; never a real agent.
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { mkdtemp, readFile, realpath, rm } from "node:fs/promises";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { test } from "node:test";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import express from "express";
import { clearDetectCaches } from "../server/runtime/agents/detect.js";
import { requireLocalMode } from "../server/runtime/local-session.js";
import { createSessionManager } from "../server/runtime/sessions/manager.js";
import { OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_ACTION, SETUP_ACTIONS } from "../server/runtime/sessions/profiles.js";
import { spawnPty } from "../server/runtime/sessions/pty-host.js";
import { createSessionsRouter } from "../server/runtime/sessions/routes.js";
import { resetLoginShellEnvForTests } from "../server/runtime/sessions/shell-env.js";
import { createSetupRouter } from "../server/runtime/setup/routes.js";
import { FAKE_LOGIN_SHELL, makeFakeAgentBin } from "./helpers/fake-agents.js";
import { setFakeKnob } from "./helpers/fake-knobs.js";
import {
  FORBIDDEN_ARGV,
  FORBIDDEN_PATH,
  H1_ENV_NAMES,
  allowedAgentFile,
  argvProblems,
  sourceProblems,
  spyOnFileAccess,
  withoutH1Env
} from "./helpers/plan-brains-safety.js";

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
const isWindows = process.platform === "win32";
const POSIX_ONLY = { skip: isWindows ? "the fake agents and the stand-in login shell are POSIX shell scripts" : false };
const SYSTEM_PATH_DIRS = ["/usr/bin", "/bin", "/usr/sbin", "/sbin"];
const SIGNIN_ARGS = ["models", "auth", "login", "--provider", "openai", "--method", "siwc"];
const SIGNIN_PATH = "/api/setup/openclaw/signin-terminal";
// The server modules this feature adds. Tasks B1b and B1c add theirs here.
const NEW_SERVER_MODULES = ["server/runtime/setup/openclaw-version.js"];

async function withEnv(vars, fn) {
  const previous = {};
  for (const key of Object.keys(vars)) previous[key] = process.env[key];
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(vars)) {
    if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
    else process.env[key] = String(value);
  }
  try {
    return await fn();
  } finally {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(previous)) {
      if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
      else process.env[key] = value;
    }
  }
}

async function waitFor(predicate, { timeoutMs = 15000, intervalMs = 20 } = {}) {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    const value = await predicate();
    if (value) return value;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, intervalMs));
  }
  throw new Error("timed out waiting for condition");
}

async function readFakeLog(file) {
  const text = await readFile(file, "utf8").catch((error) => {
    if (error.code === "ENOENT") return "";
    throw error;
  });
  return text
    .split("\n")
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map((line) => JSON.parse(line));
}

// The setup router without index.js's requireAdminWhenPublic (its new routes
// carry requireLocalMode themselves), and the sessions router behind
// requireLocalMode, as server/index.js mounts it. This file runs only in local
// mode, where requireAdminWhenPublic lets every request through;
// test/setup-session-kind.test.js mounts it and checks the other modes.
async function withApp(manager, fn) {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json());
  app.use("/api/setup", createSetupRouter({ sessionManager: manager }));
  app.use("/api/sessions", requireLocalMode, createSessionsRouter({ manager }));
  app.use((error, _req, res, _next) => res.status(500).json({ error: "unexpected", message: String(error?.message || error) }));
  const server = await new Promise((resolve) => {
    const listening = app.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", () => resolve(listening));
  });
  const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`;
  async function call(method, url, body) {
    const response = await fetch(`${base}${url}`, {
      method,
      headers: body === undefined ? {} : { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body)
    });
    const text = await response.text();
    return { status: response.status, body: text ? JSON.parse(text) : null };
  }
  try {
    return await fn({ call });
  } finally {
    server.closeAllConnections?.();
    await new Promise((resolve) => server.close(resolve));
  }
}

function track(running, handle) {
  running.add(handle.pid);
  handle.onExit(() => {
    running.delete(handle.pid);
  });
  return handle;
}

function killLeftovers(running) {
  for (const pid of [...running]) {
    try {
      process.kill(pid, "SIGKILL");
    } catch {
      // already gone
    }
    running.delete(pid);
  }
}

test("the Safety helpers: argvProblems and sourceProblems name every forbidden word, allow the sign-in and keep --accept-risk to a ticked onboard; withoutH1Env clears every H1 variable", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    [...FORBIDDEN_ARGV],
    ["setup-token", "paste-token", "--token", "--method oauth", "--device-code", "--dangerously-skip-permissions", "--yolo", "--probe"]
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    argvProblems([SIGNIN_ARGS, ["models", "set", "openai/gpt-6-sol"], ["config", "set", "tools.exec.mode", "ask"], ["models", "status", "--check", "--plain"]]),
    []
  );
  const forbidden = [
    ["models", "auth", "setup-token", "--provider", "anthropic"],
    ["models", "auth", "paste-token", "--provider", "anthropic"],
    ["models", "auth", "login", "--token", "abc"],
    ["models", "auth", "login", "--token=abc"],
    ["models", "auth", "login", "--provider", "openai", "--method", "oauth"],
    ["models", "auth", "login", "--provider", "openai", "--method=oauth"],
    ["models", "auth", "login", "--provider", "openai", "--device-code"],
    ["--dangerously-skip-permissions"],
    ["chat", "--yolo"],
    ["models", "status", "--check", "--plain", "--probe"]
  ];
  for (const argv of forbidden) assert.equal(argvProblems([argv]).length, 1, argv.join(" "));
  const onboard = ["onboard", "--non-interactive", "--accept-risk", "--auth-choice", "anthropic-cli"];
  assert.deepEqual(argvProblems([onboard], { riskTicked: true }), [], "on onboard, with the tick");
  assert.deepEqual(argvProblems([onboard]), [`--accept-risk without the risk tick in: ${onboard.join(" ")}`]);
  assert.deepEqual(argvProblems([["models", "set", "openai/x", "--accept-risk"]], { riskTicked: true }), [
    "--accept-risk outside onboard in: models set openai/x --accept-risk"
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual(argvProblems(["models auth login"]), ['not an argv list: "models auth login"'], "a line that is not a list is a problem, never passed silently");

  assert.deepEqual(sourceProblems('const args = ["models", "auth", "login", "--provider", "openai", "--method", "siwc"];'), []);
  assert.deepEqual(sourceProblems("// never setup-token or --yolo\n/* nor --device-code */\nconst ok = 1;"), [], "comments are not code");
  for (const [code, word] of [
    ['run(["models", "auth", "setup-token"]);', "setup-token"],
    ["run(['models', 'auth', 'paste-token']);", "paste-token"],
    ['run(["login", "--token", key]);', "--token"],
    ['run(["login", "--method", "oauth"]);', "--method oauth"],
    ["run(['login', '--method=oauth']);", "--method oauth"],
    ['run(["login", "--device-code"]);', "--device-code"],
    ['run(["--dangerously-skip-permissions"]);', "--dangerously-skip-permissions"],
    ['run(["chat", "--yolo"]);', "--yolo"],
    ['run(["models", "status", "--probe"]);', "--probe"]
  ]) {
    assert.deepEqual(sourceProblems(code), [word], code);
  }

  assert.deepEqual(
    [...H1_ENV_NAMES],
    ["XDG_CONFIG_HOME", "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR", "CODEX_HOME", "HERMES_HOME", "OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR", "OPENCLAW_PROFILE", "OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH", "OPENCLAW_HOME", "OPENCLAW_AGENT_DIR"]
  );
  const vars = withoutH1Env({ HOME: "/tmp/someone" });
  assert.equal(vars.HOME, "/tmp/someone", "HOME is kept: a test checks it reaches the fakes unchanged");
  for (const name of H1_ENV_NAMES) {
    assert.ok(Object.hasOwn(vars, name), name);
    assert.equal(vars[name], undefined, name);
  }
  assert.equal(allowedAgentFile("/tmp/someone"), path.join("/tmp/someone", ".openclaw", "openclaw.json"));
  assert.ok(FORBIDDEN_PATH.test(allowedAgentFile("/tmp/someone")), "the spy flags it too, so tests leave out exactly this one path");
});

test("Safety 1, 3 and 4: OpenClaw's ChatGPT sign-in, started and stopped through Agent OS, opens no agent file, runs only fixed commands (the sign-in and detection's three) and sets none of the H1 variables for any of them", POSIX_ONLY, async () => {
  const home = await realpath(await mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "agent-os-plan-safety-home-")));
  const agentOsHome = await realpath(await mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "agent-os-plan-safety-data-")));
  const bin = path.join(home, "fake-bin");
  const log = path.join(home, "fake-agent.log");
  try {
    await makeFakeAgentBin(bin);
    await setFakeKnob(home, "FAKE_AGENT_VERSION", "OpenClaw 2026.9.7");
    await withEnv(
      withoutH1Env({
        HOME: home,
        USERPROFILE: home,
        AGENT_OS_HOME: agentOsHome,
        HERMES_AGENT_OS_HOME: undefined,
        AGENT_OS_MANAGED_ROOT: path.join(home, ".agent-os"),
        SHELL: FAKE_LOGIN_SHELL,
        PATH: [bin, ...SYSTEM_PATH_DIRS].join(path.delimiter),
        ZDOTDIR: undefined,
        ENV: undefined,
        BASH_ENV: undefined,
        AGENT_OS_LAUNCH_PATH: undefined,
        npm_lifecycle_event: undefined,
        HERMES_AGENT_OS_EXECUTABLE_PATHS: undefined,
        DEMO_PUBLIC: undefined,
        HERMES_AGENT_OS_DEMO_PUBLIC: undefined,
        HERMES_AGENT_OS_PUBLIC_MODE: undefined,
        HERMES_AGENT_OS_REQUIRE_AUTH: undefined,
        FAKE_AGENT_LOG: log,
        FAKE_AGENT_MODE: undefined,
        FAKE_AGENT_VERSION: undefined
      }),
      async () => {
        assert.equal(os.homedir(), home, "tests must never see the real home folder");
        clearDetectCaches();
        resetLoginShellEnvForTests();
        const running = new Set();
        const manager = createSessionManager({ spawn: async (options) => track(running, await spawnPty(options)) });
        const seen = [];
        try {
          await withApp(manager, async ({ call }) => {
            let id = null;
            const restore = spyOnFileAccess(seen);
            try {
              const started = await call("POST", SIGNIN_PATH, { confirm: true });
              assert.equal(started.status, 201, JSON.stringify(started.body));
              id = started.body.session.id;
              await waitFor(async () => (await readFakeLog(log)).some((entry) => entry.event === "start" && entry.name === "openclaw"));
              assert.equal((await call("GET", SIGNIN_PATH)).body.session?.id, id);
              // Close in the card: the sessions Stop, with no window attached.
              const stopped = await call("POST", `/api/sessions/${id}/stop`, {});
              assert.equal(stopped.status, 200, JSON.stringify(stopped.body));
              assert.equal(stopped.body.status, "exited");
              assert.equal(stopped.body.endedBy, "stop");
              assert.equal(stopped.body.note, null);
            } finally {
              restore();
            }
            await waitFor(() => !manager.isLive(id));
          });
        } finally {
          await manager.shutdownAll({ reason: "quit" });
          killLeftovers(running);
          resetLoginShellEnvForTests();
          clearDetectCaches();
        }

        // Safety 1: the spy saw real file access (a control), and no agent file but the one allowed.
        assert.ok(seen.some((file) => file.startsWith(bin)), "the spy saw OpenClaw being looked up in the fake bin");
        assert.deepEqual(seen.filter((file) => FORBIDDEN_PATH.test(file) && file !== allowedAgentFile(home)), []);

        // Safety 3: the one program that started ran exactly the sign-in argv, and the only quick commands
        // were the fresh detection's three (W1's fake logs each quick answer of `openclaw` as a "probe").
        // The detection caches were cleared above, so the feature cache missed and both --help commands ran.
        const entries = await readFakeLog(log);
        const starts = entries.filter((entry) => entry.event === "start");
        const probes = entries.filter((entry) => entry.event === "probe");
        assert.deepEqual(starts.map((entry) => [entry.name, entry.argv]), [["openclaw", SIGNIN_ARGS]]);
        assert.deepEqual(
          probes.map((entry) => [entry.name, ...entry.argv].join(" ")).sort(),
          ["openclaw --version", "openclaw agent --help", "openclaw agent exec --help"],
          "detection's fixed commands (server/runtime/agents/openclaw.js), each once"
        );
        assert.deepEqual(argvProblems([...starts, ...probes].map((entry) => entry.argv)), []);
        assert.ok(
          entries.some((entry) => entry.event === "sigterm" && entry.pid === starts[0].pid),
          "Stop ended it with SIGTERM, with no OpenClaw command of its own"
        );
        assert.deepEqual(entries.filter((entry) => entry.event === "gateway"), [], "no Gateway or service command");

        // Safety 4: HOME as it is, and none of the H1 variables, for the sign-in and every detection command.
        for (const record of [...starts, ...probes]) {
          const what = `${record.event}: ${record.argv.join(" ")}`;
          assert.equal(record.env.HOME, home, what);
          assert.equal(record.env.USERPROFILE, home, what);
          for (const name of H1_ENV_NAMES) assert.equal(record.env[name], undefined, `${name} never reaches ${what}`);
          assert.deepEqual(record.openclawKeys, [], `no OPENCLAW_* variable reaches ${what}`);
        }
      }
    );
  } finally {
    await rm(home, { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 5, retryDelay: 100 });
    await rm(agentOsHome, { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 5, retryDelay: 100 });
  }
});
```

```js
test("openclaw's ChatGPT sign-in, chosen by its argv: refuses without a terminal; in one it shows a link and a code, saves a siwc row on Enter, says Signed in. and exits 0; Ctrl+C saves nothing; its start record lists every OPENCLAW_* name; every quick answer of openclaw is logged as a probe record", POSIX_ONLY, async () => {
  await withBin({}, async (bin, dir) => {
    const log = path.join(dir, "fake.log");
    const signIn = ["models", "auth", "login", "--provider", "openai", "--method", "siwc"];
    const env = baseEnv(dir, { FAKE_AGENT_LOG: log });

    const noTerminal = await runProbe(bin.paths.openclaw, signIn, env);
    assert.equal(noTerminal.code, 1);
    assert.equal(noTerminal.stdout.trim(), "This command needs a terminal.");
    assert.deepEqual((await readFakeAgentState(dir)).authRows, [], "nothing saved without a terminal");

    // Every quick answer of `openclaw` is logged first as a "probe" record (the start record's fields), so the
    // Safety tests also see the commands detection runs; no other name logs one.
    await runProbe(bin.paths.openclaw, ["--version"], { ...env, OPENCLAW_PROFILE: "work" });
    await runProbe(bin.paths.claude, ["--version"], env);
    const probes = (await readLog(log)).filter((entry) => entry.event === "probe");
    assert.deepEqual(
      probes.map((entry) => [entry.name, entry.argv, entry.isTTY]),
      [
        ["openclaw", signIn, false],
        ["openclaw", ["--version"], false]
      ]
    );
    assert.equal(probes[1].env.HOME, dir);
    assert.equal(probes[1].env.OPENCLAW_PROFILE, "work");
    assert.deepEqual(probes[1].openclawKeys, ["OPENCLAW_PROFILE"]);

    const session = startInPty(bin.paths.openclaw, signIn, { ...env, OPENCLAW_PROFILE: "work", OPENCLAW_SOMETHING_ELSE: "x" });
    try {
      await session.waitFor("Press Enter after you approve in your browser.", "the sign-in's three lines");
      assert.match(session.output, /Sign in with ChatGPT: https:\/\/auth\.openai\.com\/fake-signin\?state=agentos-test/);
      assert.match(session.output, /Code: FAKE-1234/);
      assert.doesNotMatch(session.output, /FAKE_ARGV/, "only the sign-in's own lines are shown");
      const start = (await readLog(log)).find((entry) => entry.event === "start" && entry.pid === session.term.pid);
      assert.deepEqual(start.argv, signIn);
      assert.equal(start.isTTY, true);
      assert.equal(start.env.HOME, dir);
      assert.equal(start.env.OPENCLAW_PROFILE, "work", "OpenClaw's state and profile variables are recorded");
      assert.deepEqual(start.openclawKeys, ["OPENCLAW_PROFILE", "OPENCLAW_SOMETHING_ELSE"], "names only, every OPENCLAW_* one");
      await session.type("approved\r", "Signed in.");
      assert.equal((await session.exited).exitCode, 0);
    } finally {
      session.stop();
    }
    assert.deepEqual((await readFakeAgentState(dir)).authRows, [
      { provider: "openai", method: "siwc", tokenSharing: true, email: "someone@example.com" }
    ]);

    const cancelled = startInPty(bin.paths.openclaw, signIn, env);
    try {
      await cancelled.waitFor("Press Enter after you approve in your browser.", "the sign-in's lines");
      cancelled.term.write("\x03");
      assert.equal((await cancelled.exited).exitCode, 130);
    } finally {
      cancelled.stop();
    }
    assert.equal((await readFakeAgentState(dir)).authRows.length, 1, "Ctrl+C saves nothing");

    // Any other argv, or another name, is the TUI as before.
    for (const [file, args] of [
      [bin.paths.openclaw, ["models", "auth", "login", "--provider", "anthropic"]],
      [bin.paths.claude, signIn]
    ]) {
      const other = startInPty(file, args, env);
      try {
        await other.waitFor(/FAKE_ARGV .*\r[\s\S]*> /, `the TUI for ${path.basename(file)} ${args.join(" ")}`);
      } finally {
        other.stop();
      }
    }
  });
});
```

```js
// The knob rule (plan brains): the environment first, else $HOME/.fake-knobs/<name>, trimmed.
function knob(knobName) {
  if (process.env[knobName] !== undefined) return process.env[knobName];
  if (!process.env.HOME) return undefined;
  try {
    return readFileSync(path.join(process.env.HOME, ".fake-knobs", knobName), "utf8").trim();
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

// A quick answer, then exit. Under the name `openclaw` it is logged first as a "probe" record
// with the fields of a "start" record (plan brains, Safety 3 and 4): agent detection runs
// `--version`, `agent exec --help` and `agent --help`, which never reach a terminal.
function answer(text, code = 0) {
  if (name === "openclaw") log({ event: "probe", ...argvRecord() });
  process.stdout.write(`${text}\n`, () => process.exit(code));
  return true;
}
```

(`argvRecord` is a function declaration further down, and `answer` is first called from the file's last line, after `SHOWN_ENV` and `SECRET_KEY` are set, so the order is fine. `log` writes with `appendFileSync`, so the record is in the file before the process exits.)

```js
// --- OpenClaw's ChatGPT sign-in (plan brains) -------------------------------------------------------

const SIGNIN_ARGV = ["models", "auth", "login", "--provider", "openai", "--method", "siwc"];
const STATE_FILE = ".fake-agent-state.json";

function isSignIn() {
  return name === "openclaw" && args.length === SIGNIN_ARGV.length && args.every((arg, index) => arg === SIGNIN_ARGV[index]);
}

// $HOME/.fake-agent-state.json: { primary, models, authRows } (test/helpers/fake-knobs.js reads it).
function readState() {
  let value = null;
  try {
    value = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(process.env.HOME || "", STATE_FILE), "utf8"));
  } catch {
    value = null;
  }
  const state = { primary: null, models: null, authRows: [], ...(value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value) ? value : {}) };
  if (!Array.isArray(state.authRows)) state.authRows = [];
  return state;
}

function signInProgram() {
  if (!(process.stdin.isTTY && process.stdout.isTTY)) {
    answer("This command needs a terminal.", 1);
    return;
  }
  process.on("SIGTERM", onTerm);
  setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), MAX_LIFETIME_MS).unref();
  process.stdin.setRawMode(true);
  process.stdin.setEncoding("utf8");
  log({ event: "start", ...argvRecord() });
  line("Sign in with ChatGPT: https://auth.openai.com/fake-signin?state=agentos-test");
  line("Code: FAKE-1234");
  line("Press Enter after you approve in your browser.");
  let finished = false;
  process.stdin.on("data", (chunk) => {
    for (const ch of chunk) {
      if (finished) return;
      if (ch === "\x03") {
        finished = true;
        out("^C\r\n");
        process.exit(130);
      }
      if (ch === "\r" || ch === "\n") {
        finished = true;
        const state = readState();
        state.authRows.push({ provider: "openai", method: "siwc", tokenSharing: true, email: "someone@example.com" });
        writeFileSync(path.join(process.env.HOME || "", STATE_FILE), `${JSON.stringify(state, null, 2)}\n`);
        process.stdout.write("\r\nSigned in.\r\n", () => process.exit(0));
        return;
      }
      if (ch >= " ") out(ch); // echoes what is typed, as a terminal program does
    }
  });
  process.stdin.on("end", () => process.exit(0));
  process.stdin.on("error", () => process.exit(0));
}
```

Create `server/runtime/setup/openclaw-version.js`:

```js
// The version gate for OpenClaw's ChatGPT sign-in (plan-brains spec §3, §7).
// OpenAI's "Sign in with ChatGPT" needs OpenClaw 2026.9.7 or newer. The numbers
// come from OpenClaw's own version line, which detection reads (the first line
// of `openclaw --version`); nothing here runs a command or reads a file.
// Callers pass ADAPTERS.openclaw.detect({ refresh: true }), never a cached
// detection, so an update installed a moment ago counts.
import { parseVersion, versionAtLeast } from "../builders/resolve.js";

export const OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_MIN_VERSION = "2026.9.7";
export const OPENCLAW_TOO_OLD_MESSAGE = "Update OpenClaw first: its ChatGPT sign-in needs version 2026.9.7 or newer.";
export const OPENCLAW_VERSION_UNKNOWN_MESSAGE = "Agent OS couldn't read OpenClaw's version.";

const NEED = parseVersion(OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_MIN_VERSION);

// { have, need, newEnough }. `have` is the three numbers of the detected line
// ("OpenClaw 2026.9.6 (eb377ac)" gives "2026.9.6"). `have` and `newEnough` are
// null when OpenClaw is not installed or its line holds no version.
export function openclawVersionInfo(detected) {
  const parsed = detected?.installed === true ? parseVersion(detected.version) : null;
  if (!parsed) return { have: null, need: OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_MIN_VERSION, newEnough: null };
  return { have: parsed.join("."), need: OPENCLAW_SIGNIN_MIN_VERSION, newEnough: versionAtLeast(parsed, NEED) };
}
```

```js
export function assertSessionArgvSafe(agentId, args, { kind = "agent", setupAction = null } = {}) {
```

```js
  // The setup kind (plan-brains spec §1): OpenClaw's ChatGPT sign-in, which
  // needs a real terminal. Made only by POST /api/setup/openclaw/signin-terminal
  // (server/runtime/setup/routes.js), never by POST /api/sessions. `action`
  // names one entry of SETUP_ACTIONS (profiles.js), which holds the only argv.
  // Not gated by Safety, not counted toward maxLive, one at a time. No folder
  // policy (it runs in HOME), no brain, no session folder, no meta.json and no
  // recording: state.dir is null, so nothing can be written for it by mistake.
  // Answers its SessionSummary, built from memory.
  async function createSetupSession({ action, detected } = {}) {
    const setup = typeof action === "string" && Object.hasOwn(SETUP_ACTIONS, action) ? SETUP_ACTIONS[action] : null;
    if (!setup) throw sessionError(400, "unknown_kind", UNKNOWN_KIND_MESSAGE);
    // The id first, so a second start is always told which session to attach to.
    const id = crypto.randomUUID();
    const running = runningSetup();
    if (running) {
      throw sessionError(409, "setup_running", SETUP_RUNNING_MESSAGE, { sessionId: running.id, setupAction: running.action });
    }
    reservedSetup = { id, action };

      const found = detected === undefined ? await detect(agentId) : detected;
      const profile = await buildProfile({
        agentId,
        folder: null,
        sessionId: id,
        kind: "setup",
        setupAction: action,
        settings: { claudeFullscreen: false },
        detected: found
      });
      const at = iso(now());
      const state = newState(null, {
        version: META_VERSION,
        id,
        kind: "setup",
        agentId,
        agentLabel: SESSION_AGENT_LABEL[agentId],
        folder: profile.cwd,
        folderName: path.basename(profile.cwd),
        folderShown: false,
        branch: null,
        status: "starting",
        createdAt: at,
        startedAt: at,
        endedAt: null,
        exitCode: null,
        signal: null,
        endedBy: null,
        dismissed: false,
        brain: null,
        agentSessionId: null,
        resumeMode: null,
        resumes: 0,
        lastUsedAt: at
      });
      state.setupAction = action;
      // startProcess puts the session into `live` and frees the reservation in one step.
      await startProcess(state, profile, { append: false, releaseSlot });
      const view = viewOfState(state);
      return toSummary(view, [view], new Map());
    } finally {
      releaseSlot();
    }
  }

  // The live setup session's SessionSummary, or null (none, or one still
  // before its spawn). GET /api/setup/openclaw/signin-terminal answers it, so a
  // card that was closed or reloaded finds the sign-in again.
  async function liveSetupSession() {
    for (const state of live.values()) {
      if (state.meta.kind === "setup" && state.status !== "exited") {
        const view = viewOfState(state);
        return toSummary(view, [view], new Map());
      }
    }
    return null;
  }
```

```js
// its own status and every field it carries, as the sessions routes answer it
// (ruling R4): setup_running's sessionId and setupAction tell the card which

function sendSessionError(error, res, next) {
```

```js
  // ---- OpenClaw's ChatGPT sign-in, in a terminal inside Agent OS (plan brains §1, §7) ----
  // The only routes that start or find a setup session. Nothing from the
```

#### Notes

1. **A setup session cannot write to disk by mistake.** Its state's `dir` is `null`, so a `persist()` or a recorder call that slipped through would throw a TypeError instead of making `<AGENT_OS_HOME>/sessions/<id>/`. `NO_RECORDER` stands in for the recorder (the contract's "private no-op recorder"), so `onOutput`, `resize` and the Stop path need no special case. `startProcess` (the recorder), `onProcessExit`, `quitCheck`, `shutdownAll` and `write` are the only places that branch on the kind (besides the kind's own new `runningSetup`, `createSetupSession` and `liveSetupSession`).
2. **It leaves the live list in the same step as its exit.** With nothing to close or write, the setup branch of `onProcessExit` returns before any `await`. There is no moment where it reads "exited" but still counts as live, so the WebSocket's `isLive` check refuses a window at once (a bare 403), and `GET /api/sessions/:id`, Stop, Resume and Dismiss answer 404, as spec §1 says.
3. **Its summary is built from memory** (`toSummary(view, [view], new Map())`, the same function the Stop fallback uses), so a sign-in that ends in the same moment still gets an answer. The only disk touch is `recordingBytes`' two `stat` calls (`<AGENT_OS_HOME>/sessions/<id>/screen.cast` and `screen.prev.cast`), which find nothing and give 0. `createSetupSession` runs a detection only when it is not handed one (the route always hands it a fresh one; Stop all's end-to-end test relies on the fallback).
4. **The route reads the version; the manager does not.** The contract puts the version gate in the route and keeps `createSetupSession` about sessions only. Stop all's end-to-end test therefore makes a setup session straight through the manager, where no version is needed.
5. **"Not installed" is tested with a stand-in detection.** OpenClaw's real lookup (`which()`) also searches `/opt/homebrew/bin` and `/usr/local/bin` after PATH. Neither holds `openclaw` on the owner's Mac today (checked with `ls`, nothing run), but a test must never depend on that, so the one "missing" test swaps `ADAPTERS.openclaw.detect` for a function and puts it back in `finally`. Every other route test has W1's fake first on PATH.
6. **The fake's sign-in program** is chosen by its exact argv and only under the name `openclaw`, so no new `FAKE_AGENT_MODE` is needed and no other fake changes. It prints only its own three lines (no `FAKE_ARGV` line), as the real command shows only its link and code; its argv and environment go to `FAKE_AGENT_LOG` as the usual `start` record. It echoes typing, and on Enter it saves one row and exits 0.
7. **`H1_ENV_NAMES` leaves out HOME and USERPROFILE.** Tests set both to the temp home on purpose, so a Safety 4 check asserts they arrive unchanged and that none of the other nine arrives at all. `withoutH1Env(env)` returns `env` plus every H1 name (and every `OPENCLAW_*` variable this process has) set to `undefined`: one object that works for `withEnv()` and for a child's `env`. B1b and B1c use both as they are.
8. **`argvProblems` is strict on purpose.** An entry that is not a list of strings is reported, never skipped, so a fake whose log format changes cannot make the check pass silently. `--method oauth` is caught as two items and as `--method=oauth`; the source scan catches it written as `"--method", "oauth"` too. Neither flags `signin.js`'s `oauth_token` or the Hermes launch's `open -a Terminal <file>` argv, which Task B1c's Step 0 checks.
9. **The method-list test in `test/sessions-manager.test.js` is not changed.** It is not in the contract's file list for B1a and it only checks that the listed methods exist; `test/setup-session-kind.test.js` covers `createSetupSession` and `liveSetupSession` instead.
10. **The admin-token public mode answers 403 before 404.** `server/index.js` mounts `app.use("/api/setup", requireAdminWhenPublic, createSetupRouter())` (line 1053). In the admin-token public mode (`HERMES_AGENT_OS_REQUIRE_AUTH=1` or `HERMES_AGENT_OS_PUBLIC_MODE=1`), `requireAdminWhenPublic` answers a non-admin request first: 403, `{ ok: false, error: "Admin token required." }` through index.js's error handler. An admin request, and the demo mode, get 404 `not_available` from `requireLocalMode`. Nothing starts in either case. `test/setup-session-kind.test.js` mounts `requireAdminWhenPublic` as index.js does and checks all three answers; `test/plan-brains-safety.test.js` leaves it out, because it runs only in local mode, where it lets every request through. This task keeps `server/index.js` as it is.
11. **Where the WebSocket upgrade is tested.** The upgrade itself is unchanged. `ws.js` asks `manager.isLive`, and `test/sessions-ws.test.js` (S9: "an attach to an ended or unknown session is refused from the live map: no disk scan, no agent detection") covers the 403. This task's tests stop at the manager calls `ws.js` makes (`attach`, `focus`, `write`, `isLive`). B2's probe (part C: signing in, a reload while signing in, a second window's 409) attaches to a real setup session through the WebSocket.
12. **The detection commands are in the Safety log too.** Each sign-in start runs a fresh detection: `openclaw --version` every time, and `openclaw agent exec --help` and `openclaw agent --help` when detection's feature cache misses (the first detection after `clearDetectCaches()`, or a new path or version). All three are fixed in `server/runtime/agents/openclaw.js` and run through `runCommand` with the server's own environment (no `options.env`). W1's fake logs every quick answer of `openclaw` as a `probe` record with the start record's fields, so the Safety 3 and 4 checks cover them; the Safety test clears the caches first, so it sees all three, each once. Only the name `openclaw` logs probes, so B1c's statement that the fake logs nothing for `hermes --version` stays true, and every existing reader of `FAKE_AGENT_LOG` filters by `event`, so no other test changes. B1b's setup-brain fake, which logs every call, covers the commands of B1b's flows.
13. **Only the sign-in route makes a setup session.** The sessions `POST /` passes only `agentId` and `folder` to `manager.create`, and `startNew` makes only `agent` and `update`. The HTTP test sends `kind: "setup"` and the action there anyway and gets an ordinary OpenClaw agent session, so a later change that forwards body fields would fail it.
14. **Copy for the owner's review at E1** (new sentences this task adds; everything else is the spec's or an earlier task's, verbatim): "A ChatGPT sign-in is already open in Agent OS." (the 409 `setup_running` message; B2 attaches instead of showing it, but it is in the API answer) and the title "OpenClaw · ChatGPT sign-in" (Hold to stop all's palette list). The spec's two version sentences are used as written, and the missing-OpenClaw answer reuses Task S3's sessions sentence. The fake's lines ("This command needs a terminal.", the link, the code, "Press Enter after you approve in your browser.", "Signed in.") are test-only, not product copy.
15. **Risks.**
    - A Close pressed while a start is still before its spawn answers 404 (the session is not live yet), so the card would think it closed while the sign-in goes on to start. B2's card should read `GET /api/setup/openclaw/signin-terminal` again after a 404 Close; this task's server answers are correct as they are.
    - If Agent OS is killed hard, a setup session leaves nothing to recover (by design); the sign-in program loses its terminal and ends on SIGHUP, as W1's fake does.
    - U3's `sessionsPageShared.ts` and `newSession.ts` (and U4's Home helpers) treat any kind that is not `"update"` as an agent session. They read `GET /api/sessions` without `kind=all`, so they never see a setup session; any later code that lists with `kind=all` must leave `kind: "setup"` out.
    - The two real-PTY tests (here and in Stop all) each run W1's fake for a few seconds; they clean up only the pids they started and have not seen exit, as every SP3 real-PTY test does.

---

### Task B1b: OpenClaw plan status, model lists, labels, the claude-plan and chatgpt-plan jobs and health lines

This task builds the server half of OpenClaw's plan brains: the questions the brain card (Task B2) asks, and the jobs behind its Apply buttons. `GET /api/setup/openclaw/plans` says whether OpenClaw is new enough for the ChatGPT sign-in (B1a's version gate), how Claude Code is signed in (`signInStatus("claude")` now also reports its `method`), whether OpenClaw holds a Sign in with ChatGPT profile with token sharing, and, while OpenClaw is on the ChatGPT plan, whether that sign-in is ready, expiring or not usable. `GET /api/setup/openclaw/plan-models` reads the account's own model list for either plan (or a dated fallback), with the Fable usage-credits note and, for the Claude plan, which models OpenClaw would really run through Claude Code. `POST /api/setup/openclaw/plan` starts a configure job with the spec's steps for the chosen plan. OpenClaw's model answer (`GET /api/setup/agents/openclaw/model`) gains `plan`, so the card says "Claude plan" or "ChatGPT plan" only when OpenClaw's own settings confirm it, and "Anthropic API key" or "OpenAI" otherwise. `healthFixLine` gets the plan lines, so a plan brain's failed hello never gets an OpenRouter or Ollama sentence.

Why it is built this way, in plain words. Agent OS only sets up the routes the vendors' terms clearly allow (spec "Terms basis"): the Claude plan is OpenClaw's own `claude-cli` runtime, which runs the person's unmodified, already signed-in `claude` program (`openclaw onboard --auth-choice anthropic-cli`); the ChatGPT plan is the official Sign in with ChatGPT the person did in the card (B1a). No key or token ever passes through Agent OS. The Claude job checks OpenClaw's runtime pins before `models set`, so OpenClaw is never left pointing at a model that would bill an API key; the ChatGPT job checks readiness by exit code only and puts the earlier model back when the plan can't be used. The server reads the sign-in again inside the job lock, because the card's read may be a minute old (Review Focus 3). Everything is read through the agents' own commands, never their files, and `models auth list` and `models status` run through `runCommand` only (output kept in memory), never the run manager (which writes every line to disk): only each sign-in's method and sharing, and the readiness exit code, ever leave those reads. The pure rules (parsers, fallback lists, names and every server sentence about plans) live in one module with no imports, so `readAgentModel` and the readers share one copy without importing each other.

The tests use fakes only. Receipt on success: `{ agentId: "openclaw", action: "configure", version, provider: "claude-plan" | "chatgpt-plan", model, changes: ["Set the model provider to <mode>", "Set the model to <id>", ...today's exec-mode and gateway lines] }`. `getSetupJob(id)` answers, and saves, a stored plan job left `"running"` with no active entry as failed, with "Agent OS quit before this finished. Apply the plan again." on its current step: the step saved as `"running"`, else the first step not `"succeeded"`, else (every step had succeeded, so Agent OS quit while writing the receipt) the step at `currentStepIndex`, else the last step. A step that succeeded is never marked failed while a later one never finished.

    | `GET /api/setup/openclaw/plan-models?plan=claude\|chatgpt` | 200 `{ models: [{ id, name, note, available }], source: "account" \| "fallback", asOf: "2026-10-15" \| null }`; any other `plan` is 400 `{ ok: false, error: 'plan must be "claude" or "chatgpt"' }` |
    | `POST /api/setup/openclaw/plan` `{ plan, model, confirm: true, acceptOpenClawRisk }` | 200 the plan job (status `"running"`). Refusals in order: 400 `{ ok: false, error: "confirm must be true" }`; 400 `{ ok: false, error: 'plan must be "claude" or "chatgpt"' }`; 400 `{ error: "openclaw_risk_not_accepted" }` (nothing runs); 409 `{ error: "job_already_running" }` (before any read); 409 `{ error: "plan_not_ready", message }` with one of `PLAN_NOT_READY_MESSAGE`; 400 `{ error: "invalid_model_id", message: "That doesn't look like a model name." }` |
