```js
test("claudePlanState is the server's claudePlanReadiness, for every status and sign-in method", () => {
  const methods = [null, ...rules.CLAUDE_PLAN_METHODS, ...rules.CLAUDE_API_METHODS, "something_else"];
  for (const installed of [true, false]) {
    for (const status of ["signed_in", "not_signed_in", "unknown"]) {
      for (const method of methods) {
        const claude = { installed, status, method, note: "" };
        assert.equal(shared.claudePlanState(claude), rules.claudePlanReadiness(claude), JSON.stringify(claude));
      }
    }
  }
  const state = (over) => shared.claudePlanState({ installed: true, status: "signed_in", method: "claude.ai", note: "", ...over });
  assert.equal(state({}), "ready");
  assert.equal(state({ method: "oauth_token" }), "ready", "Claude Code's own sign-in, used by the unmodified program");
  for (const method of ["api_key", "api_key_helper", "third_party"]) assert.equal(state({ method }), "api_billing", method);
  assert.equal(state({ method: null }), "unknown_method", "an older Claude Code that can't say how it is signed in");
  assert.equal(state({ status: "unknown" }), "unknown_method");
  assert.equal(state({ status: "not_signed_in", method: null }), "not_signed_in");
  assert.equal(state({ installed: false, status: "unknown", method: null }), "not_installed");
});

test("chatgptPlanState: the version first, then the sign-in, then token sharing", () => {
  assert.equal(shared.chatgptPlanState(plansOf({ version: { have: null, newEnough: null } })), "version_unknown");
  assert.equal(shared.chatgptPlanState(plansOf({ version: { have: "2026.9.6", newEnough: false } })), "too_old");
  assert.equal(
    shared.chatgptPlanState(plansOf({ version: { have: "2026.9.6", newEnough: false }, chatgpt: { signedIn: true, sharing: true } })),
    "too_old",
    "too old wins even with a saved sign-in: the server refuses the sign-in route too"
  );
  assert.equal(shared.chatgptPlanState(plansOf()), "signed_out");
  assert.equal(shared.chatgptPlanState(plansOf({ chatgpt: { signedIn: null } })), "signed_out", "a sign-in that could not be read counts as signed out");
  assert.equal(shared.chatgptPlanState(plansOf({ chatgpt: { signedIn: true, sharing: false } })), "no_sharing");
  assert.equal(shared.chatgptPlanState(plansOf({ chatgpt: { signedIn: true, sharing: null } })), "ready", "no sharing field: the Apply's readiness check still catches it");
  assert.equal(shared.chatgptPlanState(plansOf({ chatgpt: { signedIn: true, sharing: true, readiness: "expiring" } })), "ready");
});

test("typedModelProblem: the server's rule, with the plan's own prefix allowed and nothing else", () => {
  const serverAccepts = (text, plan) => {
    const trimmed = text.trim();
    const prefix = `${rules.PLAN_PROVIDER[plan]}/`;
    return rules.TYPED_MODEL_RE.test(trimmed.startsWith(prefix) ? trimmed.slice(prefix.length) : trimmed);
  };
  const table = [
    "claude-opus-5-5", "anthropic/claude-opus-5-5", "  claude-opus-5-5  ", "openai/gpt-6-sol", "gpt-6.1-sol",
    "openai/gpt-6.1-sol", "anthropic/gpt-6-sol", "Claude-Opus", "", "   ", "-x", "x y", "../etc", "a".repeat(100),
    "a".repeat(101), "model:tag_1", "anthropic/", "anthropic//x"
  ];
  for (const plan of ["claude", "chatgpt"]) {
    for (const text of table) {
      const problem = shared.typedModelProblem(text, plan);
      assert.equal(problem === null, serverAccepts(text, plan), `${plan}: ${JSON.stringify(text)}`);
      if (problem !== null) assert.equal(problem, "That doesn't look like a model name.");
    }
  }
  assert.equal(shared.typedModelProblem("anthropic/claude-opus-5-5", "claude"), null);
  assert.equal(shared.typedModelProblem("openai/gpt-6-sol", "claude"), "That doesn't look like a model name.", "another plan's provider is refused");
  assert.equal(shared.typedModelProblem("Claude-Opus", "claude"), "That doesn't look like a model name.", "capital letters are refused");
  assert.equal(shared.typedModelProblem("a".repeat(101), "chatgpt"), "That doesn't look like a model name.", "at most 100 characters");
});

test("planApplyModel: Apply needs a listed model that is available, or a well-formed typed name on the fallback list", () => {
  const account = listOf("account", [model("claude-opus-5-5"), model("claude-sonnet-5-5", false)]);
  const fallback = listOf("fallback", [model("claude-opus-5-5")]);
  const none = { model: null, problem: null };
  assert.deepEqual(shared.planApplyModel(account, null, "", "claude"), none, "nothing picked yet");
  assert.deepEqual(shared.planApplyModel(null, { kind: "listed", id: "claude-opus-5-5" }, "", "claude"), none, "no list yet");
  assert.deepEqual(shared.planApplyModel(account, { kind: "listed", id: "claude-opus-5-5" }, "", "claude"), { model: "claude-opus-5-5", problem: null });
  assert.deepEqual(shared.planApplyModel(account, { kind: "listed", id: "claude-sonnet-5-5" }, "", "claude"), none, "not available on the plan: no Apply");
  assert.deepEqual(shared.planApplyModel(account, { kind: "listed", id: "gone" }, "", "claude"), none, "a model the newest list no longer has");
  assert.deepEqual(shared.planApplyModel(account, { kind: "typed" }, "claude-next-6", "claude"), none, "a typed name only while the list is the fallback");
  assert.deepEqual(shared.planApplyModel(fallback, { kind: "typed" }, "  anthropic/claude-next-6 ", "claude"), { model: "anthropic/claude-next-6", problem: null }, "sent trimmed; the server strips the prefix");
  assert.deepEqual(shared.planApplyModel(fallback, { kind: "typed" }, "Bad Name!", "claude"), { model: null, problem: "That doesn't look like a model name." });
  assert.deepEqual(shared.planApplyModel(fallback, { kind: "typed" }, "   ", "claude"), none, "an empty field is not a problem yet");
  assert.deepEqual(shared.planApplyModel(fallback, { kind: "listed", id: "claude-opus-5-5" }, "Bad Name!", "claude"), { model: "claude-opus-5-5", problem: null }, "a picked model ignores the field");
});

test("Choose in Hermes and failed requests: the right sentence for each answer, the server's own first", () => {
  const words = shared.HERMES_TERMINAL_WORDS;
  assert.equal(shared.hermesLaunchWords({ opened: true, command: "/x/hermes model" }), words.opened);
  assert.equal(shared.hermesLaunchWords({ opened: false, reason: "copy", command: "/x/hermes model" }), words.copy);
  assert.equal(shared.hermesLaunchWords({ opened: false, reason: "spawn_failed", command: "/x/hermes model" }), words.spawn_failed);
  assert.equal(shared.hermesLaunchWords({ opened: false, command: "/x/hermes model" }), words.copy, "no reason: the copy words");

  const friendly = (error) => `friendly:${error.message}`;
  const invalid = apiError("invalid_model_id", "That doesn't look like a model name.", 400);
  assert.equal(shared.serverSentence(invalid), "That doesn't look like a model name.");
  assert.equal(shared.planProblem(invalid, friendly), "That doesn't look like a model name.", "never friendlyError's OpenRouter sentence for this code");
  assert.equal(shared.serverSentence(apiError("job_already_running", "", 409)), null);
  assert.equal(shared.planProblem(apiError("job_already_running", "", 409), friendly), "friendly:job_already_running");
  assert.equal(shared.serverSentence(new Error("plain")), null);
  assert.equal(shared.planProblem(new Error(group.TIMEOUT_WORDS), friendly), group.TIMEOUT_WORDS);
  assert.equal(shared.planProblem(new TypeError("Failed to fetch"), friendly), group.noAnswerWords(new TypeError("Failed to fetch")));
  assert.equal(shared.planProblem(new SyntaxError("Unexpected token <"), friendly), shared.UNREADABLE_WORDS);
  assert.equal(shared.planProblem(new Error(shared.UNREADABLE_WORDS), friendly), shared.UNREADABLE_WORDS);

  // The same sentences the rest of the app says.
  assert.equal(shared.TIMEOUT_WORDS, group.TIMEOUT_WORDS);
  assert.equal(shared.NO_ANSWER_WORDS, group.noAnswerWords(new TypeError("x")));
  assert.ok(read("src/ui/components/AgentBrainCard.tsx").includes(`"${shared.UNREADABLE_WORDS}"`));
  const panel = read("src/ui/components/SetupBrainPanel.tsx");
  assert.ok(panel.includes(shared.MAY_HAVE_APPLIED), "the Apply no-answer words are Setup's");
  assert.ok(panel.includes(shared.CANCEL_UNSURE), "the cancel no-answer words are Setup's");
});

test("the new client calls: their routes, methods and bodies (confirm: true), and the plan job's own storage key", async () => {
  const realFetch = globalThis.fetch;
  const calls = [];
  globalThis.fetch = async (url, options = {}) => {
    calls.push({ url: String(url), method: options.method ?? "GET", body: options.body ? JSON.parse(options.body) : null });
    return { ok: true, status: 200, json: async () => ({}) };
  };
  try {
    await setupApi.getOpenclawPlans();
    await setupApi.getOpenclawPlanModels("chatgpt");
    await setupApi.applyOpenclawPlan({ plan: "claude", model: "claude-opus-5-5", acceptOpenClawRisk: true });
    await setupApi.startOpenclawSignInTerminal();
    await setupApi.getOpenclawSignInTerminal();
    await setupApi.openHermesModelTerminal();
  } finally {
    globalThis.fetch = realFetch;
  }
  assert.deepEqual(calls, [
    { url: "/api/setup/openclaw/plans", method: "GET", body: null },
    { url: "/api/setup/openclaw/plan-models?plan=chatgpt", method: "GET", body: null },
    { url: "/api/setup/openclaw/plan", method: "POST", body: { plan: "claude", model: "claude-opus-5-5", acceptOpenClawRisk: true, confirm: true } },
    { url: "/api/setup/openclaw/signin-terminal", method: "POST", body: { confirm: true } },
    { url: "/api/setup/openclaw/signin-terminal", method: "GET", body: null },
    { url: "/api/setup/hermes/model-terminal", method: "POST", body: { confirm: true } }
  ]);

  const store = new Map();
  const before = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(globalThis, "sessionStorage");
  Object.defineProperty(globalThis, "sessionStorage", {
    configurable: true,
    writable: true,
    value: { getItem: (key) => (store.has(key) ? store.get(key) : null), setItem: (key, value) => store.set(key, String(value)), removeItem: (key) => store.delete(key) }
  });
  try {
    setupApi.rememberJobId("plan", "job_plan_1");
    assert.equal(store.get("agentos.setup.planJob"), "job_plan_1");
    assert.equal(setupApi.recallJobId("plan"), "job_plan_1");
    assert.equal(setupApi.recallJobId("configure"), null, "a plan job never takes the configure job's place (Setup never lands on it)");
    setupApi.rememberJobId("plan", null);
    assert.equal(store.has("agentos.setup.planJob"), false);
  } finally {
    if (before) Object.defineProperty(globalThis, "sessionStorage", before);
    else delete globalThis.sessionStorage;
  }
});

test("wiring: every request of the new cards has a time limit, Hermes never gets a session, the cards keep and log nothing, and the labels and hides are in place", () => {
  const names = "getOpenclawPlans|getOpenclawPlanModels|applyOpenclawPlan|startOpenclawSignInTerminal|getOpenclawSignInTerminal|openHermesModelTerminal|getSetupJob|cancelSetupJob";
  for (const file of ["src/ui/components/BrainPlanCard.tsx", "src/ui/components/ChooseInHermes.tsx"]) {
    const text = read(file);
    const all = text.match(new RegExp(`\\b(${names})\\(`, "g"))?.length ?? 0;
    const timed = text.match(new RegExp(`withTimeout\\(\\s*(${names})\\(`, "g"))?.length ?? 0;
    assert.ok(all > 0 && all === timed, `${file}: ${timed} of ${all} requests have a time limit`);
  }
  const card = read("src/ui/components/BrainPlanCard.tsx");
  const term = read("src/ui/components/PlanSignInTerminal.tsx");
  const hermes = read("src/ui/components/ChooseInHermes.tsx");
  // Hermes's picker runs in Terminal.app only: no session and no terminal here (spec section 4, Safety 2).
  assert.doesNotMatch(hermes, /sessionsApi|SessionTerminal|createSession|signin-terminal/);
  // Nothing typed or shown in the sign-in is kept or logged by the page (Safety 1 and 5): no console, no storage
  // writes; the terminal reads only its two display settings, and the card keeps its job id through rememberJobId.
  for (const text of [card, term, hermes]) {
    assert.doesNotMatch(text, /console\./);
    assert.doesNotMatch(text, /setItem\(|indexedDB|document\.cookie/);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(term.match(/localStorage\.[a-zA-Z]+\(/g), ["localStorage.getItem("]);
  assert.doesNotMatch(card, /localStorage|sessionStorage/);
  // Apply has the long limit (amendment A); the terminal keeps Tab while connected, so Close comes before it.
  assert.match(card, /withTimeout\(applyOpenclawPlan\(\{[^}]*\}\), PLAN_LIMITS_MS\.apply\)/);
  const closeAt = term.indexOf("void close()");
  assert.ok(closeAt > 0 && closeAt < term.indexOf("<SessionTerminal"), "the Close button comes before the terminal");
  // BrainResult: exported, and its label line names the mode from one table, never "Local" for a plan.
  const panel = read("src/ui/components/SetupBrainPanel.tsx");
  assert.match(panel, /export function BrainResult\(/);
  assert.match(panel, /BRAIN_MODE_LABEL\[target\.mode\]/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(panel, /target\.mode === "openrouter" \? "OpenRouter" : "Local"/);
  assert.match(panel, /showPlanCard = true/);
  // The Agents page: the plan names on the receipt line, Change model on a plan, no second plan card in Change brain.
  const agents = read("src/ui/components/AgentBrainCard.tsx");
  assert.match(agents, /"claude-plan": "Claude plan"/);
  assert.match(agents, /"chatgpt-plan": "ChatGPT plan"/);
  assert.match(agents, /showPlanCard=\{false\}/);
  assert.match(agents, /onChangeModel=/);
  assert.match(read("src/ui/components/BrainModelActions.tsx"), /onChangeModel \? onChangeModel\(\) : setMode\("picker"\)/);
});
```

```js
  const summary = { id: SID, kind: "setup", agentId: "openclaw", status: "live" };
  try {
    const calls = fakeFetch(() => jsonAnswer(200, summary));
    assert.deepEqual(await api.getSession(SID), summary);
    assert.deepEqual(calls, [{ url: `/api/sessions/${SID}`, method: "GET" }]);
    const encoded = fakeFetch(() => jsonAnswer(200, summary));
    await api.getSession("a b/c");
    assert.equal(encoded[0].url, "/api/sessions/a%20b%2Fc", "the id is encoded");
    fakeFetch(() => jsonAnswer(404, { error: "unknown_session", message: "That session doesn't exist anymore." }));
    const gone = await api.getSession(SID).catch((error) => error);
    assert.ok(gone instanceof ApiError, "a refusal is an ApiError");
    assert.equal(gone.status, 404);
    assert.equal(gone.message, "unknown_session");
  } finally {
    removeFakes();
  }

  assert.equal(api.SESSION_LIMITS_MS.get, 8000);
  const clock = fakeClock();
  try {
    globalThis.fetch = () => new Promise(() => {});
    let outcome = null;
    void api.getSession(SID).then(
      () => {
        outcome = "answered";
      },
      (error) => {
        outcome = error.message;
      }
    );
    clock.tick(7999);
    await flush();
    assert.equal(outcome, null, "still waiting just before 8 s");
    clock.tick(1);
    await flush();
    assert.equal(outcome, "Agent OS did not answer in time.");
  } finally {
    clock.restore();
    removeFakes();
  }
});
```

```ts
// Each answer comes from the agents' own commands on the server. Like the rest of this file, no function here has
// a time limit: callers wrap each call in withTimeout (src/ui/planBrainsShared.ts PLAN_LIMITS_MS).

export type OpenclawPlan = "claude" | "chatgpt";

export interface OpenclawPlansInfo {
  // OpenClaw's version: the ChatGPT sign-in needs 2026.9.7 or newer. null when it can't be read.
  version: { have: string | null; need: "2026.9.7"; newEnough: boolean | null };
  // Claude Code, from its own `claude auth status`. `method` is how it is signed in, or null when it can't say.
  claude: { installed: boolean; status: "signed_in" | "not_signed_in" | "unknown"; method: string | null; note: string };
  // OpenClaw's saved ChatGPT sign-in. `readiness` is set only while OpenClaw is on the ChatGPT plan; null when unknown.
  chatgpt: { signedIn: boolean | null; sharing: boolean | null; readiness: "ready" | "expiring" | "not_ready" | null };
}

export interface PlanModel {

  id: string;
  name: string;
  // The Fable usage-credits sentence, or null.
  note: string | null;
  // false only for a Claude plan model OpenClaw would run on an API key in this version.
  available: boolean;
}

export interface PlanModelList {
  models: PlanModel[];
  // "fallback": the account's list could not be read, so this is the dated list.
  source: "account" | "fallback";
  asOf: "2026-10-15" | null;
}

// The same answer as the Claude Code sign-in's Terminal button: opened on macOS, else the command to copy.

  command: string;
  reason?: "copy" | "spawn_failed";
}

export function getOpenclawPlans(): Promise<OpenclawPlansInfo> {
```

```ts
export async function listSessions(): Promise<SessionListResponse> {
  const body = await withTimeout(request<SessionListResponse>("/api/sessions"), SESSION_LIMITS_MS.list);
  if (!body || !Array.isArray(body.sessions)) throw new Error(UNREADABLE);
```

```ts
// One session's summary. Once a session is gone the server answers 404 unknown_session (a setup session leaves no
// folder behind, so that is its answer after it ends), and the caller counts that 404 as ended.
export function getSession(sessionId: string): Promise<SessionSummary> {
  return withTimeout(request<SessionSummary>(sessionPath(sessionId)), SESSION_LIMITS_MS.get);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: The words and pure rules.** Create `src/ui/planBrainsShared.ts`:

```ts
// Plan brains (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-15-plan-brains-design.md; Task B2): the words and the pure rules
// of OpenClaw's "Your plan" card (BrainPlanCard.tsx), its ChatGPT sign-in terminal (PlanSignInTerminal.tsx) and
// Hermes's "Choose in Hermes" (ChooseInHermes.tsx). Every sentence here is the spec's, word for word. The ones the
// server says too (the Claude Code readiness sentences, the two OpenClaw version sentences, the ChatGPT readiness
// sentences and the typed-name refusal), and the typed-name rule itself, are checked against the server's own
// constants by test/plan-brains-ui-logic.test.js. Only `import type` here, so that test loads this file straight
// from src/ (Node strips the types itself, decision P14).
import type { OpenclawPlan, OpenclawPlansInfo, PlanModelList, TerminalLaunch } from "../setupApi";

// ---- words ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

// OpenClaw's own security notice, shown once on the card above its one risk tick (spec section 2). The tick's
// words are Setup's (OPENCLAW_RISK_LABEL in agentModelChange.ts).
export const OPENCLAW_SECURITY_NOTICE =
  "This bot can read files and run actions if tools are enabled. A bad prompt can trick it into doing unsafe things.";

export const PLAN_LABEL: Record<OpenclawPlan, string> = { claude: "Claude plan", chatgpt: "ChatGPT plan" };

// Which provider each plan's models belong to; the server adds "anthropic/" or "openai/" itself (spec section 5).
export const PLAN_PROVIDER: Record<OpenclawPlan, string> = { claude: "anthropic", chatgpt: "openai" };

// Under the Brain card's model line, only while OpenClaw's own answer says it is on that plan (spec section 5).
export const PLAN_NOTE: Record<OpenclawPlan, string> = {
  claude:
    "Shares your Claude plan limits with Claude Code. Anthropic allows this for personal use today, but has changed these rules several times this year.",
  chatgpt: "Shares your ChatGPT plan limits with Codex."
};

// What the Claude plan section says when it offers no model list (spec section 2). Not signed in shows the
// "Sign in to Claude Code" control instead of a sentence.
export const CLAUDE_PLAN_WORDS = {
  not_installed: "Install Claude Code first.",
  api_billing: "Claude Code uses an API key or a cloud account, not your Claude plan, so OpenClaw would bill that instead.",
  unknown_method: "Agent OS couldn't tell how Claude Code is signed in. Update Claude Code, then check again."
} as const;

// The ChatGPT plan section's sentences (spec section 3).
export const CHATGPT_PLAN_WORDS = {
  too_old: "Update OpenClaw first: its ChatGPT sign-in needs version 2026.9.7 or newer.",
  version_unknown: "Agent OS couldn't read OpenClaw's version.",
  no_sharing: "Signed in, but plan use isn't allowed yet. Sign in again and allow token sharing.",
  expiring: "Your ChatGPT sign-in expires soon. Sign in again.",
  not_ready: "OpenClaw can't use your ChatGPT plan yet. Sign in again, and allow token sharing when ChatGPT asks."
} as const;

export const FALLBACK_LIST_NOTE = "Agent OS couldn't read your account's model list, so this list may be out of date.";
export const NOT_ON_PLAN_NOTE = "Not available on your plan in this OpenClaw yet";
export const TYPED_MODEL_LABEL = "Type a model name";
export const INVALID_PLAN_MODEL = "That doesn't look like a model name.";

// The two quiet lines next to "Choose in Hermes", shown before anything opens (spec section 4), in this order.
export const HERMES_PICKER_LINES = [
  "If you pick Anthropic without a Claude API key, Hermes uses your Claude Code sign-in (or its own Claude sign-in). Anthropic doesn't allow apps like Hermes to use Claude sign-ins this way: it's charged as usage credits, not your plan, it doesn't work on Pro, and it can sign Claude Code out. A Claude API key is fine.",
  "Hermes's 'ChatGPT or Codex Subscription' reuses Codex's own sign-in, which OpenAI hasn't documented for other apps. Hermes's official Sign in with ChatGPT isn't released yet."
] as const;

export const HERMES_TERMINAL_WORDS = {
  opened: "Terminal opened with Hermes's model picker. Choose there, then press Refresh.",
  copy: "Run this command in your own terminal, choose a model, then press Refresh.",
  spawn_failed: "Terminal didn't open. Run this command in your own terminal, choose a model, then press Refresh."
} as const;

// The sign-in terminal's accessible name: the setup session's own title (sessionTitle in sessionsShared.ts, Task
// B1a), so it adds no new words; the test compares the two.
export const SIGNIN_TERMINAL_LABEL = "OpenClaw · ChatGPT sign-in";

// Words the rest of the app already says (setupGroupShared.ts, AgentBrainCard.tsx, SetupBrainPanel.tsx); the test
// checks they agree.
export const UNREADABLE_WORDS = "Agent OS gave an answer that could not be read.";
export const TIMEOUT_WORDS = "Agent OS did not answer in time.";
export const NO_ANSWER_WORDS = "Agent OS did not answer.";
export const MAY_HAVE_APPLIED = "It may or may not have been applied, so check what the agent uses now before trying again.";
export const CANCEL_UNSURE = "The cancel may not have gone through.";

// ---- time limits (P26: every request has one) ----------------------------------------------------------------

// plans: the server asks Claude Code and OpenClaw several questions, so it gets the brain read's limit
// (BRAIN_READ_LIMIT_MS); models: one `models list` and one `config get` (MODEL_READ_LIMIT_MS); apply: Apply, which
// also gets the brain read's limit, because before the job exists the server detects OpenClaw again, reads the
// sign-in again (`claude auth status` or `models auth list`) and reads the model list again, all inside the job lock
// (up to about 48 s on a slow OpenClaw), and an Apply given up too early would lose the job's id; action: starting
// the sign-in, cancelling a job, reading a job and the Hermes launch; signInLookup: asking for the live setup session.
export const PLAN_LIMITS_MS = { plans: 55_000, models: 30_000, apply: 55_000, action: 20_000, signInLookup: 10_000 } as const;
// The sign-in terminal asks this often whether its session has ended (spec section 1).
export const SIGNIN_POLL_MS = 5000;
// After a 409 setup_running, the running session is asked for every second, for up to 15 s.
export const SETUP_RUNNING_WAIT_MS = 15_000;
export const SETUP_RUNNING_POLL_MS = 1000;
// On window focus the plan card reads the plans again at most this often; Hermes's card reads its model at most
// every 2 s (focus events come in bursts when windows switch).
export const PLANS_FOCUS_GAP_MS = 20_000;
export const HERMES_FOCUS_GAP_MS = 2000;

// ---- rules ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type ClaudePlanState = "ready" | "not_installed" | "not_signed_in" | "api_billing" | "unknown_method";
export type ChatgptPlanState = "version_unknown" | "too_old" | "signed_out" | "no_sharing" | "ready";

// Claude Code's sign-in methods that bill an API key or a cloud account, not the plan (the server's list).
export const CLAUDE_API_METHODS = ["api_key", "api_key_helper", "third_party"] as const;

// The server's rule (claudePlanReadiness in server/runtime/setup/openclaw-plan-rules.js), in the same order.
export function claudePlanState(claude: OpenclawPlansInfo["claude"]): ClaudePlanState {
  if (!claude.installed) return "not_installed";
  if (claude.status === "not_signed_in") return "not_signed_in";
  if (claude.method !== null && (CLAUDE_API_METHODS as readonly string[]).includes(claude.method)) return "api_billing";
  if (claude.method === null || claude.status === "unknown") return "unknown_method";
  return "ready";
}

// The version comes first: an OpenClaw too old for the sign-in (or whose version can't be read) offers no Sign in at
// all, which is what the server's sign-in route says too. A sign-in Agent OS could not read counts as signed out.
export function chatgptPlanState(plans: OpenclawPlansInfo): ChatgptPlanState {
  if (plans.version.newEnough === null) return "version_unknown";
  if (plans.version.newEnough === false) return "too_old";
  if (plans.chatgpt.signedIn !== true) return "signed_out";
  if (plans.chatgpt.sharing === false) return "no_sharing";
  return "ready";
}

// A typed model name, checked as the server checks it: the plan's own provider prefix may be typed, and what is left
// must match TYPED_MODEL_RE (spec section 5). null when it is fine.
export const TYPED_MODEL_RE = /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._:-]{0,99}$/;
export function typedModelProblem(text: string, plan: OpenclawPlan): string | null {
  const trimmed = text.trim();
  const prefix = `${PLAN_PROVIDER[plan]}/`;
  const rest = trimmed.startsWith(prefix) ? trimmed.slice(prefix.length) : trimmed;
  return TYPED_MODEL_RE.test(rest) ? null : INVALID_PLAN_MODEL;
}

// What the person picked in one plan's list: a listed model, the "Type a model name" row (only on the fallback
// list), or nothing yet.
export type PlanSelection = { kind: "listed"; id: string } | { kind: "typed" } | null;

// The model Apply would send (null keeps Apply off), and the sentence for a typed name in the wrong shape. A typed
// name is sent trimmed and as typed; the server strips the plan's prefix itself.
export function planApplyModel(
  list: PlanModelList | null,
  selection: PlanSelection,
  typed: string,
  plan: OpenclawPlan
): { model: string | null; problem: string | null } {
  if (!list || !selection) return { model: null, problem: null };
  if (selection.kind === "listed") {
    const row = list.models.find((entry) => entry.id === selection.id);
    return { model: row && row.available ? row.id : null, problem: null };
  }
  if (list.source !== "fallback") return { model: null, problem: null };
  const text = typed.trim();
  if (!text) return { model: null, problem: null };
  const problem = typedModelProblem(text, plan);
  return problem ? { model: null, problem } : { model: text, problem: null };
}

// The sentence after "Choose in Hermes", from the launch answer (spec section 4).
export function hermesLaunchWords(launch: TerminalLaunch): string {
  if (launch.opened) return HERMES_TERMINAL_WORDS.opened;
  return launch.reason === "spawn_failed" ? HERMES_TERMINAL_WORDS.spawn_failed : HERMES_TERMINAL_WORDS.copy;
}

// The sentence the server wrote for a refusal (ApiError.detail), or null. Told apart by name, like gotNoAnswer, so
// this file needs no runtime import.
export function serverSentence(error: unknown): string | null {
  if (!(error instanceof Error) || error.name !== "ApiError") return null;
  const detail = (error as Error & { detail?: unknown }).detail;
  return typeof detail === "string" && detail.trim() ? detail : null;
}

// Words for a failed plan request: the server's own sentence first (so invalid_model_id never gets friendlyError's
// OpenRouter sentence), then an answer that could not be read, then no answer at all, then `friendly` (the caller
// passes friendlyError) for a refusal that carried no sentence.
export function planProblem(error: unknown, friendly: (error: unknown) => string): string {
  const sentence = serverSentence(error);
  if (sentence) return sentence;
  if (error instanceof SyntaxError || (error instanceof Error && error.message === UNREADABLE_WORDS)) return UNREADABLE_WORDS;
  if (!(error instanceof Error && error.name === "ApiError")) {
    return error instanceof Error && error.message === TIMEOUT_WORDS ? TIMEOUT_WORDS : NO_ANSWER_WORDS;
  }
  return friendly(error);
}
```

```tsx
// The ChatGPT sign-in's terminal on OpenClaw's plan card (spec 2026-10-15 section 1): the setup session the server
// started for `openclaw models auth login --provider openai --method siwc`, shown with the same browser terminal and
// WebSocket as the Sessions page (SessionTerminal, Task U2). It is a byte pipe: what the person types goes to
// OpenClaw's own command and nowhere else, and nothing here keeps it. The session ends when the sign-in finishes, or
// when Close stops it (with no question: a sign-in has nothing to lose). This panel learns of the end three ways: an
// exited state frame, the terminal's "ended" connection, and GET /api/sessions/:id every 5 s (a 404 means the
// session is gone, which is how a setup session answers once it ended). Its sentences (a link copied, typing that
// was not sent) show in one line under the terminal.
// Keyboard: the terminal keeps Tab and Shift+Tab while it is connected (Task U2's rule, tabLeavesTerminal), so the
// Close row comes before the terminal and Tab reaches Close first. Inside the terminal, Ctrl+C is the way out: it
// goes to the sign-in program as in any terminal, the program ends, and this panel closes by itself (the card then
// puts the keyboard on the ChatGPT plan heading).
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ApiError } from "../../api";
import { getSession, sessionProblem, stopSession } from "../../sessionsApi";
import type { SessionStateFrame } from "../../types";
import { isDesktopApp } from "../desktop";
import { SIGNIN_POLL_MS, SIGNIN_TERMINAL_LABEL } from "../planBrainsShared";
import { parseTerminalPrefs, TERMINAL_PREFS_KEY, type TerminalPrefs } from "../sessionsPageShared";
import SessionTerminal, { type TerminalConnection } from "./SessionTerminal";
import { useInterval } from "./useInterval";

const PLATFORM = typeof navigator !== "undefined" ? navigator.platform || navigator.userAgent || "" : "";

// The terminal's two browser-side settings, as the Sessions page keeps them (Task U3); the defaults when this browser
// has none, or when its storage is blocked.
function readPrefs(): TerminalPrefs {
  const platform = { platform: PLATFORM, desktop: isDesktopApp() };
  try {
    return parseTerminalPrefs(window.localStorage.getItem(TERMINAL_PREFS_KEY), platform);
  } catch {
    return parseTerminalPrefs(null, platform);
  }
}

function isGone(error: unknown) {
  return error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 404;
}

export default function PlanSignInTerminal({
  sessionId,
  onEnded,
  onClose,
  autoFocus = false
}: {
  sessionId: string;
  // The session ended by itself (the sign-in finished, failed, or Ctrl+C stopped it): the card closes the panel and
  // reads the sign-in again.
  onEnded(): void;
  // Close stopped it (or it was already gone): the card closes the panel and asks once for a live sign-in.
  onClose(): void;
  // Take the keys at once: only right after the person pressed Sign in, never when a page load finds the session again.
  autoFocus?: boolean;
}) {
  const [prefs] = useState(readPrefs);
  const [ended, setEnded] = useState(false);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const [closing, setClosing] = useState(false);
  const alive = useRef(true);
  // The card is told once: either onEnded or onClose, never both.
  const told = useRef(false);
  const asking = useRef(false);
  const latest = useRef({ onEnded, onClose });
  latest.current = { onEnded, onClose };

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ended || told.current) return;
    told.current = true;
    latest.current.onEnded();
  }, [ended]);

  // One question at a time: a slow answer must not pile up behind the next tick.
  useInterval(
    async () => {
      if (asking.current) return;
      asking.current = true;
      try {
        const summary = await getSession(sessionId);
        if (alive.current && summary?.status === "exited") setEnded(true);
      } catch (error) {
        if (alive.current && isGone(error)) setEnded(true);
      } finally {
        asking.current = false;
      }
    },
    ended ? null : SIGNIN_POLL_MS
  );

  const onState = useCallback((state: SessionStateFrame) => {
    if (state.status === "exited") setEnded(true);
  }, []);
  const onConnection = useCallback((connection: TerminalConnection) => {
    if (connection === "ended") setEnded(true);
  }, []);
  const onNotice = useCallback((text: string) => setNotice(text), []);

  async function close() {
    if (closing) return;
    setClosing(true);
    setNotice("");
    try {
      await stopSession(sessionId);
    } catch (error) {
      // A session that is already gone counts as closed: the card only ever holds the id of a session that had
      // started (from the 201 or from GET /api/setup/openclaw/signin-terminal), so a 404 here means it ended, and
      // the card asks that GET once more after every Close anyway. Anything else says why and keeps the panel.
      if (!isGone(error)) {
        if (alive.current) {
          setNotice(sessionProblem(error));
          setClosing(false);
        }
        return;
      }
    }
    if (!alive.current || told.current) return;
    told.current = true;
    latest.current.onClose();
  }

  // Close first: once the keyboard is inside the connected terminal, Tab and Shift+Tab go to the sign-in program.
  return (
    <div className="os-plan-signin">
      <div className="os-plan-card__row">
        <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => void close()} disabled={closing}>
          Close
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="os-plan-term">
        <SessionTerminal
          sessionId={sessionId}
          label={SIGNIN_TERMINAL_LABEL}
          kittyKeyboard={prefs.kittyKeyboard}
          webgl={prefs.webgl}
          autoFocus={autoFocus}
          ended={ended}
          onState={onState}
          onConnection={onConnection}
          onNotice={onNotice}
        />
      </div>
      <p className="os-plan-term__notice" role="status">
        {notice}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 12: Choose in Hermes.** Create `src/ui/components/ChooseInHermes.tsx`:

```tsx
// "Choose in Hermes" on Hermes's Brain card (spec 2026-10-15 section 4). Agent OS adds nothing of its own for
// Hermes's brain: this opens Hermes's own model picker (`hermes model`) in its own Terminal.app window (the server
// writes a one-line .command file and opens it with Terminal), or, on Windows and Linux, hands back the command to
// run. Nothing typed or shown there passes through Agent OS. Agent OS can't see that window close, so the card reads
// Hermes's saved model again when the person presses Refresh and whenever this window gets focus (at most every 2 s:
// focus events come in bursts). The two quiet lines say, before anything opens, which of Hermes's own choices
// Anthropic and OpenAI don't allow for apps like Hermes.
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";
import type { TerminalLaunch } from "../../setupApi";
import { friendlyError, openHermesModelTerminal } from "../../setupApi";
import { withTimeout } from "../homeShared";
import {
  HERMES_FOCUS_GAP_MS,
  HERMES_PICKER_LINES,
  PLAN_LIMITS_MS,
  UNREADABLE_WORDS,
  hermesLaunchWords,
  planProblem
} from "../planBrainsShared";
import SetupCommand from "./SetupCommand";
import StatusMark from "./StatusMark";

export default function ChooseInHermes({ onRefresh }: { onRefresh(): void }) {
  const [launch, setLaunch] = useState<TerminalLaunch | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState("");
  const alive = useRef(true);
  const lastRead = useRef(0);
  const latest = useRef(onRefresh);
  latest.current = onRefresh;

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    function onFocus() {
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - lastRead.current < HERMES_FOCUS_GAP_MS) return;
      lastRead.current = now;
      latest.current();
    }
    window.addEventListener("focus", onFocus);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("focus", onFocus);
  }, []);

  async function choose() {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setProblem("");
    try {
      const answer = await withTimeout(openHermesModelTerminal(), PLAN_LIMITS_MS.action);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      if (!answer || typeof answer.opened !== "boolean" || typeof answer.command !== "string") throw new Error(UNREADABLE_WORDS);
      setLaunch(answer);
    } catch (error) {
      if (alive.current) setProblem(planProblem(error, friendlyError));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  function refresh() {
    lastRead.current = Date.now();
    latest.current();
  }

  return (
    <div className="os-hermes-pick">
      <div className="os-hermes-pick__lines">
        {HERMES_PICKER_LINES.map((line) => (
          <p key={line} className="os-hermes-pick__line">
            {line}
          </p>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="os-plan-card__row">
        <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => void choose()} disabled={busy}>
          Choose in Hermes
        </button>
        {launch ? (
          <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--ghost" onClick={refresh}>
            <RefreshCw size={14} aria-hidden="true" /> Refresh
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      {launch ? (
        <p className="os-hermes-pick__result" role="status">
          {hermesLaunchWords(launch)}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {launch && !launch.opened ? <SetupCommand command={launch.command} label="Copy the command" /> : null}
      {problem ? (
        <p className="os-plan-card__error" role="alert">
          <StatusMark kind="error" /> {problem}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// "Your plan": OpenClaw's plan brains (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-15-plan-brains-design.md, sections 2, 3
// and 6), on OpenClaw's Brain card (Agents page) and as Setup's third AI brain card. Two sections:
//   Claude plan   OpenClaw runs the person's own Claude Code, signed in with Claude Code's own sign-in;
//   ChatGPT plan  OpenClaw signs in with OpenAI's "Sign in with ChatGPT", in a small terminal right here
//                 (PlanSignInTerminal: a session the server runs for OpenClaw's own sign-in command).
// A section that is ready lists the models the account offers (or a dated list with a "Type a model name" row), and
// its Apply starts the plan's job on the server, which also switches OpenClaw to ask before running commands and
// says hello. One security notice and one risk tick serve both Apply buttons; the tick is cleared after each job.
//
// Honesty: every state here is the server's answer (GET /api/setup/openclaw/plans), read from the agents' own
// commands; the server reads it all again when Apply is pressed, and its refusal sentence is shown as it is. No
// token, code or sign-in passes through this card.
import { forwardRef, useCallback, useEffect, useId, useImperativeHandle, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { AlertTriangle, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";
import { ApiError } from "../../api";
import { navigateTo } from "../../nav";
import type { OpenclawPlan, OpenclawPlansInfo, PlanModelList, SetupJob } from "../../setupApi";
import {
  applyOpenclawPlan,
  cancelSetupJob,
  friendlyError,
  getOpenclawPlanModels,
  getOpenclawPlans,
  getOpenclawSignInTerminal,
  getSetupJob,
  recallJobId,
  rememberJobId,
  startOpenclawSignInTerminal
} from "../../setupApi";
import { OPENCLAW_RISK_LABEL } from "../agentModelChange";
import { BRAIN_AGENT_LABEL, CONFIGURE_STEP_LABEL, type BrainAgentLine } from "../brainShared";
import { withTimeout } from "../homeShared";
import {
  CANCEL_UNSURE,
  CHATGPT_PLAN_WORDS,
  CLAUDE_PLAN_WORDS,
  FALLBACK_LIST_NOTE,
  MAY_HAVE_APPLIED,
  NOT_ON_PLAN_NOTE,
  OPENCLAW_SECURITY_NOTICE,
  PLAN_LABEL,
  PLAN_LIMITS_MS,
  PLANS_FOCUS_GAP_MS,
  SETUP_RUNNING_POLL_MS,
  SETUP_RUNNING_WAIT_MS,
  TYPED_MODEL_LABEL,
  UNREADABLE_WORDS,
  chatgptPlanState,
  claudePlanState,
  planApplyModel,
  planProblem,
  type ChatgptPlanState,
  type ClaudePlanState,
  type PlanSelection
} from "../planBrainsShared";
import { gotNoAnswer } from "../setupGroupShared";
import PlanSignInTerminal from "./PlanSignInTerminal";
import { BrainResult } from "./SetupBrainPanel";
import SetupInstallPanel from "./SetupInstallPanel";
import StatusMark from "./StatusMark";
import { useInterval } from "./useInterval";
import "../brain.css";

export interface BrainPlanCardProps {
  // Where it is shown: OpenClaw's Brain card on the Agents page, or Setup's AI brain step (a card of its own).
  where: "agents" | "setup";
  // The plan OpenClaw is on now (its own answer, spec section 5), or null. Setup passes null.
  currentPlan: OpenclawPlan | null;
  // A plan job ended: the page should read OpenClaw's model again.
  onChanged(): void;
}

export interface BrainPlanCardHandle {
  // Change model while OpenClaw is on a plan: bring that plan's model list into view and put the keyboard there.
  showModels(plan: OpenclawPlan): void;
}

type Read<T> = { state: "loading" } | { state: "ok"; value: T; stale: string } | { state: "error"; words: string } | { state: "off" };

const JOB_POLL_MS = 1000;
const OPENCLAW_LINE: BrainAgentLine[] = [{ id: "openclaw", label: BRAIN_AGENT_LABEL.openclaw, installed: true, configured: true }];

// Outside local mode (the public demo, the admin-token public mode) these routes answer 404 not_available (spec section 7).
function isNotAvailable(error: unknown) {
  return error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 404 && error.message === "not_available";
}

function hasCode(error: unknown, ...codes: string[]) {
  return error instanceof ApiError && codes.includes(error.message);
}

const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

const BrainPlanCard = forwardRef<BrainPlanCardHandle, BrainPlanCardProps>(function BrainPlanCard({ where, currentPlan, onChanged }, ref) {
  const baseId = useId();
  const [plans, setPlans] = useState<Read<OpenclawPlansInfo>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [lists, setLists] = useState<Partial<Record<OpenclawPlan, Read<PlanModelList>>>>({});
  const [selection, setSelection] = useState<Record<OpenclawPlan, PlanSelection>>({ claude: null, chatgpt: null });
  // What the person typed in each plan's "Type a model name" row: kept while lists are read again (never thrown away).
  const [typed, setTyped] = useState<Record<OpenclawPlan, string>>({ claude: "", chatgpt: "" });
  const [riskAccepted, setRiskAccepted] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<OpenclawPlan | "signin" | null>(null);
  const [rechecking, setRechecking] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Partial<Record<OpenclawPlan, string>>>({});
  const [job, setJob] = useState<SetupJob | null>(null);
  const [jobError, setJobError] = useState("");
  // The live sign-in session shown in the ChatGPT section; `fresh` when the person just started it (it takes the keys).
  const [signin, setSignin] = useState<{ id: string; fresh: boolean } | null>(null);
  const [signinError, setSigninError] = useState("");
  // False once the card is gone: a late answer must not update a screen that is not there. The newest read wins.
  const alive = useRef(true);
  const plansGeneration = useRef(0);
  const plansAt = useRef(0);
  const listGeneration = useRef<Record<OpenclawPlan, number>>({ claude: 0, chatgpt: 0 });
  const pollBusy = useRef(false);
  const root = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const cardTitle = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const claudeTitle = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const chatgptTitle = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const chatgptSection = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const latestOnChanged = useRef(onChanged);
  latestOnChanged.current = onChanged;

  // What each plan needs now. A failed read keeps the last good answer under a note (P26); where these routes do not
  // exist (404 not_available), the card hides itself. A failed read says it in the app's own words (planProblem:
  // the server's sentence, an unreadable answer, no answer in time, no answer), never new ones.
  const readPlans = useCallback(async () => {
    const mine = (plansGeneration.current += 1);
    plansAt.current = Date.now();
    try {
      const value = await withTimeout(getOpenclawPlans(), PLAN_LIMITS_MS.plans);
      if (!alive.current || mine !== plansGeneration.current) return;
      if (!value?.version || !value.claude || !value.chatgpt) throw new Error(UNREADABLE_WORDS);
      setPlans({ state: "ok", value, stale: "" });
    } catch (error) {
      if (!alive.current || mine !== plansGeneration.current) return;
      if (isNotAvailable(error)) {
        setPlans({ state: "off" });
        return;
      }
      const words = planProblem(error, friendlyError);
      setPlans((current) => (current.state === "ok" ? { ...current, stale: words } : { state: "error", words }));
    }
  }, []);

  const readList = useCallback(async (plan: OpenclawPlan) => {
    const mine = (listGeneration.current[plan] += 1);
    setLists((current) => (current[plan]?.state === "ok" ? current : { ...current, [plan]: { state: "loading" } }));
    try {
      const value = await withTimeout(getOpenclawPlanModels(plan), PLAN_LIMITS_MS.models);
      if (!alive.current || mine !== listGeneration.current[plan]) return;
      if (!value || !Array.isArray(value.models)) throw new Error(UNREADABLE_WORDS);
      setLists((current) => ({ ...current, [plan]: { state: "ok", value, stale: "" } }));
    } catch (error) {
      if (!alive.current || mine !== listGeneration.current[plan]) return;
      const words = planProblem(error, friendlyError);
      setLists((current) => {
        const before = current[plan];
        return { ...current, [plan]: before?.state === "ok" ? { ...before, stale: words } : { state: "error", words } };
      });
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    void readPlans();
    // A ChatGPT sign-in left waiting (another page, a reload, another window) is found again (spec section 1). A
    // sign-in the person started meanwhile is never replaced by this late answer.
    withTimeout(getOpenclawSignInTerminal(), PLAN_LIMITS_MS.signInLookup)
      .then((answer) => {
        const session = answer?.session;
        if (alive.current && session && session.status !== "exited") setSignin((current) => current ?? { id: session.id, fresh: false });
      })
      .catch(() => undefined);
    // A plan job this tab started is picked up again: a running one is followed, a failed one is shown (it may say
    // Agent OS quit before it finished), and a finished or unknown one is forgotten. A question that got no answer is
    // not a reason to forget it.
    const id = recallJobId("plan");
    if (id) {
      withTimeout(getSetupJob(id), PLAN_LIMITS_MS.action)
        .then((found) => {
          if (!alive.current) return;
          if (found.status === "running" || found.status === "failed") setJob(found);
          else rememberJobId("plan", null);
        })
        .catch((error) => {
          if (!gotNoAnswer(error)) rememberJobId("plan", null);
        });
    }
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
  }, [readPlans]);

  // OpenClaw may have been updated, or Claude Code signed in, while the person was in another window (Review Focus 1).
  useEffect(() => {
    function onFocus() {
      if (Date.now() - plansAt.current < PLANS_FOCUS_GAP_MS) return;
      void readPlans();
    }
    window.addEventListener("focus", onFocus);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("focus", onFocus);
  }, [readPlans]);

  const info = plans.state === "ok" ? plans.value : null;
  const claudeState = info ? claudePlanState(info.claude) : null;
  const chatgptState = info ? chatgptPlanState(info) : null;
  // OpenClaw too old for the ChatGPT sign-in, or its version unreadable: the section shows that note and no Sign in.
  const versionBlocked = chatgptState === "too_old" || chatgptState === "version_unknown";

  // A refused Sign in (409 openclaw_too_old or openclaw_version_unknown) makes the card read the plans again, and
  // the section's note then says the same sentence: the refusal's own line goes, so it is never shown twice and
  // never comes back once OpenClaw has been updated.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (versionBlocked) setSigninError("");
  }, [versionBlocked]);

  // A section's model list is read once it is ready.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (claudeState === "ready" && !lists.claude) void readList("claude");
    if (chatgptState === "ready" && !lists.chatgpt) void readList("chatgpt");
  }, [claudeState, chatgptState, lists.claude, lists.chatgpt, readList]);

  // A job that ended may have changed OpenClaw's model, its pins or the sign-in: read everything again.
  function jobEnded() {
    latestOnChanged.current();
    setLists({});
    void readPlans();
  }

  // The controls that had the keyboard are about to go (Apply gives way to the job's steps, Cancel to the result): the
  // keyboard moves to the card's title, which stays through every state. Only when it was in the card or nowhere,
  // never away from something else the person moved to meanwhile (P26). Called before the state changes, while the
  // old controls are still there to be found.
  function keepKeysInCard() {
    const active = document.activeElement;
    if (!active || active === document.body || Boolean(root.current?.contains(active))) cardTitle.current?.focus();
  }

  useInterval(
    async () => {
      if (!job || pollBusy.current) return;
      pollBusy.current = true;
      try {
        const next = await withTimeout(getSetupJob(job.id), PLAN_LIMITS_MS.action);
        if (!alive.current) return;
        if (next.status !== "running") keepKeysInCard();
        setJob(next);
        if (next.status !== "running") jobEnded();
      } catch {
        // a passing failure; the next tick asks again
      } finally {
        pollBusy.current = false;
      }
    },
    job && job.status === "running" ? JOB_POLL_MS : null
  );

  useImperativeHandle(
    ref,
    () => ({
      showModels(plan: OpenclawPlan) {
        const target = (plan === "claude" ? claudeTitle.current : chatgptTitle.current) ?? cardTitle.current;
        target?.scrollIntoView({ block: "center" });
        target?.focus();
      }
    }),
    []
  );

  function choose(plan: OpenclawPlan, next: PlanSelection) {
    setSelection((current) => ({ ...current, [plan]: next }));
    setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, [plan]: undefined }));
  }

  async function recheck() {
    if (rechecking) return;
    setRechecking(true);
    setLists({});
    await readPlans();
    if (alive.current) setRechecking(false);
  }

  async function apply(plan: OpenclawPlan) {
    const list = lists[plan];
    const { model } = planApplyModel(list?.state === "ok" ? list.value : null, selection[plan], typed[plan], plan);
    if (!model || !riskAccepted || busy !== null || job) return;
    setBusy(plan);
    setErrors({});
    try {
      const started = await withTimeout(applyOpenclawPlan({ plan, model, acceptOpenClawRisk: riskAccepted }), PLAN_LIMITS_MS.apply);
      if (!started || typeof started.id !== "string" || !Array.isArray(started.steps)) throw new Error(UNREADABLE_WORDS);
      // The server has the job whether or not this card is still on screen, so its id is always kept.
      rememberJobId("plan", started.id);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setRiskAccepted(false);
      setJobError("");
      keepKeysInCard();
      setJob(started);
    } catch (error) {
      if (!alive.current) return;
      const words = planProblem(error, friendlyError);
      setErrors({ [plan]: gotNoAnswer(error) ? `${words} ${MAY_HAVE_APPLIED}` : words });
      // The server read the sign-in again and refused: what the card shows is out of date (Review Focus 3).
      if (hasCode(error, "plan_not_ready")) void readPlans();
      // The list changed since it was shown.
      if (hasCode(error, "invalid_model_id")) void readList(plan);
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  async function cancelJob() {
    if (!job) return;
    try {
      const next = await withTimeout(cancelSetupJob(job.id), PLAN_LIMITS_MS.action);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      if (next.status !== "running") keepKeysInCard();
      setJob(next);
      if (next.status !== "running") jobEnded();
    } catch (error) {
      if (!alive.current) return;
      const words = planProblem(error, friendlyError);
      setJobError(gotNoAnswer(error) ? `${words} ${CANCEL_UNSURE}` : words);
    }
  }

  // Back to the plans: the job is forgotten and the tick is cleared, so a new Apply asks again.
  function backToPlans() {
    rememberJobId("plan", null);
    setJob(null);
    setJobError("");
    setErrors({});
    setRiskAccepted(false);
    // The result's buttons are gone: keep the keyboard on the card.
    cardTitle.current?.focus();
  }

  // After a 409 setup_running (another window, or a start still in progress) the running session is asked for every
  // second, up to `waitMs`; request() keeps only an error's code and sentence, not its sessionId.
  async function findSignInSession(waitMs: number): Promise<string | null> {
    const deadline = Date.now() + waitMs;
    for (;;) {
      try {
        const answer = await withTimeout(getOpenclawSignInTerminal(), PLAN_LIMITS_MS.signInLookup);
        const session = answer?.session;
        if (session && session.status !== "exited") return session.id;
      } catch {
        // asked again below
      }
      if (!alive.current || Date.now() + SETUP_RUNNING_POLL_MS > deadline) return null;
      await sleep(SETUP_RUNNING_POLL_MS);
    }
  }

  async function startSignIn() {
    if (busy !== null) return;
    setBusy("signin");
    setSigninError("");
    try {
      const answer = await withTimeout(startOpenclawSignInTerminal(), PLAN_LIMITS_MS.action);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      if (!answer?.session?.id) throw new Error(UNREADABLE_WORDS);
      setSignin({ id: answer.session.id, fresh: true });
    } catch (error) {
      if (!alive.current) return;
      const running = hasCode(error, "setup_running");
      // A sign-in already open (409), or a start whose answer never came: attach to the one that is running.
      if (running || gotNoAnswer(error)) {
        const found = await findSignInSession(running ? SETUP_RUNNING_WAIT_MS : 0);
        if (!alive.current) return;
        if (found) {
          setSignin({ id: found, fresh: true });
          return;
        }
      }
      // The server checked OpenClaw's version again and refused: what the card shows is out of date.
      if (hasCode(error, "openclaw_too_old", "openclaw_version_unknown")) void readPlans();
      setSigninError(planProblem(error, friendlyError));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  // The sign-in ended (it finished, Ctrl+C in the terminal ended it, or Close stopped it): close the panel and read
  // the sign-in again (spec section 1). The keyboard moves to the ChatGPT heading when it was in the panel (or
  // nowhere), never away from elsewhere; so a keyboard user who left the terminal with Ctrl+C lands there.
  const signinOver = useCallback(() => {
    const active = document.activeElement;
    const keepFocus = !active || active === document.body || Boolean(chatgptSection.current?.contains(active));
    setSignin(null);
    void readPlans();
    if (keepFocus) chatgptTitle.current?.focus();
  }, [readPlans]);

  // Close stopped the sign-in (or found it already gone): the panel closes as for an end, then the card asks once
  // for the live sign-in, so one started meanwhile (from another window) is shown here, not left out of sight. The
  // session just closed is never shown again, even while its stop is still finishing; a sign-in the person started
  // meanwhile is never replaced.
  const closedSignIn = useCallback(
    (closedId: string) => {
      signinOver();
      withTimeout(getOpenclawSignInTerminal(), PLAN_LIMITS_MS.signInLookup)
        .then((answer) => {
          const session = answer?.session;
          if (alive.current && session && session.status !== "exited" && session.id !== closedId) {
            setSignin((current) => current ?? { id: session.id, fresh: false });
          }
        })
        .catch(() => undefined);
    },
    [signinOver]
  );

  if (plans.state === "off") return null;

  const Title = where === "setup" ? "h3" : "h4";
  const Sub = where === "setup" ? "h4" : "h5";
  const locked = busy !== null;
  const anyReady = claudeState === "ready" || chatgptState === "ready";

  const checkAgain = (
    <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--ghost" onClick={() => void recheck()} disabled={rechecking}>
      <RefreshCw size={14} aria-hidden="true" /> {rechecking ? "Checking…" : "Check again"}
    </button>
  );
  const note = (words: string) => (
    <p className="os-plan-card__state">
      <StatusMark kind="warn" label="note" /> {words}
    </p>
  );
  const errorLine = (words: string, polite = false) => (
    <p className="os-plan-card__error" role={polite ? "status" : "alert"}>
      <StatusMark kind="error" /> {words}
    </p>
  );

  function renderModels(plan: OpenclawPlan): ReactNode {
    const list = lists[plan];
    if (!list || list.state === "loading" || list.state === "off") return <p className="os-plan-card__hint">Checking…</p>;
    if (list.state === "error") {
      return (
        <>
          {errorLine(list.words)}
          <div className="os-plan-card__row">
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => void readList(plan)}>
              <RefreshCw size={14} aria-hidden="true" /> Check again
            </button>
          </div>
        </>
      );
    }
    const value = list.value;
    const fallback = value.source === "fallback";
    const picked = selection[plan];
    const chosen = planApplyModel(value, picked, typed[plan], plan);
    const name = `${baseId}-${plan}-model`;
    return (
      <>
        {list.stale ? (
          <p className="os-plan-card__hint">
            <StatusMark kind="warn" label="note" /> {list.stale}
          </p>
        ) : null}
        {fallback ? (
          <p className="os-plan-card__hint">
            <StatusMark kind="warn" label="note" /> {FALLBACK_LIST_NOTE}
          </p>
        ) : null}
        <fieldset className="os-plan-models">
          <legend className="os-visually-hidden">{PLAN_LABEL[plan]}</legend>
          {value.models.map((entry) => (
            <label key={entry.id} className={`os-plan-model${entry.available ? "" : " os-plan-model--off"}`}>
              <input
                type="radio"
                name={name}
                value={entry.id}
                checked={picked?.kind === "listed" && picked.id === entry.id}
                disabled={!entry.available || locked}
                onChange={() => choose(plan, { kind: "listed", id: entry.id })}
              />
              <span className="os-plan-model__main">
                <strong>{entry.name}</strong>
                {entry.name !== entry.id ? <span className="os-mono os-plan-model__id">{entry.id}</span> : null}
              </span>
              {entry.note ? <span className="os-plan-model__note">{entry.note}</span> : null}
              {entry.available ? null : (
                <span className="os-plan-model__note">
                  <StatusMark kind="warn" label="note" /> {NOT_ON_PLAN_NOTE}
                </span>
              )}
            </label>
          ))}
          {fallback ? (
            <div className="os-plan-model os-plan-model--typed">
              <input
                type="radio"
                name={name}
                value=""
                aria-label={TYPED_MODEL_LABEL}
                checked={picked?.kind === "typed"}
                disabled={locked}
                onChange={() => choose(plan, { kind: "typed" })}
              />
              <span className="os-field os-plan-model__typed">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={typed[plan]}
                  placeholder={TYPED_MODEL_LABEL}
                  aria-label={TYPED_MODEL_LABEL}
                  spellCheck={false}
                  autoCapitalize="off"
                  autoComplete="off"
                  disabled={locked}
                  onFocus={() => choose(plan, { kind: "typed" })}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    const text = event.target.value;
                    setTyped((current) => ({ ...current, [plan]: text }));
                    choose(plan, { kind: "typed" });
                  }}
                />
              </span>
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </fieldset>
        {chosen.problem ? errorLine(chosen.problem, true) : null}
        {errors[plan] ? errorLine(errors[plan] as string) : null}
        <div className="os-plan-card__row">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="os-btn os-btn--primary"
            aria-label={`Apply · ${PLAN_LABEL[plan]}`}
            disabled={!chosen.model || !riskAccepted || locked}
            onClick={() => void apply(plan)}
          >
            {busy === plan ? "Starting…" : "Apply"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </>
    );
  }

  function claudeBody(state: ClaudePlanState): ReactNode {
    switch (state) {
      case "not_installed":
        return (
          <>
            {note(CLAUDE_PLAN_WORDS.not_installed)}
            <div className="os-plan-card__row">
              <button type="button" className="os-brain-link" onClick={() => navigateTo("setup", { step: "plan" })}>
                Install in Setup
              </button>
            </div>
          </>
        );
      case "not_signed_in":
        return (
          <div className="os-plan-card__row">
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => navigateTo("setup", { step: "signin" })}>
              Sign in to Claude Code
            </button>
            {checkAgain}
          </div>
        );
      case "api_billing":
      case "unknown_method":
        return (
          <>
            {note(CLAUDE_PLAN_WORDS[state])}
            <div className="os-plan-card__row">{checkAgain}</div>
          </>
        );
      default:
        return renderModels("claude");
    }
  }

  function chatgptBody(state: ChatgptPlanState): ReactNode {
    const readiness = info?.chatgpt.readiness;
    const readinessWords = readiness === "expiring" ? CHATGPT_PLAN_WORDS.expiring : readiness === "not_ready" ? CHATGPT_PLAN_WORDS.not_ready : null;
    return (
      <>
        {state === "too_old" || state === "version_unknown" ? note(CHATGPT_PLAN_WORDS[state]) : null}
        {state === "no_sharing" ? note(CHATGPT_PLAN_WORDS.no_sharing) : null}
        {state === "ready" && readinessWords ? note(readinessWords) : null}
        {signin ? (
          <PlanSignInTerminal
            key={signin.id}
            sessionId={signin.id}
            autoFocus={signin.fresh}
            onEnded={signinOver}
            onClose={() => closedSignIn(signin.id)}
          />
        ) : versionBlocked ? (
          <div className="os-plan-card__row">
            <button type="button" className="os-brain-link" onClick={() => navigateTo("setup", { step: "plan" })}>
              Update in Setup
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : state !== "ready" || readinessWords ? (
          <div className="os-plan-card__row">
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => void startSignIn()} disabled={locked}>
              {busy === "signin" ? "Starting…" : "Sign in with ChatGPT"}
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        {/* Not while the version note shows: it says the same sentence the refused Sign in did. */}
        {signinError && !signin && !versionBlocked ? errorLine(signinError) : null}
        {state === "ready" ? renderModels("chatgpt") : null}
      </>
    );
  }

  let body: ReactNode;
  if (job) {
    body =
      job.status === "running" ? (
        <>
          <SetupInstallPanel
            job={job}
            stepLabels={CONFIGURE_STEP_LABEL}
            onCancel={() => void cancelJob()}
            onRetry={backToPlans}
            retryLabel="Back to AI brain"
          />
          {jobError ? errorLine(jobError) : null}
        </>
      ) : (
        <BrainResult job={job} agents={OPENCLAW_LINE} onBack={backToPlans} continueLabel="Done" />
      );
  } else if (plans.state === "loading") {
    body = <p className="os-plan-card__hint">Checking…</p>;
  } else if (plans.state === "error") {
    body = (
      <>
        {errorLine(plans.words)}
        <div className="os-plan-card__row">{checkAgain}</div>
      </>
    );
  } else {
    body = (
      <>
        {plans.stale ? (
          <p className="os-plan-card__hint">
            <StatusMark kind="warn" label="note" /> {plans.stale}
          </p>
        ) : null}
        {anyReady ? (
          <div className="os-plan-card__consent">
            <p className="os-plan-card__notice">
              <AlertTriangle size={14} aria-hidden="true" /> {OPENCLAW_SECURITY_NOTICE}
            </p>
            <label className="os-brain-risk">
              <input type="checkbox" checked={riskAccepted} disabled={locked} onChange={(event) => setRiskAccepted(event.target.checked)} />
              <span>{OPENCLAW_RISK_LABEL}</span>
            </label>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        {/* The plan OpenClaw is on now is marked for assistive tech only (aria-current); on screen its name and note
            are words on the Brain card's model line, never a colour here. */}
        <div className="os-plan-card__plans">
          <section
            className="os-plan-card__plan"
            data-plan="claude"
            aria-labelledby={`${baseId}-claude`}
            aria-current={currentPlan === "claude" ? "true" : undefined}
          >
            <Sub id={`${baseId}-claude`} className="os-plan-card__plan-title" ref={claudeTitle} tabIndex={-1}>
              {PLAN_LABEL.claude}
            </Sub>
            {claudeState ? claudeBody(claudeState) : null}
          </section>
          <section
            ref={chatgptSection}
            className="os-plan-card__plan"
            data-plan="chatgpt"
            aria-labelledby={`${baseId}-chatgpt`}
            aria-current={currentPlan === "chatgpt" ? "true" : undefined}
          >
            <Sub id={`${baseId}-chatgpt`} className="os-plan-card__plan-title" ref={chatgptTitle} tabIndex={-1}>
              {PLAN_LABEL.chatgpt}
            </Sub>
            {chatgptState ? chatgptBody(chatgptState) : null}
          </section>
        </div>
      </>
    );
  }

  // In Setup it is a card like the other two (they are "os-panel os-brain-card"); on the Agents page it sits inside
  // the Brain panel, so it is no second panel (brain.css gives it a hairline box there).
  return (
    <section
      ref={root}
      className={where === "setup" ? "os-panel os-brain-card os-plan-card" : "os-plan-card"}
      aria-labelledby={`${baseId}-title`}
    >
      <header className="os-plan-card__head">
        <Title id={`${baseId}-title`} ref={cardTitle} tabIndex={-1}>
          Your plan
        </Title>
      </header>
      {body}
    </section>
  );
});

export default BrainPlanCard;
```

```tsx
                <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)} aria-expanded={open}>
                  {open ? "Close" : "Change brain"}
                </button>
              }
            />
          </>
        )}

        {/* After the states above, not inside them: a failed brain read or Retry must never unmount these (a typed
            model name, a job's result or an open sign-in would be thrown away, P26). Both show once a good answer
            has said the agent is installed, and only in local mode, where their routes exist. */}
        {agentId === "openclaw" && localMode && installedSeen ? (
          <BrainPlanCard ref={planCard} where="agents" currentPlan={livePlan} onChanged={onModelChanged} />
        ) : null}
        {/* Hermes: only its model is read again on focus and Refresh, never the slow brain read. */}
        {agentId === "hermes" && localMode && installedSeen ? <ChooseInHermes onRefresh={() => void reloadModels()} /> : null}
      </section>
```

```js
// Task B2: plan brains in the UI (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-15-plan-brains-design.md, Testing, "UI
// probes"): "Your plan" on OpenClaw's Brain card (Claude plan and ChatGPT plan, with the in-card ChatGPT sign-in
// terminal), "Choose in Hermes" on Hermes's Brain card, Setup's third card, and the plan labels in BrainResult, each
// state with a screenshot for the owner (decision Q32), plus the five plan-brains Review Focus situations.
// Run (after `npm run build`), from the worktree root:
//   FAKE_AGENT_VERSION=2026.9.7 node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs probe .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/plan-brains.mjs
// Everything except the terminal is stubbed in the browser with context.route, registered before the page loads (the
// card reads on mount): the plans, the plan model lists, Apply, the jobs it starts, the agents' model answers, the
// brain options and the receipt. POST /api/setup/hermes/model-terminal is stubbed in EVERY page this probe opens, so
// no probe ever opens a real Terminal window. Only part C starts the real setup session, on the throwaway server
// against Task W1's fake (its sign-in program prints a fake auth.openai.com link and the code FAKE-1234, then waits
// for Enter): signing in (with the menu's count and a fresh Sessions page checked while it is live), a reload, leaving
// and returning (with the keyboard order: Close before the terminal), a second window's Sign in that gets 409 and
// attaches (Review Focus 2), Close, a sign-in that finishes, and Ctrl+C inside the terminal (the keyboard's way out).
// Every other page answers GET /api/setup/openclaw/signin-terminal with "none" and refuses its POST, so no other part
// can start one. Nothing here starts a real agent, and the probe stops every session it started.
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";

const W = 1470, H = 956;
const SUB = "plan-brains";
const OPENCLAW = "agents&agent=openclaw";
const HERMES = "agents&agent=hermes";
const SETUP_BRAIN = "setup&step=brain";
// Setup's risk tick (OPENCLAW_RISK_LABEL in src/ui/agentModelChange.ts), and the server sentences the stubs carry
// (Task B1b's constants, spec sections 2 and 5; Task B1c's Hermes refusal).
const RISK = "I understand OpenClaw can act on this computer. Agent OS will switch it to ask before running commands.";
const FABLE = "Uses usage credits: on Pro from the first request, on Max after half your weekly limit.";
const RUNTIME_CHECK_FAILED = "OpenClaw would use an Anthropic API key for this model, not your Claude plan.";
const PLAN_JOB_INTERRUPTED = "Agent OS quit before this finished. Apply the plan again.";
const HERMES_NOT_INSTALLED = "Hermes isn't installed on this computer yet.";
const OPENROUTER_HINT = "For your safety Agent OS forgets the OpenRouter connection";
const BUSY_WORDS = "Another setup job is already running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.";
const HERMES_COMMAND = "/fake/bin/hermes model";
const LONG_ID = `claude-${"long-model-name-".repeat(5)}5-5`;

const STEP_IDS = {
  claude: ["openclaw-plan-onboard", "openclaw-safe-defaults", "openclaw-plan-runtime-check", "openclaw-plan-model", "services", "health"],
  chatgpt: ["openclaw-plan-model", "openclaw-safe-defaults", "openclaw-plan-readiness", "health"]
};
const PLAN_MODEL = { claude: "claude-opus-5-5", chatgpt: "gpt-6.1-sol" };
const PLAN_MODE = { claude: "claude-plan", chatgpt: "chatgpt-plan" };

// A plan job as Task B1b answers it: each step is today's configure step shape, makeConfigureStep(id, agentId, "run"),
// so `action` is always "run". `failAt` is the index of the step that failed (with `error` and `log`).
function planJob(plan, status, { id = `job_plan_${plan}`, failAt = -1, error = null, log = [] } = {}) {
  const t = new Date().toISOString();
  const steps = STEP_IDS[plan].map((stepId, i) => {
    let state = "succeeded";
    if (status === "running") state = i === 0 ? "succeeded" : i === 1 ? "running" : "pending";
    if (status === "failed") state = i < failAt ? "succeeded" : i === failAt ? "failed" : "pending";
    return {
      id: stepId, agentId: stepId === "services" || stepId === "health" ? null : "openclaw", action: "run", status: state,
      runIds: [], error: i === failAt ? error : null, log: i === failAt ? log.map((line) => `${t} ${line}`) : [], warnings: []
    };
  });
  return {
    id, kind: "configure", status, plan, mode: PLAN_MODE[plan], model: PLAN_MODEL[plan],
    targets: { hermes: null, openclaw: { mode: PLAN_MODE[plan], model: PLAN_MODEL[plan] } }, scope: ["openclaw"],
    steps, currentStepIndex: status === "running" ? 1 : Math.max(failAt, 0), startedAt: t, endedAt: status === "running" ? null : t,
    acceptOpenClawRisk: true, acceptOpenClawRiskAt: t, previousPrimary: null,
    readiness: plan === "chatgpt" && status === "succeeded" ? "ready" : null,
    ...(status === "succeeded" ? { health: { openclaw: { doctorOk: true, promptOk: true, replyPreview: "hello" } } } : {})
  };
}

// The job reads `running` for its first `ms` (counted from the first time anyone asks), then `finished`.
function jobAfter(running, finished, ms = 2500) {
  let first = 0;
  return () => {
    if (!first) first = Date.now();
    return Date.now() - first < ms ? running : finished;
  };
}

const plansOf = ({ version = {}, claude = {}, chatgpt = {} } = {}) => ({
  version: { have: "2026.9.7", need: "2026.9.7", newEnough: true, ...version },
  claude: { installed: true, status: "signed_in", method: "claude.ai", note: "Probe: signed in.", ...claude },
  chatgpt: { signedIn: false, sharing: null, readiness: null, ...chatgpt }
});
const row = (id, name, over = {}) => ({ id, name, note: null, available: true, ...over });
const CLAUDE_LIST = {
  source: "account", asOf: null,
  models: [row("claude-opus-5-5", "Opus 5.5"), row("claude-sonnet-5-5", "Sonnet 5.5", { available: false }), row("claude-fable-5-1", "Fable 5.1", { note: FABLE })]
};
const CLAUDE_FALLBACK = {
```
