```js
};
const CHATGPT_LIST = { source: "account", asOf: null, models: [row("gpt-6.1-sol", "GPT-6.1 Sol"), row("gpt-6-luna", "GPT-6 Luna")] };
const LONG_LIST = { source: "account", asOf: null, models: [row(LONG_ID, LONG_ID), ...CLAUDE_LIST.models] };

const hermesModel = (model) => ({ agentId: "hermes", installed: true, provider: "openrouter", providerLabel: "OpenRouter", model, isPreset: false, presetSlug: null });
const openclawModel = (over = {}) => ({
  agentId: "openclaw", installed: true, provider: "openrouter", providerLabel: "OpenRouter", model: "vendor/probe-model", isPreset: false, presetSlug: null, plan: null, ...over
});
const ON_CLAUDE = openclawModel({ provider: "anthropic", providerLabel: "Claude plan", model: "claude-opus-5-5", plan: "claude" });
const ON_CHATGPT = openclawModel({ provider: "openai", providerLabel: "ChatGPT plan", model: "gpt-6.1-sol", plan: "chatgpt" });
const BRAIN = {
  options: [{ id: "openrouter", available: true }, { id: "ollama", available: true }],
  recommendation: "openrouter", reason: "Probe: both agents can take a brain.", localModel: null,
  current: {
    hermes: { installed: true, configured: true, source: "status", summary: "Probe: Hermes has a model." },
    openclaw: { installed: true, configured: true, source: "status", summary: "Probe: OpenClaw has a model." }
  },
  defaults: { hermes: "keep", openclaw: "keep" }
};

export default async function ({ browser, shot, pass, fail, api, BASE, TOKEN, HERE, HOME }) {
  const check = (ok, name, why = "") => (ok ? pass(name) : fail(name, String(why)));
  const REPO = path.resolve(HERE, "..", "..");
  // The card's own words (src/ui/planBrainsShared.ts: import type only, so Node loads it straight from src/).
  const {
    PLAN_NOTE, CLAUDE_PLAN_WORDS, CHATGPT_PLAN_WORDS, FALLBACK_LIST_NOTE, NOT_ON_PLAN_NOTE, TYPED_MODEL_LABEL, INVALID_PLAN_MODEL,
    OPENCLAW_SECURITY_NOTICE, HERMES_PICKER_LINES, HERMES_TERMINAL_WORDS, NO_ANSWER_WORDS
  } = await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(REPO, "src", "ui", "planBrainsShared.ts")).href);

  // Chrome logs every refused request (the stubbed 400s and 409s, an aborted read) as "Failed to load resource".
  const realErrors = (errors) => errors.filter((e) => !/Failed to load resource/.test(e));
  const clean = (text) => String(text || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  const waitFor = async (fn, ms = 10000) => {
    const end = Date.now() + ms;
    while (Date.now() < end) {
      try { if (await fn()) return true; } catch {}
      await sleep(250);
    }
    return false;
  };
  const shows = (locator, ms = 15000) => locator.first().waitFor({ state: "visible", timeout: ms }).then(() => true, () => false);
  const sideways = (tab) => tab.evaluate(() => document.scrollingElement.scrollWidth > document.scrollingElement.clientWidth);
  const cardOf = (tab) => tab.locator(".os-plan-card");
  const planOf = (tab, plan) => tab.locator(`.os-plan-card__plan[data-plan="${plan}"]`);
  const applyOf = (tab, plan) => tab.getByRole("button", { name: `Apply · ${plan === "claude" ? "Claude plan" : "ChatGPT plan"}`, exact: true });
  const tickOf = (tab) => cardOf(tab).getByRole("checkbox", { name: RISK, exact: true });
  const signInOf = (tab) => planOf(tab, "chatgpt").getByRole("button", { name: "Sign in with ChatGPT", exact: true });
  const textOf = async (locator) => clean(await locator.first().textContent().catch(() => ""));
  // The DOM renderer (the default on macOS, decision Q45) keeps the screen's text in .xterm-rows; a long link wraps,
  // so spaces are dropped before looking for it.
  const termText = (tab) => tab.evaluate(() => (document.querySelector(".os-plan-term .xterm-rows")?.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, ""));
  const focusWindow = (tab, times = 1) => tab.evaluate((n) => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i += 1) window.dispatchEvent(new Event("focus")); }, times);
  const activeText = (tab) => tab.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.textContent?.trim() || "");
  const storedPlanJob = (tab) => tab.evaluate(() => sessionStorage.getItem("agentos.setup.planJob"));
  const searchOf = (tab) => new URL(tab.url()).searchParams;
  async function liveSetupSessions() {
    const answer = await api("GET", "/api/sessions?kind=all");
    return (answer.json.sessions || []).filter((s) => s.kind === "setup" && s.status !== "exited");
  }
  async function stopEverything() {

  const scenario = (over = {}) => ({

      route.fulfill({ status, contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify(body) }).catch(() => undefined);
    await context.route(/\/api\/setup\/brain(\?|$)/, (route) => (s.brain === "fail" ? route.abort().catch(() => undefined) : json(route, s.brain)));
    await context.route(/\/api\/setup\/receipt$/, (route) => json(route, { receipt: [] }));
    await context.route(/\/api\/setup\/openclaw\/plans$/, async (route) => {
      s.calls.plans += 1;
      if (s.plansDelayMs) await sleep(s.plansDelayMs);
      return json(route, s.plans);
    });
    await context.route(/\/api\/setup\/openclaw\/plan-models\?plan=(claude|chatgpt)$/, (route) => {
      const plan = new URL(route.request().url()).searchParams.get("plan");
      s.calls.models[plan] += 1;
      return s.models[plan] === "fail" ? route.abort() : json(route, s.models[plan]);
    });
    await context.route(/\/api\/setup\/openclaw\/plan$/, (route) => {
      const body = route.request().postDataJSON();
      s.calls.apply.push(body);
      const [status, answer] = s.apply ? s.apply(body) : [409, { error: "job_already_running" }];
      return json(route, answer, status);
    });
    await context.route(/\/api\/setup\/jobs\/[^/?]+$/, (route) => {
      const id = decodeURIComponent(new URL(route.request().url()).pathname.split("/").pop());
      const job = s.jobs[id];
      if (!job) return json(route, { error: "job_not_found" }, 404);
      return json(route, typeof job === "function" ? job() : job);
    });
    await context.route(/\/api\/setup\/agents\/(hermes|openclaw)\/model$/, (route) => {
      if (route.request().method() !== "GET") return route.continue();
      const id = /agents\/(hermes|openclaw)\/model/.exec(route.request().url())[1];
      s.calls.model[id] += 1;
      return json(route, s.model[id]);
    });
    // ALWAYS stubbed: the real route would open a Terminal window on this Mac.
    await context.route(/\/api\/setup\/hermes\/model-terminal$/, (route) => {
      s.calls.hermesLaunch += 1;
      const [status, body] = Array.isArray(s.hermesLaunch) ? s.hermesLaunch : [200, s.hermesLaunch];
      return json(route, body, status);
    });
    await context.route(/\/api\/setup\/openclaw\/signin-terminal$/, (route) => {
      const method = route.request().method();
      if (method === "GET") {
        s.calls.signinGet += 1;
        if (s.signinGet) return s.signinGet(route, json);
      }
      if (method === "POST") {
        s.calls.signinPost += 1;
        if (s.signinPost) return s.signinPost(route, json);
      }
      return route.continue();
    });
  }

  const contexts = [];
  async function open(query, s, { size = [W, H], init = null } = {}) {
    const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: size[0], height: size[1] } });
    contexts.push(context);
    await stub(context, s);
    const tab = await context.newPage();
    if (init) await tab.addInitScript(init);
    const errors = [];
    tab.on("console", (m) => { if (m.type() === "error") errors.push(m.text()); });
    tab.on("pageerror", (e) => errors.push(String(e)));
    await tab.goto(`${BASE}/?launch=${TOKEN}`);
    await tab.goto(`${BASE}/?page=${query}`);
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1200);
    return { context, tab, errors };
  }
  // The card is on screen and nothing in it is still loading.
  async function settled(tab) {
    await shows(cardOf(tab), 25000);
    await waitFor(async () => !/Checking…/.test(await textOf(cardOf(tab))), 15000);
  }
  async function part(name, fn) {
    try {
      await fn();
    } catch (error) {
      fail(`${name}: threw`, String(error?.stack || error).split("\n").slice(0, 3).join(" | "));
    } finally {
      while (contexts.length) {
        try { await contexts.pop().close(); } catch {}
      }
    }
  }

  try {
    await stopEverything();

    // ---- A. Claude plan --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    await part("A1 Claude Code not installed", async () => {
      const s = scenario({ plans: plansOf({ claude: { installed: false, status: "unknown", method: null } }) });
      const { tab, errors } = await open(OPENCLAW, s);
      await settled(tab);
      const claude = planOf(tab, "claude");
      check((await textOf(claude)).includes(CLAUDE_PLAN_WORDS.not_installed), "A1: Install Claude Code first.");
      check((await claude.locator(".os-plan-models").count()) === 0 && (await applyOf(tab, "claude").count()) === 0, "A1: no model list and no Apply");
      check((await tickOf(tab).count()) === 0, "A1: no risk tick while nothing can be applied");
      await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "claude-not-installed");
      await claude.getByRole("button", { name: "Install in Setup", exact: true }).click();
      check(searchOf(tab).get("page") === "setup" && searchOf(tab).get("step") === "plan", "A1: Install in Setup goes to Setup's plan step", tab.url());
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "A1: console clean", errors.join(" / "));
    });

    await part("A2 Claude Code signed out", async () => {
      const s = scenario({ plans: plansOf({ claude: { status: "not_signed_in", method: null } }) });
      const { tab } = await open(OPENCLAW, s);
      await settled(tab);
      const claude = planOf(tab, "claude");
      check(await claude.getByRole("button", { name: "Sign in to Claude Code", exact: true }).isVisible(), "A2: the Sign in to Claude Code control");
      check((await claude.locator(".os-plan-models").count()) === 0 && (await applyOf(tab, "claude").count()) === 0, "A2: no model list instead");
      await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "claude-signed-out");
      const reads = s.calls.plans;
      await claude.getByRole("button", { name: "Check again", exact: true }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => s.calls.plans > reads, 5000), "A2: Check again reads the plans again");
      await claude.getByRole("button", { name: "Sign in to Claude Code", exact: true }).click();
      check(searchOf(tab).get("page") === "setup" && searchOf(tab).get("step") === "signin", "A2: it goes to Setup's Sign in step", tab.url());
    });

    await part("A3 Claude Code on an API key, or can't say how", async () => {
      for (const [method, words, name] of [["api_key", CLAUDE_PLAN_WORDS.api_billing, "claude-api-key"], [null, CLAUDE_PLAN_WORDS.unknown_method, "claude-unknown-method"]]) {
        const s = scenario({ plans: plansOf({ claude: { method } }) });
        const { tab } = await open(OPENCLAW, s);
        await settled(tab);
        const claude = planOf(tab, "claude");
        check((await textOf(claude)).includes(words), `A3 ${method}: the sentence`, await textOf(claude));
        check((await applyOf(tab, "claude").count()) === 0 && (await claude.locator(".os-plan-models").count()) === 0, `A3 ${method}: no Apply and no list`);
        await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, name);
      }
    });

    await part("A4 Claude plan list, the Fable note, a model not on the plan, the risk tick", async () => {
      const s = scenario();
      const { tab, errors } = await open(OPENCLAW, s);
      await settled(tab);
      const claude = planOf(tab, "claude");
      const text = await textOf(claude);
      check(/Opus 5\.5/.test(text) && /Sonnet 5\.5/.test(text) && /Fable 5\.1/.test(text), "A4: the account's models, by name", text);
      check((await textOf(claude.locator(".os-plan-model", { hasText: "Fable 5.1" }))).includes(FABLE), "A4: the Fable note next to Fable 5.1");
      check(await claude.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Sonnet 5\.5/ }).isDisabled(), "A4: a model not on the plan cannot be picked");
      check((await textOf(claude.locator(".os-plan-model", { hasText: "Sonnet 5.5" }))).includes(NOT_ON_PLAN_NOTE), "A4: ...and it says why");
      check((await cardOf(tab).locator(".os-plan-card__notice").count()) === 1 && (await tickOf(tab).count()) === 1, "A4: one security notice and one risk tick for the whole card");
      check((await textOf(cardOf(tab).locator(".os-plan-card__notice"))).includes(OPENCLAW_SECURITY_NOTICE), "A4: the notice is OpenClaw's own words");
      check(await applyOf(tab, "claude").isDisabled(), "A4: Apply is off before a model is picked");
      await claude.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Opus 5\.5/ }).check();
      check(await applyOf(tab, "claude").isDisabled(), "A4: risk tick not ticked, so Apply stays off");
      await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "claude-list-unticked");
      await tickOf(tab).check();
      check(!(await applyOf(tab, "claude").isDisabled()), "A4: ticked and picked: Apply is on");
      await tickOf(tab).uncheck();
      check(await applyOf(tab, "claude").isDisabled(), "A4: unticked again: Apply is off again");
      check(!(await textOf(cardOf(tab))).includes(PLAN_NOTE.claude) && (await tab.locator(".os-plan-note").count()) === 0, "A4: not on a plan: no plan note anywhere");
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "A4: console clean", errors.join(" / "));
    });

    await part("A5 the model list can't be read", async () => {
      const s = scenario({ models: { claude: "fail", chatgpt: CHATGPT_LIST } });
      const { tab } = await open(OPENCLAW, s);
      await settled(tab);
      const claude = planOf(tab, "claude");
      check((await textOf(claude.locator(".os-plan-card__error"))).includes(NO_ANSWER_WORDS), "A5: a list read that got no answer says so, in the app's own words", await textOf(claude));
      check((await applyOf(tab, "claude").count()) === 0, "A5: no Apply without a list");
      const reads = s.calls.models.claude;
      s.models.claude = CLAUDE_LIST;
      await claude.getByRole("button", { name: "Check again", exact: true }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => s.calls.models.claude > reads, 5000) && (await shows(claude.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Opus 5\.5/ }), 8000)), "A5: Check again reads the list again");
    });

    await part("A6 fallback list and typed names", async () => {
      const s = scenario({ models: { claude: CLAUDE_FALLBACK, chatgpt: CHATGPT_LIST } });
      s.apply = () => [409, { error: "job_already_running" }];
      const { tab } = await open(OPENCLAW, s);
      await settled(tab);
      const claude = planOf(tab, "claude");
      check((await textOf(claude)).includes(FALLBACK_LIST_NOTE), "A6: the out-of-date sentence");
      check(/Haiku 5\.5/.test(await textOf(claude)), "A6: the dated list");
      check((await textOf(claude.locator(".os-plan-model", { hasText: "Fable 5.1" }))).includes(FABLE), "A6: the Fable note in the fallback too");
      const field = claude.getByRole("textbox", { name: TYPED_MODEL_LABEL, exact: true });
      check(await field.isVisible(), "A6: a Type a model name field");
      await tickOf(tab).check();
      await field.fill("Bad Name!");
      check(await shows(claude.getByText(INVALID_PLAN_MODEL, { exact: true }), 3000), "A6: a typed name in the wrong shape is refused with the sentence");
      check(await applyOf(tab, "claude").isDisabled(), "A6: ...and no Apply");
      await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "claude-fallback-typed-refused");
      await field.fill("anthropic/claude-next-6");
      check((await claude.getByText(INVALID_PLAN_MODEL, { exact: true }).count()) === 0 && !(await applyOf(tab, "claude").isDisabled()), "A6: a well-formed typed name: Apply is on");
      await claude.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Opus 5\.5/ }).check();
      check((await field.inputValue()) === "anthropic/claude-next-6", "A6: picking a listed model never throws the typed name away");
      await field.click();
      await applyOf(tab, "claude").click();
      await waitFor(async () => s.calls.apply.length === 1, 5000);
      const sent = s.calls.apply[0] || {};
      check(sent.plan === "claude" && sent.model === "anthropic/claude-next-6" && sent.acceptOpenClawRisk === true && sent.confirm === true, "A6: Apply sends the typed name, the plan, the tick and confirm", JSON.stringify(sent));
      check(await shows(claude.getByText(BUSY_WORDS, { exact: true }), 5000), "A6: a refusal with no sentence uses Setup's friendly words");
    });

    await part("A7 a picked model the server refuses", async () => {
      const s = scenario();
      s.apply = () => [400, { error: "invalid_model_id", message: INVALID_PLAN_MODEL }];
      const { tab } = await open(OPENCLAW, s);
      await settled(tab);
      const claude = planOf(tab, "claude");
      await claude.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Opus 5\.5/ }).check();
      await tickOf(tab).check();
      const reads = s.calls.models.claude;
      await applyOf(tab, "claude").click();
      check(await shows(claude.getByText(INVALID_PLAN_MODEL, { exact: true }), 5000), "A7: the server's own sentence");
      check(!/OpenRouter model ID/.test(await textOf(claude)), "A7: never the OpenRouter sentence");
      check(await waitFor(async () => s.calls.models.claude > reads, 5000), "A7: the list is read again");
      await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "claude-invalid-model");
    });

    await part("A8 Claude plan: applying, applied, Change model on a plan, Change brain", async () => {
      const s = scenario();
      const running = planJob("claude", "running");
      s.apply = () => [200, running];
      s.jobs.job_plan_claude = jobAfter(running, planJob("claude", "succeeded"), 3000);
      const { tab, errors } = await open(OPENCLAW, s);
      await settled(tab);
      await planOf(tab, "claude").getByRole("radio", { name: /^Opus 5\.5/ }).check();
      await tickOf(tab).check();
      await applyOf(tab, "claude").click();
      check(await shows(cardOf(tab).locator(".os-setup-job"), 5000), "A8 applying: the job's steps show in the card");
      const steps = await textOf(cardOf(tab).locator(".os-setup-job"));
      check(["Connect OpenClaw to Claude Code", "OpenClaw safe defaults", "Check OpenClaw uses your Claude plan", "Set OpenClaw's model"].every((w) => steps.includes(w)), "A8 applying: every step has its words", steps);
      check((await storedPlanJob(tab)) === "job_plan_claude", "A8 applying: the plan job's id is kept for a reload");
      const sent = s.calls.apply[0] || {};
      check(sent.plan === "claude" && sent.model === "claude-opus-5-5" && sent.acceptOpenClawRisk === true && sent.confirm === true, "A8: Apply sends the plan, the model, the tick and confirm", JSON.stringify(sent));
      await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "claude-applying");
      s.model.openclaw = ON_CLAUDE;
      const result = cardOf(tab).locator(".os-brain-result");
      check(await shows(result, 15000), "A8 applied: the result shows in the card");
      const text = await textOf(result);
      check(text.includes("OpenClaw · Claude plan · claude-opus-5-5") && !/· Local ·/.test(text) && !text.includes(OPENROUTER_HINT), "A8 applied: the Claude plan label, never Local, no OpenRouter hint", text);
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await textOf(tab.locator(".os-agent-brain__line"))).includes("Claude plan · claude-opus-5-5"), 10000), "A8 applied: the Brain card's model line says Claude plan");
      check((await shows(tab.locator(".os-plan-note"), 5000)) && (await textOf(tab.locator(".os-plan-note"))) === PLAN_NOTE.claude, "A8 applied: the Claude plan note under the model line");
      await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "claude-applied");
      await result.getByRole("button", { name: "Change a brain", exact: true }).click();
      check(!(await tickOf(tab).isChecked()), "A8: the risk tick is cleared after a job");
      check((await planOf(tab, "claude").getAttribute("aria-current")) === "true", "A8: the plan OpenClaw is on is marked current");
      await tab.locator(".os-agent-brain .os-mp-actions").getByRole("button", { name: "Change model", exact: true }).click();
      await sleep(500);
      check((await tab.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Change model" }).count()) === 0, "A8: on a plan, Change model does not open the OpenRouter picker");
      check((await activeText(tab)) === "Claude plan", "A8: on a plan, Change model takes the keyboard to the Claude plan list", await activeText(tab));
      await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "claude-change-model");
      await tab.locator(".os-agent-brain .os-mp-actions").getByRole("button", { name: "Change brain", exact: true }).click();
      await sleep(600);
      check((await tab.locator(".os-plan-card").count()) === 1, "A8: Change brain shows no second plan card");
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "A8: console clean", errors.join(" / "));
    });

    await part("A9 a Claude apply stopped by the runtime check", async () => {
      const s = scenario();
      const running = planJob("claude", "running");
      s.apply = () => [200, running];
      s.jobs.job_plan_claude = jobAfter(running, planJob("claude", "failed", { failAt: 2, error: RUNTIME_CHECK_FAILED, log: [RUNTIME_CHECK_FAILED] }));
      const { tab } = await open(OPENCLAW, s);
      await settled(tab);
      await planOf(tab, "claude").getByRole("radio", { name: /^Opus 5\.5/ }).check();
      await tickOf(tab).check();
      await applyOf(tab, "claude").click();
      const result = cardOf(tab).locator(".os-brain-result");
      check(await shows(result, 15000), "A9: the result shows");
      const text = await textOf(result);
      check(/That didn't finish\./.test(text) && text.includes(RUNTIME_CHECK_FAILED), "A9: it says OpenClaw would use an API key", text);
      check(text.includes("[Check OpenClaw uses your Claude plan]"), "A9: the log names the step in words", text);
      check(text.includes("Claude plan") && !/· Local ·/.test(text) && !text.includes(OPENROUTER_HINT), "A9: the plan label, never Local, no OpenRouter hint", text);
      check((await tab.locator(".os-plan-note").count()) === 0, "A9: not on the plan: no plan note");
      await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "claude-runtime-check");
    });

    await part("A10 a failed brain read, and Retry, keep the plan card and what it holds (P26)", async () => {
      const s = scenario({ models: { claude: CLAUDE_FALLBACK, chatgpt: CHATGPT_LIST } });
      const running = planJob("claude", "running");
      s.apply = () => [200, running];
      s.jobs.job_plan_claude = jobAfter(running, planJob("claude", "succeeded"));
      const { tab, errors } = await open(OPENCLAW, s);
      await settled(tab);
      const claude = planOf(tab, "claude");
      await claude.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Opus 5\.5/ }).check();
      await tickOf(tab).check();
      // The job's end makes the Brain card read its brain again; that read now gets no answer.
      s.brain = "fail";
      await applyOf(tab, "claude").click();
      const banner = tab.locator(".os-agent-brain .os-banner");
      check(await shows(banner, 20000), "A10: the job ended and the Brain card's own read failed (its banner shows)");
      check(await cardOf(tab).locator(".os-brain-result").isVisible(), "A10: the plan card and the job's result stay, under the banner");
      await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "claude-brain-read-failed");
      await cardOf(tab).locator(".os-brain-result").getByRole("button", { name: "Change a brain", exact: true }).click();
      const field = claude.getByRole("textbox", { name: TYPED_MODEL_LABEL, exact: true });
      check(await shows(field, 10000), "A10: back to the plans, with the fallback list's Type a model name");
      await field.fill("claude-next-6");
      s.brain = BRAIN;
      await banner.getByRole("button", { name: "Retry" }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await tab.locator(".os-agent-brain .os-banner").count()) === 0, 15000), "A10: Retry reads the brain again");
      check((await field.inputValue().catch(() => "")) === "claude-next-6", "A10: the typed model name is still there (the card was never unmounted)", await field.inputValue().catch(() => "(gone)"));
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "A10: console clean", errors.join(" / "));
    });

    await part("RF3 Claude Code changed between the read and Apply", async () => {
      const s = scenario();
      s.apply = () => {
        s.plans = plansOf({ claude: { method: "api_key" } });
        // The plans read this refusal starts is held back 2 s, so the refusal's own line can be seen first: once the
        // read lands the section shows its note instead (the same words), and the line under the list goes with it.
        s.plansDelayMs = 2000;
        return [409, { error: "plan_not_ready", message: CLAUDE_PLAN_WORDS.api_billing }];
      };
      const { tab } = await open(OPENCLAW, s);
      await settled(tab);
      const claude = planOf(tab, "claude");
      await claude.getByRole("radio", { name: /^Opus 5\.5/ }).check();
      await tickOf(tab).check();
      const reads = s.calls.plans;
      await applyOf(tab, "claude").click();
      check(await shows(claude.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: CLAUDE_PLAN_WORDS.api_billing }), 1500), "RF3: the 409 plan_not_ready shows the server's own sentence (its detail) at once");
      check(await waitFor(async () => s.calls.plans > reads, 5000), "RF3: ...and makes the card read the plans again");
      check(
        await waitFor(async () => (await textOf(claude.locator(".os-plan-card__state"))).includes(CLAUDE_PLAN_WORDS.api_billing), 8000),
        "RF3: once that read lands, the section's own note says it (Claude Code is on an API key now)"
      );
      check((await claude.getByRole("alert").count()) === 0, "RF3: ...and the sentence is not said twice");
      check((await applyOf(tab, "claude").count()) === 0, "RF3: no Apply on an API key");
      await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "claude-plan-not-ready");
    });

    await part("RF5 Agent OS quit during a plan Apply", async () => {
      const s = scenario();
      s.jobs.job_plan_quit = planJob("claude", "failed", { id: "job_plan_quit", failAt: 0, error: PLAN_JOB_INTERRUPTED });
      const { tab } = await open(OPENCLAW, s, { init: 'sessionStorage.setItem("agentos.setup.planJob", "job_plan_quit")' });
      const result = cardOf(tab).locator(".os-brain-result");
      check(await shows(result, 20000), "RF5: the remembered plan job comes back");
      const text = await textOf(result);
      check(text.includes(PLAN_JOB_INTERRUPTED) && /That didn't finish\./.test(text), "RF5: it says Agent OS quit before it finished", text);
      check((await cardOf(tab).locator(".os-setup-job").count()) === 0, "RF5: nothing spins");
      await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "claude-interrupted");
      await result.getByRole("button", { name: "Back to AI brain", exact: true }).click();
      check(await shows(applyOf(tab, "claude"), 10000), "RF5: Apply is offered again");
      check((await storedPlanJob(tab)) === null, "RF5: the remembered job is forgotten");
    });

    // ---- B. ChatGPT plan (stubbed states) -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    for (const [label, version, words, name] of [
      ["update needed", { have: "2026.9.6", newEnough: false }, CHATGPT_PLAN_WORDS.too_old, "chatgpt-update-needed"],
      ["version unreadable", { have: null, newEnough: null }, CHATGPT_PLAN_WORDS.version_unknown, "chatgpt-version-unreadable"]
    ]) {
      await part(`B1 ChatGPT plan: ${label}`, async () => {
        const s = scenario({ plans: plansOf({ version }) });
        const { tab } = await open(OPENCLAW, s);
        await settled(tab);
        const chatgpt = planOf(tab, "chatgpt");
        check((await textOf(chatgpt)).includes(words), `B1 ${label}: the sentence`, await textOf(chatgpt));
        check((await signInOf(tab).count()) === 0, `B1 ${label}: no Sign in button (the server would refuse it too)`);
        await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, name);
        await chatgpt.getByRole("button", { name: "Update in Setup", exact: true }).click();
        check(searchOf(tab).get("page") === "setup" && searchOf(tab).get("step") === "plan", `B1 ${label}: Update in Setup goes to Setup's plan step`, tab.url());
      });
    }

    await part("RF1 OpenClaw updated while the card is open", async () => {
      const s = scenario({ plans: plansOf({ version: { have: "2026.9.6", newEnough: false } }) });
      const { tab } = await open(OPENCLAW, s);
      const opened = Date.now();
      await settled(tab);
      const chatgpt = planOf(tab, "chatgpt");
      check((await textOf(chatgpt)).includes(CHATGPT_PLAN_WORDS.too_old), "RF1: first, Update OpenClaw first");
      s.plans = plansOf();
      const reads = s.calls.plans;
      await focusWindow(tab);
      await sleep(800);
      check(s.calls.plans === reads && (await textOf(chatgpt)).includes(CHATGPT_PLAN_WORDS.too_old), "RF1: a focus inside 20 s reads nothing yet");
      await sleep(Math.max(0, opened + 20_500 - Date.now()));
      await focusWindow(tab);
      check(await shows(signInOf(tab), 15000), "RF1: a focus after 20 s sees the update and offers Sign in with ChatGPT");
      await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "chatgpt-updated-while-open");
      const again = await open(OPENCLAW, s);
      await settled(again.tab);
      check(await signInOf(again.tab).isVisible(), "RF1: a remount shows Sign in at once");
    });

    await part("B2 ChatGPT plan: signed out, no token sharing, list", async () => {
      {
        const s = scenario();
        const { tab } = await open(OPENCLAW, s);
        await settled(tab);
        check(await signInOf(tab).isVisible(), "B2 signed out: Sign in with ChatGPT");
        check((await planOf(tab, "chatgpt").locator(".os-plan-models").count()) === 0, "B2 signed out: no model list yet");
        await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "chatgpt-signed-out");
      }
      {
        const s = scenario({ plans: plansOf({ chatgpt: { signedIn: true, sharing: false } }) });
        const { tab } = await open(OPENCLAW, s);
        await settled(tab);
        check((await textOf(planOf(tab, "chatgpt"))).includes(CHATGPT_PLAN_WORDS.no_sharing), "B2 no sharing: the sentence");
        check(await signInOf(tab).isVisible(), "B2 no sharing: Sign in again is offered");
        await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "chatgpt-no-sharing");
      }
      {
        const s = scenario({ plans: plansOf({ chatgpt: { signedIn: true, sharing: true } }) });
        const { tab } = await open(OPENCLAW, s);
        await settled(tab);
        const chatgpt = planOf(tab, "chatgpt");
        check(/GPT-6\.1 Sol/.test(await textOf(chatgpt)) && /GPT-6 Luna/.test(await textOf(chatgpt)), "B2 list: the account's ChatGPT models");
        check((await signInOf(tab).count()) === 0, "B2 list: signed in and ready, so no Sign in button");
        await chatgpt.getByRole("radio", { name: /^GPT-6\.1 Sol/ }).check();
        await tickOf(tab).check();
        check(!(await applyOf(tab, "chatgpt").isDisabled()), "B2 list: picked and ticked, Apply is on");
        await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "chatgpt-list");
      }
    });

    await part("B3 ChatGPT plan: applied and ready", async () => {
      const s = scenario({ plans: plansOf({ chatgpt: { signedIn: true, sharing: true } }) });
      const running = planJob("chatgpt", "running");
      s.apply = () => [200, running];
      s.jobs.job_plan_chatgpt = jobAfter(running, planJob("chatgpt", "succeeded"));
      const { tab } = await open(OPENCLAW, s);
      await settled(tab);
      await planOf(tab, "chatgpt").getByRole("radio", { name: /^GPT-6\.1 Sol/ }).check();
      await tickOf(tab).check();
      await applyOf(tab, "chatgpt").click();
      check(await shows(cardOf(tab).locator(".os-setup-job"), 5000), "B3: the steps show");
      check((await textOf(cardOf(tab).locator(".os-setup-job"))).includes("Check your ChatGPT sign-in"), "B3: the readiness step has its words");
      s.model.openclaw = ON_CHATGPT;
      s.plans = plansOf({ chatgpt: { signedIn: true, sharing: true, readiness: "ready" } });
      const result = cardOf(tab).locator(".os-brain-result");
      check(await shows(result, 15000), "B3: the result shows");
      check((await textOf(result)).includes("OpenClaw · ChatGPT plan · gpt-6.1-sol"), "B3: the ChatGPT plan label", await textOf(result));
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await textOf(tab.locator(".os-agent-brain__line"))).includes("ChatGPT plan · gpt-6.1-sol"), 10000), "B3: the model line says ChatGPT plan");
      check((await textOf(tab.locator(".os-plan-note"))) === PLAN_NOTE.chatgpt, "B3: the ChatGPT plan note under the model line");
      await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "chatgpt-applied");
    });

    await part("B4 ChatGPT plan: expires soon, and not ready", async () => {
      for (const [readiness, words, name] of [["expiring", CHATGPT_PLAN_WORDS.expiring, "chatgpt-expires-soon"], ["not_ready", CHATGPT_PLAN_WORDS.not_ready, "chatgpt-not-ready"]]) {
        const s = scenario({
          plans: plansOf({ chatgpt: { signedIn: true, sharing: true, readiness } }),
          model: { hermes: hermesModel("vendor/hermes-model"), openclaw: ON_CHATGPT }
        });
        const { tab } = await open(OPENCLAW, s);
        await settled(tab);
        const chatgpt = planOf(tab, "chatgpt");
        check((await textOf(chatgpt)).includes(words), `B4 ${readiness}: the sentence`);
        check(await signInOf(tab).isVisible(), `B4 ${readiness}: Sign in again is offered`);
        check(await chatgpt.getByRole("radio", { name: /^GPT-6\.1 Sol/ }).isVisible(), `B4 ${readiness}: the list stays`);
        check((await chatgpt.getAttribute("aria-current")) === "true", `B4 ${readiness}: the ChatGPT plan is marked current`);
        await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, name);
      }
    });

    // ---- C. The real sign-in session (W1's fake openclaw) ----------------------------------------------------
    if (!process.env.FAKE_AGENT_VERSION) {
      fail("C: FAKE_AGENT_VERSION", "run this probe with FAKE_AGENT_VERSION=2026.9.7, so the fake OpenClaw is new enough for the sign-in");
    } else {
      await part("C sign-in terminal: signing in, reload, leave and return, 409, Close, finishing, Ctrl+C", async () => {
        await stopEverything();
        const s = scenario({ signinGet: null, signinPost: null });
        const { tab, errors } = await open(OPENCLAW, s);
        await settled(tab);
        await signInOf(tab).click();
        check(await waitFor(async () => (await termText(tab)).includes("FAKE-1234"), 20000), "C1: the terminal shows the sign-in code", await termText(tab));
        check((await termText(tab)).includes("auth.openai.com/fake-signin"), "C1: ...and OpenAI's sign-in link");
        check((await signInOf(tab).count()) === 0, "C1: no second Sign in button while the panel is open");
        const live = await liveSetupSessions();
        check(live.length === 1 && live[0].agentId === "openclaw", "C1: one live setup session", JSON.stringify(live.map((x) => [x.kind, x.agentId])));
        const id = live[0]?.id;
        const plain = await api("GET", "/api/sessions");
        check((plain.json.sessions || []).every((x) => x.kind !== "setup"), "C1: not in the plain sessions list (no tab, no Orbit, no count)");
        // Done when 4, as the page shows it: the menu's next sessions read (every 5 s) gives no count for the sign-in,
        // read the way the sessions-foundation probe reads "Sessions 2", and a fresh Sessions page has no tab for it.
        const nextList = await tab
          .waitForResponse((r) => {
            const u = new URL(r.url());
            return u.pathname === "/api/sessions" && !u.search && r.request().method() === "GET" && r.status() === 200;
          }, { timeout: 8000 })
          .then(() => true, () => false);
        await sleep(300);
        const menu = await tab.evaluate(() => {
          const item = [...document.querySelectorAll(".os-nav__item")].find((b) => b.querySelector(".os-nav__label")?.textContent?.trim() === "Sessions");
          return { found: Boolean(item), meta: item?.querySelector(".os-nav__meta")?.textContent?.trim() ?? null };
        });
        check(nextList && menu.found && menu.meta === null, "C1: the menu's Sessions item shows no count while the sign-in is live", JSON.stringify({ nextList, ...menu }));
        // The page has drawn its list once it shows a tab or its empty state (U3: the "No sessions yet" title and its
        // New session button, .os-sess-empty-new).
        const sessionsPage = await open("sessions", scenario());
        const drawn = await waitFor(
          async () =>
            (await sessionsPage.tab.locator('[role="tab"], .os-sess-empty-new').count()) > 0 ||
            (await sessionsPage.tab.getByText("No sessions yet", { exact: true }).count()) > 0,
          15000
        );
        const tabNames = await sessionsPage.tab.locator('[role="tab"]').allTextContents();
        check(drawn && !tabNames.some((name) => /ChatGPT sign-in/.test(name)), "C1: a fresh Sessions page shows no tab for the sign-in", JSON.stringify(tabNames));
        await sessionsPage.context.close();
        await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "chatgpt-signing-in");

        await tab.reload();
        await settled(tab);
        check(await waitFor(async () => (await termText(tab)).includes("FAKE-1234"), 20000), "C2: a reload while signing in: the panel attaches to the same session");
        check((await liveSetupSessions()).map((x) => x.id).join() === id, "C2: a reload starts no second session");
        await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "chatgpt-signin-reload");

        await tab.goto(`${BASE}/?page=fleet`);
        await tab.waitForTimeout(800);
        await tab.goto(`${BASE}/?page=${OPENCLAW}`);
        await settled(tab);
        check(await waitFor(async () => (await termText(tab)).includes("FAKE-1234"), 20000), "C3: leave the page and return: the panel is back");
        // The terminal keeps Tab while it is connected (Task U2's rule), so Close comes first: from the ChatGPT plan
        // heading, Tab reaches Close, then the terminal (B2 Notes 3).
        await planOf(tab, "chatgpt").locator(".os-plan-card__plan-title").focus();
        await tab.keyboard.press("Tab");
        check((await activeText(tab)) === "Close", "C3: Tab from the ChatGPT plan heading reaches Close before the terminal", await activeText(tab));
        await tab.keyboard.press("Tab");
        check(await tab.evaluate(() => Boolean(document.activeElement?.closest(".os-plan-term .xterm"))), "C3: ...and the next Tab enters the terminal");
        check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "C: console clean while signing in", errors.join(" / "));

        // A second window that did not see the session at first: its Sign in gets 409 setup_running and attaches.
        let first = true;
        const s2 = scenario({
          signinPost: null,
          signinGet: (route, json) => {
            if (first) {
              first = false;
              return json(route, { session: null });
            }
            return route.continue();
          }
        });
        const second = await open(OPENCLAW, s2);
        await settled(second.tab);
        check(await signInOf(second.tab).isVisible(), "C4: this window did not see the session at first");
        await signInOf(second.tab).click();
        check(await waitFor(async () => (await termText(second.tab)).includes("FAKE-1234"), 25000), "C4: a second Sign in gets 409, waits for the running session and attaches");
        check(s2.calls.signinPost === 1 && (await liveSetupSessions()).length === 1, "C4: still one setup session");
        await shot(second.tab, SUB, W, H, "chatgpt-signin-409-attached");

        await second.tab.locator(".os-plan-signin").getByRole("button", { name: "Close", exact: true }).click();
        check(await waitFor(async () => (await second.tab.locator(".os-plan-signin").count()) === 0, 10000), "C5 Close: the panel closes");
        check(await waitFor(async () => (await liveSetupSessions()).length === 0, 10000), "C5 Close: the session stops");
        check((await api("GET", "/api/setup/openclaw/signin-terminal")).json.session === null, "C5 Close: no setup session is left");
        check(await shows(signInOf(second.tab), 5000), "C5 Close: Sign in is offered again");
        check((await activeText(second.tab)) === "ChatGPT plan", "C5 Close: the keyboard stays in the ChatGPT plan section", await activeText(second.tab));
        check(await waitFor(async () => (await tab.locator(".os-plan-signin").count()) === 0, 12000), "C5 Close: the other window's panel closes too");
        const recordings = await api("GET", "/api/recordings");
        check((recordings.json.recordings || []).every((r) => r.sessionId !== id && r.kind !== "setup"), "C5: the sign-in left no recording (Safety 5)");
        await shot(second.tab, SUB, W, H, "chatgpt-signin-closed");

        // Finishing the sign-in: the fake writes a siwc row and exits 0; the card closes the panel and reads again.
        const s3 = scenario({ signinGet: null, signinPost: null });
        const third = await open(OPENCLAW, s3);
        await settled(third.tab);
        await signInOf(third.tab).click();
        check(await waitFor(async () => (await termText(third.tab)).includes("FAKE-1234"), 20000), "C6: a fresh sign-in starts");
        const id3 = (await liveSetupSessions())[0]?.id;
        s3.plans = plansOf({ chatgpt: { signedIn: true, sharing: true } });
        const reads = s3.calls.plans;
        await third.tab.locator(".os-plan-term").click();
        await third.tab.keyboard.press("Enter");
        check(await waitFor(async () => (await third.tab.locator(".os-plan-signin").count()) === 0, 15000), "C6: the sign-in finished, so the panel closes by itself");
        check(s3.calls.plans > reads, "C6: the card reads the sign-in again");
        check(await shows(planOf(third.tab, "chatgpt").getByRole("radio", { name: /^GPT-6\.1 Sol/ }), 15000), "C6: signed in now, so the ChatGPT models show");
        const gone = await api("GET", `/api/sessions/${id3}`);
        check(gone.status === 404, "C6: after it ends, the setup session answers 404 (the card counts that as ended)", String(gone.status));
        let rows = [];
        try { rows = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(HOME, ".fake-agent-state.json"), "utf8")).authRows || []; } catch {}
        check(rows.some((r) => r.method === "siwc"), "C6: the fake sign-in program ran to its end");
        await shot(third.tab, SUB, W, H, "chatgpt-signin-done");

        // Ctrl+C inside the terminal, the keyboard's way out (Tab stays in a connected terminal): the fake sign-in
        // program ends (exit 130, nothing saved), the panel closes by itself, and the keyboard is on the ChatGPT plan
        // heading, from where Tab reaches Sign in again.
        const s4 = scenario({ signinGet: null, signinPost: null });
        const fourth = await open(OPENCLAW, s4);
        await settled(fourth.tab);
        await signInOf(fourth.tab).click();
        check(await waitFor(async () => (await termText(fourth.tab)).includes("FAKE-1234"), 20000), "C7: a fresh sign-in starts");
        check(
          await fourth.tab.evaluate(() => Boolean(document.activeElement?.closest(".os-plan-term .xterm"))),
          "C7: right after Sign in with ChatGPT, the terminal has the keyboard (autoFocus)"
        );
        const rowsBefore = rows.length;
        await fourth.tab.locator(".os-plan-term").click();
        await fourth.tab.keyboard.press("Control+KeyC");
        check(await waitFor(async () => (await fourth.tab.locator(".os-plan-signin").count()) === 0, 15000), "C7: Ctrl+C ends the sign-in, and the panel closes by itself");
        check(await waitFor(async () => (await liveSetupSessions()).length === 0, 10000), "C7: ...and no setup session is left");
        check((await activeText(fourth.tab)) === "ChatGPT plan", "C7: the keyboard is on the ChatGPT plan heading", await activeText(fourth.tab));
        check(await shows(signInOf(fourth.tab), 5000), "C7: Sign in with ChatGPT is offered again");
        let rowsAfter = [];
        try { rowsAfter = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(HOME, ".fake-agent-state.json"), "utf8")).authRows || []; } catch {}
        check(rowsAfter.length === rowsBefore, "C7: a sign-in ended with Ctrl+C saved nothing", `${rowsBefore} -> ${rowsAfter.length}`);
      });
      await stopEverything();
    }

    // ---- D. Hermes: Choose in Hermes (the launch is always stubbed) -------------------------------------------
    await part("D1 the two lines, Terminal opened, Refresh and window focus (Review Focus 4)", async () => {
      const s = scenario({ hermesLaunch: { opened: true, command: HERMES_COMMAND } });
      const { tab, errors } = await open(HERMES, s);
      const pick = tab.locator(".os-hermes-pick");
      check(await shows(pick, 25000), "D1: Choose in Hermes is on Hermes's Brain card");
      for (const [i, line] of HERMES_PICKER_LINES.entries()) check(await pick.getByText(line, { exact: true }).isVisible(), `D1: line ${i + 1} shows before anything opens`);
      check((await pick.getByRole("button", { name: "Refresh" }).count()) === 0, "D1: no Refresh before Choose in Hermes");
      check((await tab.locator(".os-plan-card").count()) === 0, "D1: Hermes has no plan card");
      await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "hermes-lines");
      const before = (await api("GET", "/api/sessions?kind=all")).json.sessions?.length ?? 0;
      await pick.getByRole("button", { name: "Choose in Hermes", exact: true }).click();
      check(await shows(pick.getByText(HERMES_TERMINAL_WORDS.opened, { exact: true }), 5000), "D1: Terminal opened sentence");
      check((await pick.locator(".os-setup-cmd").count()) === 0, "D1: no command to copy when Terminal opened");
      check(s.calls.hermesLaunch === 1, "D1: one launch request");
      check(((await api("GET", "/api/sessions?kind=all")).json.sessions?.length ?? 0) === before, "D1: no session was made for hermes model (Safety 2)");
      await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "hermes-opened");
      const line = () => textOf(tab.locator(".os-agent-brain__line"));
      const reads = s.calls.model.hermes;
      await pick.getByRole("button", { name: "Refresh" }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => s.calls.model.hermes === reads + 1, 5000), "D1: Refresh reads Hermes's model once");
      await focusWindow(tab, 5);
      await sleep(600);
      check(s.calls.model.hermes === reads + 1, "D1: a burst of focus right after Refresh reads nothing more (2 s gap)");
      await sleep(2200);
      await focusWindow(tab, 5);
      check(await waitFor(async () => s.calls.model.hermes === reads + 2, 5000), "D1: a later burst of focus reads once");
      await sleep(600);
      check(s.calls.model.hermes === reads + 2, "D1: ...and only once");
      check((await line()).includes("vendor/hermes-model"), "D1: Hermes saved nothing yet: the old model shows", await line());
      const brain = await textOf(tab.locator(".os-agent-brain"));
      check(!/changed|couldn.t/i.test(brain) && (await pick.locator(".os-plan-card__error").count()) === 0, "D1: no error and no 'changed' words while the picker is still open", brain);
      s.model.hermes = hermesModel("vendor/hermes-new");
      await sleep(2200);
      await focusWindow(tab);
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await line()).includes("vendor/hermes-new"), 8000), "D1: window focus shows the model Hermes saved", await line());
      check(s.calls.hermesLaunch === 1, "D1: focus and Refresh never open Terminal again");
      await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "hermes-focus-new-model");
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "D1: console clean", errors.join(" / "));
    });

    await part("D2 Refresh shows the new model", async () => {
      const s = scenario({ hermesLaunch: { opened: true, command: HERMES_COMMAND } });
      const { tab } = await open(HERMES, s);
      const pick = tab.locator(".os-hermes-pick");
      await shows(pick, 25000);
      await pick.getByRole("button", { name: "Choose in Hermes", exact: true }).click();
      await shows(pick.getByRole("button", { name: "Refresh" }), 5000);
      s.model.hermes = hermesModel("vendor/hermes-refreshed");
      await pick.getByRole("button", { name: "Refresh" }).click();
      check(await waitFor(async () => (await textOf(tab.locator(".os-agent-brain__line"))).includes("vendor/hermes-refreshed"), 8000), "D2: Refresh shows the new model");
      await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "hermes-refresh-new-model");
    });

    for (const [label, launch, words, name] of [
      ["copy (Windows and Linux)", { opened: false, reason: "copy", command: HERMES_COMMAND }, HERMES_TERMINAL_WORDS.copy, "hermes-copy"],
      ["Terminal didn't open", { opened: false, reason: "spawn_failed", command: HERMES_COMMAND }, HERMES_TERMINAL_WORDS.spawn_failed, "hermes-spawn-failed"]
    ]) {
      await part(`D3 ${label}`, async () => {
        const s = scenario({ hermesLaunch: launch });
        const { tab } = await open(HERMES, s);
        const pick = tab.locator(".os-hermes-pick");
        await shows(pick, 25000);
        await pick.getByRole("button", { name: "Choose in Hermes", exact: true }).click();
        check(await shows(pick.getByText(words, { exact: true }), 5000), `D3 ${label}: the sentence`);
        check((await textOf(pick.locator(".os-setup-cmd code"))) === HERMES_COMMAND, `D3 ${label}: the command to run`);
        check(await pick.getByRole("button", { name: "Copy the command", exact: true }).isVisible(), `D3 ${label}: Copy the command`);
        check(await pick.getByRole("button", { name: "Refresh" }).isVisible(), `D3 ${label}: Refresh`);
        await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, name);
      });
    }

    await part("D4 Hermes not installed", async () => {
      const s = scenario({ hermesLaunch: [400, { error: "agent_not_installed", message: HERMES_NOT_INSTALLED }] });
      const { tab } = await open(HERMES, s);
      const pick = tab.locator(".os-hermes-pick");
      await shows(pick, 25000);
      await pick.getByRole("button", { name: "Choose in Hermes", exact: true }).click();
      check(await shows(pick.getByText(HERMES_NOT_INSTALLED, { exact: true }), 5000), "D4: the server's sentence");
      await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "hermes-not-installed");
    });

    // ---- E. Setup --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    await part("E1 Setup: the third card", async () => {
      const s = scenario();
      const { tab, errors } = await open(SETUP_BRAIN, s);
      check(await shows(tab.locator(".os-brain-cards .os-plan-card"), 30000), "E1: the plan card is in Setup's AI brain step");
      const order = await tab.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll(".os-brain-cards > *")].map((el) => el.className));
      check(order.length === 3 && /os-plan-card/.test(order[2]) && /os-brain-card/.test(order[2]), "E1: it is the third card, after OpenRouter and Local, with the brain card look", JSON.stringify(order));
      check((await tab.locator(".os-plan-card .os-brain-checks").count()) === 0, "E1: it has no per-agent ticks (it applies through its own route)");
      await settled(tab);
      check(await planOf(tab, "claude").getByRole("radio", { name: /^Opus 5\.5/ }).isVisible(), "E1: the Claude plan list shows in Setup");
      check((await tab.locator(".os-plan-note").count()) === 0 && !(await textOf(cardOf(tab))).includes(PLAN_NOTE.claude), "E1: no plan notes in Setup's card");
      check(!(await sideways(tab)), "E1: no sideways scroll");
      await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, "setup-third-card");
      check(realErrors(errors).length === 0, "E1: console clean", errors.join(" / "));
    });

    // The real Setup path: a plan job lives under its own key (agentos.setup.planJob), and only the third card asks
    // for it (Setup's own job restore and SetupBrainPanel ask only for the configure key), so the job's clock starts
    // at that one ask and nothing else can see it finished first.
    for (const plan of ["claude", "chatgpt"]) {
      await part(`E2 Setup's third card: BrainResult with the ${plan} plan label`, async () => {
        const id = `job_plan_setup_${plan}`;
        const finished =
          plan === "claude"
            ? planJob("claude", "succeeded", { id })
            : planJob("chatgpt", "failed", { id, failAt: 2, error: CHATGPT_PLAN_WORDS.not_ready, log: [CHATGPT_PLAN_WORDS.not_ready] });
        const s = scenario();
        s.jobs[id] = jobAfter(planJob(plan, "running", { id }), finished);
        const { tab } = await open(SETUP_BRAIN, s, { init: `sessionStorage.setItem("agentos.setup.planJob", "${id}")` });
        const result = tab.locator(".os-brain-cards .os-plan-card .os-brain-result");
        check(await shows(result, 30000), `E2 ${plan}: the result shows in Setup's third card`);
        const text = await textOf(result);
        const label = plan === "claude" ? "OpenClaw · Claude plan · claude-opus-5-5" : "OpenClaw · ChatGPT plan · gpt-6.1-sol";
        check(text.includes(label), `E2 ${plan}: ${label}`, text);
        check(!/· Local ·/.test(text), `E2 ${plan}: never Local`);
        check(!text.includes(OPENROUTER_HINT), `E2 ${plan}: never the OpenRouter hint`);
        if (plan === "chatgpt") check(text.includes(CHATGPT_PLAN_WORDS.not_ready) && text.includes("[Check your ChatGPT sign-in]"), "E2 chatgpt: the failed step's sentence and its words in the log", text);
        await result.first().scrollIntoViewIfNeeded().catch(() => undefined);
        await shot(tab, SUB, W, H, `setup-result-${plan}-plan`);
      });
    }

    // ---- F. Laptop sizes: no sideways scroll, long names wrap, Apply on screen ------------------------------
    for (const [w, h] of [[1280, 720], [1024, 640]]) {
      await part(`F layout ${w}x${h}`, async () => {
        const s = scenario({ plans: plansOf({ chatgpt: { signedIn: true, sharing: true } }), models: { claude: LONG_LIST, chatgpt: CHATGPT_LIST } });
        const { tab } = await open(OPENCLAW, s, { size: [w, h] });
        await settled(tab);
        check(!(await sideways(tab)), `F ${w}x${h}: no sideways scroll on OpenClaw's page`);
        const longRow = planOf(tab, "claude").locator(".os-plan-model").first();
        check(await longRow.evaluate((el) => el.scrollWidth <= el.clientWidth + 1), `F ${w}x${h}: a long model name wraps inside its row`);
        for (const plan of ["claude", "chatgpt"]) {
          const button = applyOf(tab, plan);
          await button.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
          const box = await button.boundingBox();
          check(Boolean(box) && box.y >= 0 && box.y + box.height <= h && box.x + box.width <= w, `F ${w}x${h}: Apply · ${plan} fits on screen`, JSON.stringify(box));
        }
        await cardOf(tab).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
        await shot(tab, SUB, w, h, "agents-plan-card");
        const setup = await open(SETUP_BRAIN, scenario(), { size: [w, h] });
        await shows(setup.tab.locator(".os-brain-cards .os-plan-card"), 30000);
        await settled(setup.tab);
        check(!(await sideways(setup.tab)), `F ${w}x${h}: no sideways scroll in Setup's AI brain step`);
        await setup.tab.locator(".os-plan-card").scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();
        await shot(setup.tab, SUB, w, h, "setup-plan-card");
      });
    }
  } finally {
    await stopEverything();
  }
}
```

No route lists jobs, so looking for the job after a no-answer Apply is not possible; if 55 s still passes with no answer, the card says "It may or may not have been applied, so check what the agent uses now before trying again.", and a second Apply while that job runs gets 409 `job_already_running` with Setup's friendly words.

4. **Risks.**
   - `SetupBrainPanel.tsx` imports `BrainPlanCard.tsx`, which imports `BrainResult` back from `SetupBrainPanel.tsx`. `SetupBrainPanel` uses `BrainPlanCard` only while rendering, and `BrainPlanCard` uses the hoisted function `BrainResult` only while rendering, so the import cycle is safe in either load order (`BrainPlanCard` is a `const` made by `forwardRef`, not a hoisted function, which is fine because nothing uses it while the modules load); Step 17 says to stop if `tsc` or the build disagrees. Moving `BrainResult` to its own file would remove the cycle but changes the contract's "named export of SetupBrainPanel.tsx".
   - `BrainResult`'s heading is an `h3` and the contract keeps its props unchanged. Inside the Agents page's plan card (title `h4`, sections `h5`) a job's result therefore puts an `h3` under an `h4`, out of heading order; in Setup the card's title is an `h3` too, so there it is only a same-level heading. Known limit; a heading-level prop for `BrainResult` would need a contract change.
   - The card never holds the id of a sign-in that has not started yet: ids come only from the 201 of `POST /api/setup/openclaw/signin-terminal` or from its `GET`, and both name a spawned session (B1a: `liveSetupSession()` is null before the spawn). So a 404 on Close means the session ended. The gap B1a Notes 11 names stays only in one corner: a sign-in started from another window whose spawn is still running when Close's one re-read arrives answers null, so this card shows it only on its next mount or its next Sign in (which gets 409 and attaches).
   - On the real audit server (older probes, no stubs) the plan routes ask W1's TUI fake. It answers `--version`, `config get` (an empty line) and `auth status` (`{"loggedIn":true}`, with no `authMethod`) itself. `models list`, `models auth list` and `models status` are argvs it does not know, so it starts its TUI; `runCommand` ends the child's input at once (`child.stdin?.end()` in `server/runtime/safety.js`) and the fake exits when its input ends (`startTui` in `test/fakes/tui-agent.mjs`), so those reads come back within about a second with output Agent OS can't read, never at their time limits (Task E1 Step 10 says the same). So ChatGPT shows as signed out and any model list falls back to the dated one; the Claude plan shows the "couldn't tell" sentence (no `authMethod`); and without `FAKE_AGENT_VERSION` the fake's version line, `openclaw 9.9.9-fake`, compares as older than 2026.9.7, so the ChatGPT plan shows "Update OpenClaw first" instead. Older probes' OpenClaw pictures therefore show those states, at most after a brief "Checking…". No older check reads OpenClaw's Brain card text (checked in `agents.mjs`, `setup.mjs` and `leftovers.mjs`, whose Brain card checks are on Hermes's page, where Choose in Hermes adds no "Checking…" and no "Couldn't read"), so this changes pictures, not results.
   - The probe's C1 check of a fresh Sessions page waits for a tab, U3's empty-state button `.os-sess-empty-new` or its title "No sessions yet" (U3's working copy at the time of writing). If U3's commit names its empty state differently, that one wait is the probe's to update (the orchestrator decides), not a reason to change the Sessions page.
   - The ChatGPT sharing field and the auth-list method names are provisional until S-B3 (Task E3); the card trusts the server's `sharing`, so a wrong field name shows "isn't allowed yet" or hides it, and the server's readiness check is the backstop.
   - `cancelSetupJob` on a plan job relies on Task B1b's job runner treating Cancel as today's configure jobs do; the probe does not press Cancel.
   - The sign-in terminal is 280 px high (240 px on phones); a real OpenAI link wraps over two or three lines there, which E3's live check S-B1 will show.
   - Ctrl+C as the keyboard's way out of the sign-in terminal is proven against W1's fake (it exits 130 on Ctrl+C, Task B1a). That the real `openclaw models auth login --provider openai --method siwc` also stops on Ctrl+C is expected (in a terminal's normal mode Ctrl+C sends the program SIGINT, which ends a Node program that does not handle it; a prompt that reads raw keys gets Ctrl+C as a key and, as usual for prompts, cancels) but not yet seen; E3's S-B1 can show it with one extra, cancelled sign-in. If it ever ignored Ctrl+C, the panel would still close with the mouse on Close, and Close stays the first stop in the keyboard order before the terminal.

The rule for this task (the orchestrator does it, never a worker): it never starts a real agent and never runs an agent's CLI (`claude`, `codex`, `agent`, `cursor-agent`, `hermes`, `openclaw`); every server it starts has a throwaway HOME, the fake login shell (decision Q1c) and a PATH of the fake bin plus `/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin`; it never reads `.env` files, `~/.tauri/agent-os.key` or anything under `~/.claude`, `~/.codex`, `~/.cursor`, `~/.openclaw` or `~/.hermes`, and never touches `/Applications`. Steps 1 to 8 and 13 run only tests, builds and the audit harness, as every task's controller check does. The live steps 9 to 12 use fakes only and a throwaway HOME, so under the owner's AUTONOMY ruling (ledger, 2026-10-16: live tests run without asking, recording and restoring settings) they run without a question: Step 0 records his state first (his own `claude` processes, whether Terminal.app runs, the browser pane's tabs, the two ports) and Step 12 compares it and puts back what E1 changed. The same ruling covers the push and the pull request (Step 16): only after green tests, a clean final review and the secrets, credentials-file and NDA scan, never a force-push, with the diff summary and the scan's result written into the Step 17 report. His global CLAUDE.md asks before a public or `main` push unless he says otherwise; the AUTONOMY line records that he did, for this project. The Docker check keeps one question, asked inside Step 14's message (Step 16 says why). If the orchestrator is unsure the AUTONOMY ruling still stands, it confirms it with the owner once, before Step 9, not per step.

Where the plan-brains diff starts and ends. The commit B1a was built on is its start; B2's last commit is its end, so the Minor sweep, which lands after B2, stays out of it:

```bash
S=/private/tmp/sp3-verify; mkdir -p $S
L=.superpowers/sdd/2026-10-15-sp3-sessions-engine/progress.md
LINE=$(grep -E "^Task B1a: complete" $L)
BASE=$(printf '%s\n' "$LINE" | grep -o -E "BASE [0-9a-f]{7,40}" | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f2)
[ -n "$BASE" ] || BASE=$(printf '%s\n' "$LINE" | grep -o -E "commits [0-9a-f]{7,40}\.\." | head -1 | sed -E 's/commits ([0-9a-f]+)\.\./\1/')
git rev-parse --verify "$BASE^{commit}" > $S/brains-base && cat $S/brains-base
LINE=$(grep -E "^Task B2: complete" $L)
END=$(printf '%s\n' "$LINE" | grep -o -E "commits [0-9a-f]{7,40}\.\.[0-9a-f]{7,40}" | head -1 | sed -E 's/.*\.\.//')
[ -n "$END" ] || END=$(printf '%s\n' "$LINE" | grep -o -E "\(commit [0-9a-f]{7,40}" | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f2)
git rev-parse --verify "$END^{commit}" > $S/brains-end && cat $S/brains-end
BRAINS_BASE=$(cat $S/brains-base); BRAINS_END=$(cat $S/brains-end)
git merge-base --is-ancestor $BRAINS_BASE $BRAINS_END && git merge-base --is-ancestor $BRAINS_END HEAD && echo ANCESTORS
git log --format='%h %s' $BRAINS_BASE..$BRAINS_END
git log --format='%h %s' $BRAINS_END..HEAD
```

Expected: two full commit ids (B1a's base, the U4 commit or a controller fix right after it; then B2's last commit); `ANCESTORS`; the first list holds the B1a, B1b, B1c and B2 commits, plus only controller fix commits the ledger names for them; the second list holds the Minor sweep's commit or commits, plus only controller fix commits the ledger names for it, and nothing else.

Show that the five new files ran inside that suite run (TAP names no file, so each file's test names are looked up in the log):

```bash
S=/private/tmp/sp3-verify
cat > $S/find-tests.mjs <<'EOF'
// The test names of the given files, and whether each one ran in a suite's TAP log.
// node find-tests.mjs --list <file>...        prints "<file> | <name>" for every test and describe
// node find-tests.mjs <suite log> <file>...   counts the names found as "# Subtest: <name>" in the log
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";

const NAME = /^\s*(?:test|it|describe)(?:\.(?:skip|only|todo))?\(\s*(["'`])((?:\\.|(?!\1).)*)\1/gm;
const namesOf = (file) =>
  [...readFileSync(file, "utf8").matchAll(NAME)]
    .map((match) => match[2].replace(/\\(.)/g, "$1"))
    .filter((name) => !name.includes("${"));

const [first, ...files] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (first === "--list") {
  for (const file of files) for (const name of namesOf(file)) console.log(`${file} | ${name}`);
} else {
  const seen = new Set(
    readFileSync(first, "utf8")
      .split("\n")
      .map((line) => line.trim())
      .filter((line) => line.startsWith("# Subtest: "))
      .map((line) => line.slice("# Subtest: ".length).replace(/\\#/g, "#").replace(/\\\\/g, "\\"))
  );
  let missing = 0;
  for (const file of files) {
    const names = namesOf(file);
    const lost = names.filter((name) => !seen.has(name));
    missing += lost.length;
    console.log(`${file}: ${names.length} names, ${names.length - lost.length} in the suite log`);
    for (const name of lost) console.log(`  missing: ${name}`);
  }
  process.exitCode = missing || !files.length ? 1 : 0;
}
EOF
node $S/find-tests.mjs $S/suite.log test/setup-session-kind.test.js test/plan-brains-safety.test.js test/openclaw-plans.test.js test/hermes-model-terminal.test.js test/plan-brains-ui-logic.test.js; echo "exit $?"
```

```bash
// every short label at the exact place the contract puts it. Only the files the plan-brains tasks write or
// change are read, so a sentence an older file already holds (for example "your Claude plan" in
// src/ui/builderShared.ts) proves nothing here. Comments never count.
// Usage, from the worktree root: node /private/tmp/sp3-verify/copy-check.mjs
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";

const FILES = {
  src: [
    "src/ui/planBrainsShared.ts",
    "src/ui/components/BrainPlanCard.tsx",
    "src/ui/components/PlanSignInTerminal.tsx",
    "src/ui/components/ChooseInHermes.tsx",
    "src/ui/brainShared.ts",
    "src/ui/components/AgentBrainCard.tsx",
    "src/ui/components/SetupBrainPanel.tsx",
    "src/ui/sessionsShared.ts",
    "src/ui/stopAllShared.ts"
  ],
  server: [
    "server/runtime/setup/openclaw-version.js",
    "server/runtime/setup/openclaw-plan-rules.js",
    "server/runtime/setup/openclaw-plans.js",
    "server/runtime/setup/hermes-model-terminal.js",
    "server/runtime/setup/jobs.js",
    "server/runtime/setup/routes.js",
    "server/runtime/sessions/manager.js"
  ]
};

// Comments: whole lines that start with //, /*, * or {/* are dropped; a /* ... */ inside one line is dropped;
// a // after a space, ; , { } ( or ) ends the line (so "https://" inside a string stays).
function stripComments(code) {
  return code
    .split("\n")
    .filter((line) => !/^\s*(\/\/|\/\*|\*|\{\s*\/\*)/.test(line))
    .map((line) => line.replace(/\/\*.*?\*\//g, "").replace(/(^|[\s;,{}()])\/\/.*$/, "$1"))
    .join("\n");
}

// Read the code the way the page shows it. Handled, and nothing else: JSX string pieces such as {" "} and
// {"'"} become their text; string pieces joined with + become one; \uXXXX and \u{...} escapes; \' \" \` and
// \\; the entities &apos; &#39; &quot; &#34; &middot; &#183; &rsquo; &#8217; &nbsp; &#160; and &amp;; every
// run of spaces and line breaks becomes one space. Anything else is read by hand (a MISSING line).
function asShown(code) {
  return stripComments(code)
    .replace(/(?<!\$)\{\s*(["'])((?:\\.|(?!\1).)*)\1\s*\}/g, (_, _quote, inner) => inner)
    .replace(/(["'`])\s*\+\s*(["'`])/g, "")
    .replace(/\\u\{([0-9a-fA-F]+)\}/g, (_, hex) => String.fromCodePoint(parseInt(hex, 16)))
    .replace(/\\u([0-9a-fA-F]{4})/g, (_, hex) => String.fromCharCode(parseInt(hex, 16)))
    .replace(/\\(['"`\\])/g, "$1")
    .replace(/&(apos|#39);/g, "'")
    .replace(/&(quot|#34);/g, '"')
    .replace(/&(middot|#183);/g, "·")
    .replace(/&(rsquo|#8217);/g, "’")
    .replace(/&(nbsp|#160);/g, " ")
    .replace(/&amp;/g, "&")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ");
}

let problems = 0;
const read = (file) => {
  if (!existsSync(file)) {
    problems += 1;
    console.log(`NO FILE: ${file}`);
    return "";
  }
  return asShown(readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
};
const shown = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(FILES).map(([side, files]) => [side, files.map(read).join("\n")]));

// Long sentences, found anywhere in that side's plan-brains files.
const SENTENCES = [
  ["src", "Your plan"],
  ["both", "Claude Code uses an API key or a cloud account, not your Claude plan, so OpenClaw would bill that instead."],
  ["both", "Install Claude Code first."],
  ["src", "Sign in to Claude Code"],
  ["both", "Agent OS couldn't tell how Claude Code is signed in. Update Claude Code, then check again."],
  ["src", "This bot can read files and run actions if tools are enabled. A bad prompt can trick it into doing unsafe things."],
  // The risk tick is not here: the card renders Setup's OPENCLAW_RISK_LABEL, so it is checked under LABELS.
  ["server", "OpenClaw would use an Anthropic API key for this model, not your Claude plan."],
  ["src", "Agent OS couldn't read your account's model list, so this list may be out of date."],
  ["src", "Not available on your plan in this OpenClaw yet"],
  ["server", "Uses usage credits: on Pro from the first request, on Max after half your weekly limit."],
  ["src", "Shares your Claude plan limits with Claude Code. Anthropic allows this for personal use today, but has changed these rules several times this year."],
  ["both", "Update OpenClaw first: its ChatGPT sign-in needs version 2026.9.7 or newer."],
  ["both", "Agent OS couldn't read OpenClaw's version."],
  ["src", "Sign in with ChatGPT"],
  ["src", "Signed in, but plan use isn't allowed yet. Sign in again and allow token sharing."],
  ["both", "Your ChatGPT sign-in expires soon. Sign in again."],
  ["both", "OpenClaw can't use your ChatGPT plan yet. Sign in again, and allow token sharing when ChatGPT asks."],
  ["src", "Shares your ChatGPT plan limits with Codex."],
  ["src", "Choose in Hermes"],
  ["src", "Copy the command"],
  ["src", "If you pick Anthropic without a Claude API key, Hermes uses your Claude Code sign-in (or its own Claude sign-in). Anthropic doesn't allow apps like Hermes to use Claude sign-ins this way: it's charged as usage credits, not your plan, it doesn't work on Pro, and it can sign Claude Code out. A Claude API key is fine."],
  ["src", "Hermes's 'ChatGPT or Codex Subscription' reuses Codex's own sign-in, which OpenAI hasn't documented for other apps. Hermes's official Sign in with ChatGPT isn't released yet."],
  ["src", "Terminal opened with Hermes's model picker. Choose there, then press Refresh."],
  ["src", "Run this command in your own terminal, choose a model, then press Refresh."],
  ["src", "Terminal didn't open. Run this command in your own terminal, choose a model, then press Refresh."],
  ["both", "That doesn't look like a model name."],
  ["server", "Your plan's usage limit is used up. Try again after it resets."],
  ["server", "OpenClaw isn't signed in to your plan anymore. Sign in again."],
  ["server", "Couldn't reach Anthropic."],
  ["server", "Couldn't reach OpenAI."],
  ["server", "The agent didn't answer within a minute. Try again."],
  // New sentences of the contract (the owner reviews them in this task).
  ["server", "A ChatGPT sign-in is already open in Agent OS."],
  ["server", "Install OpenClaw first."],
  ["server", "Sign in to Claude Code first, then try again."],
  ["server", "Sign in with ChatGPT first, then try again."],
  ["server", "OpenClaw had no model set before, so it keeps "],
  ["server", "Agent OS quit before this finished. Apply the plan again."],
  ["server", "Hermes isn't installed on this computer yet."],
  ["src", "Check again"],
  ["src", "Install in Setup"],
  ["src", "Update in Setup"]
];

// Short labels, checked at the one place the contract puts each of them.
const escape = (text) => text.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
const pair = (key, value) => new RegExp(`["']?${escape(key)}["']?\\s*:\\s*["'\`]${escape(value)}["'\`]`);
const quoted = (value) => new RegExp(`["'\`]${escape(value)}["'\`]`);
const named = (name, value) => new RegExp(`\\b${escape(name)}\\s*=\\s*["'\`]${escape(value)}["'\`]`);
const RISK_TICK = "I understand OpenClaw can act on this computer. Agent OS will switch it to ask before running commands.";
const LABELS = [
  ["src/ui/brainShared.ts", "BRAIN_MODE_LABEL", pair("claude-plan", "Claude plan")],
  ["src/ui/brainShared.ts", "BRAIN_MODE_LABEL", pair("chatgpt-plan", "ChatGPT plan")],
  ["src/ui/brainShared.ts", "CONFIGURE_STEP_LABEL", pair("openclaw-plan-onboard", "Connect OpenClaw to Claude Code")],
  ["src/ui/brainShared.ts", "CONFIGURE_STEP_LABEL", pair("openclaw-plan-runtime-check", "Check OpenClaw uses your Claude plan")],
  ["src/ui/brainShared.ts", "CONFIGURE_STEP_LABEL", pair("openclaw-plan-model", "Set OpenClaw's model")],
  ["src/ui/brainShared.ts", "CONFIGURE_STEP_LABEL", pair("openclaw-plan-readiness", "Check your ChatGPT sign-in")],
  ["src/ui/planBrainsShared.ts", "PLAN_LABEL", pair("claude", "Claude plan")],
  ["src/ui/planBrainsShared.ts", "PLAN_LABEL", pair("chatgpt", "ChatGPT plan")],
  ["src/ui/planBrainsShared.ts", "TYPED_MODEL_LABEL", /TYPED_MODEL_LABEL\s*=\s*["'`]Type a model name["'`]/],
  ["src/ui/components/AgentBrainCard.tsx", "PROVIDER_NAME", pair("claude-plan", "Claude plan")],
  ["src/ui/components/AgentBrainCard.tsx", "PROVIDER_NAME", pair("chatgpt-plan", "ChatGPT plan")],
  ["server/runtime/setup/openclaw-plan-rules.js", "openclawProviderLabel", quoted("Claude plan")],
  ["server/runtime/setup/openclaw-plan-rules.js", "openclawProviderLabel", quoted("Anthropic API key")],
  ["server/runtime/setup/openclaw-plan-rules.js", "openclawProviderLabel", quoted("ChatGPT plan")],
  ["server/runtime/setup/openclaw-plan-rules.js", "openclawProviderLabel", quoted("OpenAI")],
  ["src/ui/sessionsShared.ts", "sessionTitle", / · ChatGPT sign-in`/],
  ["src/ui/stopAllShared.ts", "sessionStopTitle", / · ChatGPT sign-in`/],
  // The risk tick (spec section 2: Setup's words). The words sit only at Setup's constant, in a file no plan-brains
  // task changes; the card imports that constant and renders it as an element's text.
  ["src/ui/agentModelChange.ts", "OPENCLAW_RISK_LABEL", named("OPENCLAW_RISK_LABEL", RISK_TICK)],
  ["src/ui/components/BrainPlanCard.tsx", "OPENCLAW_RISK_LABEL import", /import\s*\{[^}]*\bOPENCLAW_RISK_LABEL\b[^}]*\}\s*from\s*["']\.\.\/agentModelChange["']/],
  ["src/ui/components/BrainPlanCard.tsx", "OPENCLAW_RISK_LABEL render", />\s*\{\s*OPENCLAW_RISK_LABEL\s*\}\s*</]
];

let missing = 0;
for (const [where, sentence] of SENTENCES) {
  const lost = (where === "both" ? ["src", "server"] : [where]).filter((side) => !shown[side].includes(sentence));
  if (lost.length) {
    missing += 1;
    console.log(`MISSING in ${lost.join(" and ")}: ${sentence}`);
  }
}
let misplaced = 0;
for (const [file, name, pattern] of LABELS) {
  if (!existsSync(file) || !pattern.test(asShown(readFileSync(file, "utf8")))) {
    misplaced += 1;
    console.log(`NOT AT ITS PLACE (${name} in ${file}): ${pattern.source}`);
  }
}
console.log(`${SENTENCES.length - missing} of ${SENTENCES.length} sentences found where they are shown`);
console.log(`${LABELS.length - misplaced} of ${LABELS.length} labels found at their place`);
process.exitCode = missing || misplaced || problems ? 1 : 0;
EOF
node $S/copy-check.mjs; echo "exit $?"
```

Expected: no `NO FILE` line, `41 of 41 sentences found where they are shown`, `20 of 20 labels found at their place` and `exit 0`. (Run on a copy of `a6c9f4a`, before any B task, the same script finds 0 of 41 sentences and 1 of 20 labels: the one label already true there is the risk tick's words at `OPENCLAW_RISK_LABEL`, which `agentModelChange.ts` held before SP3, while the card's import and render of it are B2's; so a pass here is still B1a, B1b, B1c and B2's own work.) A `MISSING` or `NOT AT ITS PLACE` line is read by hand before anything goes back: a sentence split by a JSX expression (a variable in the middle, or an inline element) or written in a form the script's comment does not list is fine if the page shows it whole (the probe's screenshot or text check proves that); a reworded sentence goes back to its task. Then compare each B task's Notes list of new copy with the contract's "New sentences" list: a sentence in neither the spec nor the contract goes back to its task (contract, Copy). Not in the script, on purpose: "Link copied. Open it in your browser." is U2's sentence (`SessionTerminal`'s words), which `PlanSignInTerminal` shows through `onNotice` (Step 14 shows it); "Apply", "Refresh", "Close" and the Apply buttons' names `Apply · Claude plan` and `Apply · ChatGPT plan` are too short to find in code text and are the probe's checks by role and name. The three items the owner kept are checked word for word: the two Hermes lines and the Fable note among the sentences, and the risk tick as the three `OPENCLAW_RISK_LABEL` labels (its words at Setup's constant, and the card's import and render of it; the probe checks the same words on screen). A `NOT AT ITS PLACE` line for the card's import or render, with the tick's words right on screen, means B2 wrote the sentence out instead of using Setup's constant: it goes back to B2, because a second copy can drift from Setup's.

```bash
const forbidden = /setup-token|paste-token|--token|oauth|device-code|--dangerously|--yolo|--probe|--accept-risk/;
```
